title: 1. atha mānaparibhāṣādhyāyaḥ
text: śriyaṃ sa dadyādbhavatāṃ purāri- ryadaṅgatejaḥprasare bhavānī | virājate nirmalacandrikāyāṃ mahauṣadhīva jvalitā himādrau || 1 || Dī. karaśirasācyutamīśaṃ bhavabhavapuṣṭikṣayālayamupāyam | svargāpavargayorapi tāpatrayanāśanārthamabhivande || 1 || sagaṇagaṇeśaṃ matidaṃ vighnasamūhāṃśca hanti yaḥ smaraṇe | tadanu gurorapi caraṇaṃ gadahānyai dīnamanujānām || 2 || ye durjanāḥ paraguṇānanusūcayanti te'pi svabhāvavaśagāḥ kimu vāraṇīyāḥ | ye śāstrabodhaguṇadoṣavicāradakṣāste sajjanāḥ praṇutibhiḥ khalu vandanīyāḥ || 3 || śrīvāstavyakulaprakāśamaṇayo ye pūrvajā viśrutāḥ śrīhammīrapure mahājanatate yeṣāṃ sthitiḥ kathyate | ye kāmaṃ madavihvalāmiva ravaiḥ kṣīrābdhipāraṃgatāmatyāścaryasucandrakāntivitatāṃ prakhyātakīrtiṃ gatāḥ || 4 || tadanvaye kiṃ bahunā prasiddhaḥ śrīcakrapāṇiḥ kulakairavenduḥ | nānāguṇālīyamabhūcca yasya samastavaidyodghaṭanādirūpā || 5 || tasya buddhisubhagasya tanūjo bhāvasiṃha iti bhūpatimānyaḥ | suśrutādikarahasyavidhijño yo yaśāṃsi vipulāni (ca ) lebhe || 6 || tasyātmajo dīrghamatiḥ prahṛṣṭo nāmnā''ḍhamallo'lpanibandhadarśī | tena svagurvarcanatatpareṇa vidhāsyate śārṅgadharaprakāśaḥ || 7 || kecicchāstraviśāradāḥ katipaye divyauṣadhīkovidā nānāvyādhiparīkṣaṇeṣu caturāḥ karmotsukāścāpare | kāmaṃ tānadhikartumutsukamanā nāhaṃ samartho yata- steṣāṃ sannidhimetya cātra racitaṃ yatkiñcideva śrutam || 8 || hastīkāntapurī purā purajitā kāśīva vidvajjanai- rvyāptā yatra saraḥsaridguṇavarā carmaṇvatī pāpahā | yasyāṃ hṛdgatavāsudevacaraṇadvandvāmbujaḥ kṣmāpatiḥ khyāto dharma ivāsti dharmagatiṣu śrījaitrasiṃhaḥ prabhuḥ || 9 || tasyāṃ śārṅgadharoktānāṃ yogānāṃ ca prakāśinī | kriyate sā''ḍhamallena saṃhitāyāḥ pradīpikā ||10|| abhinavanibandharacanāṃ śrotuṃ kaḥ ko'tra lolupo bhavati | yaḥ kṛpayā parakāvyaṃ paśyati sarvaṃ sa vai dhīraḥ || 11 || atheha pṛthutaraduradhigamāyurvedatattvāṅkitasadgranthaparisamāptyarthaṃ śrotṝṇāmapi pratyūhavyapohārthaṃ manasi viśiṣṭeṣṭadevatāpraṇāmapūrvakamāśīrvṛttamādau nibaddhavān granthakāraḥ | tadyathā- śriyamityādi | yadaṅgatejaḥprasare bhavānī virājate sa purārirbhavatāṃ śriyaṃ dadyādityanvayaḥ | yathā himādrau jvalitā mahauṣadhī rājate | kva satyāṃ | nirmalacandrikāyāṃ nirmalā yā candrikā jyotsnā tasyāmityarthaḥ | nirmalacandrikāyāmityasya sthāne nirmalacandrikāta iti kecit paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | purāriḥ puranāmā daityaviśeṣaḥ sa evāriryasya, yadvā purasyāriḥ purāriḥ śiva ityarthaḥ | śriyamiti kalyāṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ vā | bhavatāmityatra yasmai ditsā rocate dhārayate vā tat sampradānamityanena caturthī na syādityata āha – ‘vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇi bhavanti’ iti nyāyādiha ditsārthe ṣaṣṭhyapi bhavatītyarthaḥ | yadaṅgatejaḥprasare tejaḥsamūhe ardhāṅge iti sambandhaḥ | etena vibhūtyaliptāṅgasyāpi śubhratvādadrisāmyam | ‘bhavānī pārvatī caṇḍī’tyamaraḥ | anenāśīrnirdeśaṃ kathitavānācāryaḥ | yataḥ– ‘‘āśīrnamaskriyāvastunirdeśo vā'pi tanmukham’ iti trividhaṃ prabandhamukhalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati | āśīrgrahaṇamatra duṣkṛtādīnāṃ vipākajanyaduḥkhasvarūparoganivṛttyarthaṃ tannivṛttyā sukhaśriyaḥprāptiriti bhāvaḥ || 1 || atha grantho'yaṃ sakalajanopakārārthaṃ bhavatu iti matvā sadgranthasya sambandhaḥ kathanīyaḥ | tadyathā ‘siddhiḥ śrotṛpravṛttīnāṃ sambandhakathanādyataḥ | tasmāt sarveṣu śāstreṣu sambandhaḥ pūrvamucyate |’ iti | anena tāvat pūrvaṃ tamāha -prasiddhayogā ityādi | ye prasiddhayogāḥ santi teṣāṃ susaṃgrahaḥ sajjanarañjanāya mayā śārṅgadhareṇa vidhīyate viśeṣeṇa kriyata ityabhiprāyaḥ | natu kriyate yataścarakasuśrutādimunibhiritastato vistṛtā mayā saṃhṛtya prakārāntareṇa likhyata iti bhāvaḥ | etena granthasya viśiṣṭatvaṃ darśitam | kīdṛśā yogāḥ? munibhiḥ prayuktā iti | traikālikadarśī puruṣātiśayo hi munirucyate | taiḥ pūrvaṃ kathitā ityarthaḥ | etena granthasya prāmāṇyaṃ kathitam | punaḥ kīdṛśāḥ ? cikitsakairvaidyairbahuśo vāraṃvāramanubhūtā | nāmarūpayojanādibhirdṛṣṭapratyayā ityarthaḥ | etenātra sajjanānāṃ darśanādyutkaṇṭhā syādityabhiprāyaḥ || 2 || Gū. maṅgalācaraṇam - śārṅgadharasaṃhitārthamahaṃ vyākhyātumārabhe | tatra siddhiṃ diśatu māṃ vighnādhīśo gaṇādhipaḥ || paramanipuṇo granthakṛtprāripsitanirvighnaparisamāptaye tadadhyetṝṇāmapi pratyūhavyūhopaśāntaye adhyayananirvāhāya vyutpattaye ca āśīrvādarūpamaṅgalamācarati | tasya ca kartavyatāyāṃ śiṣṭācāraḥ pramāṇam | śriyaṃ sa dadyādityādi | saḥ bhavatāṃ śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ dadyāt puro daityastasyāriḥ śrīmānmahādevaḥ, athavā śrīśabdena saṃpat | yaduktaṃ ‘lakṣmīsarasvatīdhātrivargasaṃpadvibhūtiśobhāsu | upakaraṇaveśaracanāvidhāsu ca śrīriti prathite’ti vyāḍiḥ | sa kaḥ | yadaṅgatejaḥprasare bhavānī virājate, yasya śaṃbhoryadaṅgaṃ tasya tejaḥprasaraḥ pracāraḥ tasminbhavānī pārvatī virājate śobhate | kasmin kasyāṃ keva? himādrau nirmalacandrikāyāṃ jvalitā mahauṣadhīva himādrau himaparvate nirmalacandrikāyāṃ candrajyotsnāyāṃ madhye yathā jvalitā mahauṣadhī rājate tadvadiyamapi karpūragauravattayā himādrivat śambho pratītasya pārśve mahauṣadhīva bhavānī virājate ityarthaḥ ||1|| ādau cikitsānimittamutkṛṣṭayogasaṃhārārthaṃ padyamāha -prasiddheti | munibhiḥ prayuktā ye siddhayogāḥ cikitsakairbahuśaḥ anubhūtāśca yogāḥ cikitsādhikāriṇaḥ teṣāṃ yogānāṃ susaṃgrahaḥ śārṅgadhareṇa vidhīyate kathyate | yujyata iti yogaḥ kvāthacūrṇādigaṇaḥ || 2 || prasiddhayogā munibhiḥ prayuktā- ścikitsakairye bahuśo'nubhūtāḥ | vidhīyate śārṅgadhareṇa teṣāṃ susaṃgrahaḥ sajjanarañjanāya || 2 || Dī. atha grantho'yaṃ sakalajanopakārārthaṃ bhavatu iti matvā sadgranthasya sambandhaḥ kathanīyaḥ | tadyathā ‘siddhiḥ śrotṛpravṛttīnāṃ sambandhakathanādyataḥ | tasmāt sarveṣu śāstreṣu sambandhaḥ pūrvamucyate |’ iti | anena tāvat pūrvaṃ tamāha -prasiddhayogā ityādi | ye prasiddhayogāḥ santi teṣāṃ susaṃgrahaḥ sajjanarañjanāya mayā śārṅgadhareṇa vidhīyate viśeṣeṇa kriyata ityabhiprāyaḥ | natu kriyate yataścarakasuśrutādimunibhiritastato vistṛtā mayā saṃhṛtya prakārāntareṇa likhyata iti bhāvaḥ | etena granthasya viśiṣṭatvaṃ darśitam | kīdṛśā yogāḥ? munibhiḥ prayuktā iti | traikālikadarśī puruṣātiśayo hi munirucyate | taiḥ pūrvaṃ kathitā ityarthaḥ | etena granthasya prāmāṇyaṃ kathitam | punaḥ kīdṛśāḥ ? cikitsakairvaidyairbahuśo vāraṃvāramanubhūtā | nāmarūpayojanādibhirdṛṣṭapratyayā ityarthaḥ | etenātra sajjanānāṃ darśanādyutkaṇṭhā syādityabhiprāyaḥ || 2 || Gū. ādau cikitsānimittamutkṛṣṭayogasaṃhārārthaṃ padyamāha - gū. - prasiddheti | munibhiḥ prayuktā ye siddhayogāḥ cikitsakairbahuśaḥ anubhūtāśca yogāḥ cikitsādhikāriṇaḥ teṣāṃ yogānāṃ susaṃgrahaḥ śārṅgadhareṇa vidhīyate kathyate | yujyata iti yogaḥ kvāthacūrṇādigaṇaḥ || 2 || hetvādirūpākṛtisātmyajāti- bhedaiḥ samīkṣyāturasarvarogān | cikitsitaṃ karṣaṇabṛṃhaṇākhyaṃ kurvīta vaidyo vidhivatsuyogaiḥ || 3 || Dī. idānīṃ ‘rogamādau parīkṣeta tato'nantaramauṣadham’ ityādi matamālocya śārṅgadharo'pyāha - hetviti | vaidya āturasarvarogān samīkṣya paścāt cikitsitaṃ vidhivat kurvīteti | anyathā doṣaḥ syāt | tathāhyuktam – ‘yastu rogamavijñāya karmāṇyārabhate bhiṣak | na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim’ iti | kaiḥ kṛtvā samīkṣyetyāha - heturnidānam, ādirūpaṃ pūrvarūpam, ākṛtiḥ svarūpam, sātmyamupaśayaḥ, jātiḥ samprāptiriti; eṣāṃ bhedaiḥ nānātmakatvena ete vyastāḥ samastāśca vyādhibodhakā jñeyā ityarthaḥ | yadvā heturādiryeṣāṃ te hetvādayaḥ, te ca rūpādayaśca tairityarthaḥ | etena hetvādipañcabhiḥ rūpādibhiśca āturarogān parīkṣyeti bhāvaḥ | tathāhi vāgbhaṭe –‘darśanasparśanapraśnaiḥ parīkṣetātha rogiṇam | rogaṃ nidānaprāgrūpalakṣaṇopaśayāptibhi:’ iti | hetvādipañcakaṃ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātameva | rūpāditrayaṃ yathārūpamiti cākṣuṣaṃ tena śarīrasya sthūlakṛśatāvarṇavikārādayaḥ, etena darśanajñānamalaṅkaroti | ākṛtiriti āsamantādeva kṛtiḥ kṛtikāraṇamiti samucitakauśalyenaiva nāḍyādibhiḥ śītoṣṇādikajñānarūpamityarthaḥ, etena sparśanajñānamalaṅkaroti | sātmyena hitaṃ kathyate bhavatāṃ kiṃ sātmyamityādivākyena praśnajñānamalaṅkaroti | athavā sātmyamabhilaṣitaṃ vadantyanye yato yena yadvāñchitaṃ bhavati tasya tenaiva doṣādīnāṃ kṣīṇavṛddhatvaṃ jñāyate, iti darśanādikaṃ trayaṃ kathitam | jātiśabdena viśiṣṭendriyajñānamabhidhīyate | yataḥ - suśrute ‘ṣaḍvidho hi rogāṇāṃ vijñānopāyaḥ, tadyathā pañcabhiḥ śrotrādibhiḥ praśnena ceti’ | ato darśanādayastraya evādau vyākhyātāḥ, śeṣāḥ śrotrādayo jātibhedena kathitāḥ | taduktaṃ suśrutācāryeṇa ‘tatra śrotrendriyavijñeyā viśeṣā rogeṣu praṇaṣṭaśalyavijñānīyādiṣu vakṣyante saphenaṃ raktamīrayannanilaḥ saśabdo nirgacchatītyevamādayaḥ | sparśanendriyavijñeyāḥ śītoṣṇaślakṣṇakarkaśamṛdukaṭhinatvādayaḥ sparśaviśeṣā jvaraśoṣādiṣu | cakṣurindriyavijñeyāḥ śarīropacayāpacayāyurlakṣaṇabalavarṇavikārādayāḥ | rasanendriyavijñeyāḥ pramehādiṣu rasaviśeṣāḥ | gandhendriyavijñeyā riṣṭaliṅgādiṣu vraṇānāmavraṇānāṃ ca gandhaviśeṣāḥ’ | iti hetvādayo vyākhyātāḥ, tatrādyaḥ pakṣo vyavahārasiddho dvitīyastu kalpito'pi sādhuḥ | samīkṣyeti samyak prakāreṇa vicārya, etadgrahaṇaṃ tajjñānavicchedārtham | yataḥ ‘mithyādṛṣṭā vikārā hi durākhyātāstathaiva ca | tathā duḥparidṛṣṭāśca mohayeyuścikitsakam’ iti | cikitsā rogāpanayanaṃ karma vyādhipratīkāraḥ dhātusāmyārthā kriyā cetyādiparyāyavācakaiḥ śabdaiścikitsā kathitā | tathācoktaṃ – ‘caturṇāṃ bhiṣagādīnāṃ śastānāṃ dhātuvaikṛte | pravṛttirdhātusāmyārthā cikitsetyabhidhīyate’ iti | taccātra dvividhaṃ karma karṣaṇabṛṃhaṇākhyamiti | karṣaṇamiti pravṛttadoṣāṇāṃ, bṛṃhaṇamiti kṣīṇānām; tathāca - ‘kṣīṇā vardhayitavyā’ ityādi | tathā –‘rogastu doṣavaiṣamyaṃ doṣasāmyamarogitā’ iti vacanāt | suyogairiti śobhanadravyakṛtaprayogaiḥ śīghramārogyotpādakairityarthaḥ ||3|| Gū. auṣadhayogānāṃ prayogastu hetvādibhirvyādhiṃ jñātvā kartavyastadvijñānārthaṃ ślokamāha -hetvādītyādi | hetvādirūpākṛtisātmyajātibhedaiḥ āturasya sarvarogān samīkṣya dṛṣṭvā vaidyaḥ karṣaṇa-bṛṃhaṇākhyaṃ cikitsitaṃ kurvītetyanvayaḥ | karṣaṇaṃ kṛśīkaraṇaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ balavardhanaṃ ākhyā nāma yasya tat cikitsitaṃ hetvādisarūpaṃ ca ākṛtiśca sātmyaṃ ca jātibhedaśca te hetvādirūpākṛtisātmyajātibhedāstaiḥ hetvādīni nidānapañcakaheturnidānaṃ, rūpaṃ gaurādirvarṇaviśeṣaḥ | tathā cakṣuṣā yadgrāhyaṃ vastujātaṃ saṃsthānādi tadapi rūpam | ākṛtistu cakṣurādīndriyasvarapraticchāyākriyādiṣu anyeṣvapi bhāveṣu prākṛteṣu nimittataḥ vikṛtiryā samāse'riṣṭaṃ taditi lakṣayet | sātmyaṃ deśādi taiḥ, ādiśabdātprāgrūpārūpopaśayasaṃprāptayo gṛhyante hetvādirūpaṃ hetvādikārtsnyaṃ tena ākṛtyā ca sātmyena ca jātiḥ saṃprāptiḥ tasyā ye bhedāḥ saṃkhyāvikalpaprādhānyabalakālāḥ | vaidyaḥ āturasya sarvarogān samīkṣya proktaṃ cikitsitaṃ kurvīta vyādheḥ kiyanto'pyupāyā bhavanti || 3 || divyauṣadhīnāṃ bahavaḥ prabhedā vṛndārakāṇāmiva visphuranti | jñātveti saṃdehamapāsya dhīraiḥ saṃbhāvanīyā vividhaprabhāvāḥ || 4 || Dī. idānīṃ dravyāṇāṃ vividhaprabhāvāḥ santi teṣāṃ hetubhiḥ parīkṣāṃ nirākartumāha -divyauṣadhīnāmiti | divyauṣadhīnāṃ bahavo bhedā vṛndārakāṇāmiva visphuranti prakaṭībhavanti ityarthaḥ - iti jñātvā vicārya tadā sandehamapāsya dūrīkṛtya vividhaprabhāvā aparimitaśaktayo'vicchinnaśaktayo vā sambhāvanīyāḥ teṣāṃ sambhāvanā kartavyetyarthaḥ | dhīrairiti jñeyam | etenā'cintyo hi maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ prabhāva iti tātparyārthaḥ | divyauṣadhīnāmiti divyagrahaṇamatra dravyāṇāṃ viśiṣṭatvajñānārtham | vṛndārakāṇāmiti yathā devānāṃ bhedā aparimitāstathaiva dravyabhedā ityabhiprāyaḥ | prabhāvāścetyacintanīyāḥ | dhīrairiti gambhīrabuddhibhiḥ | dhīrā hi bāhyādhyātmikānāṃ hitāhitaparicchedakāriṇo bhavanti, ato dhīragrahaṇamatrāniścayārthajñāpakatvavyavacchedārtham || 4 || Gū. divyeti | asyārthaḥ - divyauṣadhīnāṃ bahavaḥ prabhedāḥ visphuranti tān jñātvā saṃdehaṃ vāpāsya dhīraiḥ vividhaprabhāvāḥ saṃbhāvanīyā vicāraṇīyāḥ | vṛndārakā devāsteṣāmiva yathā devānāṃ bahavaḥ prabhedāstathauṣadhīnāmiti | divyā yā oṣadhyaḥ tāsāṃ bahavaḥ prabhedā visphuranti | keṣāmiva ? vṛndārakāṇāmiva tānbhedān vanasthānādibhyaḥ jñātvā saṃdehaṃ apāsya dūrīkṛtya karma kārayedityarthaḥ ||4 || svābhāvikāgantukakāyikāntarā rogā bhaveyuḥ kila karmadoṣajāḥ tacchedanārthaṃ duritāpahāriṇaḥ śreyomayānyogavarānniyojayet || 5 || Dī. atha prayojanamapi sarvasyaiva syāt tathāhi – ‘sarvasyaiva hi śāstrasya karmaṇo vā'pi kasyacit | yāvat prayojanaṃ noktaṃ tāvat kena na gṛhyate’ iti, ata eva tadadhikṛtyāha -svābhāviketi - svābhāvikādayo rogāḥ karmadoṣajā bhaveyuḥ | kiletyāgamaniścayārtham | tacchedanārthaṃ teṣāmupaśamanimittam| yogavarān prayogaśreṣṭhān niyojayet; etena samastārṣatantrābhyantarasthān yogān vicintya ācāryeṇātra te yojyanta iti bhāvaḥ | svābhāvikā iti svabhāvena bhavāḥ svābhāvikāḥ, te kṣutpipāsājarāmṛtyunidrāprabhṛtayaḥ | āgantukā iti abhighātanimittāḥ, te vyālādikṛtāśca | kāyikāntarā iti śārīrā antarjātāśca śārīrāste'nnapānamūlāḥ | vātādidoṣadvārā'sṛkpittakāsādayaḥ, antaḥśabdena mano'bhidhīyate, tadudbhavā mānasā ityarthaḥ | te kāmakrodhādinimittā madamūrcchāsanyāsagrahabhūtonmādādaya iti | suśrute svābhāvikādayo darśitāḥ | karmadoṣajā iti | eke karmajāḥ, eke doṣajāḥ, apare karmadoṣajāśca | tathācoktam-‘karmaprakopeṇa kadācideke doṣaprakopeṇa bhavanti cānye | tathā'pare prāṇiṣu karmadoṣaprakopajāḥ kāyamanovikārāḥ’ iti | karmajādīnāṃ saṃjñā keṣāñcijjñāpanārthaṃ likhyate yathā-‘ye cāmayāḥ syuraparadraviṇāpahārādgurvaṅganāgamanavipravadhādibhirye | duṣkarmabhistanubhṛtāmiha karmajāste nopakrameṇa bhiṣajāmupayānti śāntim ||’ kiñca-‘dānairdayādiratithidvijadevatānāṃ gurvarcanāpraṇatibhiśca japaistapobhiḥ | ityuktapuṣyanicayairupacīyamānāḥ prākkarmajā api rujaḥ praśamaṃ prayānti’ iti | atha doṣajā yathā-‘svahetuduṣṭairanilādidoṣairupaplutaiḥ kheṣu pariskhaladbhiḥ | bhavanti ye prāṇabhūtāṃ vikārāste doṣajā bheṣajasiddhisādhyāḥ’ | ubhayotpannā yathā-‘dānādibhiḥ karmabhirauṣadhaiśca karmakṣaye doṣaparikṣaye ca | sidhyanti ye ratnavatāṃ kadācit te karmadoṣaprabhavā vikārāḥ ||’ iti | duritāpahāriṇa iti duritaśabdena duḥkhamabhidhīyate tatsaṃyogā vyādhaya ityuktatvāt | śreyomayāniti puṇyasvarūpān | ye'nyepi puṇyamayāste duḥkhacchedanāya sambhavanti, ucyate-‘paraduḥkhavināśārthaṃ mahānto nijaśaktibhiḥ | karma kurvanti yat puṇyaṃ tena puṇyamayāḥ smṛtāḥ’ iti || 5 || Gū. svābhāvikāgantukakāyikāntarā rogāścaturdhā bhaveyuḥ karmajā doṣajāḥ karmadoṣajāśceti tridhā bhaveyuḥ | svabhāvena bhavantīti svābhāvikāḥ kṣutpipāsājarānidrāmṛtyuprabhṛtayo bhaveyuḥ | kileti niścayena karmadoṣajā bhaveyuḥ | tacchedanārthaṃ duritāpahāriṇo yogānniyojayedityanvayaḥ | kiṃviśiṣṭānyogān? śreyomayān tatra svābhāvikā rogāḥ kṣutpipāsādayaḥ, āgantukā bhūtābhiṣaṅgādayaḥ, kāyikā ajīrṇādayaḥ, āntarāḥ mānasikāḥ kāmādayaḥ, karmajā doṣajāḥ karmadoṣajāḥ, yathā ‘brahmahā kṣayarogī syāt’ doṣavātapittakaphajanyāḥ, tacchedanārthaṃ teṣāṃ doṣāṇāṃ chedanārthaṃ duritāpahāriṇaḥ rogāpahāriṇaḥ varān śreṣṭhān yojayet | kiṃviśiṣṭān ? śreyomayān kalyāṇadāyina ityarthaḥ || 5 || prayogānāgamātsiddhānpratyakṣādanumānataḥ | sarvalokahitārthāya vakṣyāmyanativistarān || 6 || Dī. idānīṃ pratyakṣasiddhayogānāṃ kathanena saṃkṣepakaraṇena ca nijagranthasya māhātmyamāha - prayogāniti | āgamādisiddhān prayogān sarvalokahitārthāya anativistarān vakṣyāmi kathayiṣyāmītyarthaḥ | anativistaraṃ yathā syādityeke paṭhanti | āgamādīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tu jaijjaṭādibhirācāryairuktaṃ tadeva subodhārthaṃ likhyate | yathā-āgamo vedaḥ, āptānāṃ śāstraṃ vā | tathāhi-‘siddhaṃ siddhaiḥ pramāṇaistu hitaṃ cātra paratra ca | āgamaḥ śāstramāptānāmāptāḥ satyārthavedinaḥ’ iti | āgamāt siddhāḥ śrūyante-yathā-‘jīvedvarṣasahasrāṇi yogasyāsya prabhāvataḥ| vṛddhā ca śatavarṣīyā bhavet ṣoḍaśavārṣikī’ ityādi | pratyakṣamiti yatkiñcidevārthasya sākṣātkāri jñānaṃ tadeva pratyakṣaṃ, tathāhi- ‘manokṣigatamabhrāntaṃ vastu pratyakṣamucyate | indriyāṇāmasaṃjñānaṃ vastu tadvai bhramaḥ smṛtaḥ |’ iti | tat siddhā yathā vamanavairecanādikayogāḥ pratyakṣaphalāḥ | anumānata iti anu paścādavyabhicāriliṅgālliṅgī jñāyate yena tadanumānam | tat siddhā yathā mṛtpāṇḍurogeṇa mṛdbhakṣaṇamanumīyate, chardyā makṣikādibhakṣaṇaṃ, tvakparipāṭanādibhiḥ pakvāmavraṇamiti | kena hetunā tvayā kriyate iti vivakṣāyāṃ sarvalokahitārthāyetigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| sarvaloka iti loko hi dvividhaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamātmakabhedena | atra puruṣaprādhānyājjanā eva lokaśabdena gṛhyante | ārṣeṇā'pi granthena jñānaṃ bhaviṣyati kimanena tadupajīvinā granthenetyāśaṅkyānativistarāniti grahaṇaṃ kṛtam na atiśayena vistaro yatra tāniti | yato bahuprapañcaracitānyūhāpohapūrvapakṣasamādhānādinā tantrāṇi sodvegakarāṇi bhavanti tasmāt saṃkṣipyānulikhāmītyarthaḥ || 6 || Gū. pratyakṣādanumānataḥ āgamātsiddhān prayogān anativistarān alpānityarthaḥ || 6 || prathamaṃ paribhāṣā syādbhaiṣajyākhyānakaṃ tathā | nāḍīparīkṣādividhistato dīpanapācanam || 7 || tataḥ kalādikākhyānamāhārādigatistathā | rogāṇāṃ gaṇanā ceti pūrvakhaṇḍo'yamīritaḥ || 8 || Dī. athānukramaṇikāmāha - atheti | athaśabda ānantaryārthe maṅgalārthe vā | anukramaṇikā iti adhyāyānāmanukramaṇaṃ trikhaṇḍānāmityarthaḥ| idānīṃ tāmanukramaṇikāṃ darśayitumāha -prathamamityādi | paribhāṣādirogagaṇanāntaiḥ saptabhiradhyāyaiḥ kṛtvā pūrvakhaṇḍo'yamīritaḥ kathita ityarthaḥ, ācāryeṇa iti śeṣaḥ | te ke adhyāyā ityāha - prathamamiti | prathamamādau paribhāṣā tulanādikam | dvitīye bhaiṣajyākhyānakam | bhaiṣajyākhyānakamityauṣadhabhakṣaṇavidhiḥ | tatheti grahaṇāt dravyarasaguṇavipākādīnāṃ kathanaṃ ṛtuṣaṭkakathanaṃ ca | nāḍīparīkṣādividhiriti tṛtīyam | ādigrahaṇādiha svapnādīnāṃ kathanam | tato'nantaraṃ dīpanapācanādilakṣaṇakathanaṃ caturtham | ādiśabdāt sraṃsanabhedanānulomanavamanalekhanastambhanādikathanam | tato'nantaraṃ kalādikākhyānamiti pañcamaṃ, ādigrahaṇāt sṛṣṭikramaśārīrādikathanam | tathetyanantaraṃ āhārādigatiriti ṣaṣṭham | ādiśabdāt garbhotpattikumārapoṣaṇoktaprakṛtilakṣaṇakathanaṃ ca | rogāṇāṃ gaṇanā ceti itiśabdenāvaśiṣṭaṃ saptamamityarthaḥ, etena sādhyā ya uktā rogā jvarādayasteṣāṃ gaṇanā saṃkhyākathanamiti pūrvakhaṇḍādhyāyānukramaḥ kathitaḥ || 7-8 || Gū. tadādau svarasaḥ puṭapākaśca tataḥ kvāthādi tataḥ phāṇṭaḥ dvivacanātpaṃtho (?) pi | tataḥ himaḥ, tataḥ kalkaḥ, tataḥ cūrṇaṃ, tataḥ guṭikā, tato'valehaḥ, snehaḥ ghṛtataile, tataḥ saṃdhānaṃ āsavāriṣṭaṃ, tataḥ dhātuśuddhiḥ dvivacanānmāraṇarasakathanaṃ ityayaṃ madhyamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ smṛtaḥ kathitaḥ || 9 || svarasaḥ kvāthaphāṇṭau ca himaḥ kalkaśca cūrṇakam | tathaiva guṭikālehau snehaḥ sandhānameva ca || 9 || dhātuśuddhī rasāścaiva khaṇḍo'yaṃ madhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ | Dī. atha madhyamakhaṇḍānukramaṇikāṃ darśayannāha - svarasa ityādi | svarasādirasāntairdvādaśabhiradhyāyairmadhyamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ smṛtaḥ, kathita ityarthaḥ | svarasādayo vikhyātā eva te cāgre vakṣyamāṇāḥ santi | tatra svaraseṣu puṭapākavidhikathanam | kvāthe pramathyādyuṣṇodakakṣīrapākānnakriyāvidhikathanam | phāṇṭe manthavidhikathanam | snehagrahaṇādghṛtakalpanā tailakalpanā ca | sandhānamityanena madyabhedakathanam | dhātuśuddhirityatra samastadhātūpadhātūnāṃ śodhanamāraṇādikathanam | rasā iti bahuvacanena sarveṣāṃ rasoparasādīnāṃ śodhanamāraṇādikathanam | iti madhyamakhaṇḍasyādhyāyānukramo vyākhyātaḥ || 9 || snehapānaṃ svedavidhirvamanaṃ ca virecanam || 10 || tatastu snehabastiḥ syāttataścāpi nirūhaṇam | tataścāpyuttaro bastistato nasyavidhirmataḥ || 11 || dhūmapānavidhiścaiva gaṇḍūṣādividhistathā | lepādīnāṃ vidhiḥ khyātastathā śoṇitavisrutiḥ||12|| netrakarmaprakāraśca khaṇḍaḥ syāduttarastvayam | Dī. idānīmuttarakhaṇḍānukramamāha- snehapānamiti | snehapānādinetrakarmaprakārāntaraistrayodaśabhiradhyāyairuttaraḥ khaṇḍaḥ syāt | tatra dhūmapāne vraṇadhūpanaṃ gṛhadhūpanaṃ ca, gaṇḍūṣe kavalādīnāṃ lakṣaṇagrahaṇāt kavalapratisāraṇakathanam | pralepetyādigrahaṇānmūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇavidhikathanam | śeṣaṃ subodham | ityuttarakhaṇḍādhyāyānukramaḥ kathitaḥ ||90-12|| Gū. tatrādau caturvidhasnehapānaṃ tataḥ svedavidhiḥ tataśca vamanaṃ tato virecanaṃ tataḥ snehabasti, tato nirūhaṇabastiḥ tato'pyuttarabastiḥ, tato nasyavidhiḥ tato dhūmapānavidhiḥ tato gaṇḍūṣaḥ ādiśabdātkavalavidhiśca tato lepavidhiḥ ādiśabdānmūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇavidhiḥ tato śoṇitamokṣaḥ tato netrakarmaprakāraḥ ityevamuttarakhaṇḍaḥ || 10-12 || dvātriṃśatsaṃmitādhyāyairyukteyaṃ saṃhitā smṛtā || 13 || ṣaḍviṃśatiśatānyatra ślokānāṃ gaṇitāni ca | Dī. idānīṃ saṃhitāniruktipūrvakaṃ ślokasaṃkhyāmāha - dvātriṃśaditi | yataḥ pūrvoktānāṃ trikhaṇḍānāṃ dvātriṃśadadhyāyairyukteyaṃ tasmāt saṃhitā kathitā | saṃmitasthāne saṃhita iti kecit paṭhanti | tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ | atra saṃhitāyāṃ ślokānāṃ gaṇitāni gaṇanāni ṣaḍviṃśatiśatāni bhavantītyadhyāhāryam | adhyāya iti padasamūho vākyaṃ, vākyasamūhaḥ prakaraṇaṃ, prakaraṇasamūho'dhyāya iti || 13 || Gū. iyaṃ śārṅgadharanāmnī saṃhitā smṛtā kathitā | kiṃviśiṣṭeyam ? dvātriṃśadadhyāyaiḥ saṃmitā ca samyak prakāreṇa racitā ca | atra asyāṃ gaṇitāni ṣaḍviṃśatiśatāni ślokānāṃ saṃtīti śeṣaḥ || 13 || atha māgadhaparibhāṣā | na mānena vinā yuktirdravyāṇāṃ jāyate kvacit || 14|| ataḥ prayogakāryārthaṃ mānamatrocyate mayā | Dī. athedānīṃ tāvat pūrvaṃ paribhāṣāṃ darśayitumāha-na māneneti | mānena parimāṇena vinā dravyāṇāṃ yuktiḥ kartavyavidhiḥ kvacit kutrā'pi na jāyate notpadyate ata ityasmāt prayogakāryārthaṃ prayogāṇāṃ yogānāṃ kāryārthaṃ kartavyavidhinimittaṃ mānaṃ tulanādi atra saṃhitāyāṃ mayā ācāryeṇa ucyate kathyate ityarthaḥ | bhakṣyamānavyavacchedārthamuktaṃ tadbhakṣyamānaṃ vakṣyamāṇamapyasti iti || 14 || Gū. atha paribhāṣāmānena vinā dravyāṇāṃ yuktiḥ na jñāyate notpadyate ataḥ asmātprayogakāryārthaṃ mayā mānaṃ ucyate | tanmānaṃ dvividhaṃ, taduktaṃ granthāntare-‘kāliṅgaṃ māgadhaṃ ceti dvividhaṃ mānamucyate | māgadhaṃ pravaraṃ prāhuḥ kāliṅgaṃ ca taduttaram’ iti || 14 || māgadhīyaṃ mānam-- trasareṇurbudhaiḥ proktastriṃśatā paramāṇubhiḥ || 15 || trasareṇustu paryāyanāmnā vaṃśī nigadyayate | Dī. idānīṃ paramāṇvādigamyamānārthaṃ lakṣaṇānyāha-trasareṇuriti | paramāṇubhiryastriṃśatā sa eva trasareṇuḥ proktaḥ kathito budhaistadvedibhiḥ puruṣaiḥ | paramāṇuḥ susūkṣmaḥ svabhāvato grāhyo na cakṣuṣā anumānena ceti kecit | tathāhi -‘jālāntaragate bhānau yat sūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ | tasya triṃśattamo bhāgaḥ paramāṇuḥ sa ucyate ||’ iti | triṃśateti paramāṇūnāṃ daśatrisaṃkhyairityarthaḥ | trasareṇureva paryāyanāmnā ekārthavācakaśabdena kṛtvā dhvaṃsīti ( vaṃśīti ) nigadyate kathyate | yatra samānārthakatā śabdānāṃ tatra te paryāyā ucyante ityarthaḥ | dhvaṃsīlakṣaṇaṃ tu etasyāgre kecit paṭhanti | yathā- ‘jālāntaragataiḥ sūryakarairdhvaṃsī vilokyate’ iti | sūryakarairādityaraśmibhiḥ || 15 || Gū. budhaistriṃśatparamāṇubhiḥ trasareṇuḥ proktaḥ sa eva trasareṇuḥ paryāyaśabdena vaṃśī nigadyate || 15 || jālāntaragate bhānau yatsūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ || 16|| tasya triṃśattamo bhāgaḥ paramāṇuḥ sa kathyate | jālāntaragataiḥ sūryakarairvaṃśī vilokyate || 17 || Gū. triṃśatetyatra viṃśatyādyāḥ sadaikatve bhavanti tasmādbahuvacanāntaparamāṇorlakṣaṇaṃ darśayati ‘jālāntaragate sūrye yatsūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ | tasya triṃśattamo bhāgaḥ paramāṇuḥ sa ucyate’ bhavediti śeṣaḥ | vaṃśaraṃdhraṃ praviṣṭaṃ yadrajastadvaṃśī tasyāstriṃśatā paramāṇunā yā saṃkhyā sā vaṃśītyarthaḥ || 16 || 17 || ṣaḍvaṃśībhirmarīciḥ syāttābhiḥ ṣaḍbhistu rājikā | tisṛbhī rājikābhiśca sarṣapaḥ procyate budhaiḥ || 18 || yavo'ṣṭasarṣapaiḥ prokto guñjā syāttaccatuṣṭayam | ṣaḍbhistu raktikābhiḥ syānmāṣako hemadhānyakau || 19|| Dī. atha marīciprabhṛtīnāṃ paramparāmāha -- ṣaḍvaṃśībhiriti | ṣaḍvaṃśībhirekā marīcirbhavediti | marīcibhirmānasaṃjñakābhirmarīcibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃkhyābhirekā rājikā kathitā ityadhyāhāraḥ | rājikā sarṣapabhedaḥ, tisṛbhī rājikābhiriti rājikātritayenaikaḥ sarṣapaḥ procyate kathyate budhairiti | sarṣapagrahaṇenātra gaurasarṣapo jñeya iti prasiddhiḥ | aṣṭasarṣapaiḥ kṛtvā eko yavaḥ kathitaḥ | yavo'nnaviśeṣaḥ | guñjāmāha - taccatuṣṭayamānena guñjā syāt, tena ekā guñjā kathitā ityabhiprāyaḥ, guñjā raktikā vācyā | atha māṣakamāha-ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaṭsaṃkhyābhī raktikābhirguñjābhireko māṣa iti khyātaḥ, sa eva hemadhānyakaparyāyanāmnā kathita iti svamate, kvacit saptabhiḥ kvacit pañcabhirdaśabhirvā guñjābhiḥ kṛtvā māṣakaḥ kathitaḥ sa eva māṣako marīcyādibhirvicāryamāṇo'tra na viruddhaḥ, tacca vistarabhayānna likhyate || 18 || 19 || Gū. budhaiḥ tisṛbhiḥ rājikābhiḥ sarṣapaḥ procyate aṣṭasarṣapairyavaḥ proktaḥ taccatuṣṭayaṃ guñjā syāt ṣaḍbhī raktikābhiḥ māṣakaḥ syāt sa eva māṣakaḥ paryāyaśabdena hemaśca nigadyate dhānyakaśca nigadyate || 18 || 19 || māṣaiścaturbhiḥ śāṇaḥ syāddharaṇaḥ sa nigadyate | ṭaṅkaḥ sa eva kathitastaddvayaṃ kola ucyate ||20|| kṣudrako vaṭakaścaiva draṅkṣaṇaḥ sa nigadyate | Dī. idānīṃ śāṇaparimāṇaṃ kolaparimāṇaṃ ca vaktumāha - māṣairiti | caturbhirmāṣakairekaḥ śāṇo dharaṇaṃ ṭaṅkaśca kathitaḥ | māṣo'tra ṣaḍbhirguñjābhistulita iti sarvatra | taddvayamiti śāṇadvayenaivaikaḥ kolaḥ | kolo badarasaṃjña iti kecit | tasya paryāyavācakāḥ kṣudramoṭarakadraṃkṣaṇādayaḥ, te'tra ṭaṅkadvayamānasaṃjñakā boddhavyāḥ ||20|| Gū. caturbhirmāṣaiḥ śāṇaḥ syāt sa eva dharaṇo nigadyate sa eva śāṇaḥ paryāyaśabdena ṭaṅkaḥ kathitaḥ, taddvayaṃ ṭaṅkadvayaṃ kola ucyate sa eva kolaparyāyaśabdena kṣudraka ucyate vaṭakaścocyate draṃkṣaṇaśca nigadyate amūni ṭaṅkadvayasya nāmānītyabhiprāyaḥ || 20 || koladvayaṃ ca karṣaḥ syātsa proktaḥ pāṇimānikā ||21|| akṣaṃ picuḥ pāṇitalaṃ kiṃcitpāṇiśca tindukam | biḍālapadakaṃ caiva tathā ṣoḍaśikā matā || 22 || karamadhyo haṃsapadaṃ suvarṇaṃ kavalagrahaḥ | udumbaraṃ ca paryāyaiḥ karṣa eva nigadyate || 23 || Dī. karṣamāha -- koladvayamiti | koladvitayameva karṣaḥ syāt, sa catuḥśāṇa ityarthaḥ | tasya paryāyasaṃjñakā pāṇimānikādayaḥ | pāṇimānikā karatalaṃ viduriti bhāvaḥ | akṣa iti vibhītakaphalaṃ tacca karṣamānasaṃjñam | tindukaṃ tindukaphalam | viḍālapadakaṃ aṅgulitrayagrāhyaṃ cūrṇadravyaṃ tat karṣasaṃjñamityarthaḥ | ṣoḍaśikā ṣoḍaśamāṣakaparimitetyarthaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 21-23 || Gū. koladvayaṃ kolayoḥ dvayaṃ karṣaḥ syāt pāṇimāṇikādyā uduṃbarāntaṃ karṣasya paryāyavācakāḥ caturbhiṣṭaṅkaiḥ karṣaḥ syādityarthaḥ || 21-23 || syātkarṣābhyāmardhapalaṃ śuktiraṣṭamikā tathā | śuktibhyāṃ ca palaṃ jñeyaṃ muṣṭirāmraṃ caturthikā || 24 || prakuñcaḥ ṣoḍaśī bilvaṃ palamevātra kīrtyate | Dī. ardhapalaṃ palamānaṃ cāha--syāt karṣābhyāmiti | karṣadvayenārdhapalaṃ kathitaṃ, tadeva śuktiḥ | aṣṭamikā ca śuktiḥ prasiddhā, aṣṭamikā aṣṭaśāṇasaṃjñamānaviśeṣaḥ | palamapyāha - śuktibhyāmiti | śuktidvayenaiva palaṃ boddhavyam | palaṃ prasiddham | etasyāpi muṣṭyādayaḥ paryāyavācakā jñeyāḥ | atra muṣṭyādiṣu palameva kīrtyate nānyat | muṣṭirnakhāntamuṣṭiḥ | āmraṃ phalam | caturthiketi catuḥkarṣa iti bhāvaḥ | ṣoḍaśī ṣoḍaśaśāṇamitaḥ, śāṇo 'traivokto jñātavyaḥ, na tu vyāvahārikaḥ | bilvaṃ bilvaphalaṃ etat saṃjñā pale boddhavyā || 24 || Gū. dvābhyāṃ karṣābhyāmardhapalaṃ syāt ardhapalameva śuktiḥ aṣṭamikā ca saiva paryāyaśabdena aṣṭaṭaṅkamitā śuktiriti dvābhyāṃ śuktibhyāṃ palaṃ jñeyaṃ muṣṭyādyāḥ ṣaṭpalasya paryāyavācakāḥ ṣoḍaśaṭaṅkaṃ palaṃ jñātavyamiti śeṣaḥ || 24 || palābhyāṃ prasṛtirjñeyā prasūtaśca nigadyate || 25 || prasṛtibhyāmañjaliḥ syātkuḍavo 'rdhaśarāvakaḥ | aṣṭamānaṃ ca sa jñeyaḥ kuḍavābhyāṃ ca mānikā ||26|| śarāvo 'ṣṭapalaṃ tadvajjñeyamatra vicakṣaṇaiḥ | Dī. idānīṃ prasṛtipūrvakaṃ mānikāntaṃ mānamāha - palābhyāmiti | paladvayenaikā prasṛtirjñeyā prasāritāṅgulikaratalaṃ prasṛtiḥ saiva dvātriṃśat śāṇamitā | prasṛtibhyāmiti prasṛtidvayenaikāñjaliḥ, añjalistu karadvayamilitasampuṭakākāraḥ prasiddhaḥ, sa eva kuḍavaḥ ardhaśarāvakaśca kathitaḥ, kuḍavaḥ prasiddhaścatuḥpalapramitaḥ ardhaśarāvakaścatuḥṣaṣṭiśāṇasaṃjñaḥ | kuḍavābhyāmiti | kuḍavadvayenaikā mānikā saiva śarāvaḥ | aṣṭapalaṃ ca śarāvaḥ sa tu sāṣṭāviṃśatiśatasaṃkhyākaśāṇaiḥ kathitaḥ ||25||26|| Gū. dvābhyāṃ palābhyāṃ prasṛtirjñeyā dvātriṃśat ṭaṅkānāṃ prasṛtiḥ paryāyaśabdena prasṛtiśca nigadyate dvābhyāṃ prasṛtibhyāmañjaliḥ syāt sa evāñjaliḥ kuḍavo 'rdhaśarāvakaśca paryāyaśabdena sa eva mānamapyañjalirjñeyaḥ catuḥṣaṣṭikānāmañjalirityabhiprāyaḥ | dvābhyāṃ kuḍavābhyāṃ mānikā, mānikāparyāyavācakaḥ śarāvaḥ aṣṭapalaṃ ca aṣṭāviṃśacchatottaraṭaṅkānāṃ māniketyarthaḥ || 25 || 26 || śarāvābhyāṃ bhavetprasthaścatuḥprasthaistathāḍhakam || 27 || bhājanaṃ kaṃsapātraṃ ca catuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ ca tat | Dī. atha prasthā 'ḍhake darśayitumāha -- śarāvābhyāmiti | śarāvadvayena ekaḥ prasthaḥ sa ca ṣoḍaśapalaparimito bhavati | catuḥprasthaiḥ kṛtvā āḍhakamekaṃ tacca bhājanaṃ kaṃsapātraṃ ca kathitaṃ, bhājanādayo 'pyāḍhakasyaiva paryāyā ityarthaḥ | etaccatuḥṣaṣṭipalaparimitaṃ boddhavyam || 27 || Gū. dvābhyāṃ śarāvābhyāṃ prastho bhavet ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaradviśataṭaṅkānāṃ prasthaḥ, catuḥprasthaiḥ āḍhakaṃ bhavet caturviṃśottarasahasraṭaṅkānāmāḍhakaṃ, tadeva bhājanaṃ kāṃsyapātraṃ ca tadeva paryāyaśabdena catuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ cocyate ||27|| caturbhirāḍhakairdroṇaḥ kalaśo nalvaṇormaṇaḥ || 28 || unmānaśca ghaṭo rāśirdroṇaparyāyasaṃjñakāḥ | droṇābhyāṃ śūrpakumbhau ca catuḥṣaṣṭiśarāvakāḥ || 29 || śūrpābhyāṃ ca bhaveddroṇī vāhī goṇī ca sā smṛtā | Dī. atha droṇaprabhṛti droṇīparyantamānamāha - caturbhiriti | caturbhiścatuḥsaṃkhyākairāḍhakaiḥ kṛtvā eko droṇaḥ, sa ca kalaśādiparyāyanāmabhirupalakṣito dvātriṃśaccharāvatulito jñeyaḥ | droṇābhyāmiti | droṇadvayena śūrpakumbhau kathitau, śūrpaśca kumbhaśceti | śūrpaścatuḥṣaṣṭiśarāvako jñeyaḥ | śūrpābhyāmiti | śūrpadvayena ekā droṇī saiva vāhī goṇī ca kathitā, atra catuḥṣaṣṭiprasthā bhavantīti tātparyārthaḥ || 28 || 29 || Gū. caturbhirāḍhakairdroṇa ucyate sa eva kalaśaḥ, nalvaṇaḥ, armaṇaśca, unmānaśca,ghaṭaśca,rāśiśca paryāyaśabdena sa evetyuttaracatuḥsahasraṭaṅkānāṃ droṇaḥ ||28||29|| droṇīcatuṣṭayaṃ khārī kathitā sūkṣmabuddhibhiḥ || 30 || catuḥsahasrapalikā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikā ca sā | Dī. idānīṃ khārīparimāṇamāha-droṇīcatuṣṭayamiti | droṇīcatuṣṭayaṃ sambhāraṃ tat khārīśabdavācyaṃ, tena ṣaṇṇavatyadhikacatuḥsahasrapalamānena sā jñātavyā, ata eva sūkṣmabuddhibhiriti grahaṇam || 30 || palānāṃ dvisahasraṃ ca bhāra ekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 31 || tulā palaśataṃ jñeyā sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ | Dī. atha bhāraparimāṇaṃ tulāparimāṇamapyāha - palānāmiti | pūrvapratipāditānāṃ palānāṃ yat sahasradvayaṃ tena eko bhāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ kathitaḥ | etena bhāro viṃśatitulābhiḥ parimito bhavati | tulā ca palaśataparimitā jñeyā | tathācoktam - ‘tulāpalaśataṃ tāsāṃ viṃśatirbhāra ucyate | khārī bhāradvayenaiva smṛtā ṣaḍbhājanādhikā’ iti | eṣa niścayaḥ sarvatraiva sarvadeśeṣveva prayogeṣu vā jñeya ityarthaḥ, natu kevalaṃ magadhadeśe | eveti niścayārthabodhakaḥ || 31 || māṣaṭaṅkākṣabilvāni kuḍavaḥ prasthamāḍhakam || 32 || rāśirgoṇī khāriketi yathottaracaturguṇāḥ | Dī. idānīṃ sakalamānajñāpanāryaṃ ślokenaikena mānamāha-- māṣetyādi | māṣādikhāryavasānā yathottaraṃ caturguṇā jñeyāḥ | yo yasmāduttaro yathottaraṃ, etena kimuktaṃ bhavati-māṣāccaturguṇaḥ śāṇaḥ śāṇāt karṣaścaturguṇaḥ karṣāccaturguṇaṃ bilvamityādyā apare mitā iti | bilvamatra palaṃ, rāśirdroṇasaṃjñaḥ, goṇītyanena droṇī kathitā || 32 || guñjādimānamārabhya yāvatsyātkuḍavasthitiḥ || 33 || dravārdraśuṣkadravyāṇāṃ tāvanmānaṃ samaṃ matam | prasthādimānamārabhya dviguṇaṃ taddravārdrayoḥ || 34 || mānaṃ tathā tulāyāśca dviguṇaṃ na kvacitsmṛtam | Dī. idānīṃ dravārdraśuṣkadravyāṇāmanuktānāṃ mānaṃ nirdeṣṭumāha-guñjāprabhṛtimānamārabhya yāvat kuḍavasthitiḥ syāt tāvaddravyādīnāṃ mānaṃ samaṃ jñeyam | guñjā ādiryeṣāṃ te māṣakakolākṣaśuktiprasṛtāḥ kuḍavaparyantāḥ | dravaṃ toyādi, ārdraṃ tatkṣaṇoddhṛtaṃ; śuṣkaṃ sūryāṃśubhiḥ śoṣitaṃ cirakālaṃ dhṛtaṃ ca | eke yāvanna kuḍavasthitiriti paṭhanti tatra kuḍavādarvāk samamiti | tathāhi—‘raktikādiṣu māneṣu yāvanna kuḍavo bhavet | śuṣke dravārdrayostāvat tulyaṃ mānaṃ prakīrtitam’ iti | etadapi tantrāntare yathā-‘prasthādi mānamārabhya dviguṇaśca dravārdrayoḥ | kuḍavo 'pi kvaciddṛṣṭo yathā dantīghṛte matam’ iti || 33 || dī.- prasthādimānamiti | prasthādiparimāṇamārabhya yāvat tulā pūryate tāvaddravārdrayordviguṇaparimāṇaṃ jñeyam | dviguṇaṃ tu śuṣkadravyādityarthaḥ | tathāca-‘śuṣkadravyasya yā mātrā tvārdrasya dviguṇā hi sā | śuṣkasya gurutīkṣṇatvāttasmādardhaṃ prayojayet’ | prasthādimānamityādiśabdāt ṣoḍaśapalamārabhya yāvat palaśataṃ pūryate tāvadityarthaḥ | (na tathā tulāyāḥ |) tulāyā upari mānaṃ kvacit kutrāpi dviguṇaṃ na tatkāryaṃ dravārdrayoriti śeṣaḥ | uparimānamiti droṇādikam | tathāca -‘dvaiguṇyaṃ na tulāmānāditi mānavido viduḥ | yato dravārdraśuṣkādeḥ prasiddhiścātra lokataḥ’ | etadabhiprāyaṃ snehapākaviṣaye prāyaśo manyante kvacit || 34 || mṛdvṛkṣaveṇulohāderbhāṇḍaṃ yaccaturaṅgulam || 35 || vistīrṇaṃ ca tathoccaṃ ca tanmānaṃ kuḍavaṃ vadet | Dī. idānīṃ dravamānārthaṃ kuḍavapātranirmāṇamāha- mṛditi | mṛdādivastubhirnirmitaṃ yadbhāṇḍaṃ bhavati tat paramitaṃ dravadravyaṃ kuḍavasaṃjñitaṃ vadet | kathaṃbhūtaṃ ? āyāmaparimāṇābhyāṃ caturaṅgulapramāṇaṃ, tathā uccenāpi caturaṅgulam | veṇuṃ vaṃśaṃ, lohamaṣṭavidhaṃ tacca suvarṇarajatatāmrāraghoṣatrapusīsakalohasaṃjñam | ādigrahaṇāccarmaśrṛṅgadantopalādayaḥ | aṅgulaśabdenātrāṅguṣṭhanakhatala- bhāgaṃ gṛhṇanti | kecit ‘madhyamāṅgulikāyāstu madhyamaparvamitāṅgulami’ti | yadvā caturbhiraṅgulibhiḥ parimitaṃ caturaṅgulamiti prasiddham | etat parimāṇaṃ dravadravyārthaṃ boddhavyam || 35 || Gū. taddviguṇaṃ na, tarhi tulayā vinā kutaḥ? tadāha - mṛdvṛkṣaveṇulohādeḥ caturaṅgulaṃ vistīrṇaṃ coccaṃ ca yadbhāṇḍaṃ tanmānaṃ kuḍavaṃ vadet mṛṇmayaṃ, vṛkṣakāṣṭhakṛtaṃ, vaiṇavaṃ vṛkṣavadveṇukṛtaṃ, lohamāyasaṃ caturaṅgulīkṛtaṃ tanmānaṃ kuḍavamityarthaḥ, pūrvadeśe prasiddhamiti || 35 || yadauṣadhaṃ tu prathamaṃ yasya yogasya kathyate || 36 || tannāmnaiva sa yogo hi kathyate 'tra viniścayaḥ | Dī. atha prayogāṇāmādidravyāṅkitasaṃjñā nirdeṣṭumāha- yaditi | yasya yogasya gaṇasvarūpasya prathamamādipaṭhitamauṣadhaṃ bhavati tannāmnaiva sa yogaḥ kathyate ityatra viniścayo jñātavyaḥ| yathā-kṣudrādi, guḍūcyādīti tātparyārthaḥ | magadhadeśe prāyaśaḥ pracaratītyato māgadhaparibhāṣā kathyate || 36 || Gū. yasya yogasya yatprathamaṃ auṣadhaṃ kathyate sa yogastannāmnaiva bhavediti niścayaḥ || 36 || iti māgadhaparibhāṣā || atha kāliṅgaparibhāṣā | sthitirnāstyeva mātrāyāḥ kālamagniṃ vayo balam ||37|| prakṛtiṃ doṣadeśau ca dṛṣṭvā mātrāṃ prakalpayet | Dī. idānīṃ kāliṅgaparibhāṣāṃ darśayitumāha -- atheti | tatrādau mātrāvyavacchedārthaṃ ślokamekaṃ paṭhanti kecit tamāha - sthitiriti | mātrāyāḥ parimāṇasya sthitirvyavasthā nāsti, yataḥ kālādikamavekṣya parimāṇaṃ yuñjyādityabhiprāyaḥ | kālaṃ śītoṣṇavarṣālakṣaṇaṃ, bheṣajagrahaṇakālaṃ vā | agnirapi caturvidho mandatīkṣṇaviṣamasamabhedena | vayo 'pi trividhamādimadhyāntam | balamapi hīnottamamadhyamam | prakṛtirapi tridhā hīnamadhyottamā, athavā deśajātiśarīrādibhiḥ prakṛterbahavo bhedāḥ | doṣo 'pi trividho vātādibhedena | deśo 'pi dvividho bhūmidehaprabhedena | bhūmideśastu tridhā jāṅgalānūpasādhāraṇabhedena, dehadeśo 'pi tridhaiva pūrvoktaḥ || 37 || Gū. atra mātrāyāḥ sthitirnāstyeva - yato mandāgnayo hrasvā hīnasattvā narāḥ kalau ||38|| atastu mātrā tadyogyā procyate sujñasammatā | Dī. atha bhakṣaṇārthaṃ prāguktā kāliṅgaparibhāṣā 'sti atastāmapi darśayannāha - yata iti | yataḥ kāraṇāt kalau kaliyuge īdṛśā narāḥ santi, ataḥ sthitihetoḥ tadyogyaiṣā narāṇāṃ vihitā mātrā bhakṣaṇadravyaparimāṇaṃ procyate kathyate ityarthaḥ | kathambhūtā ? sujñasammatā iti mānavedibhiḥ puruṣairvicāryamāṇā ityarthaḥ | kīdṛśāste narāḥ | mandāgnaya iti svalpāhāriṇaḥ, hrasvāścetyalpakāyāḥ hīnasattvā iti svalpabalāḥ || 38 || Gū. kutaḥ ? yataḥ kalau mandāgnayo narāḥ hrasvāḥ hīnasattvāśca, ataḥ kālamagniṃ vayaḥ balaṃ prakṛtiṃ doṣaṃ deśaṃ dṛṣṭvā yā tu tatsammatā tadyogyā mātrā procyate sā yojyeti śeṣaḥ || 38 || yavo dvādaśabhirgaurasarṣapaiḥ procyate budhaiḥ || 39 || yavadvayena guñjā syāttriguñjo valla ucyate | māṣo guñjābhiraṣṭābhiḥ saptabhirvā bhavetkvacit||40|| syāccaturmāṣakaiḥ śāṇaḥ sa niṣkaṣṭaṅka eva ca | gadyāṇo māṣakaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ karṣaḥ syāddaśamāṣikaḥ ||41 || catuṣkarṣaiḥ palaṃ proktaṃ daśaśāṇamitaṃ budhaiḥ | catuṣpalaiśca kuḍavaṃ prasthādyāḥ pūrvavanmatāḥ || 42 || Dī. idānīṃ tattulanamāha - yava ityādi | dvādaśabhirdvādaśasaṃkhyākairgaurasarṣapaireko yavaḥ, gauragrahaṇaṃ tadanyajātivyavacchedārtham | īdṛśena yavadvayena ekā guñjā syādbhavet| triguñjo guñjātrayaḥ, eko vallaḥ vallasaṃjñaḥ prasiddhaḥ parimāṇaḥ | aṣṭābhiraṣṭasaṃkhyābhirguñjābhiḥ kṛtvā eko māṣaḥ kathitaḥ, māṣo 'tra ṭaṅkasya caturthāṃśaḥ | kvaciditi kutrāpi saptabhirguñjādibhiḥ kṛtvā māṣako jñeya iti tantrāntarīyamataṃ, tacca viṣakalpe pracaritamiti vadanti kecit sarvatrāprasiddhatvāt | guñjāpyatraivoktā jñeyā | caturmāṣakaiḥ kṛtvā ekaḥ śāṇaḥ sa eva niṣkaḥ ṭaṅkaśca paryāyanāmnā kathitaḥ | ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃkhyākairmāṣakaiḥ kṛtvā eko gadyāṇaḥ, sa ca sārdhaṭaṅkaikena parimito bhavati | gadyāṇa iti parimāṇasaṃjñāśabdaḥ | daśamāṣakaireva ekaḥ karṣaḥ syāt, karṣo 'kṣaḥ kathitaḥ sa ca sārdhadviśāṇamitaḥ | catuṣkarṣaiḥ kṛtvā palamekaṃ proktaṃ kathitam; palaṃ prasiddhaṃ karṣeṇaivoktaṃ, mānatastat palaṃ daśaśāṇamitaṃ boddhavyam | īdṛśaiścaturbhiḥ palaiḥ kṛtvā kuḍavamekaṃ taccatvāriṃśacchāṇaparitulitaṃ bhavati | prasthādyāḥ pūrvavan matāḥ | iti prasthādyavaśiṣṭaṃ māgadhaparibhāṣāvajjñeyamanukrameṇetyarthaḥ | na tu tattulyamānaṃ ; etena kuḍavāccheṣamānamapyatraiva pratipāditapalena parimitaṃ boddhavyam | na tu māgadhaparibhāṣoktapaleneti tātparyārthaḥ || 39-42 || Gū. dvādaśagaurasarṣapaiḥ kṛtvā budhairyavaḥ procyate; gaurasarṣapaiḥ pītasarṣapaiḥ | yavadvayena guñjā syāt bhavet triguñjo valla ucyate aṣṭabhiḥ guñjābhiḥ saptabhirvā kvacidbhavet caturmāṣakaiḥ śāṇaḥ syāt sa eva niṣkaḥ ṭaṅkaśca; ṣaḍbhiḥ māṣakairgadyāṇaḥ syāt daśamāṣikaḥ karṣo bhavet catuṣkarṣaiḥ palaṃ proktaṃ kiṃ viśiṣṭaṃ daśaśāṇamitaṃ catuḥpalaiḥ kṛtvā kuḍavaṃ proktaṃ prasthādyāḥ pūrvavajjñeyāḥ || 39-42 || iti kāliṅgaparibhāṣā || kāliṅgaṃ māgadhaṃ ceti dvividhaṃ mānamucyate || 43 || kāliṅgānmāgadhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mānaṃ mānavido viduḥ | Dī. yadyapi deśāntare bahūni mānāni santi tathāpi dve parimāṇe prasiddhe iti vicāryāha - kāliṅgamiti | kaliṅgamiti kecit paṭhanti | kāliṅgamiti kaliṅgadeśe pracuraṃ prasiddhaṃ yat tat kāliṅgaṃ; magadhadeśe prāyaśaḥ pracaratīti māgadhamānam | iti dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇamiti, dvividhaṃ dviprakāramucyate mānavedibhiḥ kathyata ityarthaḥ ||43|| iti kāliṅgaparibhāṣā || navānyeva hi yojyāni dravyāṇyakhilakarmasu | vinā viḍaṅgakṛṣṇābhyāṃ guḍadhānyājyamākṣikaiḥ ||44| Dī. idānīṃ dravyāṇāṃ yuktāyuktavicāramāha- navānīti | akhilakarmasviti daśadhā dravyakalpanāviṣayeṣu nūtanadravyāṇi yojyānīti bhāvaḥ | yataḥ- ’sarvaṃ ca kṣīravadvīryayuktaṃ bhavati bheṣajam | teṣāmalābhe gṛhṇīyādanatikrāntavatsaram’ iti | viḍaṅgādidravyaṃ vinā tena viḍaṅgaprabhṛtikaṃ purātanaṃ guṇakaramiti tātparyārthaḥ purātanatvaṃ saṃvatsarādupari bhavati | tatra dhānyaṃ dhānyakaṃ, ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tadatrāpakvaṃ jñeyaṃ, pakvaṃ tu hīnavīryaṃ syāt | tathāhi - ‘ghṛtamabdāt paraṃ pakvaṃ hīnavīryaṃ prajāyate | tailaṃ pakvamapakvaṃ vā cirasthāyi guṇādhikam’ iti purāṇaṃ rūkṣādiguṇasaṃyuktatvāt || 44 || Gū. hīti niścayena akhilakarmasu navānyeva dravyāṇi yojyāni | viḍaṅgakṛṣṇābhyāṃ vinā, guḍadhānyājyamākṣikaiśca vinā || guḍūcī kuṭajo vāsā kūṣmāṇḍaṃ ca śatāvarī | aśvagandhā sahacarī śatapuṣpā prasāriṇī ||45|| prayoktavyā sadaivārdrā dviguṇā naiva yojayet | śuṣkaṃ navīnaṃ yaddravyaṃ yojyaṃ sakalakarmasu || 46 || ārdraṃ ca dviguṇaṃ yuñjyādeṣa sarvatra niścayaḥ | Dī. idānīṃ ye sarvakāleṣvārdrā adviguṇā dravyaviśeṣā yojyāstānāha - guḍūcīti | guḍūcīpūrvakāḥ prasāriṇīparyantā oṣadhyaḥ sadaiva sarvasmin kāle ṛtau vā tatkālīnoddhṛtāḥ prayoktavyāḥ, ete ca dravyaviśeṣā dviguṇā na kāryā vīryotkṛṣṭatvāt | guḍūcī prasiddhā; kuṭajo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ sa ca kauraiyāśabdavācyaḥ | vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, sahacaraḥ kuraṇṭakaḥ piyāvāsā iti śeṣaḥ | prasāriṇī svanāmakhyātā | etasyāgre ’śuṣkaṃ navīnaṃ yaddravyaṃ yojyaṃ sakalakarmasu | ārdraṃ ca dviguṇaṃ yuñjyādeṣa sarvatra niścayaḥ’ iti ślokaṃ paṭhanti kecit sa coktamevārthaṃ draḍhayati na doṣaḥ paunaruktyā | dviguṇamatra ekadravyabhāgāpekṣayā tat pūrvamuktaṃ na tu samasamānāt | sarvatreti kalpanāsu || 45 || Gū. guḍūcyādyāḥ prasāriṇyantāḥ sadaivārdrāḥ prayoktavyāḥ, dviguṇā naiva kārayet || 45 ||yābhiḥ pūrvoktābhirvinā śuṣkaṃ navīnaṃ yaddravyaṃ tatsakalakarmasu yojyam | ārdraṃ yaddravyaṃ tadviguṇaṃ yuñjyātprasthādimāneṣu tulāyā vinā dravārdradravyaṃ yadyuktaṃ bhavati tadā dviguṇaṃ kāryaṃ nānyatra eṣo mayā niścayaḥ kṛtaḥ ||4 6 || kāle 'nukte prabhātaṃ syādaṅge 'nukte jaṭā bhavet|| 47 || bhāge 'nukte tu sāmyaṃ syātpātre 'nukte ca mṛṇmayam | drave 'nukte jalaṃ grāhyaṃ taile 'nukte tilodbhavam ||48|| Dī. idānīmanuktaprayoge tadbhakṣaṇakālādikamāha - kāle bheṣajabhakṣaṇasamaye 'nukte aprakāśite sati prabhātaṃ prātaḥkāla eva syāt, tathāṅge dravyāvayave 'nukte sati jaṭā mūlaṃ syādityarthaḥ | bhāge dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇe 'nukte sati sāmyaṃ syāt sarveṣāṃ samatā bhavatītyarthaḥ | pātre iti dravyasya karaṇārthaṃ sthāpanārthaṃ ca bhājane 'nukte sati tadā mṛṇmayaṃ mṛtpātraṃ grāhyam | cakārāddravānuktaviṣaye pānīyaṃ, tathācoktaṃ ‘drave 'pyanukte jalameva deyaṃ bhāge 'pyanukte samatā vidheyā | aṅge 'pyanukte vihitaṃ tu mūlaṃ kālepyanukte divasasya pūrvam’ iti || gū. - auṣadhabhakṣaṇārthamanukte kāle sati prabhātaṃ syāt | aṅge anukte sati jaṭā bhavet | anukte māne sati sāmyaṃ syāt | kvāthādikathanasamaye anukte pātre sati mṛṇmayaṃ syāt bhavet || 47 || 48 || ekamapyauṣadhaṃ yoge yasminyatpunarucyate | mānato dviguṇaṃ kāryaṃ taddravyaṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ || 49 || Dī. atha yogeṣu punaruktadravyasya mānamāha- ekamiti | yatra yoge ekaṃ vāpi dravyaṃ dviparyāyanāmnā kathitaṃ tadevauṣadhaṃ mānataḥ parimāṇāt dviguṇaṃ kāryaṃ dviguṇitā ca ekadravyabhāgāpekṣayā iti tattvadarśibhirāyurvedarahasyajñāpakaiḥ proktamityarthaḥ | tathāhi – ‘ghṛte taile ca yoge ca yaddravyaṃ punarucyate | tajjñātavyamihāryeṇa mānato dviguṇaṃ bhavet ||’ iti || 49 || Gū. yasminyoge ekamapyauṣadhaṃ punarucyate taddravyaṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ vaidyairmānataḥ dviguṇaṃ proktam | anyadapi sāṃpradāyikaṃ prayogaṃ vadanti granthāntarāt - ‘cūrṇasnehāsavā lehāḥ prāyaḥ syuścandanānvitāḥ | kaṣāyalepayoścātra yujyate raktacandanam’ || 49 || cūrṇasnehāsavā lehāḥ prāyaśaścandanānvitāḥ | kaṣāyalepayoḥ prāyo yujyate raktacandanam || 50 || Dī. idānīṃ sāmānyacandanagrahaṇaṃ yogaviśeṣeṣu vibhajannāha - cūrṇeti | cūrṇādayaḥ kalpanāḥ candanagrahaṇena śvetacandanānvitā jñeyāḥ | āsavagrahaṇena sarve sandhānakāśca | avalehagrahaṇena guṭikāgrahaṇaṃ, yathā lavaṅgādicūrṇe lākṣāditaile triphalāghṛte drākṣāsave cyavanaprāśāvalehe draṣṭavyam | kaṣāyalepayostu candanagrahaṇena raktacandanaṃ yojyamityarthaḥ | kaṣāyaṃ svarasādipañcakaṃ tena svarasakvāthaphāṇṭahimakalkādayaḥ | lepo daśāṅgaprabhṛtayaḥ | prāya iti grahaṇāt kutrāpi vyādhyanurūpaṃ boddhavyam | na cātra niyamārthaṃ ‘prāyaḥśabdaḥ, yato nyūnamācaṣṭe kvacit | tathāhi - ‘prāyaḥśabdo viśeṣārthe kvacinnyūne 'pi dṛśyate’ iti| chardyarthamelādicūrṇaṃ raktacandanānvitamiti prasiddhiḥ, vyādhivihitatvāt | tathācoktaṃ - ‘raktaṃ śītaṃ guru svādu charditṛṣṇāsrapittajit | tiktaṃ netrahitaṃ vṛṣyaṃ jvaravraṇaviṣāpaham’ iti || 50 || guṇahīnaṃ bhavedvarṣādūrdhvaṃ tadrūpamauṣadham | māsadvayāttathā cūrṇaṃ hīnavīryatvamāpnuyāt || 51 || hīnatvaṃ guṭikālehau labhete vatsarātparam | hīnāḥ syurghṛtatailādyāścaturmāsādhikāttathā || 52 || oṣadhyo laghupākāḥ syurnirvīryā vatsarātparam | purāṇāḥ syurguṇairyuktā āsavā dhātavo rasāḥ ||53|| Dī. idānīṃ prasiddhadravyāṇāṃ kālātikrameṇa hīnaguṇatvamāha - guṇahīnamiti | varṣādūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarādupari tadrūpamauṣadhaṃ guṇahīnaṃ bhavet svakāryakaraṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ | tadrūpamiti yādṛśaṃ dravyasvarūpaṃ tādṛśameva tadrūpaṃ kathitaṃ na tu cūrṇādikalpitam | tathāca - ‘dhāturūpaṃ dravyavarjaṃ na śreṣṭhaṃ vatsaroṣitami’ti | tathā cūrṇaṃ tālīsādyādikaṃ, māsadvayādupari hīnavīryasya bhāvaḥ hīnavīryatvamāpnuyāt, vīryahānirapyatra bhāvamātraṃ na tu sarvathā vīryarahitatvam , yatastantrāntare dṛśyate hi lavaṇabhāskarādīnāṃ bahuparimāṇaṃ cirakālasevanārtham | taduktaṃ - ‘pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ dhānyākaṃ kṛṣṇajīrakam | saindhavaṃ ca viḍaṃ caiva patraṃ tālīsakeśaram || eṣāṃ dvipalikān bhāgān pañca sauvarcalasya ca | maricā 'jājiśuṇṭhīnāmekaikasya palaṃ palam|| tvagele cārdhabhāge ca sāmudrāt kuḍavadvayam | dāḍimāt kuḍavaṃ caiva dve pale cāmlavetasāt ||’ iti | etat sambhāraṃ bahukālopayogikam, anyathā vyarthametat tasmādbhāvamātraṃ cūrṇasya māsadvayādupari hīnatvaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| guṭikā vijayādiguṭikā, lehāḥ khaṇḍakhādyā avalehaprabhṛtayaścirakālasthitā api svaguṇaṃ na parityajanti kintu kiñcidguṇarīhatā iti bhāvaḥ | tathā tailaghṛtādyāścaturmāsādhikādapi vatsarāt paraṃ svaguṇaṃ na parityajanti kintu kiñcidguṇarahitā iti bhāvaḥ, caturmāsādhikādvatsarāt paraṃ ṣoḍaśamāsāduparītyarthaḥ | eke caturmāsādhikāstatheti paṭhanti | tatra caturmāsagrahaṇena varṣākālaṃ manyante, ‘varṣāyāmuṣitaṃ snehaṃ pakvaṃ hīnatvamāpnuyāt’ iti vacanāt | tatheti grahaṇāt atrāpi na bhāvamātraṃ kintu dravyasamūhapākajasya guṇasya hānirna tu prakṛtiguṇahāniḥ | tathāca ‘lehaḥ siddho guḍādīnāṃ guṇahīno bhaveddhruvam | snehādyāḥ pūrvavīryāḥ syuste caturmāsatastathā’ iti | kecittu ‘hīnaṃ ca syād ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ tailaṃ vā vatsarāt param’ iti keṣāñcinmatamavalokya paṭhanti tanna sarvasammatam | yataḥ sarvasammataṃ vākyamidaṃ dṛśyate ‘ghṛtamabdāt paraṃ kiñciddhīnavīryatvamāpnuyāt | tailaṃ pakvamapakvaṃ vā cirasthāyi guṇādhikam’ iti | laghupākā oṣadhyo varṣādupari nirvīryāḥ syuḥ, niḥśeṣeṇa vīryarahitā ityarthaḥ | na tu hīnatvam | tāśca yavagodhūmapramukhāḥ | tathāca ‘eteṣu yavagodhūmatilamāṣā navā hitāḥ | rūḍhāḥ purāṇā virasā na tathā guṇakāriṇaḥ |’ iti | atha cirakālasthitā ye utkṛṣṭaguṇāḥ syustānāha - purāṇā ityādi | purāṇāścirakālasthitā bahusaṃvatsaroṣitā apītyarthaḥ | guṇairyuktā iti te āsavādayo viśiṣṭaguṇānvitā bhavantītyadhyāhāryam | āsavā madyabhedāḥ, āsavā iti bahuvacanena sarve sandhānakāśca jñeyāḥ | dhātava iti suvarṇarajatādayaḥ, bahuvacanācca saṃsiddhamṛgāṅkādayo 'pi boddhavyāḥ || 51-53 || Gū. varṣātsaṃvatsarādūrdhvaṃ tadrūpaṃ auṣadhaṃ guṇahīnaṃ bhavet | varṣādūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarādanantaraṃ na tu varṣāṛtubhya ūrdhvaṃ | tathā tena prakāreṇamāsadvayānantaraṃ cūrṇaṃ hīnavīryatvamāyāt| guṭikāvalehau etau dvau saṃvatsarātparaṃ hīnatvaṃ labhete | tathā tena prakāreṇa varṣādadhikāḥ ghṛtatailādyāḥ hīnāḥ syuḥ bhaveyuḥ | caturmāsādhikāḥ cāturmāsyādhikā laghupākāḥ oṣadhyaḥ vatsarātparaṃ nirvīryāḥ syuḥ | āsavā dhātavo rasāḥ purāṇā eva guṇairyuktāḥ syuḥ ||51-53|| vyādherayuktaṃ yaddravyaṃ gaṇoktamapi tattyajet | anuktamapi yadyuktaṃ yojayettatra tadbudhaḥ || 54 || Dī. idānīṃ rogāṇāmuktānuktadravyaviśeṣamāha - vyādheriti | yasya vyādherayuktamasātmyaṃ yaddravyaṃ gaṇeṣūktamapi tattyājyam, yathā atīsāre pathyā | yadgaṇe 'nuktamapi vyādheḥ sātmyaṃ tatra tadyojyamiti vyavahāraḥ | yathā 'tīsāre stambhanārthaṃ vatsakapāṭhādi | tathācoktam - ‘gaṇoktamapi yaddravyaṃ bhavedvyādhau na yaugikam | taduddharedyaugikaṃ tu prakṣipedanyayaugikam iti || 54 || Gū. vyādheḥ rogasya yat ahitam ayuktaṃ dravyaṃ tat gaṇoktamapi tyajet | gaṇeṣvanuktaṃ dravyaṃ yuktaṃ bhavati cedāyojayet || 54 || iti yuktāyuktavicāraḥ || āgneyā vindhyaśailādyāḥ saumyo himagirirmataḥ | atastadauṣadhāni syuranurūpāṇi hetubhiḥ || 55 || anyeṣvapi prarohanti vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca | Dī. idānīṃ dravyāharaṇārthaṃ deśādikathanamāha - āgneyā iti | yato vindhyaśailādyā āgneyāḥ agniguṇabhūyiṣṭhāḥ | ādigrahaṇānmalayasahya- pāriyātrā(parvatā)dayaḥ| himagiristu saumyo mataḥ, saumyaguṇabhūyiṣṭha ityarthaḥ | ato hetostadudbhavāni dravyāṇi tadrūpāṇi syuruṣṇaśītavīryāṇi bhavantītyarthaḥ | na kevalaṃ śailajātāni anyeṣvapi vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca yāni prarohanti tānyapi hetubhiḥ kṛtvā śītoṣṇavīryāṇi bhavantīti tātparyārthaḥ | heturapi ṛtusvarūpamiti, etena yādṛśaṃ ṛturūpaṃ śītoṣṇādikaṃ bhavati tādṛśameva tajjātadravyasya vīryamityarthaḥ | āgame 'pi ‘agnīṣomīyatvājjagataḥ’ iti | vanamudyānaṃ, upavanaṃ puruṣavyāpārakṛtaṃ pūrvamuktam || 55 || Gū. vindhyaśailādyāḥ oṣadhyaḥ āgneyāḥ, himagiriḥ saumyo mataḥ, himagirau yā oṣadhyaḥ tāḥ saumyāḥ śītaguṇayuktāḥ, ato himagiriḥ parvataḥ saumyo mataḥ | kutaḥ? yataḥ tadauṣadhāni teṣāṃ parvatānāmauṣadhāni hetubhiḥ anurūpāṇi syuḥ yathā śītahetubhirutpannānāṃ rogāṇāṃ uṣṇānyauṣadhānyuṣṇaheturūpāṇi śītalahetunāśakāni bhavanti evaṃ śītānyauṣadhāni uṣṇaheturūpāṇi uṣṇahetunāśakāni bhavantītyarthaḥ | na cāgneyāḥ saumyāścauṣadhyaḥ parvateṣvevotpadyante nānyatra nahyanyeṣvapi tadāha || 55 || gṛhṇīyāttāni sumanāḥ śuciḥ prātaḥ suvāsare ||56|| ādityasaṃmukho maunī namaskṛtya śivaṃ hṛdi | sādhāraṇadharādravyaṃ gṛhṇīyāduttarāśritam || 57 || Dī. idānīṃ dravyāṇāmāharaṇakramamāha - gṛhṇīyāditi | sumanāḥ śobhanacittaḥ puruṣa iti śeṣaḥ, tāni pūrvoktāni dravyāṇi prātararuṇodaye gṛhṇīyādutpāṭya dhārayediti bhāvaḥ | kathaṃbhūtaḥ? śuciriti bāhyābhyantareṇa, ādityamukha iti pūrvābhimukhaḥ, maunītyajalpakaḥ, suvāsare iti viśiṣṭanakṣatrādisaṃyukte dine | kiṃ kṛtvā? citte īśvaraṃ namaskṛtya | sādhāraṇadharādravyamiti sādhāraṇadharā jāṅgalānūpamiśritā pṛthvī tatrotpannadravyam | uttarāśritamiti uttaradigvibhāgasthitaṃ mūlaṃ dravyamiti śeṣaḥ | etena dravyāṇāṃ savīryatvaṃ darśitam | keciduttarāśrita iti puruṣaviśeṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti | sa ca uttarābhimukhobhūtvā gṛhṇīyāditi | gṛhṇīyāditi dviruktirniścayārthajñāpanārtham, nānyathā gṛhṇīyādityasya tātparyārthaḥ | eke tu gṛhṇīyāditi padaṃ pūrvaślokena yojanīyamiti vadanti ||56||57|| Gū. anyeṣu vaneṣu parvateṣu yānyauṣadhāni prarohanti tāni śucirbhūtvā sumanāḥ pumān prātareva suvāsare gṛhṇīyāt | grahaṇavidhānamāha - maunayuktaḥ sa pumān ādityasaṃmukho bhūtvā śivaṃ hṛdi namaskṛtya uttarāśritaṃ sādhāraṇadharādravyaṃ auṣadhaṃ gṛhṇīyādityarthaḥ | granthāntarādbhūmerlakṣaṇamāha ‘varṇagandharasopetā ṣaḍvidhā bhūmirucyate’ | tatra samāṃ gaurāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ lohitāṃ dṛṣadvatīṃ bahujalāṃ kaṭhināṃ ca bhūmimauṣadhagrahaṇāya parīkṣeta | tatra sādhāraṇā bhūmiḥ śreṣṭhā | suśrutaḥ sādhāraṇāṃ bhūmimāha - ‘sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā bhūmiḥ sādhāraṇā smṛtā | dravyāṇi yatra tatraiva tadguṇāśca viśeṣataḥ’ || 56 || 57 || valmīkakutsitānūpaśmaśānoṣaramārgajāḥ | jantuvahnihimavyāptā nauṣadhyaḥ kāryasiddhidāḥ ||58|| Dī. idānīṃ kutsitasthānajātadravyasya parityāgamāha -valmīketi | valmīkādiṣu sthāneṣu jātā utpannā oṣadhyo na kāryakarāḥ tathā jantuvahnihimavyāptāśca, ityatra vyāptaśabdo jantvādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisaṃbadhyate | kutsitaṃ bībhatsasthānaṃ, ānūpaṃ jalaprāyasthānaṃ jalavyāptamityarthaḥ | jantuvyāptā iti kṛmijagdhāḥ, vahnivyāptā dāvāgnidagdhāḥ, himavyāptāstuṣārābhivyāptāḥ | oṣadhya iti bahuvacanenātra puṣpaphalamūlatvaksāraniryāsādayo boddhavyāḥ || 58 || Gū. valmīkakutsitānūpaśmaśānoṣaramārgajāḥ jantuvahnihimavyāptāścauṣadhyaḥ kāryasiddhidā na | valmīkajaṃ tu mṛṇmayaṃ, jalaprāyamānūpaḥ | sugamamanyat || 58 || śaradyakhilakāryārthaṃ grāhyaṃ sarasamauṣadham | virekavamanārthaṃ ca vasantānte samāharet || 59 || Dī. idānīmṛtuviśeṣeṇa virekavamanārthamapidravyāharaṇakālamāha - śaradīti | śaradi śaratkāle akhilakāryārthaṃ sakalaprayoganimittaṃ grāhyam | vasantānte grīṣmakāle samāharedgṛhṇīyādityarthaḥ | yadyapi akhilakāryagrahaṇenāpi virekavamanamapi prāptameva tathāpi vākyānāṃ dvaividhyena sāmānyaviśiṣṭatvaṃ darśitamiti na doṣo 'khilagrahaṇena | tathāca ‘grīṣme mañjarikāgreṣu varṣāsu dalacarmaṇī | vasante mūlamāśritya vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca rasasya ca’ || 59 || Gū. śaradi akhilakāryārthaṃ sarvakāryārthaṃ sarasam auṣadhaṃ grāhyam | virekavamanārthaṃ vasantānte vasantamadhye samāharet ||59|| atisthūlajaṭā yāḥ syustāsāṃ grāhyāstvaco budhaiḥ | gṛhṇīyātsūkṣmamūlāni sakalānyapi buddhimān ||60|| nyagrodhādestvaco grāhyāḥ sāraḥ syādbījakāditaḥ | tālīsādeśca patrāṇi phalaṃ syāttriphalāditaḥ || 61 || dhātakyādeśca puṣpāṇi snuhyādeḥ kṣīramāharet | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ pūrvakhaṇḍe paribhāṣā nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ||1|| Dī. athānuktāvayavānāṃ dravyāṇāmaṅgagrahaṇamāha - atisthūleti | yā oṣadhyaḥ atisthūlajaṭāḥ pṛthutaramūlāḥ tāsāmoṣadhīnāṃ tvaco valkalā grāhyāḥ, tāśca vaṭanimbāmraprabhṛtayaḥ | dhruvamiti niścayena | yāni sūkṣmamūlāni dravyāṇi tānyapi sakalāni gṛhṇīyāt, buddhimāniti sadvaidyaḥ | sūkṣmamūlāni gokṣurakaṇṭakāriprabhṛtīni | sakalānīti mūlapatrapuṣpaśākhānvitānītyarthaḥ | ‘atisthūlajaṭāyāḥ syu’riti kecit paṭhanti | tatrātisthūlajaṭānāṃ tvaco grāhyā iti daśamūlapakṣe pracāraḥ || atha dravyāṇāṃ prasiddhāṅgāharaṇatvena viśeṣamāha - nyagrodhāderiti | nyagrodhāderityanena viśeṣo darśitaḥ, nyagrodho vaṭavṛkṣastadāderdravyasyānuktatvāt tvaco valkalā grāhyāḥ, ādiśabdāt plakṣāmrajambūkapītanakāśvatthaprabhṛtayaḥ | bījakādita iti | bījako vijayāsāro vṛkṣaviśeṣastadāditastatprabhṛteḥ sāro madhyasthitaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣo grāhyaḥ, ādiśabdāt khadirāsanabandhūkavavvūlādīnāṃ grahaṇam | tālīsāderiti tālīsaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ tadādestatpūrvakāt patrāṇi palāśāni grāhyāṇi ādigrahaṇāt patrakakaumārīnāgavallīpatraśākādayaḥ | triphalādita iti triphalā prasiddhā | tadāditastatprabhṛteḥ phalaṃ grāhyam ādigrahaṇāt priyaṅgukaṅkolamadanaphalādayaḥ | tālīsādeśceti | cakārādanuktānyapi puṣpaniryāsaśuṅgādīnyanumānato boddhavyāni || 60 || 61 || iti śrīvātsavyanvayāprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ prathamakhaṇḍe paribhāṣā nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || Gū. yā auṣadhyaḥ atisthūlajaṭāḥ syurdhruvamiti niścayena tāsāṃ tvaco grāhyāḥ | buddhimānpumān sūkṣmamūlāni auṣadhāni gṛhṇīyādityarthaḥ | nyagrodhādeḥ sthūlavṛkṣasya tvaco grāhyāḥ bījakāditaḥ vijayasārakhadirādeḥ sāraḥ syāt triphalāditaḥ phalaṃ syāt ādiśabdājjātīphalakaṭphalādayo 'pi || 60 || 61 || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne paribhāṣādhyāyaḥ prathamaḥ || 1 || Editor's notes 1 ‘'bhito namaḥ’ iti pā.; ↩ 2 ‘vighnabhūtā ityatrābhūtatadbhāve cvirna sambhavati, rogāṇāmutpattita eva vighnasvarūpatvenāvighnasvarūpatvābhāvāt’ iti gaṅgādharaḥ; ↩ 3 ‘dravāderdviguṇaṃ matam’ pā. | ↩ 4 vandhanīdhṛtapāṭho nāsti ‘kha’ pustake | ↩ 5 dravyāṇāṃ gurulaghutvāttaratamābhyāṃ tato'pyasaṃbhavādidaṃ kuḍavabhāṇḍaṃ samadravadravyārthaṃ boddhavyam | vastutastu ‘ārdradravyasya kuḍavaḥ palairaṣṭābhireva ca | śuṣkadravyacatuṣkeṇa kuḍavaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ’ iti hārītoktamihāpi smartavyam || ↩ 6 svakalpita ityartha:| kvacittu yogasyaiva mahimajñāpanārthaṃ nāmāntaraṃ kalpitaṃ bhavati | yathā sudarśanacakravajjvareṣu cūrṇamiti luptomā etena lehatailarasādiṣu na doṣa: | ↩ 7 ‘mādimadhyottaram’ pā. | ↩ 8 ādiśabdena pittakaphagrahaṇam| ↩ 9 mānamiti mūlapāṭhaṃ tyaktvā sāmeti śodhanaṃ kalikātāmudrakāṇāṃ pāṇḍityamūlakam | ↩ 10 iyaṃ ṭippaṇirdvādaśe pṛṣṭhe draṣṭavyā | ↩ 11 ‘tasyāstulitena pā. | ↩ 12 ‘prāhurmānavido janāḥ’ pā. | ↩ 13 ‘vāsānimbapaṭolaketakabalākṛṣmāṇḍakendrīvarī varṣābhukuṭajāśca kandasahitā: sāpūtigndhāmṛatā: | aindrīnāgabalākuraṇṭakapuraśchamṛtā sarvadā sādro eva tu na kvacidviguṇitā: kāryeṣu yojyā budhai: ||’ iti bhāvamiśroktamapīha dhyeyam || ↩ 14 dīpikāmate prakṣiptamidam| ↩ 15 ‘kuṭaiyā’ pā. | ↩ 16 ‘ato’ iti vardhitaṃ kalikātānivāsibhiḥ | ↩ 17 prakṣiptamidam| ↩ 18 kalikātāmudritapustake ‘kāla’ iti | ↩ 19 ata evākallakasya saptavarṣaparyantamapi guṇā na hīyante | ↩ 20 ‘cavika’ pā. | ↩ 21 ‘kālā.’ pā.| ↩ 22 ‘rahitā’ pā.| ↩ 23 ‘sādhikāḥ’ pā. | ↩

title: 2. atha bhaiṣajyākhyānakādhyāyaḥ
text: atha bhaiṣajyākhyānakādhyāyaḥ | bhaiṣajyamabhyavaharetprabhāte prāyaśo budhaḥ | kaṣāyāṃśca viśeṣeṇa tatra bhedastu darśitaḥ || 1 || Dī. pūrvamuktaṃ ‘bhaiṣajyākhyānakaṃ tathā’ iti, idānīṃ taddarśayannāha -bhaiṣajyasya ākhyānakaṃ bhakṣaṇakālādikathanam – tadadhikṛtyāha - bhaiṣajyamiti | budho bhaiṣajyaṃ prāyaśo bāhulyena prabhāte abhyavaharet bhakṣayedityarthaḥ | bhiṣajā saṃstutaṃ dravyaṃ bhaiṣajyam | budha ityanena auṣadhakālān vīkṣya svabuddhyā śīlayedityarthaḥ | nātra prabhātameva sarveṣāṃ niyatakālam | ata eva vakṣyante atraiva viśeṣāḥ | yathā - kaṣāyāṃśca viśeṣeṇeti | viśeṣagrahaṇena kaṣāyān prātarevābhyavaharet nānyatra | kaṣāyāniti bahuvacanena svarasādayaḥ pañcakaṣāyasaṃjñakā jñātavyāḥ, tadyathā - ‘svarasaḥ kalpaniryūhau himaphāṇṭau ca viśrutāḥ’ iti | tatra auṣadhabhakṣaṇe bhedaḥ kālabhedo darśitaḥ kathita ityarthaḥ | vakṣyamāṇa iti śeṣaḥ || 1 || Gū. prāyaśo bāhulyena prabhāte bhaiṣajyam avaharet prayojayet viśeṣataḥ kaṣāyāṃśca prayojayet | tatra bhedastu darśitaḥ ‘kālenukte prabhātaṃ syā’dityatra || 1 || jñeyaḥ pañcavidhaḥ kālo bhaiṣajyagrahaṇe nṛṇām | kiñcitsūryodaye jāte tathā divasabhojane || 2 || sāyantane bhojane ca muhuścāpi tathā niśi | Dī. idānīṃ tadbhedamāha - jñeya iti | bhaiṣajyagrahaṇe auṣadhabhakṣaṇanimitte nṛṇāṃ pañcavidhaḥ pañcaprakāraḥ kālaḥ samayo jñeyaḥ | etaccātipātivyādhiṣu na kālaniyama ityeke bhāṣante, yataḥ ‘atipātiṣu rogeṣu necchedvidhimimaṃ bhiṣak | pradīptāgāravacchīghraṃ tataḥ kuryāt pratikriyām’ iti | satyaṃ, tathāpi kartavyametat | atha pañcaprakārānāha – kiñciditi | tatra kiṃcit sūryodaye jāte sati ekaḥ kālaḥ, sa tu prāyaśaḥ kaṣāyārthamādau pratipāditaḥ; ‘kaṣāyārthaṃ viśeṣeṇa’ iti vacanāt | dvitīyastu divasabhojane bheṣajakālaḥ sa pañcavidho bhavati | bhojanāgre yathā lavaṇārdrakaṃ bhojanamiśraṃ yathā hiṅgughṛtādikaṃ, bhojanamadhye yathā pānīyādikaṃ, bhojanānte yathā lavaṅgaharītakyādi bhojanapūrvānte ceti yathā dhātrīlohamalapitte | tṛtīyakālastu sandhyāsamayabhojane jñeyaḥ, so 'pi trividhaḥ grāse grāsāntare bhuktānte ceti sa cānumānato boddhavyaḥ | caturthakālastu vāraṃvāraṃ kathitaḥ, sa dvividhaḥ, tatra dravyaṃ sānnaṃ nirannaṃ ceti | pañcamaḥ kālastu niśi rātrau boddhavyaḥ||2|| Gū. atha pañcavidhakālaḥ - tamāha - nṛṇāṃ bhaiṣajyagrahaṇe bhakṣaṇārthe pañcavidhaḥ kālo jñeyaḥ - kiñcitsūryodaye jāte prathamakālo jñeyaḥ | tathā tena prakāreṇa divasabhojanena madhyāhne dvitīyaḥ kālo jñeyaḥ | ca punaḥ sāyantane bhojane tṛtīyaprahare tṛtīyaḥ kālo jñeyaḥ | muhuḥ ko 'rthaḥ - caturthaprahare caturthaḥ kālo jñeyaḥ | atra muhuravyayam | caturthapraharārdhe darśitaḥ | niśi sandhyāyāṃ pañcamaḥ kālo jñeyaḥ | iti pañcakālānāmanukramaṇikā || 2 || prāyaḥ pittakaphodreke virekavamanārthayoḥ || 3 || lekhanārthaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ prabhāte tatsamāharet | evaṃ syātprathamaḥ kālo bhaiṣajyagrahaṇe nṛṇām || 4 || Dī. atha teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ viśeṣavivaraṇamāha - prāya iti | pittakaphodreke sati virekavamanārthayoḥ dravyaṃ prabhāte bhakṣayedityabhiprāyaḥ | yathā pittodreke virekaḥ kaphodreke vamanam iti | udreko doṣotkaṭaḥ | anyathā asmin kāle 'pi vamanavirekayorna niṣedhaḥ | tathāhi ‘sadyobhuktasya vā jāte jvare sāme viśeṣataḥ | vamanaṃ vamanārhasya śastamityāha vāgbhaṭaḥ’ ityādivacanāt | vamanātiyogena virekaṃ mṛdu kārayet ityapi na kevalaṃ vamanavirekanimittam | lekhanārthaṃ ca prātareva lekhanaṃ pattalīkaraṇaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ doṣāṇāṃ ca | puruṣāṇāṃ yathāsthūlasya madhvambunā, doṣāṇāṃ yathā - vāyostailaṃ, pittasya ghṛtaṃ, kaphasya madhu iti | evamiti parisamāptaḥ prathamaḥ kālaḥ || 3-4 || Gū. atha prathamakālaḥ | prāyaḥ atiśayena kaphodreke pittakaphādhikye virekavamanārthayoḥ, ca punaḥ lekhanārthe kṛśīkaraṇārthe medorogādau dantadhāvanārthe ca | tatra bhaiṣajyaṃ prabhāte samāharet bhakṣayedityarthaḥ | evam, amunā prakāreṇa bhaiṣajyagrahaṇe prathamaḥ kālaḥ syāt iti prathamaḥ || 3 || 4 || bhaiṣajyaṃ viguṇe 'pāne bhojanāgre praśasyate | arucau citrabhojyaiśca miśraṃ ruciramāharet || 5 || samānavāte viguṇe mande 'gnāvagnidīpanam | dadyādbhojanamadhye ca bhaiṣajyaṃ kuśalo bhiṣak || 6 || vyānakope ca bhaiṣajyaṃ bhojanānte samāharet | hikkākṣepakakampeṣu pūrvamante ca bhojanāt || 7 || evaṃ dvitīyakālaśca prokto bhaiṣajyakarmaṇi | Dī. atha dvitīyakālamāha - bhaiṣajyamiti | apāne gudasthite vāte viguṇe kruddhe bhojanāgre bhuktādau bhakṣayedbhaiṣajyamiti śeṣaḥ | arucau satyāṃ citrabhojyairmanojñavyañjanādikaiḥ saha miśraṃ militaṃ ruciraṃ rucikaraṃ yathā syāttathā bhakṣayedbhaiṣajyamiti pūrvavanmantavyam | samānavāte nābhisthite vāyau viguṇe prakupite satyagnimāndye 'pi ca agnidīpanamagnikaraṃ dravyaṃ bhojanamadhye dadyādityarthaḥ | tathā hikkākṣepakakampeṣu satsu bhojanasya pūrvamante ca dadyāt | ākṣepako vātaroge paṭhitaḥ, kampo 'pi vātaroge || 5-7 || Gū. apāne gudasthe vāyau viguṇe sati bhaiṣajyaṃ madhyāhne bhojanāgre bhojanādau praśasyate yujyate | dvitīye kāle madhyāhne iti sarvatraiva yojyam | arucau satyāṃ citrabhojyaiḥ saha ruciram auṣadhaṃ miśram annayuktaṃ yathā syāttathā āharet prayojayet | citrabhojyaiḥ nānāvyañjanaiḥ, samānavāte nābhisthe vāyau, mande 'gnau ca sati agnidīpanabhaiṣajyaṃ kuśalo bhiṣak bhojanamadhye dadyāt| kuśalo bhiṣak vaidyakaśāstre nipuṇaḥ | vyānakope sarvaśarīrasthe vāyau kupite sati bhaiṣajyamauṣadhaṃ bhojanānte bhojanamadhye samāharedyojayet| hikkākṣepakakampeṣvadhikeṣu satsu bhojanātpūrvaṃ ante ca bhaiṣajyaṃ yojayediti śeṣaḥ | ākṣepakaḥ vāyuḥ | evamamunā prakāreṇa dvitīyaḥ kālaḥ bhaiṣajyakarmaṇi proktaḥ || 5-7 || udāne kupite vāte svarabhaṅgādikāriṇi || 8 || grāse grāsāntare deyaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ sāndhyabhojane | prāṇe praduṣṭe sāndhyasya bhuktasyānte ca dīyate || 9 || auṣadhaṃ prāyaśo dhīraiḥ kālo 'yaṃ syāttṛtīyakaḥ | Dī. atha tṛtīyakālamāha - udāne iti | udāne kaṇṭhasthite vāte kupite, kathaṃbhūte svarabhaṅgādikāriṇi, svarabhaṅgo vikṛtasvaratvaṃ mūkatvaṃ vā, ādigrahaṇāt kaṇṭhagatarogāṇāṃ grahaṇam | sāndhyabhojane sandhyāsamayabhojane 'gre grāse kavale grāsāntare kavalayormadhye bheṣajyaṃ deyamityabhiprāyaḥ | tathā prāṇe hṛdayasthite prāṇavāte praduṣṭe sati sāndhyasya bhuktasyāhārasya ante prānte auṣadhaṃ deyamityarthaḥ | dhīrairiti gambhīrabuddhibhiḥ puruṣaiḥ | ayaṃ tṛtīyaḥ kālaḥ syājjānīyāt | nanu kathaṃ vāyoḥ prāṇādayaḥ pañcabhedā darśitāḥ pittakaphayostu nodāhṛtāḥ? ucyate - anilastu doṣadhātumalādīnāṃ pradhānatamaḥ prakopakāraṇahetuśca ata evāsya prakopeṇa pittakaphayoḥ prakopa eva ‘ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvāneva prakopayet’ iti vacanāt | anyadapi ‘svayambhūreṣa bhagavān vāyurityabhiśabditaḥ | acintyavīryo doṣāṇāṃ netā rogasamūharāṭ’ ||8-9 || Gū. udāne kaṇṭhasthe vāyau kupite sāndhyabhojane tṛtīyaprahare bhaiṣajyaṃ grāsagrāsāntare deyam | bhūte udāne svarabhaṅgādikāraṇaṃ śīlaṃ yasya tasmin hṛdisthe prāṇavāte praduṣṭe sati sāndhyasya bhuktasyānte tṛtīyapraharamadhye dhīraiḥ prāyaśo bāhulyena auṣadhaṃ dīyate | ityayaṃ tṛtīyaḥ kālaḥ syāt | iti tṛtīyakālaḥ || 8 || 9 || muhurmuhuśca tṛṭchardihikkāśvāsagareṣu ca || 10 || sānnaṃ ca bheṣajaṃ dadyāditi kālaścaturthakaḥ | Dī. atha caturthakālamāha -muhurmuhurityādi | tṛḍādiṣu satsu muhurmuhurvāraṃvāraṃ sānnamiti bhaktamiśritaṃ dravyaṃ dadyāt | cakārāt kvacinnirannavyavahārānna doṣaḥ | tṛṭ tṛṣṇā, garamatra viṣam | iti caturthaḥ kālaḥ || 10 || Gū. muhusturye prahare ko 'rthaḥ | punaḥ tṛṭchardihikkāśvāsagareṣu sānnaṃ bheṣajam | tṛṭ tṛṣṇā, garaṃ viṣam | iti caturthaḥ ||10|| ūrdhvajatruvikāreṣu lekhane bṛṃhaṇe tathā || 11 || pācanaṃ śamanaṃ deyamanannaṃ bheṣajaṃ niśi | iti pañcamakālaḥ syāt prokto bhaiṣajyakarmaṇi||12|| Dī. atha pañcamakālamāha - ūrdhveti | rātrau pācanaśamanarūpamauṣadhaṃ cānnarahitaṃ deyamiti bhāvaḥ | kutra ? ūrdhvajatruvikāreṣu tathā lekhane bṛṃhaṇe ca jatru grīvāmūlaṃ, tadūrdhvavikārāḥ śirorogādayaḥ | tathāca - ‘ūrdhvajatrujaroge tu sāyaṃ syādavalehikā’ ityādivacanāt lekhanaṃ pravṛddharogāṇāṃ hrasvānāṃ bṛṃhaṇamiti kṣīṇadoṣavardhanamiti bhāvaḥ | niśīti sāmānyena sakalarātrāvityeke bhāṣante, saṃpradāne tu prathamaṃ yāmaṃ varamityarthaḥ | ‘iti pañcamakālaḥ syāt’| ityasya sthāne ‘ityevaṃ pañcamaḥ kālaḥ’ pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | bhaiṣajyahetave dravyabhakṣaṇanimitte ityevaṃ pañcamaḥ kālaḥ kathitaḥ || 11 || 12 || Gū. ūrdhvajatruvikāreṣu satsu tathā karaṇīye lekhane bṛṃhaṇe 'rthe pācanaṃ dravyaṃ sthānānmalasañcayamūrdhvamadho vā yannayettacchamanam ityayaṃ bhaiṣajyahetave pañcamakālaḥ proktaḥ | iti pañcamakālaḥ || 11 || 12 || dravye raso guṇo vīryaṃ vipākaḥ śaktireva ca | saṃbandhena kramādetāḥ pañcāvasthāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||13|| rasaḥ - madhuro 'mlaḥ paṭuścaiva kaṭutiktakaṣāyakāḥ | ityete ṣaḍrasāḥ khyātā nānādravyasamāśritāḥ||14|| dharāmbukṣmānalajalajvalanākāśamārutaiḥ | vāyvagnikṣmānilairbhūtadvayai rasabhavaḥ kramāt || 15 || guṇāḥ - guruḥ snigdhaśca tīkṣṇaśca rūkṣo laghuriti kramāt | dharāmbuvahnipavanavyomnāṃ prāyo guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||16|| eṣvevāntarbhavantyanye guṇeṣu guṇasañcayāḥ | vīryam - vīryamuṣṇaṃ tathā śītaṃ prāyaśo dravyasaṃśrayam ||1 7|| tatsarvamagnīṣomīyaṃ dṛśyate bhuvanatraye | atraivāntarbhaviṣyanti vīryāṇyanyāni yānyapi||18|| vipākaḥ - tridhā vipāko dravyasya svādvamlakaṭukātmakaḥ | miṣṭaḥ paṭuśca madhuramamlo 'mlaṃ pacyate rasaḥ || 19 || kaṣāyakaṭutiktānāṃ pākaḥ syātprāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ | madhurājjāyate śleṣmā pittamamlācca jāyate || 20 || kaṭukājjāyate vāyuḥ karmāṇīti vipākataḥ | prabhāvaḥ - prabhāvastu yathā dhātrī lakucasya rasādibhiḥ || 21 || samāpi kurute doṣaṃ niyatasya vināśanam | kvacittu kevalaṃ dravyaṃ karma kuryātprabhāvataḥ || 22 || jvaraṃ hanti śirobaddhā sahadevījaṭā yathā | kvacidraso guṇo vīryaṃ vipākaḥ śaktireva ca ||23|| karma svaṃ svaṃ prakurvanti dravyamāśritya ye sthitāḥ | Dī. idānīṃ dravye rasādīnāṃ viśeṣāvasthāmāha - dravya iti | dravye pradhānabhūte rasādayaḥ pañcā 'vasthāḥ kathitāḥ, saṃbandhena kramāditi jñānakramāt, tāśca rasaguṇavīryavipākaprabhāvādayo rasāḥ ṣaṭ madhurādayaste tu madhurāmlalavaṇatiktoṣaṇakaṣāyāḥ | guṇā viṃśatiḥ - te yathā-guru-manda-hima-snigdha-ślakṣṇa-sāndra-mṛdu-sthira-sūkṣma-viśadā iti daśa; viparyayāstu - laghu-tīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣakharadravakaṭhinasarasthūlapicchilāḥ; evaṃ viṃśatiguṇāḥ kathitāḥ | vīryamiti dvividhaṃ śītamuṣṇaṃ ceti| kecidaṣṭavidhamāhuḥ - śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣaviśadapicchilamṛdu tīkṣṇaṃ ceti, yataḥ - ‘vīryasaṃjñā guṇā hyete te 'pi dravyāśrayā matāḥ’ iti vacanāt| vipākastu trividhaḥ svādvamlakaṭukātmaka iti | kecidgurulaghudvāreṇa dvividhamāhuḥ | tatra madhuraḥ kaṭukātmakaḥ yato madhurākhyo guruḥ kaṭukākhyo laghuriti | śaktiścācintyaprabhāvo dravyāṇāṃ yathā maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ vidhiḥ | ete 'pi rasādayo dravyāśritā bhavanti tasmāddravyaṃ pradhānamityāhuḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘pāko nāsti vinā vīryādvīryaṃ nāsti vinā rasāt | raso nāsti vinā dravyāddravyaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ smṛtam’ iti | dravyamiti sāmānyagrahaṇena mūlatvaksāraniryāsādīnyabhidhīyante | tadyathā - ‘mūlatvaksāraniryāsanālasvarasapallavāḥ | kṣīraṃ kṣāraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ bhasma tailāni kaṇṭakam || patrāṇi śṛṅgakandāni prarohāstūdbhidādayaḥ | dravyaśabdena gṛhyante jaṅgamāḥ pārthivāstathā ||’ iti | jaṅgamā api yathā - ‘madhūni gorasāḥ pittaṃ vasā majjā 'sṛgāmiṣam | viṇmūtracarmareto 'sthi snāyuśṛṅganakhaṃ khurāḥ || jaṅgamebhyaḥ prayujyante keśā lomāni rocanāḥ’ iti | pārthivāśca yathā - ‘suvarṇaṃ samalāḥ pañca lohāśceti kalāsu ca | manaḥ śilāle maṇayo lavaṇaṃ gairikāñjanam’ ityādi || atha teṣāṃ rasādīnāṃ svarūpamāha - madhura iti | madhurādayaḥ ṣaḍrasā dravyāśritāḥ santo 'pi vyākhyātā eva | tatra madhuro ghṛtaguḍādiḥ, amlo amlīkāmātuluṅgādiḥ, paṭurlavaṇaparyāyaḥ sa ca saindhavādiḥ, kaṭuko marīcādiḥ, tikto nimbādiḥ, kaṣāyo harītakyādiḥ || eteṣāṃ mūrtīnāmutpattimāha - dharetyādi | utpatistu bhūtadvayena bhavati | bhūtaṃ pṛthivyādi | kramāditi yuktakrameṇa tadyathā - dharāmbubhyāṃ madhuro rasaḥ, tena pṛthivyambubāhulyena madhurarasa utpadyate, evaṃ kṣmā 'nalābhyāmamlaḥ, jalajvalanābhyāṃ lavaṇaḥ, ākāśamarudbhyāṃ kaṭukaḥ, vāyvagnibhyāṃ tiktaḥ, kṣmā 'nilābhyāṃ kaṣāya iti rasaḥ || atha guṇāḥ - gururiti | gurusnigdhādayo guṇāḥ kramāt dharādīnāṃ kathitāḥ | kramo yathā - dharāyā guruḥ, ambunaḥ snigdhaḥ, vahnestīkṣṇaḥ, pavanasya rūkṣaḥ, vyomno laghuriti | prāya iti prāyeṇa ete 'tra mukhyā guṇā guṇānāṃ madhye kathitāḥ | pañcaguṇagrahaṇaṃ bhūtakrameṇa kṛtam | eṣveva pañcaguṇeṣu anyo 'pi ślakṣṇasāndramṛduprabhṛtiguṇasaṃcayo boddhavyaḥ | sa cāpyanumānato nirūpaṇīyaḥ | guṇā iti bahuvacanatvena vyavāyī vikāsī cākarau dvau dvāviṃśatyarthamiti kecit, satvaṃ rajastamaśceti trayo mahāguṇāḥ kathitā iti kaiścit || atha vīryam - vīryamiti śaktiḥ | taddvividhamapi prāyaśo bāhulyena dravyāśrayaṃ dravyādhīnaṃ bhavati | dvividhaṃ śītoṣṇabhedena | yasmādbhuvanatrayamagnyātmakaṃ somātmakaṃ ca dṛśyate | atraiva śītoṣṇavīrye anyāni yāni vīryāṇi tānyantarbhaviṣyantīti kecit vadanti na svamatam, yataḥ prāyaśa iti grahaṇena śītoṣṇaṃ viśiṣṭavīryam | anyānīti snigdharūkṣaviśadapicchilamṛdutīkṣṇādīni mahābhūtāni tu kṣmāmbujvalanākāśamarutaḥ || atha vipākamāha - miṣṭa iti | prāyaśo bāhulyenātra trividha eva vipākaḥ madhuro 'mlaḥ kaṭuka iti | viśiṣṭo pāko vipākastatra miṣṭo madhuraḥ paṭurlavaṇa etayormadhura iti madhuravipāka ityabhiprāyaḥ | amlo 'mlamiti | amlo rasaḥ amlameva pacyate | kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ rasānāṃ kaṭuriti kaṭukavipākaḥ syāt | etadabhiprāyeṇa tantrāntare coktam ‘tridhā vipāko dravyasya svādvamlakaṭukātmakaḥ’ iti | ata eva vipākānāṃ trividhaṃ karma bhavati | tadāha -madhurādityādi | madhurānmadhuravipākāt śleṣmā prajāyate prakopamāpadyate ityarthaḥ | amlāccetyamlavipākāt pittamiti | kaṭukāditi kaṭukavipākādvāyuriti | etāni karmāṇi yat kurvanti tat karma, karmaśabdenātra doṣaprakopavyāpāralakṣaṇaṃ dharma iti || idānīṃ prabhāvamāha - prabhāva iti | viśiṣṭo bhāva utkṛṣṭā śaktirityarthaḥ | yathā dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ rasādibhiriti rasaguṇavīryavipākādibhiḥ samā samānaguṇā laghurapyasti tathāpi tadevāmalakīphalaṃ prabhāvāddoṣatrayanāśanaṃ niyatameva | iti rasādiprabhāvaḥ || kevalaṃ dravyaprabhāvamāha - kvacidityādi | kutrāpi kevalamekadravyameva prabhāvataḥ karma kuryāt | yathā sahadevījaṭā śirobaddhā satī jvaraṃ hantīti | ata evācintyo maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ prabhāva iti viśrutiḥ | eke ‘prabhāvastu yathā dhātrīlakucasya rasādibhiri’ti paṭhanti | tatra lakucaphalasya rasādibhiḥ saha dhātrī samānadharmā, tatrāpi dhātrī prabhāvādeva doṣatrayanāśinī bhavati | lakucaphalam - lakucaḥ kṣudrapanasaḥ, nāraṅgaphalamityeke || 13-23 || atha dravyāśritānāṃ rasādīnāṃ nijotkṛṣṭatāmāha - kvaciditi | dravyamāśritya sthitā ye rasādayaste svaṃ svaṃ karma kurvanti | kvacidrasa iti yathā - tiktā guḍūcī uṣṇavīryāpi pittaṃ śamayati | kvacidguṇo yathā - kaṭukaṃ mūlakaṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ ca vardhayati snigdhaguṇatvāt | kvacidvīryamiti yathā - mahatpañcamūlaṃ kaṣāyaṃ tiktānurasaṃ vātaṃ śamayati uṣṇavīryatvāt | nanu guṇavīryayoḥ ko bhedaḥ? ucyate, ya eva guṇā dhātrīphale ta eva harītakyāṃ santi | vīrye viśeṣo 'sti yataḥ uṣṇavīryā harītakīṃ śītavīryaṃ dhātrīphalamiti, tasmādbhinnatvaṃ pratipāditamiti na doṣaḥ | kvacidvipāka iti yaddravyaṃ pariṇāmakāle svābhāvikaṃ rasaṃ parityajya rasāntaraṃ bhajate tatra vipāketi saṃjñā, yathā śuṇṭhī kaṭukāpi vātaṃ śamayati madhurapākatvāt | kvacit śaktiriti | yathā śaktitaḥ prabhāvataḥ yato rasaguṇavīryavipākairyat karma kartuṃ na śakyate tatkarma kurvan prabhāva iti saṃjñā, yathā khadiraḥ kuṣṭhaṃ hanti | ata evāha suśrutaḥ - ‘amīmāṃsyānyacintyāni prasiddhāni svabhāvataḥ | āgamenopayojyāni bheṣajāni vicakṣaiṇaiḥ’ || iti dravyādikathanam || 13-23 || Gū. natā rasādayaḥ pañcāvasthāḥ sambandhena dravye prakīrtitāḥ | sambandhena tatkāryānusandhānena dravye rasaḥ dravye guṇaḥ dravye vīryaṃ śītoṣṇādike dravye 'pi pākaḥ vigataḥ vikāraṃ prāptaḥ rasādipākaḥ vipākadravye śaktiḥ | śaktiḥ prabhāvaḥ sarvaṃ rasādikaṃ dravye tiṣṭhatīti | tasmāddravyaṃ pradhānam | nanu rasādikaṃ vihāya dravyamiti pradhānaṃ kriyate | kecidācāryā bruvate - dravyaṃ pradhānameva kasmādvyavasthitatvāt | iha khalu dravyaṃ vyavasthitaṃ na rasādayaḥ | yathā āme phale rasādayaste pakve na santi nityatvācca | nityaṃ hi dravyamanityā guṇāḥ, yathā pārthivaṃ dravyaṃ na rasādaya āśrayatvācca | dravyamāśritā rasādayo bhavanti ārambhasāmarthyācca dravyāśrita ārambhaḥ yathā vidāryaśvagandhādīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ kvāthanārthe kuṭṭanapācanādikarasārambhaḥ kriyate na tathā rasādiṣvārambhaḥ | śāstre hi dravyaṃ pradhānamuddeśe hi yogānāṃ yathā mātuluṅgāgnimanthau ceti na rasādaya upadiśyante | kramāpekṣitvācca rasādīnām | rasādayo hi dravyādayaḥ sādhyante yathā mahāvṛkṣaḥ kṣīṇo 'pi yasmāddravyaṃ tasmāddravyaṃ pradhānam | dravyalakṣaṇaṃ tu kriyāvadguṇavatsamavāyikāraṇamiti netyāhuḥ - anye rasān pradhānān bruvate | kasmāt | āgamāt | āgamo hi śāstramucyate | śāstre rasādhikatā yathā rasāyatta āhāra iti | tasmiṃśca prāk upadeśāt te rasā yathā madhurāmlalavaṇā vātaṃ śamayanti | anumānācca | rasato hyanumīyate dravyam | yathā madhuramiti ṛṣivacanācca | ṛṣivacanaṃ vedo yathā kiṃcitkriyārthaṃ rasamāharediti | tasmādrasāḥ pradhānam | raseṣu guṇasaṃjñā rasalakṣaṇamanyatrāpi lakṣayāmaḥ | netyāhuḥ | anye vīryaṃ pradhānamiti | kasmādvaṃśenauṣadhaṃ niṣpadyate | ihauṣadhakarmāṇyūrdhvādhobhāgobhayabhāgasaṃśodhanasaṃśamanasaṃgrāhikāgnidīpanapīḍanale khanabṛṃhaṇarasāyanavājīkaraṇaśvayathuharakāraṇavilayanadahanadāraṇamanthanaprāṇaghnaviṣaghnaśamanāni vīryapradhānāni bhavanti | tadvīryaṃ dvividham | uṣṇaṃ śītaṃ ca agnīṣomīyatvājjagataḥ | kecidaṣṭavidhamāhuḥ - uṣṇaṃ śītaṃ snigdhaṃ rūkṣaṃ viśadaṃ picchilaṃ mṛdu tīkṣṇaṃ ceti | etāni vīryāṇi svaguṇotkarṣāt saptabhiḥ bhūryātmakaṃ karma kurvanti | yathā tāvadanantamūlaṃ tiktānurasaṃ vātaṃ śamayatyuṣṇavīryatvāt | madhuraṃ kṣaudraṃ vā tadetannidarśanamātramuktam | bhavanti cātra nacaite karmakāriṇaḥ tasmādvīryaṃ pradhānamiti netyāhuḥ | anye pākapradhānamiti | kasmāt samyagmithyāvipakvatvāt iha sarvadravyāṇyabhāvahṛtāni samyagmithyāvipakvāni guṇaṃ doṣaṃ vā janayanti | tatrāhuḥ - anye pratisaṃpāka iti kecittrividhamicchanti | yathā kṣīramukhāgatamabhipacyamānaṃ madhurameva syāt tathā śāliyavamudgādayaḥ prakīrṇasvabhāvamuttarakāye 'pi na parityajanti tadvaditi kecidvadanti | avalavalopaplavatāṃ vaśamāyāntītyevamanavasthitiḥ | tasmādasiddho na rasaḥ | āgamo hi dvividha eva pāko madhuraḥ kaṭuśca tayormadhurākhyo guruḥ kaṭukākhyo laghuriti | tatra pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśānāṃ dvaividhyaṃ bhavati | guṇasādharmyādgurutā laghutā ca | pṛthivyāpaśca gurvyaḥ śeṣāṇi tu laghūni | tasmāddvividha eva pākaḥ | bhavati cātra dravyeṣu pacyamāneṣvambupṛthivīguṇā nivartante 'dhikastatra pāko madhura ucyate | tejonilākāśaguṇo dravyamāneṣu na nivartate 'dhikastatra pākaḥ kaṭurucyate | pṛthaktvadarśināmeṣa vādināṃ vādasaṃgrahaḥ | caturṇāmapi sāmarthyamittham | tatra vipaścitaḥ tat dravyamātmanā kiṃcidvīryeṇa sahitaṃ kiñcidrasavipākābhyāṃ doṣaṃ hanti karoti vā | kecana śaktiṃ pradhānamāhuḥ | netyāhuranye | dravyameva pradhānam | kutaḥ ‘pāko nāsti vinā vīryaṃ nāsti vīryaṃ vinā rasāt | raso nāsti vinā dravyāt dravyaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ smṛtam||vīryaṃ saṃjñā matāyeṣṭau tepi dravyāśrayāḥ smṛtāḥ | raseṣu na bhavantyete nirguṇāstu guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || dravye dravyāṇi yasmācca vipacyante na ṣaḍrasāḥ || śreṣṭhaṃ dravyamato jñeyaṃ śeṣā bhāvāstadāśrayāḥ ||’ yato dravyaṃ pradhānaṃ tasmādrasādayo dravyeṣu pratiṣṭhitāstānyasmin nānādravyasamāśritā ityete ṣaḍrasāḥ khyātāḥ | ata ūrdhvamutpattiṃ vakṣyāmaḥ dvābhyāṃ bhūtābhyāṃ kramāt rasabhavaḥ rasotpattirdharāmbubhyāṃ madhurarasotpattiḥ, kṣmānalābhyāṃ amlarasotpattiḥ,jalajvalanābhyāṃ kaṭurasotpattiḥ, ākāśamārutābhyāṃ kaṭurasotpattiḥ, vāyvagnibhyāṃ tiktarasotpattiḥ, ambvanilābhyāṃ kaṣāyarasotpattiriti rasotpattiḥ | rasalakṣaṇamata ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | tatra yaḥ purīṣamutpādayati, prahlādayati, tarpayati, jīvayati, mukhamupalepayati, śleṣmāṇaṃ cābhivardhayati, sa madhuro 'pi dantaharṣamutpādayati, mukhasrāvaṃ janayati | sa lavaṇaḥ yo jihvāgraṃ bādhate, udvegaṃ janayati, śiro gṛhṇīte, nāsikāṃ ca srāvayati sa kaṭukaḥ yo galalakṣaṇadoṣamutpādayati, mukhavairasyaṃ janayati | sa tiktaḥ yo vakraṃ pariśoṣayati jihvāṃ stambhayati kaṇṭhaṃ badhnāti hṛdayaṃ karṣayati pīḍayati rasaḥ kaṣāya iti | ataḥ sarvāṇi dravyāṇyupadekṣyāmaḥ | tadyathā kākolyādikṣīraghṛtavasāmajjāśāliṣaṣṭikagodhūmamāṣaśṛṅgāṭakakaserukatrapusairvārukarkārukālābukaliṅgagalaughapriyaṅgupuṣkarabījakāśmaryamadhūkadrākṣākharjūrarājādanatālinālikerekṣuvikārabalātibalātmaguptāvidārīvayasyāgokṣurakajīramocarasamadhūlikākūṣmāṇḍaprabhṛtīni samāsena madhuro vargaḥ | dāḍimāmalakamātuluṅgāmrātakakapitthakara- mardakabadarakolaśacīnāmalakatintiḍīkākośāprabhavyaparevatanetraphalalakucāmlavetasaudadhitakrasurāśuktasauvīrakatuṣodakadhānyāmlaprabhṛtīni samāsena amlo vargaḥ | pippalyādiśigrumadhuśigrumūlakalaśunasusukhaśītaśivakuṣṭhadevadāru hareṇukāvalguphalacaṇḍāguggulumastulāṅgalīśukanāsāpīluprabhṛtīni śālasārādiśca prāyaśaḥ kaṭuko vargaḥ | āragvadhādiguḍūcyādimaṇḍūkaparṇīvetrakarīraharidrādvayendravāruṇasvādukaṇṭakasaptaparṇabṛhatīdvayaṃ śaṅkhinī dravantī- tṛvṛcchatavedhanakarkoṭakakāravellakavartākakaravīrasumanaśaṅkhapuṣpābhārṅgītrāyamāṇakarohiṇīvaijayantīsuvarcalā punarnavā vṛścikālījyotiṣmatīprabhṛtīni samāsena tikto vargaḥ | nyagrodhādi rāsnādi priyaṃgvādi rodhrādi triphalā śallakībījaṃ vāmrabakulatindukaphalāni karakaśākaphalapāṣāṇabhedakavanaspatiśālasārādiśca prāyaśaḥ kurabakādi dārakajīvantikā cillī pālaṅkyā suniṣaṇṇakaprabhṛtīni līvarakādayo mudgādayaśca samāsena kaṣāyo vargaḥ | tatraiṣāṃ rasānāṃ saṃyogastriṣaṣṭiḥ | bhavati cātra ‘bhūtejovārijairdravyaiḥ samaṃ yāti samīraṇaḥ | pittaṃ kṣayamavāpnoti khabhūmijalavāyujaiḥ || khatejo 'nilajaiḥ śleṣmā samameti śarīriṇām | viyatpavanajātābhyāṃ vṛddhimabhyeti mānataḥ || āgneyameva yaddravyaṃ teneyamudīryate | vasudhā jalajātābhyāṃ balāsaḥ parivardhate | evametadguṇādhikyaṃ dravye dravyaṃ viniścitam ||’ iti | rasā dharādharāmbuvahnipavanavyomnāṃ prāya atiśayena kramādguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ | dharāyāṃ guṇā ambuni snigdhaguṇaṃ, vahnau tīkṣṇaguṇaṃ, pavane rūkṣaguṇaṃ, eṣu guṇeṣu antaranye guṇasañcayā bhavanti santītyarthaḥ | pañcabhūtānāṃ guṇāḥ kathitāḥ | iti guṇāḥ | ṛṣayaḥ śītaṃ coṣṇaṃ dvividhaṃ vīryamāhuḥ, evaṃ śītaṃ ekamuṣṇaṃ | kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ vīryaṃ prāyaśaḥ dravyasaṃśrayaṃ prāyaśaḥ atiśayena dravye saṃśrayaṃ sthānaṃ yasya tat | kutaḥ yadyasmātkāraṇādbhuvanatrayamagnīṣomīyaṃ dṛśyate somātmakamagnyātmakaṃ cetyarthaḥ | somātmakaṃ vīryamagnyātmakaṃ rajaḥ, tayorjaṅgamānāmutpattiḥ sthāvarāṇāmutpattau bhāno raśmibhiruṣṇatvādrajoguṇayuktāyāṃ bhuvi satyāṃ somātmakāt śītavīryāt meghānāṃ prāyaśaḥ bhuvi sthāvarāṇāmutpattiḥ | ataḥ jagattritayaṃ somātmakaṃ anyāni vīryāṇi sarvamagniṣomīyaṃ dṛśyante vīryāṇi tānyatraiva agniṣomīye vīryamantarmadhye bhaviṣyantītyabhiprāyaḥ | iti vīryaṃ | miṣṭakaṭutiktānāṃ rasānāṃ pākaḥ prāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ syāt bhavedityarthaḥ | yaduktaṃ - ‘tridhā vipāko dravyasya svādvamlakaṭukātmakaḥ |’ tadāha ‘madhurācchleṣmā jāyate, amlāt pittaṃ jāyate, kaṭukāt vāyuḥ jāyate etāni karmāṇi pākataḥ jāyante iti pākaḥ | prabhāvaṃ vadati | yathā api ni iti niścayena lakucasya rasādibhiḥ samāhitā dhātrīdoṣatrayasya vināśaṃ kurute | anyatprabhāvamāha - kvacitkevalaṃ dravyaṃ prabhāvataḥ karma kuryāt yathā - sahadevījaṭā śirasi baddhā satī jvaraṃ hantīti sugamamanyat | iti prabhāvaḥ | kvacitkasminsthale dravyam āśritya rasādayaḥ sthitāḥ te svaṃ svaṃ karma kurvanti, kvacidrasaḥ svaṃ karma karoti, kvacidguṇaḥ svaṃ karma karoti, kvacidvīryaṃ svaṃ karma karoti, kvacidvipākaḥ svaṃ karma karoti, kvacicchaktiḥ prabhāvaḥ svaṃ karma karoti spaṣṭamanyat | iti dravyaguṇavīryavipākaprabhāvāḥ || 13-23 || cayakopaśamā yasmindoṣāṇāṃ saṃbhavanti hi || 24 || ṛtuṣaṭkaṃ tadākhyātaṃ rave rāśiṣu saṃkramāt | Dī. atha doṣopacayaprakopopaśamān darśayannāha —cayakopaśamā iti | doṣāṇāṃ vātādīnāṃ cayakopaśamā iti cayaḥ sañcayaḥ, sa ca saṃhatirūpā vṛddhiḥ, svasthānavṛddhirityanye | kopaḥ prakopaḥ sa ca pravilayarūpā vṛddhiḥ prakopaḥ | śama ityuparamaḥ | yathāvātapittakaphānāṃ śaraddhemantagrīṣmeṣu yathāsaṃkhyamupaśamaḥ svabhāvata eva | tadṛtuṣaṭkaṃ grīṣmaprāvṛṅvarṣāśaraddhemantavasantākhyamityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha - rave rāśiṣu saṃkramāditi raveḥ sūryasya rāśiṣu meṣādiṣu saṃkramāt praveśādityarthaḥ || 24 || Gū. atha ṣaṭkaṃ yasmin ṛtuṣaṭke doṣāṇāṃ vātapittakaphānāṃ cayakopaśamāḥ saṃbhavanti tadeva ṛtuṣaṭkaṃ rave rāśiṣu saṃkramāt ākhyātam – tadevāha - jīvitamaraṇe ca manuṣyāṇāmāpannetyasūkṣmāṃ kalāmapi na līyate iti kālaḥ, kalayati utpādayati maraṇaṃ nayati vā bhūtānīti kālaḥ | tasya saṃvatsarātmano bhagavānādityo gativiśeṣeṇākṣinimeṣikā kāṣṭhākalāmuhūrtāhorātrapakṣamāsartvayanasaṃvatsarayugapravibhāgaṃ karoti | tatra laghvakṣaroccāramātrokṣinimeṣaḥ, pañcādaśākṣinimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhā,triṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ kalāviṃśatikalo muhūrtaḥ, triṃśanmuhūrtamahorātraṃ, pañcadaśāhorātrāṇi pakṣaḥ, sa ca dvividhaḥ, śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaśca, tau māsaḥ, tatra mārgaśīrṣādayo dvādaśa māsāḥ, dvimāsakamṛtuṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍ ṛtavo bhavati tadevartuṣaṭkam | ete cayakopaśamā eke kevalaprakopāḥ || 24 || grīṣmo meṣavṛṣau proktau prāvṛḍmithunakarkayoḥ || 25 || siṃhakanye smṛtā varṣāstulāvṛścikayoḥ śarat | dhanurgrāhau ca hemanto vasantaḥ kumbhamīnayoḥ || 26 || Dī. idānīmṛtuṣaṭkaṃ rāśidvayena darśayannāha - grīṣma iti | meṣasaṃkrāntiprabhṛti vṛṣasakrāntyavasānaṃ grīṣmaṛtuḥ proktaḥ kathita ityarthaḥ | evaṃ mithunādikarkāntaṃ prāvṛṭ, siṃhādikanyāntaṃ varṣāṛtuḥ, tulādivṛścikāntaṃ śarat, dhanurādigrāhāntaṃ hemantaḥ, grāho makaraḥ, kumbhādimīnāntaṃ vasanta iti | etena rāśidvayena dvimāsikamapi ṛtuṣaṭkaṃ bhavati | taddoṣacayādinimittamabhihitaṃ tattvajñānārtham | yaduktaṃ suśrutena - doṣopacayaprakopopaśamanimittaṃ ‘te tu bhādrapadādyena dvimāsikena varṣādayo vyākhyātāḥ’ yathāyathaṃ saṃkhyātāḥ | ye tu tantrāntare - ‘māsairdvisaṃkhyairmāghādyai’rityādinā śiśiravasantagrīṣmavarṣāśaraddhemantā bhavanti te tu śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇāścandrādityayoḥ kālavibhāgakaratvāccāyananimittāḥ | yataḥ ‘māsarāśisvarūpākhyamṛtau yallakṣaṇatrayami’ti vacanāt | nanu prāvṛḍvarṣayoḥ ko bhedaḥ? ucyate, prathamaḥ pravṛttaḥ kālaḥ prāvṛṭ tasyānubandho varṣā ityatra bhedaḥ | evaṃ ‘śiśire śītamadhikaṃ raukṣyaṃ cādānakālajam’ ityanena śiśirahemantayorapi bhedo 'sti | pūrvamuktaṃ cayakopasamā ṛtavo bhavantīti || tayormadhyamadhye ādau suśrutādiṣvapyuktatvāt kevalaprakope ṛtumāha - te śiśiravasantagrīṣmavarṣāśaraddhemantāḥ teṣāṃ māghaphālgunau śiśiraḥ, caitravaiśākhau vasantaḥ, jyeṣṭhāṣāḍhau grīṣmaḥ, śrāvaṇabhādrapadau varṣā, āśvinakārtikau śarat, mārgapauṣau hemanta iti | ete śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇāścandrādityayoḥ kālavibhāgakaratvāt | ayane dve bhavato dakṣiṇamuttaraṃ ca | tayordakṣiṇaṃ varṣāśaraddhemantāsteṣu bhagavansoma āpyāyate sāmlalavaṇamadhurāśca balavanto bhavanti uttarottaraṃ ca sarvaprāṇināṃ balamabhivardhate | uttaraṃ ca śiśiravasantagrīṣmāsteṣu bhagavānarka āpyāyate tiktakaṭukaṣāyā rasā balavanto bhavanti uttarottaraṃ ca sarvaprāṇināṃ balamapahīyate | bhavati cātra ‘śītāṃśuḥ kledayetpūrvāṃ vivasvān śoṣayatyapi | tāvubhāvapi saṃsṛjya vāyuḥ pālayati prajāḥ ||’ iti | meṣavṛṣau etau dvau rāśī grīṣmaḥ proktaḥ, mithunakarkayoretayordvayo rāśyoḥ prāvṛṭ , siṃhakanye ete dve varṣāḥ smṛtā, tulāvṛścikayoḥ śarat bhavati, dhanurgrāhau dvau hemantaḥ proktaḥ, kumbhamīnayormadhye vasantaḥ proktaḥ | nanu śiśiraṃ vihāya prāvṛṭgrahaṇaṃ kimiti kriyate nahi atra śiśirastu hemante praviṣṭaḥ śleṣmaṇaścayahetutvāt | yadi śiśiraḥ hemante na praviśati tadā śleṣmaṇaścayāt vasantaṃ vihāya kaphasya kopaḥ śiśire syāt | nanvanye 'pi carakādayo granthāḥ santi śiśiraṃ hemante ekīkartuṃ kenāpi na śakyate bhavadbhiḥ kathaṃ kriyate tadatrāsminnāyurveda yatra dvau samavetau bhavataḥ tatra śiśirastu hemante
