prayoktavyaḥ, varṣāprāvṛṣorbhedaḥ kartavyaḥ prathamo varṣākālaḥ prāvṛṭ tadanukaraṇaṃ, tasya prāvṛṣo 'ṅgam | yadāha suśrutaḥ ‘iha tu varṣāśaraddhemantavasantagrīṣmaprāvṛṣaḥ ṣaṭ ṛtavo bhavanti doṣopacayaprakopopaśamanimittaṃ te tu bhādrapadādyena dvimāsikena samākhyātāḥ | yatra cayasamāvetau na staḥ kopa evāsti tatra prāvṛṭ vihāya śiśirasahitāḥ ṣaṭ ṛtavaḥ santi | tadāha granthāntare ‘hemantavarṣāśiśireṣu vāyoḥ pittasya varṣāsu nidāghayośca | kaphasya kopaṃ kusumāgame ca kurvīta yadyasya hitaṃ tadeṣām ||’ atra kathitāyāḥ prāvṛṣaḥ hemante praviṣṭasya śiśirasya sandeho na kāryaḥ || 25 || 26 || grīṣme saṃcīyate vāyuḥ prāvṛṭkāle prakupyati | varṣāsu cīyate pittaṃ śaratkāle prakupyati || 27 || hemante cīyate śleṣmā vasante ca prakupyati | prāyeṇa praśamaṃ yāti svayameva samīraṇaḥ || 28 || śaratkāle vasante ca pittaṃ prāvṛḍṛtau kaphaḥ | kārtikasya dinānyaṣṭāvaṣṭāvāgrayaṇasya ca || 29 || yamadaṃṣṭrā samākhyātā svalpabhukto hi jīvati | Dī. etaccayasāmye kṛtacayakopasamānāha -grīṣme iti | vāyurgrīṣme sañcīyate sañcayamāpadyata ityarthaḥ | evaṃ pittaśleṣmāṇāvapi svasvaṛtuṣu cayakopāvāpadyete | samyaggrahaṇaṃ svasañcayakāraṇārthaṃ boddhavyam, tat sañcayakāraṇaṃ tantrāntarādavagantavyam | tadyathā ‘tā evauṣadhayo nidāghe niḥsārā rūkṣā atimātraṃ laghvyo bhavantyāpaśca, tā upayujyamānāḥ sūryapratāpopaśoṣitadehānāṃ dehināṃ raukṣyāllaghutvādvaiśadyācca vāyoḥ sañcayamāpādayanti’ iti | nanu śītasya vāyoruṣṇe grīṣme sañcayaḥ kathaṃ saṃbhavati ? ucyate - sarveṣu vātaguṇeṣu raukṣyaṃ pradhānaṃ tenauṣadhīnāmatyartharaukṣyeṇa rūkṣasya vāyorgrīṣme sañcayaḥ syādityadoṣaḥ | yadaivaṃ cayayukto bhavati | prāvṛṭkāle prakupyatīti prāvṛṭkāle prāvṛṣi, prakupyatīti praśabdo 'tra prakarṣakāraṇaṃ sūcayati; tadyathā - ‘sa sañcayaḥ prāvṛṣi cātyarthaṃ jalopaklinnāyāṃ bhūmau klinnadehānāṃ dehināṃ śītavātavarṣerito vātikān vyādhīn janayati’ | vāyuḥ prakopamāpadyata iti tātparyārthaḥ | evaṃ pittamapi varṣāyāṃ sañcitaṃ śaratkāle prakupyati | kapho 'pi hemante sañcayamāpadya vasante prakopaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | anayoḥ kāraṇaṃ tantrāntarādavagantavyam | keṣāñcit jñāpanārthaṃ likhyate, yathā - ‘tatra varṣāsvauṣadhayastaruṇyo 'lpavīryā ‘āpaścāprasannāḥ kṣitimalaprāyāstā upayujyamānā bhavanti’ | meghā vasante jalapraklinnāyāṃ bhūmau klinnadehānāṃ prāṇināṃ śītavātaviṣṭambhitāgnīnāṃ vidahyante, vidāhāt pittasañcayamāpādayanti | sa sañcayaḥ śaradi praviralameghe viyatyupaśuṣyati | paṅke arkakiraṇapravilāpitaḥ paittikān vyādhīn janayati | tā evauṣadhayaḥ kālapariṇāmāt pariṇatavīryā balavatyo hemante bhavantyāpaśca prasannāḥ | snigdhā atyarthaṃ gurvyastā atyarthaṃ upayujyamānā mandakiraṇatvādbhānoḥ satuṣārapavanopastambhitadehānāṃ dehināmavidagdhāḥ snehāt śaityāt gauravādupalepācca śleṣmaṇaḥ sañcayamāpādayanti | sa sañcayo vasante 'rkaraśmipravilāpitaḥ īṣat stabdhadehānāṃ dehināṃ ślaiṣmikān vyādhīn janayati’ ityevaṃ doṣāṇāṃ sañcayaprakopau darśitau | nanu doṣāṇāṃ sañciteṣu ṛtuṣu kathaṃ na prakopaḥ? iti | ucyate, śītasya vāyorgrīṣmasyātyuṣṇatvāttasminneva kāle na prakupyanti | (sañcīyamānamapi pittaṃ ṛtuśaityāt tasmin kāle na prakupyati) ṛtvādisvabhāvāt kaphasya sañcīyamānasya himānīvaśāt tadānīṃ styānataiva bhavati na prakopaḥ| vasante ca prakupyati iti cakāragrahaṇenātra sañcayādikamahorātrayorapi jānīyāt | tadyathā - ‘tatra pūrvāhṇe vasantasya liṅgaṃ madhyāhne grīṣmasyāparāhṇe prāvṛṣaḥ pradoṣe vārṣikaṃ śāradamardharātre pratyuṣasi haimantamupalakṣayet’ || atha doṣāṇāmupaśamamāha - prāyeṇetyādi | samīraṇo vāyuḥ śaratkāle svayameva kāraṇaṃ vinā praśamaṃ yāti prāpnoti | svayameveti svabhāvataḥ svalakṣaṇata ityarthaḥ | svalakṣaṇaṃ punareṣāṃ śītoṣṇavarṣādi | evaṃ vasante 'pi pittaṃ, prāvṛṭkāle kapha iti | atra yat śaradvasantaprāvṛṭcayopaśamārthamuktaṃ tadrāśiparivartanāt anyathā tantrāntaravirodhaḥ | prāyeṇetigrahaṇāt doṣajā api vyādhayaḥ praśamaṃ yānti svayameveti suśrutaḥ | tathāhi - ‘tatra paittikānāṃ vyādhīnāmupaśamo hemante, ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ nidāghe, vātikānāṃ ghanātyaye svabhāvata eva’ | atra śītoṣṇavarṣālakṣaṇakālaprabhāvādupaśamaḥ | tasmāt pūrvebhyo na virodhaḥ || 27 || 28 || Gū. vāyuḥ grīṣme cīyate prāvṛṭkāle prakupyati pittaṃ varṣāsu cīyate śaradi prakupyati prakopaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | śleṣmā hemante cīyate vasante prakupyati | śamamāha samīraṇo 'tiśayena śaratkāle svayameva śamaṃ yāti, pittaṃ ca vasante, hemante śamaṃ yāti | kaphaḥ prāvṛṭṝtau śamaṃ yāti | uṣṇaṛtau veti pāṭhe grīṣme śamaṃ yāti | suśrutādibhyo 'pyuktatvāt | yadāha suśrutaḥ - ‘tatra vātikavyādhīnāmupaśamo ghanātyaye, paittikānāṃ vyādhīnāmupaśamo hemante, ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ nidāghe svabhāvāt | ete sañcayaprakopopaśamā vyākhyātāḥ | evamahorātramapi varṣamiva śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇaṃ doṣopacayaprakopopaśamairjānīyāt | tatra pūrvāhṇe vasantasya liṅgaṃ madhyāhne grīṣmasyāparāhṇe prāvṛṣaḥ pradoṣe vārṣikaṃ śāradamardharātre pratyuṣasi haimantikamupalakṣayet || 27 || 28 || cayakopaśamā doṣā vihārāhārasevanaiḥ || 30 || samānairyāntyakāle 'pi viparītairviparyayam | laghurūkṣamitāhārādatiśītācchramāttathā || 31 || pradoṣe kāmaśokābhyāṃ bhīcintārātrijāgaraiḥ | abhighātādapāṃ gāhājjīrṇe 'nne dhātusaṃkṣayāt ||32|| vāyuḥ prakopaṃ yātyebhiḥ pratyanīkaiśca śāmyati | vidāhikaṭukāmloṣṇabhojyairatyuṣṇasevanāt || 33 || madhyāhne kṣuttṛṣo rodhājjīryatyanne 'rdharātrake | pittaṃ prakopaṃ yātyebhiḥ pratyanīkaiśca śāmyati 34 || madhurasnigdhaśītādibhojyairdivasanidrayā | mande 'gnau ca prabhāte ca bhuktamātre tathā 'śramāt || 35|| śleṣmā prakopaṃ yātyebhiḥ pratyanīkaiśca śāmyati || iti dāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ pūrvakhaṇḍe bhaiṣajyākhyānakaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ dravyarasaguṇavipākaprabhāva ṛtuṣaṭkākhyānādhyāyo dvitīyaḥ || Dī. idānīṃ doṣāṇāmakāle 'pi cayādinimittaṃ hetumāha - cayetyādi | doṣā vātādayaḥ samānairvihārāhārasevanaiḥ kṛtvā cayādīn yānti prāpnuvantītyarthaḥ | viparītairasamānaiḥ kṛtvā akāle apraśamaṛtāvapi viparyayaṃ nāśaṃ prāpnuvantītyarthaḥ | samānairiti doṣānurūpakāraṇaiḥ | tadyathā - laghurūkṣaśītādayo vātaguṇasamānāḥ vidāhikaṭukāmloṣṇādayaḥ pittaguṇasamānāḥ, madhurasnigdhaśītādayo 'pi śleṣmaguṇasamānā iti | eṣāṃ viparītairviparyayairyathā - gurusnigdhoṣṇādayo vātaguṇaviparyayāḥ, avidāhimadhuraśītādayaḥ pittaguṇaviparītāḥ, tiktoṣṇarūkṣādayaḥ śleṣmaguṇaviparītā’ iti || atha doṣāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ prakopaśamakāraṇānyāha - laghvityādi | laghvādidhātusaṃkṣayāntaiḥ kāraṇairvāyuḥ prakopaṃ yāti prāpnotītyarthaḥ | eteṣāṃ pratyanīkairviparītaiśca śāmyatītyarthaḥ | āhāraśabdo laghvādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ saṃbadhyate tena laghvāhārāt rūkṣāhārāt mitāhārādityarthaḥ | laghviti pākataḥ, rūkṣam - asnigdhaṃ, mitaṃ svalpaṃ, atiśītādityatiśītasevanāt, atiśramāditi atiśarīrāyāsāt, atiśabdo 'trāpi boddhavyaḥ, pradoṣe rajanīmukhe, kāmaśokābhyāmiti kāmo 'bhilāṣaḥ sa ca strīsaṅkalparūpaḥ abhimatakāminyādyaprāptiriti bhāvaḥ | śoko dhanabandhunāśādinā, bhītirbhayaṃ, kāmaśokabhayādvāyuriti | abhighātaḥ śastralaguḍādīnām, apāṃ gāhādatijalāvagāhāt, atiśabdo 'tra pūrvādanuvartate, jīrṇe 'nne āhāre paripākaṃ gate sati, dhātusaṅkṣayāditi rasādidhātūnāṃ kṣīṇatvāt, yaduktaṃ ‘dhātukṣayātsrute rakte mandaḥ sañjāyate 'balaḥ | pavanaśca paraṃ kopaṃ yāti tasmātprayatnataḥ’ ityādi | pratyanīkairiti laghvādīnāṃ viparyayaiste 'pyanumānato 'vagantavyāḥ || atha pittam | vidāhīti | vidāhibhojyādibhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pittaṃ prakopaṃ yāti | eṣāṃ pratyanīkairviparītaiḥ kṛtvā śāmyatīti | bhojyaśabdo vidāhādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisaṃbadhyate tena vidāhibhojyaiḥ kaṭukabhojyairamlabhojyairuṣṇabhojyairiti | yadvā vidāhīti bhinnārthasūcakaṃ jñeyam | tena vidāhī vaṃśakarīrādi pittakaratvāt | uṣṇabhojanaṃ ca vīryāt sparśādvā | atyuṣṇasevanādityātapāgnīnām | kṣuttṛṣo rodhāditi kṣut kṣudhā tasyā avarodhāt tṛṭ tṛṣā tasyā avarodhāt, avarodho vegadhāraṇam | eke kṣuttṛṣo roṣāditi paṭhanti | tatra kṣuttṛṣorativegāt, roṣāt krodhāt, tathāca ‘krodhāt pittaṃ prakupyati’ iti | pratyanīkairiti vidāhibhojyādīnāṃ viparītairiti sugamam || atha kaphaḥ | madhureti | madhurabhojyādibhiḥ śleṣmā prakopaṃ yāti | eṣāṃ pratyanīkairnāśakaraiḥ śāmyati śāntiṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ | bhojyaśabdo 'trāpi madhurādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate tena madhurabhojyaiḥ snigdhabhojyaiḥ śītādibhojyaiśca | ādiśabdāt guruślakṣṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam | divasanidrayā kaphavṛddhiḥ syāt yataḥ ‘rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ snigdhaṃ prasvapanaṃ divā’ iti vacanāt | aśramāditi avyāyāmāt ‘vyāyāmaḥ kaphanāśanaṃ’ ityukteḥ || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ prathamakhaṇḍe bhaiṣajyākhyānakaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || Gū. doṣā vātapittakaphāścayaprakopaśamā yeṣu tān cayakopaśamān svasvaṛtūn parityajya samānairnirantarairvihārāhārasevanaiḥ akāle 'pi viparyayaṃ yānti | vihāro vāgdehamanonivartitatve viśeṣo vyāyāmajāgaraṇādhyayanādirūpaḥ | āhāro mithyāhāraḥ | yaduktaṃ carake ‘akāle anyadoṣaṛtau viparyayaṃ kopaṃ yāntītyarthaḥ | viparītaistaddhetunāśakartṛbhirupāyaiḥ sāmyaṃ yānti | tadāha - ‘laghurūkṣamitāhārāghātaśītāt śramāttathā |’ pradoṣe laghurūkṣamitāhārādyāti viparītaiḥ taddhetunāśakartṛbhiḥ sāmyaṃ yāti | sugamamanyat | granthāntarāt sāmyakartṛtvamāha - ‘snigdhoṣṇasthiravṛṣyavallavaṇavat svādvamlatailātapasnānābhyañjanabastimāṃsamadirāsaṃvāha- nonmardanam | snehasvedanirūhaṇaṃ ca śayanasnānopanāhādikaṃ pānāhāravihārabheṣajamidaṃ vāyuṃ praśāntiṃ nayet’ ebhiḥ prayogairvāyuḥ sāmyaṃ yāti | ebhirhetubhiḥ pittaṃ prakopaṃ yāti pratyanīkaiḥ śāntikartṛbhirupāyaiḥ śyāmyati| śāntiṃ kartumupāyānāha - ‘tiktasvādukaṣāyaśītapavanacchāyāniśāvījanaṃ jyotsnābhūtagṛhapravāsajalajastrīgātrasaṃsparśanam | sarpiḥkṣīravirecakaiśca rudhirasrāvapradehādikaṃ pānāhāravihārabheṣajamidaṃ pittaṃ praśāntiṃ nayet||’ ebhiḥ prayogaiḥ pittaṃ sāmyaṃ yāti | ebhirhetubhiḥ śleṣmā kopaṃ yāti aśramāt śramarahitāt | sugamamanyat | śītakartṛbhirupāyaiḥ śamaṃ yāti| śleṣmaṇaḥ śāntikartṝnupāyānāha granthāntarāt ‘rūkṣāhārakaṣāyatiktakaṭukavyāyāmaniṣṭhīvanaṃ strīsevādhvaniyuddhajāgarajalakrīḍāpaghātāttathā | dhūmo nasyaśirovirekavamanasvedopavāsādikaṃ pānāhārāvihāra- bheṣajamidaṃ śleṣmāṇamugraṃ jayet’ ebhirupāyairakāle 'pi kupitā doṣāḥ śāmyaṃ yāntītyabhiprāyaḥ || 30-35 || Editor's notes 1 ‘bhaktādau, bhaktamadhye, bhaktānte’ pā. | ↩ 2 saṃvedana pā. | ↩ 3 prakṣiptamidam | ↩

title: 3. atha nāḍīparīkṣādividhiradhyāyaḥ
text: tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ | atha nāḍīparīkṣādividhiradhyāyaḥ | karasyāṅguṣṭhamūle yā dhamanī jīvasākṣiṇī | tacceṣṭayā sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ jñeyaṃ kāyasya paṇḍitaiḥ || 1 || Dī. pūrvamuktaṃ nāḍīparīkṣādividhiriti anantaraṃ nāḍīparīkṣāmāha - atheti - karasyeti | jīvasākṣiṇī yā dhamanī sā karasyāṅguṣṭhamūle 'stīti kriyāpadaṃ yojyaṃ, tacceṣṭayā kṛtvā kāyasya śarīrasya sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca jñeyaṃ paṇḍitairiti śeṣaḥ | dhamanīti | śabdavāhinī nāḍī dhamanī jīvanaṃ tanau ityato dhamanī jīvasākṣiṇīti prāṇavāyoḥ sākṣibhūtā ata eva kutracijjīvanāḍīti kathitā | tathāhi -‘pradarśayeddoṣanijasvarūpaṃ vyastaṃ samastaṃ yugalīkṛtaśca | mūkasya mugdhasya vimohitasya dīpaḥ padārthāniva jīvanāḍī’ iti || lakṣaṇamapi ca - ‘asthnaḥ prakoṣṭhabāhyasya madhyamānāmikāśritā | jīvanāḍīti sā proktā nandinī tattvavedanā’ iti | tacceṣṭayā duḥkhamiti doṣādivaiṣamyadharmaḥ | yataḥ ‘rogastu doṣavaiṣamyam’ ityādivacanāt | paṇḍitairiti pravīṇaiḥ nāḍīgrahaṇasya samayaviśeṣajñairityarthaḥ | yataḥ - ‘sadyaḥ snātasya bhuktasya kṣuttṛṣṇā ' 'tapaśīlinaḥ | vyāyāmaśrāntadehasya samyaṅ nāḍī na budhyate’ iti || 1 || Gū. karasyāṅguṣṭhamūle yā dhamanī sā jīvasākṣiṇī jīvo 'sti no veti bodhanī jñeyā | budhaiḥ tacceṣṭayā mandasthiracalagāminyā kāyasya dehasya sukhaṃ mukhaṃ ca jñeyam || 1 || nāḍī dhatte marutkope jalaukāsarpayorgatim | kuliṅgakākamaṇḍūkagatiṃ pittasya kopataḥ || 2 || haṃsapārāvatagatiṃ dhatte śleṣmaprakopataḥ | Dī. idānīṃ doṣāṇāṃ nijasvarūpaceṣṭāmāha - nāḍīti | marutkope vātaprakope jalaukāsarpayorgatiṃ gamanaṃ dhatte nāḍīti śeṣaḥ | jalaukāsarpayostiryaggatirityabhiprāyaḥ tadvadatrā 'pi | pittaprakopatastu kuliṅgādīnāṃ gatiṃ dhatte, kuliṅgo gṛhacaṭakaḥ | kākamaṇḍūkau prasiddhau eteṣāmutplavanagatirityarthaḥ | eke kuliṅgasthāne kalāpīti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | kalāpī mayūraḥ | śleṣmaprakopāt haṃsapārāvatagatiṃ dhatte | atrāpi nāḍīti saṃbadhyate | etena mandagativāhinī bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ | yato haṃsapārāvatayorapi mandagatiḥ syāt || 2 || Gū. marutkope sati nāḍī jalaukāsarpayorgatiṃ gamanaṃ dhatte | nāḍī pittasya kopataḥ kuliṅgakākamaṇḍūkagatiṃ dhatte | kuliṅgo gṛhacaṭakaḥ haṃsapārāvatagatiṃ śleṣmaprakopataḥ dhatte || lāvatittiravartīnāṃ gamanaṃ saṃnipātataḥ || 3 || kadācinmandagamanā kadācidvegavāhinī | dvidoṣakopato jñeyā - Dī. atha sannipātasaṃsargayornāḍīceṣṭāmāha —lāveti | sannipātatastridoṣakopāt lāvādīnāṃ gamanaṃ nāḍī dhatte iti pūrvādanuvartate | lāvatittirau prasiddhau, vartīti vartikā (dharadhara) śabdavācyā | gaḍūrukābhidhānetyanye | eteṣāṃ sottālā gatiḥ sūcyate || dvidoṣakopādapi nāḍī kadācinmandagāminī kadācidvegavāhinīti || Gū. nāḍī sannipātataḥ tridoṣaprakopataḥ lāvatittiravartikānāṃ gamanaṃ dhatte | natvekasya jantorgatyā nāmnāṃ prakupitasya doṣasya bodho bhavedato dvitrijantūnāṃ gatiḥ darśitā yathā vikṛtimāpanno vāyuḥ sarpagatiṃ dhatte | sāmyaṃ gato vāyuḥ jalaukāgatiṃ dhatte evamanye 'pi jñeyāḥ ||3|| dvidoṣakopataḥ kadācinmandagamanā kadācidvegavāhinī jñeyā || hanti ca sthānavicyutā || 4 || sthitvā sthitvā calati yā sā smṛtā prāṇanāśinī | atikṣīṇā ca śītā ca jīvitaṃ hantyasaṃśayam || 5 || Dī. idānīmasādhyāyā lakṣaṇamāha - hantīti | sthānavicyutā svasthānāccalitā nāḍīti śeṣaḥ | hantīti āturamiti śeṣaḥ | yā sthitvā sthitvā calati gacchati sāpi prāṇanāśinī jñeyā | etena kadācidvahati kadācinna vahatītyabhiprāyaḥ | atikṣīṇā ceti bisatantuvat, atiśītā ceti himasparśavat | asaṃśayaṃ niścayena jīvitaṃ prāṇān hanti nāḍīti śeṣaḥ | cakārāt kuṭilā cordhvādhogamanaśīlāpi prāṇanāśinī boddhavyā | tathācoktaṃ - ‘nāḍī madhyavahāṅguṣṭhamūle yātyarthamucchalet | śanairūrdhvārdhagamanā kuṭilā hanti mānavam ||’ iti || 4 || 5 || Gū. sthānavicyutā satī hanti | yā dhamanī sthitvā sthitvā calati sā prāṇanāśinī smṛtā kathitā | atikṣīṇā śītā gacchatī satī prāṇino jīvitaṃ jīvanāśaṃ asaṃśayaṃ niḥsaṃdehena hanti dūrīkarotītyarthaḥ || 4 || 5 || jvarakopeṇa dhamanī soṣṇā vegavatī bhavet | kāmakrodhādvegavahā kṣīṇā cintābhayaplutā || 6 || mandāgneḥ kṣīṇadhātośca nāḍī mandatarā bhavet | asṛkpūrṇā bhavetkoṣṇā gurvī sāmā garīyasī || 7 || laghvī vahati dīptāgnestathā vegavatī matā | sukhitasya sthirā jñeyā tathā balavatī smṛtā || 8 || capalā kṣudhitasyāpi tṛptasya vahati sthirā | Dī. atha jvarādīnāṃ dhamanīlakṣaṇamāha -jvarakopeṇeti | jvarakopeṇa sāmānyajvarasya prakopeṇa kṛtvā dhamanī nāḍī soṣṇā uṣṇayuktā bhavet | jvarasyoṣṇātmakatvānna kevalaṃ soṣṇā vegavatī bhavet | jvarasya dehendriyamanaḥsantāpitatvāt | kāmakrodhādapi vegavahā vegayuktā anauṣṇyena jvaravadbhinnā | kāmo 'bhimatakāminyādyaprāptiḥ, krodho hiṃsātmakādirūpaḥ, cintābhayapluteti cintābhayayuktā nāḍī kṣīṇā susūkṣmā jñeyā | cintā cittodvegarūpā, bhayaṃ śatruprabhṛtīnām | eke cintābhayaśramāditi paṭhanti | cintābhayaśramānnāḍī kṣīṇā susūkṣmā jñeyā | cintā mānasodvegarūpā jñeyā | tatra śramād glāneḥ mandāgneḥ kṣīṇadhātośca puruṣasya nāḍī mandatarā bhavet, atyarthaṃ mandagatirityarthaḥ | asṛkpūrṇā rudhiraprakopāt pūritā nāḍī koṣṇā gurvī ca bhavet | koṣṇā īṣaduṣṇā gurvī gurutarā pāṣāṇavadityarthaḥ | eke soṣṇeti paṭhanti | sāmā āmayuktā nāḍī garīyasī syāt atyarthaṃ gurvī bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | āmena saha vartata iti sāmā, āmo 'paripakvarasaḥ | tadyathā - ‘jaṭharānaladaurbalyādavipakvastu yo rasaḥ | sa āmasaṃjñako dehe sarvadoṣaprakopakaḥ’ iti | athavā āmagrahaṇena āmāditrayamannajamajīrṇaṃ gṛhyate tena tairyuktetyarthaḥ | tatra āmaṃ vidagdhaṃ viṣṭabdhaṃ ceti | eke sāmā garīyasīti paṭhanti | āmena saha vartata iti sāmā | te ca doṣadūṣyatādayaḥ | yataḥ ‘āmena tena saṃpṛktā doṣā dūṣyāśca dūṣitāḥ | sāmā ityupadiśyante ye ca rogāstadudbhavāḥ’ iti | etena kimuktaṃ bhavati sāmadoṣāt sāmadūṣyāt sāmadūṣitāt sāmarogācceti | dūṣyā rasādayo dhātavaḥ | dūṣitāni malamūtraprabhṛtīni | dīptāgneḥ prabalāgneḥ puruṣasya laghvī vegavatī ca vahati | laghvī tūlavat saiva vegayuktā jñeyā natu pūrvoktā | sukhitasya svasthasya sthirā prakṛtisthā bhavatītyarthaḥ | na kevalaṃ svasthā tathā balavatī balayuktā na kṣīṇetyabhiprāyaḥ | kṣudhitasya bubhukṣitasyāpi capalā cañcalā na mandetyarthaḥ | etena prakṛtisthitāgniriti bhāvaḥ | tṛptasya bhojanādinā santuṣṭasya puruṣasya sthirā niścalaiva||6-8|| iti nāḍīparīkṣā || Gū. sā dhamanī nāḍī jvarakopeṇa jvarādhikyena soṣṇā atyuṣṇā satī vegavatī bhavet kāmāt krodhācca vegavahā syāt cintābhayāplutā satī kṣīṇā bhavedityarthaḥ | atiśayena mandā mandatarā asṛkpūrṇā nāḍī koṣṇā īṣaduṣṇā satī gurvī calet | koṣṇā īṣaduṣṇā gurvī alpagariṣṭhā sāmā āmayuktā nāḍī garīyasī bhavet | atiśayena gariṣṭhā garīyasī | dīptāgneḥ puruṣasya nāḍī laghvī vahati | tathā dīptāgneḥ puṃsaḥ laghvī matā smṛtā | sukhino rogarahitasya puṃsaḥ sthirā jñeyā tathā balavatī smṛtā | kṣudhitasya puṃsaḥ nāḍī capalā syāt | tṛptasya kṛtabhojanasya puṃsaḥ nāḍī sthirā vahati | anyānyapi nāḍīparīkṣāsthānānyāha granthāntarāt - ‘pādayornāḍikāsthānaṃ gulphasyādho 'ṅgulatrayam | kaṇṭhamūleṅgulidvandve nāsāmūleṅgulādhikam| narasyāṅguṣṭhamūle ca nāḍī caturthikā matā | sthānānyetāni nāḍīnāṃ tāsu prāṇo vyavasthitaḥ’| karasya nāḍī sadaivāvalokanīyā anyā yāstisro nāḍyaḥ maraṇasamaye 'valokanīyā nānyatra | anyatra karasyāvalokanīyeti | sadyaḥsnātasya bhuktasya kṣuttṛṣātapaśīlinaḥ | vyāyāmaśrāntadehasya samyaṅnāḍī na budhyate | bhāraprahāramūrcchābhayaśokapramukhakāraṇānnāḍī saṃmūrcchitāpi bāḍhaṃ punarapi jīvanaṃ labhate || 6-8 || iti nāḍīparīkṣā || dūtāḥ svajātayo 'vyaṅgāḥ paṭavo nirmalāmbarāḥ | sukhino 'śvavṛṣārūḍhāḥ śubhrapuṣpaphalairyutāḥ || 9 || sujātayaḥ suceṣṭāśca sajīvadiśi saṃśritāḥ | bhiṣajaṃ samaye prāptā rogiṇaḥ sukhahetave || 10 || Dī. pūrvamuktamādigrahaṇāt dūtasvapnādīnāṃ lakṣaṇakathanam | atha dūtalakṣaṇānyāha --dūtā iti | evaṃvidhā dūtā yadā bhiṣajaṃ vaidyaṃ prāptāstadā rogiṇa āturasya sukhahetave bhavantītyadhyāhāryam | vaidyāhvānāya praśnāya āgatāḥ puruṣā dūtāḥ kīdṛśāstānāha - svajātaya iti | svasyāṃ jātau svagotre vā jātāḥ svajātayaḥ | eke ‘sajātaya’ iti paṭhanti tatra sapakṣā ityarthaḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘pāṣaṇḍāśramavarṇānāṃ sapakṣāḥ karmasiddhaye | ta eva viparītāḥ syurdūtāḥ karmavipattaye’ iti | avyaṅgā iti | vyaṅgā hastāvayavahīnāḥ na vyaṅgā avyaṅgāḥ | paṭava iti pravīṇāḥ | etena vicitrakālajñāḥ kathitāḥ | nirmalāmbarā iti śubhravastradhāriṇaḥ, tena raktakṛṣṇavastrādirahitā ityarthaḥ | sukhina iti adīnāḥ | aśvavṛṣārūḍhā iti aśvārūḍhā vṛṣārūḍhāśca | āsamantāt kāreṇa rūḍhāḥ iti yadgrahaṇaṃ tanmahiṣoṣṭrakharādiyānaniṣedhārtham | śubhrapuṣpaphalairyutā iti śvetapuṣpairebhiḥ sāraphalaiśca saṃyuktā ityabhiprāyaḥ | etena raktapītakṛṣṇādibhiḥ sāraphalarahitā ityarthaḥ | yata evaṃvidhāni puṣpaphalānyamaṅgalāni bhavanti | tathācoktam ‘tailakardamadigdhāṅgā raktasraganulepanāḥ | phalaṃ pakvamasāraṃ vā gṛhītvā 'nyacca tadvidham | vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtāste cāpi garhitāḥ’ iti | sujātaya iti śobhanā jātiryeṣāṃ te tathāvidhāḥ | etenānyajātijanitā niṣiddhāḥ | pāpakṛdgarbhotpattirahitā ityarthaḥ | yadvā vijñātajātaya iti piṇḍārthaḥ | suceṣṭāśceti ceṣṭātra kāyakṛto vyāpāraḥ śobhanavyāpāra ityabhiprāyaḥ | śobhanagrahaṇaṃ duśceṣṭitavyavacchedārtham | tathāhyuktaṃ ’chindantastṛṇakāṣṭhāni spṛśanto nāsikāṃ stanam | vastrāntānāmikākeśanakharomadṛśaspṛśaḥ | sroto 'varodhahṛdgaṇḍamūrdhoraḥkukṣipāṇayaḥ | kapālopala- bhasmāsthituṣāṅgārakarāśca ye | vilikhanto mahīṃ kiñcinmuñcanto loṣṭabhedinaḥ |‘ ityādi duśceṣṭitā darśitāḥ | suceṣṭāśceti cakāragrahaṇāt sudarśanāḥ suveṣā api gṛhyante anyathā garhitāḥ syuḥ | tathāhi - ’napuṃsakaḥ strībahavo naikakāryā asūyakāḥ | pāśadaṇḍāyudhadharāḥ prāptā vā syuḥ paraṃparā | ārdrajīrṇāpasavyaikamalinoddhatavāsasaḥ | nyūnādhikāṅgā udvignā vikṛtā raudrarūpiṇaḥ | vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtāste cāpi garhitāḥ’ | sajīvadiśi saṅgatā iti jīvanena prāṇānilena saha yā dik nāḍī tasyāṃ saṅgatāḥ prāptā ityarthaḥ | tathāca - ’yasyāṃ prāṇamarudvāti sā nāḍī jīvasaṃyutā’ iti | nāḍī cātra nāsāsaṃbandhinī jñeyā | yadvā - jīvena saha vartata iti yā dik diśā tasyāmityārthaḥ | tena yāmyadikrahitadiśāyāḥ prāptā iti tātparyārthaḥ | yato yāmyadik niṣiddhā | tathāhi - ’yāmyāṃ diśaṃ prāñjalayo viṣamaikapadasthitāḥ | vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtāste cāpi garhitāḥ’ iti | samaye prāptā iti samaye śubhavelātithinakṣatrādiyukte kāle anyathā aśubhakarā iti bhāvaḥ | taduktam - ‘vaidyasya paitrye daive vā kārye cotpātadarśane | madhyāhne cārdharātre vā sandhyayoḥ kṛttikāsu ca || ārdrāśleṣāmaghāmūlapūrvāsu bharaṇīṣu ca | caturthyāṃ vā navamyāṃ vā ṣaṣṭhayāṃ saṃdhidineṣu ca || dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ deśe tvaśucau vā hutāśanam | jvalayantaṃ pacantaṃ vā krūrakarmaṇi codyatam|| nagnaṃ bhūmau śayānaṃ vā vegotsargeṣu vā 'śucim| prakīrṇakeśamabhyaktaṃ svinnaṃ viklavameva ca | vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtāste cāpi garhitāḥ’ iti ||9||1 .|| Gū. karmaṇaḥ samaye snānābhyaṅgādirahitakāle yasyāṃ prāṇamarudvāti sā nāḍī jīvasaṃyutā candrasūryasthāne yayordvayornāḍyormadhye yasyāṃ nāḍyāṃ prāṇamarudvāti gandhagrahaṇādhikārī bhūtvā saṃcārī sā nāḍī jīvasaṃyutā vācyā tasyāṅgasthaḥ pṛcchako yadā pṛcchati tadā sa rogī jīvati anyathā mriyate || anyatrāpyuktaṃ - ’candrasthāne yadā vāyuḥ sūryasthāne ca pṛcchakaḥ | tadā na jīvati rogī yadi vaidyaśatairvṛtaḥ’ | etatpūrvoktasya sa jīvasyāṅgasya vyākhyātam | iti dūtalakṣaṇāni || 9 || 10 || vaidyāhvānāya dūtasya gacchato rogiṇaḥ kṛte || 11 || na śubhaṃ saumyaśakunaṃ pradīptaṃ ca sukhāvaham | cikitsāṃ rogiṇaḥ kartuṃ gacchato bhiṣajaḥ śubham || 12 || yātreyaṃ saumyaśakunaṃ proktaṃ dīptaṃ na śobhanam | Dī. idānīṃ gacchato dūtasya śakunānyāha --. vaidyāhvānāyeti | rogiṇa āturasya kṛte nimitte vaidyāhvānāya gacchato dūtasya saumyaśakunaṃ bherīmṛdaṅgādi na śobhanamityarthaḥ | pradīptamasaumyaṃ sukhāvahaṃ bhavati | gacchata iti mārge calitasya | etena viparītaśakunānyatra śubhakārāṇi boddhavyāni | uktaṃ ca jyotiḥśāstre - ‘sadyo raṇe karmaṇi ca praveśe śukle gṛhe naṣṭavilokane ca | vyādhau ca nadyuttaraṇe bhayārte śastaḥ prayāṇādviparītabhāvaḥ ||? iti dūtaśakunalakṣaṇāni saṃpūrṇāni || idānīṃ gacchato vaidyasyāpi śakunāni darśayannāha - cikitsāmiti | rogiṇa āturasya cikitsāṃ rogāpanayanaṃ karma kartuṃ gacchato mārge cālitasya bhiṣajo vaidyasya yātreyaṃ saumyaśakunaṃ proktamidaṃ śubhaṃ kathitaṃ dīptamaśubhamaśakunaṃ na śobhanamityarthaḥ | yātreyaṃ yātrāyogyaṃ yathā - bherīmṛdaṅgamṛdumardalaśaṅkhaveṇuvedadhvanirmadhuramaṅgalagītaghoṣāḥ | putrānvitā ca yuvatiḥ surabhiḥ savatsā dhautāmbaraśca rajako 'bhimukhaḥ praśastaḥ’ | anyacca -‘bhṛṅgārāñjanavardhamānamakulābaddhaikapaśvāmiṣaśaṅkhakṣīranṛpānnapūrṇakalaśacchatrāṇi siddhārthakāḥ | vīṇāketanamīna paṅkajadadhikṣaudrājyagorocanāḥ, kanyāśaṅkhasitekṣuvastrasumanoviprāśca ratnāni ca’ iti | dīptamityatrātreyaṃ tadyathā ‘gamanaṃ dakṣiṇe vāmānna śastaṃ śvasṛgālayoḥ | vāmaṃ nakulacāṣāṇāṃ nobhayaṃ śaśasarpayoḥ || bhāsakauśikayoścaiva na praśastaṃ kilobhayam | darśanaṃ ca rutaṃ cāpi na godhākṛkalāsayoḥ || kulatthatilakārpāsatuṣapāṣāṇabhasmanām | pātraṃ neṣṭaṃ tathā 'ṅgāratailakardamapūritam || prasannetaramadyānāṃ pūrṇaṃ vā raktasarṣapaiḥ | śavakāṣṭhapalāśānāṃ śuṣkāṇāṃ pathi saṅgamāḥ | neṣyanti patitāntasthadīnāndharipavastathā’ iti || 11 || 12 || Gū. āturamupakramamāṇena bhiṣajā āyurevādau parīkṣaṇīyam | satyāyuṣi dhṛtyagnivayodehabalasatvasātmya- prakṛtibheṣajadeśān parīkṣayet | tatra pāṇipādapārśvapṛṣṭhastanāgradarśanavadanaskandhalalāṭadīrghāṃgulipūrvocchvāsa- prekṣaṇabāhuvistīrṇabhūstanāntaroraḥskandhahṛjjaṅghāmeḍhragrīvāgambhīrasatvasvaranābhistanamupacitamahāromaśakarṇapaścānmaṇikatānuliptamūrdhānupūrvyāviśuṣyamāṇaśarīraṃ paścācchuṣyamāṇahṛdayaṃ puruṣaṃ jānīyāt dīrghāyuḥ khalviti tamekāntenopakramet | ebhirlakṣaṇairviparītairalpamiśritairmadhyamāyuriti | vyādhayastu trividhāḥ sādhyāḥ, yāpyāḥ, pratyākhyeyāśca, taddṛṣṭvā karma kārayet | prāgabhihitā ṛtavaḥ ‘śīte śītapratīkāramuṣṇe coṣṇanivāraṇam | kuryātkriyāṃ prāptakālaṃ na hāpayet’ | prāgabhihitogniścaturvidhaḥ viṣamo vātena, tīkṣṇaḥ pittena, mandaḥ śleṣmaṇā, samaḥ sarvasāmānyāditi | yaḥ kadācit samyak pacati kadācit śūlādhmānādīnkaroti sa viṣamaḥ | yaḥ gurvādikamāśu pacati sa tīkṣṇaḥ | yaḥ laghurapi na pacati sa mandaḥ | yaḥ kālamannamupayuktaṃ pacati sa samaḥ | vayastu trividhaṃ bālaṃ madhyaṃ vṛddhamiti | tatronaṣoḍaśavarṣā bālāḥ; te tridhā kṣīrapāḥ, kṣīrānnādā, annādā, iti | teṣu saṃvatsaraparāḥ kṣīrādā dvivatsaraparāḥ kṣīrānnādāḥ parato 'nnādā iti ṣoḍaśasaptatyorantaraṃ madhyaṃ vayaḥ; tasya vikalpo vṛddhiryauvanaṃ sampūrṇatā hāniriti tatrāviṃśateḥ vṛddhirātriṃśato yauvanamācatvāriṃśataḥ sarvadhātvindriyabalavīryasaṃpūrṇatā ata ūrdhvamaśīteḥ paraṃ hāniryāvatsaptatiriti saptatestūrdhvaṃ kṣīyamāṇadhātvindriyajīrṇāgāramivābhivṛṣṭaśītaṃ vṛṣamācakṣate ‘bālye vivardhate śleṣmā madhyame pittameva tu | bhūyiṣṭhaṃ varddhate vāyurvṛddhastadvīkṣya varjayet | agnikṣāravirekaistu bālavṛddhau vivarjayet| tatsādhyeṣu vikāreṣu śuddhiṃ kuryātkriyāṃ bhiṣak | dehaḥ sthūlaḥ kṛśo madhya iti prāgupadeśitaḥ | karṣayedbṛṃhayeccāpi mahāsthūlakṛśau narau | rakṣaṇaṃ caiva madhyasya kurvīta satataṃ bhiṣak ||’ balameva pradhānaṃ kecitkṛśā eva balavantaḥ sthūlā abalavantaḥ tasmādbalaṃ parīkṣayet | satvamāha - ‘satvavān sahate sarvaṃ saṃstabhyātmānamātmanā | rājasastapyamānānyaiḥ sahate nāma tāmasaḥ’ | prakṛtimagre vakṣyāmaḥ | pūrvoktaṃ bheṣajamāha - ‘bālasya prathame māsi deyā bheṣajaraktikā’ ityādi pūrvoktam | śamamāha yathāvahṛdakanagorūpaḥ kaphamārutarogavān evamanyepi jñeyāḥ | evaṃ sarvaṃ jñātvā paścānmārge śakunāni parīkṣya tadā cikitsāṃ kurvanti | rogiṇaḥ cikitsāṃ kartuṃ gacchataḥ bhiṣajaḥ yātreyaṃ saumyaśakunaṃ śobhanaṃ proktaṃ dīptaṃ na | rogiṇaḥ kṛte vaidyāhvānāya gacchato dūtasya saumyaśakunaṃ śubhaṃ na pradīptaṃ sukhāvahamityarthaḥ | iti śakunaḥ ||11||12|| nijaprakṛtivarṇābhyāṃ yuktaḥ sattvena saṃyutaḥ || 13 || cikitsyo bhiṣajā rogī vaidyabhakto jitendriyaḥ | Dī. atha kīdṛśo rogī cikitsyastaddarśayannāha - nijaprakṛtīti | bhiṣajā vaidyena īdṛśo rogī cikitsyaḥ, cikitsā rogāpanayanaṃ karma tadyogyo bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ | kīdṛśaḥ ? tamāha - nijaprakṛtivarṇābhyāṃ yukta iti yādṛśau yasya prakṛtivarṇau staḥ tādṛgbhyāmeva saṃyukta ityarthaḥ | nanu keyaṃ prakṛtiḥ ? katibhedā ? kiṃkāraṇaṃ vā asyā iti ? taducyate - keyaṃ prakṛtiḥ svabhāva ityarthaḥ | sa cābālapravṛttā niṣekādvā vātārabdhādyā āprayāṇādanuvartate | kati bhedā iti | sapta prakṛtayo bhavanti pṛthagdoṣairdvandvaiḥ samastaiśca | kiṃkāraṇamiti tadāha suśrutaḥ ‘śukraśoṇitasaṃyoge yo bhaveddoṣa utkaṭaḥ | prakṛtirjāyate tena tasyā me lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu’ iti | sā hi prakṛtirjātyādīn ṣaḍupādhīnapekṣate | taduktaṃ carake ‘tatra prakṛtirhi jātiprasaktā kulaprasaktā ca deśānupātinīti ca kālānupātinī ca vayo 'nupātinī ca pratyātmaniyatā ceti’ | tatra jātiprasaktā nāma tāsu tāsu manuṣyādijātiṣu te te karacaraṇādayaḥ svabhāvaviśeṣāḥ, vacaneṣu ca nānāvidhā eva vyaktyādayo dharmaviśeṣāḥ, manasi ca dharmādharmamaithunāhāraprabhṛtayo 'pi bhāvāḥ | kulaprasaktā nāma dvijakule tapaḥpriyatādayaḥ, kṣatriyakule samarapriyatādayo dharmaviśeṣā bhavanti | deśānupātinī nāma lāṭakarṇāṭāyanādīnāṃ kāye vāci manasi ca te te svabhāvaviśeṣā bhavanti | kālānupātinī nāma dehādiṣu daurbalyādidainyaglānyādyapekṣā | gadeṣu ca doṣādyapekṣaṇīyam | vayonupātinī nāma bālyādyavasthāsu kālādau maryādādayo dharmāḥ | pratyātmaniyatā ceti ātmani niyatā pratipuruṣaniyatetyarthaḥ | te punaḥ kāye vāci manasi ca svabhāvaviśeṣāḥ prakṛtipuruṣabhedabhinnā dṛśyanta iti | kecittu pāñcabhautikīṃ prakṛtimāhuḥ | anye tu prakṛtiṃ sattvarajastamomayīmāhuḥ | pūrvamuktaḥ prakṛtivarṇābhyāṃ yuktaḥ | atastāvat prakṛtistu saṃkṣepeṇoktā | idānīṃ varṇamāha - varṇaśabdena prabhā kathyate | saiva cchāyāpyabhimatā | eteṣāṃ medo 'pyastītyeke bhāṣante | sā yathā - ‘varṇaprabhāmiśritā yā chāyā sā parikīrtitā | varṇamākrāmati cchāyā prabhā varṇaprakāśinī || āsannā lakṣyate chāyā prabhā dūrāttu lakṣyate’ iti | na kevalaṃ varṇaprabhācchāyānāṃ lakṣaṇabhedaḥ, saṃkhyābhedo 'pyasti | sa yathā caturdhā varṇāḥ - gauraḥ, kṛṣṇaḥ, śyāmaḥ, gauraśyāma iti | prabhā saptavidhā - raktā, pītā, sitā, śyāvā, harit, pāṇḍurā, asiteti || chāyāpi pañcavidhā - snigdhā, vimalā, rūkṣā, malinā, saṃkṣipteti | punaḥ kīdṛśo rogī cikitsyaḥ ? sattvena saṃyuta iti | sattvaṃ tu vyasanābhyudayakriyāsthāneṣvapi karmakaram | yataḥ - ‘sattvavān sahate sarvaṃ saṃstabhyātmānamātmanā | rājasastabhyamāno 'nyaiḥ sahate naiva tāmasaḥ |’ iti suśrutaḥ | cakṣuṣopapannārthe pravarāvaramadhyamabalaṃ sattvaṃ trividham | eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ na likhitamatra granthabāhulyāt | punaḥ kīdṛśaḥ ? vaidyabhakta iti vaidyāhlādakaraḥ tadvākyapālane 'nurakta ityarthaḥ | yataḥ ‘āḍhyo rogī bhiṣagvaśyo jñāpakaḥ sattvavānapi’ iti vacanāt | punaḥ kathambhūtaḥ ? jitendriyo jitendriyaviṣayaḥ, viṣayāstu srakcandanavanitādayaḥ | āturalakṣaṇam || 13 || Gū. bhiṣajā īdṛśo rogī cikitsyaḥ | kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ ? nijaprakṛtivarṇābhyāṃ yuktaḥ | ( nanu yadvā kiṃ karoti na tu dahanaṃ sthālī tandulānodanaṃ kartuṃ kṣamaḥ | tathāca śatapuṣpā laghustīkṣṇā pittakṛddīpanī kaṭurityādivacanaṃ vahnimakurvāṇamapi āmaṃ pacati yathā sthālīsthabahudugdhamuktikācūrṇaprathamajalayogāttandulādikaṃ pacati natvagniṃ prajvālayati ‘nāma puṣpaṃ kaṣāyoktaṃ rūkṣaṃ labdhvāmapācana’miti | tathāca ‘citrakaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke dīpanaḥ pācano laghu’riti | kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ ? satvena satvaguṇena saṃyutaḥ | punaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ ? vaidyabhakto jitendriyaḥ | iti rogilakṣaṇam || 13 || svapneṣu nagnānmuṇḍāṃśca raktakṛṣṇāmbarāvṛtān || 14 || vyaṅgāṃśca vikṛtānkṛṣṇānsapāśānsāyudhānapi | badhnato nighnataścāpi dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritān ||15|| mahiṣoṣṭrakharārūḍhāṃstrīpuṃso yastu paśyati | sa svastho labhate vyādhiṃ rogī yātyeva pañcatām||16|| adho yo nipatatyuccājjale 'gnau vā vilīyate | śvāpadairhanyate yo 'pi matsyādyairgilito bhavet || 17|| yasya netre vilīyete dīpo nirvāṇatāṃ vrajet | tailaṃ surāṃ pibedvāpi lohaṃ vā labhate tilān ||18|| pakvānnaṃ labhate 'śnāti viśetkūpaṃ rasātalam | sa svastho labhate rogaṃ rogī yātyeva pañcatām ||19|| duḥsvapnānevamādīṃśca dṛṣṭvā brūyānna kasyacit | snānaṃ kuryāduṣasyeva dadyāddhematilānapaḥ || 20 || paṭhetstotrāṇi devānāṃ rātrau devālaye vaset | kṛtvaivaṃ tridinaṃ martyo duḥsvapnātparimucyate || 21 || Dī. athānantaraṃ svapnānyāha - svapneṣviti | evaṃvidhān svapnān strīpuruṣayormadhye yaścaikaḥ paśyati sa eva yadi svastho 'nāturastarhi vyādhiṃ labhate | yadā rogī paśyati tadā pañcatvaṃ maraṇaṃ yāti prāpnotītyarthaḥ | kīdṛśān svapnān ? tānāha - nagnān vastrādirahitān, muṇḍāniti muṇḍitān, raktakṛṣṇāmbarāvṛtāniti raktakṛṣṇavastraveṣṭitānityarthaḥ | vyaṅgāniti avayavādirahitān nāsākartanādibhirapi vyaṅgānityabhiprāyaḥ | vikṛtāniti paṅgukubjaprabhṛtīn, kṛṣṇāniti citrakalpitavat kārṣṇyābhāsaḥ, sapāśāniti pāśayutān, pāśo dīrghaḥ paśūnāṃ bandhanarajjuḥ, badhnato nighnata iti niṣṭhuraprahananakarmakāriṇaḥ dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritāniti | ete tu yadā dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritā bhavanti tadā pracuramaniṣṭaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ | tatra nairṛtaṃ bhāgadheyamiti vadanti | mahiṣoṣṭrakharārūḍhāniti mahiṣādivāhaneṣu ārohitā ityarthaḥ | te tu yamasaṃbandhinaścāśubhakarā iti bhāvaḥ || athāparāṇi duḥsvapnānyāha - adha iti | svapneṣu yo 'pi evaṃvidho bhavati so 'pyaniṣṭaḥ kīdṛśastamāha - adho yo nipatatyuccādityādi | puruṣa uccādatyuccasthānādadho nimnasthāne nipatati skhalatītyarthaḥ | atyuccaṃ parvatādikam | yo jale 'gnau vā vilīyate līno bhavati | etena jale bruḍati agnau pataṅgavat patatītyabhiprāyaḥ | yo 'pi śvāpadairhanyate śunaścaraṇairākṛṣyata iti | eke svāpadairiti paṭhanti, tatra svāpadairnijabandhunāśādibhirupahanyate pīḍyata ityarthaḥ | matsyādyairiti gilito bhakṣito yo bhavet | ādigrahaṇānmakaranakraśiśumāraprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam | yasya puruṣasya ca netre vilīyete vilīnatāṃ prāpnuta iti | svapneṣviti śeṣaḥ | etena svacakṣuṣī vigalite paśyatītyarthaḥ | dīpo nirvāṇatāṃ vrajediti | etena kimuktam | yaḥ svapne 'pyakasmāddīpaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ paśyatītyabhiprāyaḥ | yaśca tailaṃ surāṃ vā pibet yaśca lohaṃ labhate tilān vā labhate yaśca pakvānnaṃ siddhamannaṃ labhate yaśca tadaśnāti bhakṣayati ca yo mātaraṃ kuḍyaṃ viśet māturgṛhaṃ praviśatītyarthaḥ | eteṣāṃ svapneṣviti saṃbandhaḥ | surātra piṣṭamayī na tu madyaviśeṣaḥ | svapne viśiṣṭamadyapānaṃ praśastam | taduktaṃ ‘rudhiraṃ pibati svapne madyaṃ vāpi kathaṃcana | brāhmaṇo labhate vidyāmitarastu dhanaṃ labhet’ iti | lohamityasya sthāne lauhamiti pāṭhāntaraṃ tatra lauhaṃ lohamayaṃ yaṣṭyādi | vāgrahaṇāt kārpāsapiṇyākalavaṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam | eteṣāṃ lābhe 'pyaniṣṭaṃ bhavati | eke viśet kuḍyaṃ ca mātaramityatra kuḍyamutsaṅgaṃ vyākhyānayanti | jananīṃ praviśennara iti paṭhanti kecit tatra māturudare praviśatītyarthaḥ | tatra mātrā saha śayanaṃ karotītyanye || idānīṃ duḥsvapnadarśanotpannāriṣṭanivṛttyarthaṃ kiñcit pratīkāramāha - duḥsvapnānīti | evamādīni pūrvoktanagnamuṇḍādīni duḥsvapnāni duḥkhotpādakāni dṛṣṭvā svapnāvasthāyāmālokya kasyacit purato na brūyāt na prakāśayedityarthaḥ | paramukhenāniṣṭaśravaṇabhayāt | tadanu kiṃ kuryāt? tadāha - snānamiti | uṣasi prātareva snānaṃ kuryāt hema tilānayaśca dadyāt | hema suvarṇam, tilān kṛṣṇān, ayo lohaḥ | punaḥ kiṃ kuryādityāha - paṭhediti | devānāṃ stotrāṇi devānāṃ viṣṇuprabhṛtīnāṃ stotrāṇi agnitrayādīni | yathā - ‘agnitrayaṃ trīṇi ca puṣkarāṇi nāmatrayaṃ trīṇi padāni viṣṇoḥ | rudrastrinetrastripathā ca gaṅgā etāni duḥsvapnavināśanāni |’ iti | iti dinakṛtyaṃ | rātrāvapi devālaye devamaṇḍapaṃ vaset | tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāditi keṣāñcinmatam | atha duḥsvapnamupasaṃharan phalamāha -kṛtvaivamiti | evamuktaprakāreṇa snānadānādikaṃ karma kṛtvā saṃpādya tridinaṃ dinatrayaṃ yathā syāt martyaḥ puruṣaḥ duḥsvapnāt duḥkhajanakanimittāt parimucyate sukhī bhavatītyarthaḥ || 14-21 || Gū. svapneṣu naghnato ghnantaḥ strī vā pumān yaḥ paśyati dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ āśritān paśyati | yadā svasthaḥ paśyati tadā sa svasthaḥ vyādhiṃ labhate, naro yaḥ striyaḥ puṃsaḥ svapneṣu naghnato ghnantaḥ dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ āśritān nagnān paśyati, muṇḍān paśyati, raktakṛṣṇāmbarāvṛtān paśyati, vyaṅgān paśyati, vikṛtān paśyati, kṛṣṇān sapāśān paśyati, sāyudhān paśyati, mahiṣoṣṭrakharārūḍhān etān yaḥ svasthaḥ paśyati cettadā vyādhiṃ labhate | rogī paśyati cettadā pañcatāṃ maraṇāvasthāṃ yātītyarthaḥ | strīpuṃsa ityatrākārāntaḥ śabdaḥ, kutaḥ ‘acaturavicaturasucaturastrīpuṃsa-’ ityādyāḥ śabdā nipātyante tasmādakārānto bhavatyeva | vyaṅgān pādakhañjān vikṛtān kutsitarūpān kṛṣṇān śyāmān sapāśān bandharajjusahitān | sugamamanyat | punarbahirnāyāti sa svasthaḥ dṛṣṭvā vyādhiṃ labhate | rogī pañcatāṃ yātīti sarvatrānuṣaṅgaḥ | yasya puṃsaḥ svapneṣu netre vilīyete bhagnāyete, dīpaḥ nirvāṇatāṃ netrādarśanāvasthāṃ vrajet prāpnuyāt saḥ svasthaścet evaṃ paśyati rogī bhavet, rogī pañcatāṃ yātītyarthaḥ | pumān svapneṣu tailaṃ pibet vā surāṃ pibet vā lohaṃ labhate vā kutrāpi pakvānnaṃ labhate vā tilān labhate snāti vā mānavaḥ vā kūpān viśet punarbahirna yāti sa svasthaḥ evaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyādhiṃ labhate, rogī pañcatāṃ yātītyarthaḥ | ādīni prathamāni duḥsvapnāni dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ kasyacinna kathayet | tarhi kiṃ kuryāt, uṣasi snānaṃ kṛtvā ayo lohaṃ dadyāt hema tilān dadyāt paścāddevānāṃ stotrāṇi devālaye paṭhet punā rātrau tatraiva vaset martyaḥ tridinaṃ evaṃ kṛtvā duḥsvapnātparimucyate mukto bhavati ||14-21|| svapneṣu yaḥ surānbhūpāñjīvataḥ suhṛdo dvijān | gosamiddhāgnitīrthāni paśyetsukhamavāpnuyāt || 22 || tīrtvā kaluṣanīrāṇi jitvā śatrugaṇānapi | āruhya saudhagośailakarivāhānsukhī bhavet || 23 || śubhrapuṣpāṇi vāsāṃsi māṃsamatsya phalāni ca | prāpyāturaḥ sukhī bhūyātsvastho dhanamavāpnuyāt ||24|| agamyāgamanaṃ lepo viṣṭhayā ruditaṃ mṛtiḥ | āmamāṃsāśanaṃ svapne dhanārogyāptaye viduḥ || 25 || jalaukā bhramarī sarpo makṣikā vāpi yaṃ daśet | rogī sa bhūyādullāgha: svastho dhanamavāpnuyāt ||26|| iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ nāḍīparīkṣādividhiradhyāyaḥ || Dī. atha duḥsvapnāni pratipādya saṃprati praśastasvapnāni darśayannāha - svapneṣviti | yaḥ puruṣaḥ svapneṣu surādīn paśyet sa sukhamāpnuyādityarthaḥ | surānitīndraprabhṛtidevān, bhūpāniti rājñaḥ, suhṛdo mitrāṇi, dvijān brāhmaṇān, ete tu jīvanta iti prakṛtiprāṇayutānityarthaḥ | tathānyānapi | gauḥ | samiddhāgniḥ prajvalitavahniḥ | tīrthāni prayāgādīni || aparāṇyāha - tīrtveti | yaḥ puruṣaḥ svapneṣu evaṃvidho bhavati sa sukhī bhavedityarthaḥ | kīdṛśastamāha - kaluṣanīrāṇi sakardamapānīyāni tīrtvā uttīrya sthitamiti bhāvaḥ | śatrugaṇān ripusamūhān jitvā āgata iti tātparyārthaḥ | saudhagośailādīnāruhya prāpta iti bhāvaḥ | saudho dhavalagṛhaḥ, gaurvṛṣabhaḥ, śailaḥ parvataḥ, karī hastī, vāhānaśvādīn, kaluṣanīrāṇīti bahuvacanena nadīnadasamudrādīnāṃ grahaṇam | taduktam ‘nadīnadasamudrāṃśca kṣubhitān kaluṣodakān | taret kalyāṇalābhāya vyādherapagamāya ca’ iti || anyānyapyāha - śubhreti | āturo rogī śubhrapuṣpādīni prāpya sukhī bhūyādanāturaḥ syādityarthaḥ | yadā svastho 'pīdṛśaḥ syāt tadā dhanamāpnuyāditi bhāvaḥ | śubhrapuṣpāṇīti śubhrapuṣpaprabhṛtīni, vāsāṃsi cātra śubhrāṇi jñātavyāni, māṃsamatra āmaṃ natu paripakvaṃ vakṣyamāṇatvāt| phalānīti āmraprabhṛtīni || athetarāṇyāha - agamyeti | agamyāgamanaṃ anucitasthānagamanaṃ, viṣṭhāyāḥ purīṣasya lepaḥ karacaraṇādiṣu, ruditamiti rodanam | ātmanaḥ parasya vā | mṛtirmaraṇaṃ āmamāṃsamityatra pare pakvamāṃsāśanamiti paṭhanti | etacca svapne dhanārogyāptaye dhanaprāptaye ārogyaprāptaye ca || jalauketi | jalaukādayo yaṃ puruṣaṃ daśanti bhakṣayanti svapneṣviti śeṣaḥ | sa yadā rogī bhavati tadā rogaḥ syāt | svasthopi dhanaṃ prāpnotītyabhiprāyaḥ | jalaukā prasiddhā, bhramarīti kṛṣṇavarṇamadhumakṣikābhedaḥ, makṣikāśca svalpāḥ, sarpo 'jagaraprabhṛtikaḥ | vāgrahaṇāt varaṭā-madhumakṣikā-maśakādīnāṃ grahaṇam || iti svapnalakṣaṇam || 22-26 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ prathamakhaṇḍe nāḍīparīkṣādividhiradhyāyastṛtīyaḥ || Gū. atha susvapnānyāha - iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ nāḍīparīkṣādividhiradhyāyaḥ ||svapneṣu yaḥ surāndevānparipaśyati, bhūpān rājñaḥ paśyati, jīvataḥ suhṛdaḥ mitrān paśyati, sa sukhaṃ āpnuyāditi || 22-26 || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpinyāṃ tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || pacennāmaṃ vahnikṛcca dīpanaṃ tadyathā miśiḥ | Dī. pūrvamuktaṃ tato dīpanapācanaṃ, ato dīpanapācanādīnāṃ lakṣaṇānyāha - pacediti | yaddravyamāmaṃ na pacedvahnikṛcca bhavati taddīpanaṃ jānīyāt | yathā miśiḥ śatapuṣpā | tathācoktaṃ dravyaguṇāvalyām - ‘śatapuṣpā laghustīkṣṇā pittakṛddīpanī kaṭuḥ’ iti | dīpanaṃ jaṭharāgneḥ | agniguṇabhūyiṣṭhatvāt | nanu kathametadguṇayuktamiśirnāmaghnībhavati tadavināśakatvena kathamagneḥ prabodhaḥ syāt ? ucyate - dravyāṇāṃ prabhāvo vicāraṇīya iti suśrutaḥ na hetubhirvicāryate | taduktam - ‘nauṣadhairhetubhirvidvān parīkṣeta kathaṃcana | sahasreṇāpi hetūnāṃ nāmbaṣṭādivirecayet ||’ iti || āma ityaparipakvarasaḥ | tadyathā - ‘jaṭharānaladaurbalyādavipakvastu yo rasaḥ | sa āmasaṃjñako jñeyo dehadoṣaprakopanaḥ ||’ iti || Gū. yaddravyaṃ āmaṃ na pacet vahnikṛdasti tat dīpanaṃ | yathā miśiḥ śatapuṣpā | Editor's notes 1 ‘dhamanti pavanaṃ tanāvityato dhamanyaḥ’ pā. | ↩ 2 ‘madhye kāpi samāśritā ’madhyakāmasamāśritā’ pā. | ↩ 3 ‘sottālagati’ pā. | ↩ 4 ‘pyartha’ pā. | ↩ 5 ‘varardhara’ pā. | ↩ 6 nāsti ‘ka’ pustake | ↩

title: 4. atha dīpanapācanādhyāyaḥ
text: pacennāmaṃ vahnikṛcca dīpanaṃ tadyathā miśiḥ | Dī. pūrvamuktaṃ tato dīpanapācanaṃ, ato dīpanapācanādīnāṃ lakṣaṇānyāha - pacediti | yaddravyamāmaṃ na pacedvahnikṛcca bhavati taddīpanaṃ jānīyāt | yathā miśiḥ śatapuṣpā | tathācoktaṃ dravyaguṇāvalyām - ‘śatapuṣpā laghustīkṣṇā pittakṛddīpanī kaṭuḥ’ iti | dīpanaṃ jaṭharāgneḥ | agniguṇabhūyiṣṭhatvāt | nanu kathametadguṇayuktamiśirnāmaghnībhavati tadavināśakatvena kathamagneḥ prabodhaḥ syāt ? ucyate - dravyāṇāṃ prabhāvo vicāraṇīya iti suśrutaḥ na hetubhirvicāryate | taduktam - ‘nauṣadhairhetubhirvidvān parīkṣeta kathaṃcana | sahasreṇāpi hetūnāṃ nāmbaṣṭādivirecayet ||’ iti || āma ityaparipakvarasaḥ | tadyathā - ‘jaṭharānaladaurbalyādavipakvastu yo rasaḥ | sa āmasaṃjñako jñeyo dehadoṣaprakopanaḥ ||’ iti || Gū. yaddravyaṃ āmaṃ na pacet vahnikṛdasti tat dīpanaṃ | yathā miśiḥ śatapuṣpā | pacatyāmaṃ na vahniṃ ca kuryādyattaddhi pācanam || 1 || nāgakeśaravadvidyāccitro dīpanapācanaḥ | Dī. atha pācanamāha - pacatyāmamityādi | yaddravyamāmaṃ pacati vahniṃ na kuryāt tat pācanaṃ jñeyam | atrāpi dravyaprabhāvo boddhavyaḥ | tacca nāgakeśaravadvidyājjānīyāt | yataḥ ‘nāgakeśarakaṃ rūkṣamuṣṇaṃ laghvāmapācanam’ iti | āmapācanamiti virūkṣaṇam | sāmānāṃ doṣadhātumalānāmityeke | ubhayātmakamāha - citro dīpanapācana iti | citraka ubhayakāryakaro bhavati | dīpanaḥ pācanaśca | taduktam - ’citrakaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke vahnikṛtpācano laghuḥ |’ iti || 1 || Gū. yat (dravyaṃ) āmaṃ pacati vahniṃ na kuryāt tatpācanam | tadāha citraḥ citrakaḥ, nāgakeśaravaddīpanapācanaṃ vidyāt jānīyāt granthāntarāt mādhuryācchītabhāvācca na punardīpano mataḥ | yatkāmaṃ pācanaṃ kuryāt tattu dīpanamucyate ||1|| na śodhayati na dveṣṭi samān doṣāṃstathoddhatān ||2|| samīkaroti viṣamāñśamanaṃ tadyathā 'mṛtā | Dī. atha saṃśamanamāha - na śodhayatīti | yat kiñcit pītalīḍhāśitamanirhṛtya doṣaṃ saṃśamayati tat saṃśamanam | etena kimuktaṃ yaddravyaṃ na vāmayati na virecayati iti vyādhinā saha ekībhūya tatsthameva vyādhimupaśamayati tat saṃśamanamiti bhāvaḥ | doṣaśabdo 'tra doṣeṣu kāryavyādhiṣvapi vartate | kārye kāraṇopacārāt | asamaṃ samaṃ karoti samīkaroti | yathā-amṛtā guḍūcī saṃśamanī prasiddhā | taduktaṃ - ‘rasāyanī saṃśamanī doṣāṇāṃ jvaranāśinī | guḍūcī kaṭukā laghvī tiktā 'gnidīpanī matā’ iti | kecittu - ‘na śodhayati yaddoṣān samān nodīrayatyapi | samīkaroti ca kruddhān tat saṃśamanamucyate’ iti paṭhanti | atrāpi sa evā 'bhiprāyaḥ | samyak śamayatīti saṃśamanaṃ, samyag duṣṭadoṣasyānirharaṇapūrvakaṃ śamanaṃ aduṣṭasyānudīraṇaṃ ca, vyādhiśamane tu prastutavyādhiśamanaṃ, aprastutavyādheranudīraṇamiti spaṣṭārthajñāpanāya na doṣaḥ || punarbhāvakathanāt || 2 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ uddhatān varddhitān doṣānna śodhayati upaśamaṃ no nayati samānsaprakṛtisthānna dveṣṭi na vardhayati kiṃtu samīkaroti tat śamanaṃ jñeyam | yathā amṛtā guḍūcī tadvadityarthaḥ || 2 || kṛtvā pākaṃ malānāṃ yadbhittvā bandhamadho nayet ||3|| taccānulomanaṃ jñeyaṃ yathā proktā harītakī | Dī. athānulomanamāha - kṛtveti | yaddravyaṃ malānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ pākaṃ kopaśāntiṃ kṛtvā bandhaṃ nibandhaṃ ca bhittvā bhinnatāṃ nītvā adho nayet adhaḥ karoti vātādikamiti śeṣaḥ, tena pratilomādanulomaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | taccānulomanaṃ jñeyaṃ, anulomanaṃ vātādīnāmadhaḥpravartanaṃ rasaguṇatvāt | yathā harītakī | saivā 'nulominī prasiddhaiva | bandhamiti doṣāṇāṃ parasparagrathitatvaṃ | eke vātamūtrapurīṣādīnāmapravṛttirūpaṃ vibandhamāhuḥ || 3 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ aparipacyamānānāṃ malānāṃ pākaṃ kṛtvā bandhaṃ ca bhittvā adhaḥ nayet koṣṭhādadhaḥ pātayet tataḥ anulomanaṃ jñeyaṃ | yathā harītakī || 3 || paktavyaṃ yadapaktvaiva śliṣṭaṃ koṣṭhe malādikam || 4 || nayatyadhaḥ sraṃsanaṃ tadyathā syātkṛtamālakaḥ | Dī. atha sraṃsanamāha - paktavyamiti | yaddravyaṃ malādikam apaktvaiva teṣāṃ pākamakṛtvā adho nayati adhaḥ patanaṃ karoti tat sraṃsanaṃ syāt | yathā kṛtamālakaḥ | kīdṛśaṃ malādikam ? ityāha - paktavyamiti | pacyamānam ata eva koṣṭhe āśliṣṭaṃ, koṣṭha iti pācakasthāne, āśliṣṭamityāśritam | kecit koṣṭhaśabdena hṛdayādīnyapi gṛhyante | tathāhi -‘sthānānyāmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca | hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaśca koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate’ iti | etadabhiprāyeṇā 'pi śodhanamasyāhuḥ || 4 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ koṣṭhe śliṣṭaṃ paktavyaṃ malādikam apaktvaivāpācayitvā adhaḥ nayati tatsraṃsanaṃ syāt | yathā kṛtamālakaḥ āragvadhaḥ || 4 || malādikamabaddhaṃ ca baddhaṃ vā piṇḍitaṃ malaiḥ || 5 || bhittvādhaḥ pātayati tadbhedanaṃ kaṭukī yathā | Dī. atha bhedanamāha - maleti | yanmalādikamabaddhaṃ malabaddhaṃ vā ata eva malairdoṣaiśca kṛtvā piṇḍitaparipākāt piṇḍībhūtam | īdṛśaṃ malādikaṃ bhittvā sthānāt sañcālyādhaḥ pātayati tadbhedanaṃ jñātavyamiti śeṣaḥ | yathā kaṭukī | baddhaṃ, vibaddhaṃ, śuṣkaṃ, grathitaṃ ca | tatra śuṣkaṃ purīṣaviṣayaṃ | grathitaṃ doṣādīnām | tathā abaddhamapi dvividham | ekaṃ dravarūpaṃ purīṣaviṣayaṃ svatantramekaṃ malādikamiti, malo 'tra doṣaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt rūkṣadūṣitādīnāmapi grahaṇam | bhittveti tatpurīṣaṃ bhittvā vidāryādhaḥ pātayati dravyamiti śeṣaḥ || 5 || Gū. yaddravyam abaddhaṃ malādikaṃ piṇḍitaiḥ piṇḍībhūtairmalairbaddhaṃ vā bhittvādhaḥ pātayati udbhedanaṃ | yathā kaṭukī ||5|| vipakvaṃ yadapakvaṃ vā malādi dravatāṃ nayet || 6 || recayatyapi tajjñeyaṃ recanaṃ trivṛtā yathā | Dī. atha recanamāha - vipakvamiti | yaddravyaṃ vipakvamapakvaṃ vā malādi doṣādikaṃ dravatāṃ nayet dravabhāvaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | na kevalaṃ dravatāṃ nayet recayatyapi ca tadrecanaṃ jñeyaṃ, yathā tṛvṛtā ‘nisotaḥ’ | yato virecanadravyāṇi gurvambuguṇabhūyiṣṭhāni tāni gurutvādadho gacchanti | gurutvāditi gurutvaṃ ceha prabhāvaviśeṣādhiṣṭhitam | trivṛtādikaṃ samavetaṃ grāhyaṃ na tu gurutvamātram | anyathā matsyapiṣṭānnamasūrādīnāṃ virecakatvaṃ syāt | ambuguṇabhūyiṣṭhamityarthaḥ, prabhāvāt | malādikamiti ādigrahaṇāt dūṣyadūṣitādīnāmatra saṃgrahaḥ || 6 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ vipakvaṃ malādi apakvaṃ vā dravatāṃ nayet prāpayet punarbahireva yāti tat recanaṃ jñeyam | yathā tṛvṛtā || apakvapittaśleṣmāṇau balādūrdhvaṃ nayettu yat || 7 || vamanaṃ taddhi vijñeyaṃ madanasya phalaṃ yathā | Dī. atha vamanamāha - apakvamiti | yaddravyamapakvaṃ pākamagacchantaṃ pittaśleṣmāṇaṃ vyastaṃ miśritaṃ vā balāt haṭhātkāreṇa ūrdhvaṃ nayet mukhe kṛtvā vāmayedityabhiprāyaḥ | tadvamanaṃ vijñeyaṃ yathā madanasya phalam | balāditi prabhāvasūcakaśabdaḥ, yato vamanadravyāṇi vāyvagniguṇabhūyiṣṭhāni, vāyvagnī hi laghutvācca tānyūrdhvamuttiṣṭhanti | laghutvaṃ ceha prabhāvaviśeṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ madanaphalādidravyasamavetaṃ grāhyaṃ na tu laghutvamātram, anyathā kapiñjalalājādīnāṃ ca vāmanīyatvaṃ syāt | nanu kaphasya vamanaṃ pittasya virecanaṃ praśastamiti prasiddhiḥ, tat kathaṃ pittasya vamanamiti ? ucyate -apakvapittasya vamanādeva nibarhaṇaṃ boddhavyam | tacca dṛśyate hi kaṭutiktaharitpītāmlavamanatvena yataḥ pittadagdhamamlatāmupaitīti | ata evā 'mlapittacikitsāyāmādau vamanamityadoṣaḥ || 7 || Gū. yaddravyam apakvaṃ pittaśleṣmānnacayam ūrdhvaṃ nayet hi niścayena tat vamanaṃ vijñeyam | yathā madanasya phalam, apakvaṃ pittaṃ ca apakvaḥ śleṣmā ca apakvamannaṃ ca apakvapittaśleṣmānnānāṃ cayam apakvapittaśleṣmānnacayam atra śleṣman śabdasya nakārasya lope yāte sati lope 'śi punarna saṃdhirityuktatvāt | sa ‘savarṇe dīrghaḥ saha’ ityanena sūtreṇa pūrvāparavarṇayormitho ghaṭanarūpasandhirna atra punargrahādeva sandhiḥ, anyathā dāmodaḍiṣvityādau sandhirna syāt | ato 'tra sandhiryukta eva || 7 || sthānādbahirnayedūrdhvamadho vā malasaṃcayam || 8 || dehasaṃśodhanaṃ tatsyāddevadālīphalaṃ yathā | Dī. atha śodhanamāha - sthānāditi | yaddravyaṃ sthānāt prakupitasthānāt malasañcayaṃ doṣādīnāṃ svasthānādūrdhvamadho vā bahirnayet bahiḥ karoti taddehe śarīre śodhanaṃ kathitam | yathā devadālīphalam | devadālīvallīsaṃjñā | ūrdhvaṃ mukhanāsikābhyāṃ, adhaḥ pāyumeḍhramārgeṇa | dehagrahaṇena śoṇitāvasecanamapi gṛhyate śodhanatvāt | yataḥ śodhanaṃ dvividhamācakṣate bahirāśrayamabhyantarāśrayaṃ ca | tatra bahirāśrayaṃ śastrakṣārāgnipralepādayaḥ | abhyantarāśrayaṃ tu catuḥprakāraṃ vamanarecanāsthāpanaśoṇitamokṣaṇaṃ ca | eke śirovirecanaṃ manyante | taccātra vamanāntarbhūtaṃ boddhavyam, ūrdhvaśodhanatvāt || 8 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ sthānādbahiḥ sthānānnirasya ūrdhvaṃ vā adhaḥ malasañcayaṃ nayet taddehe saṃśodhanaṃ syāt | yathā devadālīphalam || 8 || śliṣṭānkaphādikāndoṣānunmūlayati yadbalāt ||9|| chedanaṃ tadyathā kṣārā maricāni śilājatu || Dī. atha chedanamāha - śliṣṭāniti | yaddravyaṃ śliṣṭān sañcitān, parasparagrathitānityeke, atyarthaṃ kupitānityapare, kaphādikān doṣān, ādigrahaṇena vātapittaśoṇitakṛmigrahaṇaṃ na tu dūṣyadūṣyatādikaṃ, yataḥ doṣāniti punargrahaṇaṃ kṛmiśoṇitayorapi doṣasaṃjñā | taduktaṃ suśrute ‘narte dehaḥ kaphādasti na pittānna ca mārutāt | śoṇitādapi vā nityaṃ deha etaistu dhāryate’ ityādipratipāditatvāt | kṛmistu guggulukalpe yathā pañcādidoṣān śamayedityādipraśne kṛmidoṣanibarhaṇādityādinā, tanmate kṛmestu doṣasaṃjñā | balāditi svaśaktitaḥ, unmūlayati ucchedayati, tacchedanaṃ jñeyam | yathā kṣārā yavakṣārādayaḥ, maricānīti bahuvacanatvena śvetamaricamapi grāhyam | nanu vātādikramaṃ parityajya kaphādikrameṇa ślokaḥ kasmādiha kṛtaḥ ? taducyate, dehasya ūrdhvamūlatvamadhaḥśākhatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ pūrvācāryaiḥ, ūrdhvabhāge ca kaphādhiṣṭhānatvāttato 'nena kapha eva prathamaṃ darśitaḥ | taduktam - ‘ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhaṃ tristhūṇaṃ pañcadaivatam | kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidvān yo vai veda sa vedavit ’ || 9 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ śliṣṭān lagnān malādikāndoṣān balādunmūlayati svabhāvānnāśayati tacchedanaṃ jñeyam | yathā kṣārā maricāni śilājatu || 9 || dhātūnmalānvā dehasya viśoṣyollekhayecca yat ||1 .|| lekhanaṃ tadyathā kṣaudraṃ nīramuṣṇaṃ vacā yavāḥ | Dī. atha lekhanamāha - dhātūniti | yaddravyaṃ dhātūn rasādīn malān vā | atra malānveti yadgrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tanmanodoṣavyavacchedārtham | yato manodoṣapratīkārakamanyadapyastīti | tathāhi ‘dhīrdhṛtirjñānavijñānaṃ manodoṣauṣadhaṃ param’ iti | ke te manodoṣāḥ ? ityuttaramāha ‘rajastamaśca manaso dvau ca doṣāvudāhṛtau’ ityādi | eke - ‘lekhanaṃ tadyathā kṣaudranīrakoṣṇaṃ vacā yavāḥ ’ iti paṭhanti | tatra kṣaudranīre madhvambunī milite iti yogo lekhanasaṃjñaḥ, koṣṇamityuṣṇapānīyaṃ ‘kaṃ śiro jalamākhyātam’ iti vacanāt| uṣṇaṃ ca tatkaṃ ceti koṣṇaṃ alpasvaratvāt pūrvanipātaḥ | ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ svakapolakalpanayā kenā 'pi likhitaḥ yato bahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate | yavā iti bahuvacanagrahaṇena evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭā anye 'pi boddhavyāḥ || 10 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ dehasthān dhātūnmalānviśoṣya śuṣkaṃ kṛtvā lekhayet sthūlasya kṛśādi kārayet tallekhanam | yathā kṣaudram uṣṇaṃ nīraṃ vacā yavāḥ || 10 || dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ yatsyāduṣṇatvāddravaśoṣakam || 11 || grāhi tacca yathā śuṇṭhī jīrakaṃ gajapippalī | Dī. atha grāhilakṣaṇamāha - dīpanamiti | yaddravyaṃ dīpanamagnikaraṃ - pācanamāmādīnāṃ, dravaśoṣakamiti dravasvarūpāṇāṃ doṣadhātumalādīnāṃ śoṣakamityarthaḥ, uṣṇatvāt uṣṇavīryatvāt | dravaśoṣakamiti yojyaṃ, dīpanādikāryakaratvena upalakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ| tadgrāhi vijñeyam | yathā śuṇṭhī jīrakaṃ, gajapippalī, gajapippalī cavyaphalam | nanu saṃgrāhakamanilaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ yato 'nilasya śoṣaṇātmakatvāt | tatkathamuktamuṣṇatvāditi | ucyate - pakvāmagrāhakatvena dvividhaṃ hi saṃgrāhakatvaṃ tatra yad grahaṇyāmāmaṃ sampācya vahniṃ kṛtvā tatrasthaṃ dravaṃ ca śoṣayitvā stambhanaṃ karoti taduṣṇagrāhakaṃ jñeyam | yaddravyamatīsārādau pakvamalādikaṃ saṃstabhya saṃgrahaṃ karoti tacchītagrāhakaṃ jñeyametadanilaguṇabhūyiṣṭhamityadoṣaḥ || 11|| Gū. yaddravyam uṣṇatvād dravaśoṣakaṃ dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ syāt tadgrāhi yathā śuṇṭhī jīrakaṃ gajapippalī || 11 || raukṣyācchaityātkaṣāyatvāllaghupākācca yadbhavet || 12 || vātakṛtstambhanaṃ tatsyādyathā vatsakaṭuṇṭukau | Dī. atha ca tadeva stambhanamāha - raukṣyāditi | yaddravyaṃ raukṣyāt | rūkṣaguṇatvāt, śaityāditi śītavīryatvāt, kaṣāyāditi kaṣāyarasatvāt, laghupākācca laghuparipākādvātakṛdbhavati tat stambhanaṃ syāt | vātaguṇasādharmyaṃ hetucatuṣṭayam | anilasya śoṣaṇātmakatvenānilaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ dravyaṃ stambhanaṃ bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ | yathā vatsakaṭuṇṭukau, yatheti dṛṣṭāntatvenopadarśitam | vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, ṭuṇṭukaḥ syonākaḥ | vātakṛdityanena koṣṭhavāyorviṣṭambhakaḥ | tasmāt taddravyaṃ stambhanaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ || 12 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ raukṣyācchaityātkaṣāyatvāt laghupākādvātakṛt tatstambhanaṃ syāt | yathā vatsakaṭuṇṭukau | vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, ṭuṇṭukaḥ syonākaḥ || 12 || rasāyanaṃ ca tajjñeyaṃ yajjarāvyādhināśanam || 13 || yathā 'mṛtā rudantī ca gugguluśca harītakī | Dī. atha rasāyanamāha -- rasāyanaṃ ceti | yaddravyaṃ jarāvyādhināśanaṃ bhavati tadrasāyanaṃ jñeyam | rasādīnāṃ dhātūnāmayanamāpyāyanarūpaṃ rasāyanam | yathā amṛtā guḍūcī, rudantī śākabhedaḥ paścime atīva vikhyātaḥ | gugguluḥ śālaniryāsaḥ prasiddhaḥ | harītakī prasiddhā | jarā vārdhakyaṃ, vyādhayo jvarādayo rogā grāhyāḥ | nanu vyādhigrahaṇena jarāgrahaṇaṃ tat kathamatra jarā pṛthagabhihitā ? ucyate - jarā svābhāvikī jñeyā svabhāvakathanatvena pṛthagabhidhānamityadoṣaḥ | yataḥ saptaterūrdhvaṃ svabhāvavadbhavatīti ||13|| Gū. yaddravyaṃ jarāvyādhināśanaṃ tat rasāyanaṃ syāt | yathā 'mṛtā, rudantī ca, gugguluśca, harītakī ( ca) || 13 || yasmādravyādbhavetstrīṣu harṣo vājīkaraṃ ca tat || 14 || yathā nāgabalādyāḥ syurbījaṃ ca kapikacchujam | Dī. atha vājīkaraṇamāha - yasmāditi | yasmāddravyāt strīṣu strīpuruṣayoḥ harṣaḥ kāmaśaktisuratasukhaṃ bhavet tadvājīkaraṃ jñātavyam | yathā nāgabalādyāḥ syuriti nāgabalā gāṅgerukī ādiśabdāt jātiphalāhiphenabhaṅgāprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam | kapikacchubījamapi vājīkaraṇaṃ kapikacchurvānarī | dvividhadṛṣṭāntenātra dvividhaṃ vājīkaraṇaṃ sūcitam | ekaṃ vīryastambhanarūpam aparaṃ vīryavardhanamityanena paunaruktyāpyadoṣaḥ || 14 || Gū. yasmāddravyāt strīṣu harṣo bhavet tat vājīkaraṃ, yathā nāgabalādyāḥ syuḥ, kapikacchujaṃ bījaṃ ca || 14 || yasmācchukrasya vṛddhiḥ syācchukralaṃ ca taducyate || 15|| yathā 'śvagandhā musalī śarkarā ca śatāvarī | Dī. athātra tadeva vīryakaradravyaṃ prakaṭayannāha - yasmāditi | śukralamiti śukravṛddhikaram | śeṣaṃ subodham || 15 || Gū. yasmāddravyāt śukrasya vṛddhiḥ syāt tat śukralaṃ syāt | yathā aśvagandhādyā jñeyāḥ || 15 || dugdhaṃ māṣāśca bhallātaphalamajjāmalāni ca || 16 || pravartakāni kathyante janakāni ca retasaḥ | Dī. atha śukrasya janakāni pravartakāni ca dravyāṇyāha - dugdhamiti | retasaḥ śukrasya dugdhādīni dravyāṇi pravartakāni kathyante | na kevalaṃ pravartakāni utpādakarāṇi ca ? kathyante prabhāvāt | māṣo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ, āmalānīti āmalakaphalāni | śeṣaṃ prasiddham || 16 || pravartanī strī śukrasya recanaṃ bṛhatīphalam || 17 || jātīphalaṃ stambhakaṃ ca śoṣaṇī ca harītakī | Dī. vājīkaraṇānāmauṣadhānāṃ viśeṣānāha - pravartanīti | śukrasya vīryasya pravartanī prakaṭakāriṇī strī kathitetyarthaḥ | recanaṃ bṛhatīphalamiti śukrasyetyatrāpi sambandhaḥ | bṛhatī bṛhatkaṇṭakārikā tasyāḥ phalam | stambhakamavarodhakaraṃ jātīphalaṃ bhavati | atrāpi vīryasyeti sambandhaḥ | śoṣaṇī hīnakāriṇī harītakī kathitā | cakārādatrāpi śukrasyetyarthaḥ | eke śoṣaṇī ca harītakītyasya sthāne kāliṅgaṃ kṣayakāri ceti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca kāliṅgaṃ phalavartulamiti || 17 || Gū. srī śukrasya pravartanī, yaddravyaṃ tadrecanaṃ yathā bṛhatīphalaṃ puṃso nāryāḥ śukrasya staṃbhanaṃ jātīphalaṃ syāt, kaliṅgaṃ brahmaśīrṣaṃ kṣayakāri syāt || 17 || dehasya sūkṣmachidreṣu viśedyatsūkṣmamucyate || 18 || tadyathā saindhavaṃ kṣaudraṃ nimbatailaṃ rubūdbhavam | Dī. atha sūkṣmadravyamāha - dehasyeti | yaddravyaṃ dehasya śarīrasya sūkṣmachidreṣu romakūpaprabhṛtiṣu viśet praveśaṃ karoti tatsūkṣmamucyate | yathā saindhavādikam | sūkṣmo guṇaviśeṣaḥ, srotonusaraṇaśīlatvāt | saindhavaṃ prasiddhaṃ kṣaudraṃ madhu nimbatailaṃ nimbaṃ ca tailaṃ ca, yadvā nimbasya tailaṃ rubūdbhavaṃ tailaṃ ca, rubūdbhavameraṇḍasaṃbhavam || 18 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ dehasya sūkṣmacchidreṣu viśet praviśet tatsūkṣmamucyate | yathā saindhavaṃ kṣaudraṃ nimbatailaṃ eraṇḍatailaṃ ( ca) || 18 || pūrvaṃ vyāpyākhilaṃ kāyaṃ tataḥ pākaṃ ca gacchati ||19|| vyavāyi tadyathā bhaṅgā phenaṃ cāhisamudbhavam | Dī. atha vyavāyidravyamāha -- vyavāyīti | vyavāyīti guṇaviśeṣaḥ | apakvamevākhilaṃ dehaṃ vyāpnoti paścānmadyaviṣayavat pākaṃ yāti | evaṃ bhaṅgā, ahiphenaṃ ca, ahiphenaṃ “aphū” śabdavācyam | anye tu ‘tadabhāvāya kalpate’ iti paṭhanti | tatrā 'pi sthitaye kalpate nordhvamadho vā pravartata iti sa evārthaḥ | anye punarbhāvaśabdamabhiprāyārthamicchanti | tatra niyatadravyaprabhāveṇātmaśaktyanurūpaṃ taddravyaṃ madyaviṣayavat viśeṣābhiprāyāya kalpate ityarthaḥ || 19 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ pūrvam akhilaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ kāyaṃ vyāpya paścātpākaṃ gacchati tadvyavāyi | yathā bhaṅgā ahisamudbhavaṃ phenam || 19 || sandhibandhāṃstu śithilānyatkaroti vikāśi tat || 20 || viśleṣyaujaśca dhātubhyo yathā kramukakodravāḥ | Dī. atha vikāśidravyasyāpi kiñcidbhedaṃ darśayannāha - sandhibandhāniti | yaddravyaṃ sandhibandhān śithilībhūtān karoti tadvikāśi boddhavyaṃ, vikāśi ityapi guṇaviśeṣaḥ, na kevalaṃ sandhibandhān śithilān karoti kintu dhātubhya ojo balaṃ viśleṣya vibhajya pākaṃ gacchati ityadhyāhāraḥ | dhātuśaithilyamapi karoti ityabhiprāyaḥ | cakārādapakvamevetyatrāpi saṃbandhaḥ | kramukakodravā iti | kramukaṃ pūgaphalam, kodravaṃ kudhānyaviśeṣaḥ | ataḥ kramukakodravā madakarā jñeyāḥ | dhātuśaithilyāt ojo balamiti | suśrutena taduktam - ‘rasādīnāṃ śukrāntānāṃ dhātūnāṃ yatparaṃ tejastat khalvojastadeva balamityucyate’ yataḥ - ‘dehaḥ sāvayavastena vyāpto bhavati dehinām’’ iti | sandhiprabhṛtīnāṃ śithilatvena śramāṇāṃ cotpadyate tena ojaḥkṣayo bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ | ata evāha kaścit - ’abhighātātkṣayātkopādyānācchokācchramāt kṣudhaḥ | ojaḥ saṃkṣīyate hyebhyo dhātugrahaṇaniḥsṛtam’ iti | anye tu saviśeṣo vyavāyī tīkṣṇaviśeṣo vikāśīti bruvate, tanna sarvamatam || 20 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ dhātubhyaḥ ojaḥ vīryaṃ viśleṣya sandhibandhān śithilān karoti tadvikāśi yathā kramukaḥ, pūgīphalaṃ, kodravāśca || 20 || buddhiṃ lumpati yaddravyaṃ madakāri taducyate || 21 || tamoguṇapradhānaṃ ca yathā madyaṃ surādikam | Dī. atha madakāridravyasya lakṣaṇāni darśayannāha -- buddhimiti | yaddravyaṃ buddhiṃ jñānaviṣayaṃ lumpati ācchādayati tanmadakāri kathyate, ata eva tamoguṇapradhānaṃ tamoguṇabahulamityarthaḥ | yathā surādikaṃ madyādikam | buddhistu medhādhṛtismṛtimatipratipattiṣu vartate | eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ prasaṅgāducyate | tadyathā medhā granthākarṣaṇasāmarthyaṃ, dhṛtiḥ santuṣṭiḥ,anye niyamātmikāṃ buddhimāhuḥ | smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhūtasya smaraṇam | arthadhāraṇāśaktirityanye | matiranāgataviṣayopadeśaḥ, trikālaviṣayā buddhirityanye; pratipattirarthāvabodhaprāgalbhyamiti | surādikamityādigrahaṇāt sarve madyavikārā gṛhyante | nanumadyaṃ tu buddhismṛtivāgviceṣṭādikaramuktam | taduktaṃ - ‘buddhismṛtiprītikaraḥ sukhaṃ ca pānānnanidrārativardhanaṃ ca | sampāṭhagītasvaravardhanaṃ ca prokto 'tiramyaḥ prathamo mado hi’ tat kathaṃ buddhilopakamabhihitam ?, ucyate - madasya catvāraḥ pānāvasthāḥ kathitāḥ tatra prathamaṃ madapānaṃ buddhyādikaṃ karoti, śeṣāstu buddhyādikaṃ lumpantītyadoṣaḥ | taduktaṃ mādhavena - ‘avyaktabuddhismṛtivāgviceṣṭaḥ sonmattalīlākṛtirapraśāntaḥ | ālasyanidrābhihito muhuśca madhyena mattaḥ puruṣo madena’ ityādi || 21 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ buddhiṃ lumpati tanmadakāri ucyate | yathā tamoguṇapradhānaṃ madyaṃ surā || 21 || vyavāyi ca vikāśi syātsūkṣmaṃ chedi madāvaham || 22 || āgneyaṃ jīvitaharaṃ yogavāhi smṛtaṃ viṣam | Dī. atha prāṇaharadravyamāha - vyavāyi ceti | yaddravyaṃ vyavāyādiguṇayuktaṃ bhavati tajjīvitaharaṃ prāṇaharaṃ smṛtaṃ kathitam | yathā viṣam | tadeva yogavāhi smṛtamityarthaḥ | vyavāyīti samastadehaṃ vyāpya paścāt pākaṃ gacchatīti vyavāyī guṇaḥ, vikāśī guṇaśca sakaladehaṃ vyāpya dhātuśaithilyaṃ karoti | sūkṣmo guṇastu sūkṣmāt sūkṣmeṣu srotassvanusvaraḥ smṛtaḥ | chedanaṃ manodoṣadhātumalādīn balādunmūlayati tacchedi kathitam | madāvahamiti madakārakam | āgne- yamityāgneyaguṇabhūyiṣṭham | yogavāhīti rasādiṣu draṣṭavyam || 22 || Gū. jīvitaharaṃ jīvanāśakaṃ yaddravyaṃ tadakhilakāyavyāpakatvāt vyavāyi sandhibandhaśithilakāritvāt | vikāśi syāt, sūkṣmaṃ madāvahaṃ syāt, chedi syāt, āgneyaṃ ca syāt, yathā yogavāhi smṛtaṃ viṣam ||22|| nijavīryeṇa yaddravyaṃ srotobhyo doṣasaṃcayam || 23 || nirasyati pramāthi syāttadyathā maricaṃ vacā | Dī. atha pramāthidravyamāha - nijavīryeṇeti | yaddravyaṃ nijavīryeṇa svaprabhāveṇa kṛtvā srotobhyaḥ karṇamukhanāsādīnāṃ anyavivarebhyaśca vā doṣabāhulyaṃ nirasyati tat pramāthisaṃjñaṃ kathitam | yathā maricaṃ vacā | doṣaśabdo'tra vyādhiṣvapi vartate kāraṇe kāryopacārāt, tena vyādhisañcayamapītyarthaḥ || 23 || Gū. yaddravyaṃ nijavīryeṇa svaprabhāveṇa srotobhyaḥ rasavāhiśirāmārgebhyaḥ doṣasaṃcayaṃ nirasya dūrīkaroti tatpramāthi syāt| yathā maricaṃ vacā || 23 || paicchilyādgauravāddravyaṃ ruddhvā rasavahāḥ śirāḥ || 24 || dhatte yadgauravaṃ tatsyādabhiṣyandi yathā dadhi || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne dīpanapācanā'dhyāyaścaturthaḥ | Dī. athābhiṣyandilakṣaṇamāha - paicchilyāditi | yaddravyaṃ paicchilyāt picchilaguṇayogāt, gauravāt guruguṇayogāt, gurupākasvabhāvādvā rasavahāścaturviṃśatisaṃkhyākāḥ śirāḥ rudhvā saṃrudhya gauravaṃ gurutāṃ dhatte tadabhiṣyandi kathitam | yathā dadhi abhiṣyandīti | śleṣmaprakopīti rūḍhiḥ guṇasādharmyāt śleṣmā'pi picchilagauravādiguṇayuktaḥ || 24 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ prathamakhaṇḍe dīpanapācanādividhiradhyāyaścaturthaḥ ||iti sūtrasthānam || Gū. yaddravyaṃ paicchalyāccaikkaṇyāt gauravāt rasavahāḥ śirā rudhvā gauravaṃ dhatte tadabhiṣyandi syāt | yathā dadhi ||24|| iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthapradīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne dīpanapācanādiguṇoktividhirnāmādhyāyaścaturthaḥ| (śārīram) Editor's notes 1 ‘śra’ ka. ↩ 2 chedanam pā. ↩

title: 5. atha kalādikākhyānādhyāyaḥ
text: dhātvāśayāntarasthastu yaḥ kledastvadhitiṣṭhati | dehoṣmaṇā vipakvo yaḥ sā kaletyabhidhīyate ||1||) kalāḥ saptāśayāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ sapta tanmalāḥ | saptopadhātavaḥ sapta tvacaḥ sapta prakīrtitāḥ || 1 || trayo doṣā navaśataṃ snāyūnāṃ saṃdhayastathā | daśā'dhikaṃ ca dviśatamasthnāṃ ca triśataṃ tathā ||2|| saptottaraṃ marmaśataṃ śirāḥ saptaśataṃ tathā | caturviṃśatirākhyātā dhamanyo rasavāhikāḥ || 3 || māṃsapeśyaḥ samākhyātā nṛṇāṃ pañcaśataṃ budhaiḥ | strīṇāṃ ca viṃśatyadhikāḥ kaṇḍarāścaiva ṣoḍaśa ||4|| nṛdehe daśa randhrāṇi nārīdehe trayodaśa |’ etatsamāsataḥ proktaṃ vistareṇādhunocyate || 5 || atha sapta kalāḥ | māṃsāsṛṅmedasāṃ tisro yakṛtplīhnoścaturthikā | pañcamī ca tathā'ntrāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭhī cāgnidharā matā || 6 || retodharā saptamī syāditi sapta kalāḥ smṛtāḥ | Dī. pūrvamuktaṃ kalādikākhyāna iti | atastaddarśayannāha - kalā iti | kalādi - pratānānāmetannāmasaṃkhyākathanam | samāsataḥ saṃkṣepāt | proktaṃ kathitamityartha: | tadyathā - kalāḥ saptasaṃkhyākāḥ tāśca dhātvāśayāntaramaryādā | tathāhi - ‘dhātvāśayāntaraistasya yatkledastvadhitiṣṭhati | dehoṣmaṇā vipakvo yaḥ sā kaletyabhidhīyate ||’ iti | āśayāḥ sapta, āśayāḥ sthānāni tāni koṣṭhaśabdenopalakṣitāni tathāhi - ‘sthānānyāmāni pakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca | hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaśca koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate ||’ iti | dhātavaḥ sapta kathitāḥ, dhātavo rasādayaḥ, te-‘rasā'sṛṅmāṃsamedo'sthimajjaśukrāṇi dhātavaḥ’ iti | sapta tanmalā dhātumalāḥ, teṣāṃ dhātūnāṃ pratipākataḥ kaphādisaṃjñā ityarthaḥ | saptopadhātava iti | dhātusamīpe bhavā upadhātavaḥ, yathā gomayādibhyo vṛścikādisaṃbhavaḥ, te stanyarajaḥprabhṛtayaḥ | tvacaḥ sapta prakīrtitāḥ iti śukraśoṇitasyābhipacyamānakṣīrasyeva santānikāḥ saptatvaco bhavanti | trayo doṣāḥ vātapittakaphasaṃjñāḥ, dhātvādīn dūṣayantīti | sandhiravayavādīnā sandhānam | granthiriti loke | atra cakāragrahaṇāt daśottaraśatadvayādapi adhikā boddhavyāḥ | taduktam - ‘jñeyaṃ cikitsakairnūnaṃ sandhīnāṃ ca śatadvayam | daśottaraṃ sahasre dve nijagādā'trinandana:’ iti | asthnāṃ ca triśataṃ matamiti | asthi sārabhūtaṃ śarīrasyādhārarūpaṃ ca kathitam | saptottaraṃ marmaśatamiti | marmāṇi jīvasyādhārarūpāṇi tāni saptā'dhikaśatasaṃkhyāni | tathā śirāḥ saptaśatāni ceti | doṣadhātujalavāhinyaḥ śirāḥ kathitāḥ, cakārādatra na ca saptaśataṃ niyatam anyāśca santītyeke bhāṣante; taduktaṃ -“dvisaptatisahasrāṇi nāḍīnāṃ tadvinirgatāḥ | tābhyo vinirgatā nāḍyastābhyo'thānyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || tāvatyo nāḍyo dehe yāvatyo romakūpakāḥ | sthūlamūlāḥ susūkṣmāgrāḥ patrarekhāpratānavat” iti | dhamanyo nāḍīviśeṣāścaturviśatisaṃkhyakāḥ kathitāstāśca rasavahā jñeyāḥ, śirā dhamanyo nāḍyaśca parasparaparyāyavācakā jñeyāḥ, bhinnatvamāsāṃ kāryatvāt | māṃsapeśya iti - nṛṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ māṃsapeśyaḥ pañcaśatasaṃkhyakāḥ samākhyātāḥ | budhairitiśeṣaḥ | peśī dīrghākṛtimāṃsakhaṇḍaḥ, aparaiścaturasrā peśītyucyate | tathācoktam ‘caturasrā bhavet peśī vṛttaḥ piṇḍo ghanaḥ smṛtaḥ | śālmalīmukulākārāmarbudaṃ paricakṣate’ iti | strīṇāṃ viṃśatyadhikā ityanena māṃsapeśyaḥ kathitāḥ, adhikāśca pañcaśatāt, tena viṃśatyadhikapañcaśatamāṃsapeśyaḥ strīṇāṃ bhavantītyabhiprāyaḥ | viṃśatervivaraṇamāha - stanayoḥ pañca pañca, catasraśca yonau, garbhamārge tisraḥ, garbhāśaye ca tisra iti | kaṇḍarāścaiva ṣoḍaśeti - kaṇḍarā mahāsnāyuḥ | ṣoḍaśeti ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyakāḥ | tadyathā - catasraḥ pādayoḥ, hastayoścatasraḥ, grīvāyāṃ catasraḥ, pṛṣṭhe catasraḥ | nṛdehe daśa randhrāṇi | nārīdehe trayodaśeti | nṛdehe puruṣaśarīre daśasaṃkhyakāni randhrāṇi chidrāṇi santītyadhyāhāryam | nārīdehe strīśarīre trayodaśa randhrāṇīti bhāvaḥ | tānyagre vakṣyamāṇāni jñātavyāni | etat sarvaṃ kalādikaṃ samāsataḥ saṃkṣepāt proktaṃ kathitamityarthaḥ ||1-5||atha ‘vistareṇādhunocyata’ ityuktaṃ prāk idānīṃ vistarameteṣāṃ darśayannāha -māṃseti | māṃsāsṛṅmedasāṃ tisraḥ kalāḥ, tāsāṃ saṃjñā yathā - māṃsadharā, raktadharā, medodharā iti caturthikā yakṛtplīhno: sā śleṣmadharā yakṛtplīhnormadhye ityabhiprāyaḥ | pañcamī kalā cāntrāṇāṃ sā purīṣadharā | ṣaṣṭhī cāgneḥ sā pittadharā | saptamī kalā retodharā iti sapta kalāḥ smṛtāḥ kathitāḥ | taduktaṃ suśrute - “tāsāṃ prathamā māṃsadharā nāma yasyāṃ māṃse śirāsnāyudhamanīsrotasāṃ pratānā bhavanti | yathā viṣamṛṇālāni vivardhante samantataḥ | bhūmau paṅkodakasthāni tathā māṃse śirādayaḥ ||” iti | nanu rasādraktaṃ tato māṃsamityādikramaḥ tatkathaṃ prāgeva māṃsadharā kathitā ? ucyate - śarīrapoṣaṇārthaṃ rasādikramo'yaṃ na tu dhāraṇe | ata eva māṃsadharatvena pūrvaṃ pratipādya kalā nirdiṣṭāḥ parasparānugrahāt | dvitīyā raktadharā (nāma) māṃsasyābhyantaratastasyāṃ śoṇita viśeṣataśca śirā snāyuyakṛtplīhnośca bhavati | “vṛkṣādyathābhiprahatāt kṣīriṇaḥ kṣīramāvahet | māṃsādevaṃ kṣatāt kṣipraṃ śoṇitaṃ saṃprasicyate” iti | tṛtīyā medodharā (nāma,) medo hi sarvabhūtānāmudarasthamaṇvasthiṣu ca mahatsu ca majjā bhavati | “sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tvabhyantarāśritaḥ| athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyate’ iti || caturthī śleṣmadharā nāma sarvasandhiṣu prāṇabhṛtāṃ bhavati | snehābhyakte yathāhyakṣe cakraṃ sādhu pravartate | sandhayaḥ sādhu vartante saṃśliṣṭāḥ śleṣmaṇā tathā ||’ iti | pañcamī purīṣadharā (nāma) yā'ntaḥkoṣṭhe malamabhivibhajate pakvāśayasthā | “yakṛt samantāt koṣṭhaṃ ca tathā'ntrāṇi samāśritā uṇḍukasthaṃ vibhajate malaṃ maladharā kalā ||” iti | ṣaṣṭhī pittadharā nāma yā caturvidhamannapānamupayuktamāmāśayāt pracyutaṃ pakvāśayopasthitaṃ dhārayati | “aśitaṃ khāditaṃ pītaṃ līḍhaṃ koṣṭhagataṃ nṛṇām | tajjīryati yathākālaṃ śoṣitaṃ pittatejasā||” iti | saptamī śukadharā (nāma) yā sarvaprāṇināṃ sarvaśarīravyāpinī | “yathā payasi sarpistu gūḍhaścekṣau raso yathā | śarīreṣu tathā śukraṃ nṛṇāṃ vidyādbhiṣagvaraḥ | dvyaṅgule dakṣiṇe pārśve bastidvārasya cāpyadhaḥ | mūtrasrotaḥpathācchukraṃ puruṣasya pravartate | kṛtsnadehāśritaṃ śukraṃ prasannamanasastathā | strīṣu vyāyacchataścāpi harṣāt tatsampravartate ||” || 6 || Gū. adhunā sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ kalādyaṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | nṛdehe sapta kalāḥ santi, sapta āśayāḥ santi,sapta dhātavaḥ santi, tanmalāḥ teṣāṃ dhātūnāṃ saptopadhātavaḥ santi, sapta tvacaḥ prakīrtitāḥ | dehe traya: doṣāḥ santi, navaśataṃ snāyūnāṃ sandhayaḥ santi | tathetyuktatvāt daśādhikaṃ snāyavaḥ santi, tāstu snāyūnāṃ sandhaya uktāḥ, dehe asthisaṃgrahaṃ triśataṃ, dehe saptottaraśataṃ marmasthalamasti, tathā śirā sūkṣmā nāḍī saptasaptaśatamasti, nṛdehe rasavāhikā dhamanyaḥ caturviṃśatiḥ ākhyātāḥ kathitāḥ | atra śirāsnāyudhamanīnāṃ bhedosti svakarmakarttṛtvāt | nṛṇāṃ dehe māṃsapeśyaḥ māṃsagranthayaḥ budhaiḥ pañcaśataṃ samākhyātāḥ | strīṇāṃ dehe māṃsapeśyaḥ viṃśatyadhikā ākhyātāḥ |dehināṃ dehe kaṇḍarā mahānāḍya ṣoḍaśa samākhyātāḥ | nṛdehe daśa randhrāṇi santi nārīdehe trayodaśa randhrāṇi chidrāṇi santītyarthaḥ | etatkalādikaṃ samāsataḥ proktaṃ vistareṇa adhunā ucyate || 1-5 || māṃsāsṛṅmedasāṃ tisraḥ kalāḥ, yakṛtplīhoretayordvayoścaturthīkalā, āntrāṇāṃ pañcamī kalā, ṣaṣṭhī kalā agnidharā matā smṛtā, retodharā saptamī kalā syāt ityanena krameṇa sapta kalāḥ smṛtāḥ kathitāḥ | tarhi kalā kā ? māṃsāsṛkmedasāṃ sīmā kalāḥ, rañjakapittasya sthānaṃ yakṛt, raktavāhinī yā śirā tasyāḥ mūlaṃ plīhā || 6 || śleṣmāśayaḥ syādurasi tasmādāmāśayastvadhaḥ || 7 || ūrdhvamagnyāśayo nābhervāmabhāge vyavasthitaḥ | tasyopari tilaṃ jñeyaṃ tadadhaḥ pavanāśayaḥ || 8 || malāśayastvadhastasmādastirmūtrāśayastvadhaḥ | jīvaraktāśayamuro jñeyāḥ saptāśayāstvamī || 9 || puruṣebhyo'dhikāścānye nārīṇāmāśayāstrayaḥ | dharā garbhāśayaḥ proktaḥ stanau stanyāśayau matau ||10|| Dī. idānīṃ saptā'śayānāha - śleṣmāśaya iti | urasi vakṣasthale śleṣmāśayaḥ, āśayo'dhiṣṭhānaṃ tadviśiṣṭasthānaṃ kaphasyetyarthaḥ | tasmāt śleṣmāśayādadhaḥ āmāśayaḥ, āmopari pakvāhāraḥ tasyā'śayaḥ sthānamityarthaḥ | sa eva stanāntarāt kiñcidadho jñātavyaḥ; tathācoktam - “nābhistanāntaraṃ jantorāmāśaya udāhṛtaḥ |” nābherūrdhvamagnyāśayaḥ sa eva grahaṇīsthānaṃ kathitam | “agnyadhiṣṭhānamannasya grahaṇād grahaṇī matā | nābherupari sa hyagnibalopastambhavāhi ca” iti vacanāt | vāmabhāge vyavasthita iti so'pyagnyāśayastu nābhervāmabhāge āśrita ityarthaḥ | vāmabhāge puruṣasya iti vyākhyānaṃ vā tasyopari tilaṃ jñeyam | tilamityanena kloma kathitam tatpipāsāsthānamityabhiprāyaḥ | ata eva jalavāhi- śirāmūlaṃ tilamityuktamācāryeṇa | eke tasyopari jalaṃ jñeyamityevaṃ paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | tathāhyuktam – “agnerūrdhvaṃ jalaṃ sthāpyaṃ tadannaṃ ca jalopari | agneradhaḥ svayaṃ vāyuḥ sthito'gniṃ dhamate śanaiḥ || vāyunā- dhamamāno'gniratyuṣṇaṃ kurute jalam | tadannamuṣṇatoyena samantāt pacyate śanaiḥ” iti | tadadhaḥ pavanāśaya iti | tat tasyāgnyāśayasyādhaḥ pavanāśayo vāyoḥ sthānamityarthaḥ | tasya vāyoḥ samāna iti saṃjñā | malāśayastvadhastasyeti | tasya pavanāśayasyādho malāśayaḥ sa ca pakvāśayaḥ kathitaḥ | tasyaikadeśe vā vibhaktamaladhāraka uṇḍuko vidyate ata evoṇḍukāt pakvāśayo bhinnaḥ iti ḍuṃ ( tu) ḍuka, poha ( ṭa) lakaḥ iti loke | carake tu purīṣāntraśabdenoṇḍukaḥ pratipāditaḥ iti | bastirmūtrāśayaḥ smṛta iti atrāpi pavanāśayasyādhaḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ | bastistu carmakhallāṭa- kākāro mūtrādhāraḥ sa ca pakvāśayasamīpe sthitaḥ | jīvaraktāśaya iti - ‘jīvatulyaṃ raktaṃ, tasyāśayasthānaṃ tacca ‘plīhā’ iti prasiddhaṃ hṛdayasya vāmabhāgāśritaṃ bhavati | ata eva jīvaraktāśayamura iti pratipāditaṃ jñeyaṃ saptāśayāstkyī iti amī pūrvoktāḥ saptāśayā boddhavyāḥ | taduktaṃ vāgbhaṭena - “tāḥ sapta sapta cādhārā raktasyādyāḥ kramāt pare | kaphāmapittapakvānāṃ vāyormūtrasya ca smṛtāḥ” iti | nārīṇāmāśayāstraya iti puruṣāśayebhyo'dhikāḥ strīṇāṃ traya evāśayā vijñeyā eko garbhāśayaḥ, dvau stanyāśayau ca | garbhāśayaśca pakvāśayāntare vartate, stanyāśayau kṣīrāśayau || 7-10 || Gū. āśayānāha - śleṣmāśaya urasi syāt tasmādurasaḥ āmāśayaḥ adhaḥ syāt, puṃsaḥ vāmabhāge nābherūrdhvaṃ agnyāśayaḥ sthitaḥ asti, tasyāgnyaśayopari tilaṃ pācakapittaṃ jñeyaṃ, tasya tilasyādhaḥ pavanāśayo jñeyaḥ, tasya vāyoḥ adhaḥ malāśayo jñeyaḥ ,mūtrāśayaḥ mūtrasthalaṃ bastirjñeyaḥ jīvaraktāśayaḥ uro jñeyaḥ jīvaraktasya ya āśayaḥ jīvaraktāśayaḥ jīvaraktasthānamityarthaḥ | amī śleṣmādyāḥ saptāśayā jñeyāḥ, puruṣebhyaḥ nārīṇāṃ traya āśayā adhikā: santi tānāha - ekastu dharā garbhāśayaḥ ; dvāvāśayau stanau matau kiṃviśiṣṭau stanyāśayau dugdhasyādhārau āvartau yonistasyā yaḥ tṛtīya āvartaḥ cakrākāraḥ sa eva garbhāśayaḥ | suśrute'pyuktam “śaṅkhanābhyākṛtiryonirāvartaḥ sā prakīrtitā | tasyāstṛtīye tvāvarte garbhaśayyā prakīrtitā || 7 -10” || rasāsṛṅmāṃsamedo'sthimajjāśukrāṇi dhātavaḥ | jāyante'nyonyataḥ sarve pācitāḥ pittatejasā ||11|| (rasādraktaṃ tato māṃsaṃ māṃsānmedaḥ prajāyate | medaso'sthi tato majjā majjāyāḥ śukrasaṃbhavaḥ ||12|| Dī. atha dhātūnāṃ saptasaṃkhyāvivaraṇaṃ darśayannāha - raseti | rasādayaḥ sarve dhātavaḥ pittatejasā pratidhātvāgninā pācitāḥ paripācyamānā anyonyataḥ parasparānugrahājjāyante utpadyanta iti bhāvaḥ | taduktam - ‘rasādraktaṃ tato māṃsaṃ māṃsānmedaḥ prajāyate | medaso'sthi tato majjāṃ majjāyāḥ śukrasaṃbhavaḥ’ iti | pariṇāmastrividha eva dhātūnāṃ malasthūlāṇabhāgaviśeṣeṇa bhavati | tadyathā - annāt pacyamānādviṇmūtraṃ malaḥ sāro rasaḥ | rasādagnipakvāt malaṃ kaphaḥ sthūlo bhāgo rasaḥ, sūkṣmabhāgo raktam | raktādagnipakvāt malaṃ pittaṃ, sthūlabhāgaḥ śoṇitam, aṇubhāgo māṃsamiti | māṃsādagnipacyamānāt malaḥ śrotranāsāprajananādi srotomalaṃ, sthūlo bhāgo māṃsaṃ, sūkṣmabhāgo medaḥ, tato'pi nijavahnipacyamānānmalaḥ svedaḥ, sthūloṃ'śo medaḥ, sūkṣmabhāgo'sthi | tato'pi pacyamānāt malaḥ keśalomaśmaśrūṇi, sthūlo'sthi, sūkṣmastu majjā | tato majjñaḥ pāvakapacyamānādapi malo nayanapurīṣatvacāṃ snehaḥ, sthūlo bhāgo majjā, sūkṣmabhāgaḥ śukraḥ | tataḥ punaḥ pacyamānādapi malo notpadyate | sa hi sahasradhādhmātaḥ suvarṇavat sthūlo bhāgaḥ | śukrameva snehabhāgasūkṣmastejobhūtaṃ oja iti || 11-12 || Gū. atha dhātavaḥ | rasādayaḥ saptaite dhātavaḥ pittatejasā pācitāḥ santaḥ sarve'nyonyataḥ jāyante utpadyante | tānāha - bhakṣitastu nopadravatvaṃ prāptaṃ taṃ rasavāhinyo nāḍyaḥ hṛtsthānīyavāyunā pradhamanti tatra hṛdayasthaṃ yatpittaṃ tadrasaṃ paripācya raktatvaṃ nayanti raktato māṃsaṃ bhavati (māṃsanmedo bhavati) medato'sthi bhavati, asthna: majjā bhavati majjāyāḥ śukraṃ bhavati evaṃ sapta dhātavaḥ jāyanta ityaryaḥ || 1 1- 12 || jihvānetrakapolānāṃ jalaṃ pittaṃ ca rañjakam | karṇaviḍrasanādantakakṣāmeḍhrādijaṃ malam ||13|| nakhanetramalaṃ vaktre strigdhatvaṃ piṇḍikāstathā | jāyante saptadhātūnāṃ malānyetānyanukramāt || 14 || kaphaḥ pittaṃ malaṃ kheṣu prasvedo nakharoma ca | netraviṭ tvakṣu ca sneho dhātūnāṃ kramaśo malāḥ ||15|| Dī. idānīṃ malānāha - jihveti | saptadhātūnāṃ rasādīnāṃ etāni malānyanukramājjāyante | jihvānetrakapolānāṃ jalamiti | tena jihvājalaṃ netrajalaṃ | jalamatra kaphadravametadrasasya malamiti bhāvaḥ | rañjakaṃ pittaṃ raktasya malaṃ rañjakaṃ rasasya rāgakaramityuktatvāt | karṇaviṭ māṃsasya malaṃ nāsāmalaṃ cetyanye | rasanādantakakṣāmeḍhrādijaṃ malaṃ medasaḥ | ā- digrahaṇāt svedamapi kecit, na svamataṃ, yataḥ svedastu upadhātuṣu patita eva nakhā iti asthnāṃ malaṃ nakhā iti bahuvacanatvena keśalomādīnāṃ grahaṇam | (netramalaṃ vaktrasnigdhatā ca majjño malaṃ) netramalaṃ nayanapurīṣam | piṇḍikā iti śukasya | piṇḍikātra yauvanodbhavā | tatheti grahaṇāt śmaśrūṇyapi gṛhyante yataḥ ākṛṣṭāṇḍakoṣasya puṃsaḥ śmaśrupātāt śmaśru śukramalamityeke | apare ṣaḍeva malān yathākramaṃ kathayanti | te tu netramalaṃ vaktrasnigdhatvaṃ piṇḍikādikaṃ ca majjño malamiti vyākhyānayanti | taduktaṃ ‘kiṭṭamannasya viṇmūtraṃ rasasya tu kapho'sṛjaḥ | pittaṃ māṃsasya tu malaṃ kheṣu svedastu medasaḥ || nakhamasthnastu lomādyā majjñaḥ sneho'kṣiviṭtvacaḥ | prasādaḥ kiṭṭadhātūnāṃ pākādeva vivardhate || śukrasyātiprasannatvānmalābhāva iti smṛtiḥ |” iti || 13 - 15 || Gū. atha saptadhātūnāṃ malāḥ | jihvānetrakapolānāṃ yadrañjakaṃ kāntikaraṃ pittaṃ tadeva rasamalaṃ, kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ pittaṃ jalaṃ dravarūpaṃ, athavā jihvānetrakapolayoryadrañjakaṃ kāṃtidaṃ, punaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ pittaṃ dravatvātpittarūpaṃ karṇaviṭ karṇamalaṃ raktamalaṃ, rasanādantamalaṃ māṃsamalaṃ, kakṣāmeḍhrādijaṃ malaṃ medomalaṃ, nakhamasthimalaṃ, netramalaṃ majjāmalaṃ,vaktrasnigdhatvaṃ piḍikāśca śukramalaṃ, vaktrapiḍikā yauvanapiḍikāḥ navamanukramāt saptadhātūnāṃ malāni jāyante yathā rasāsṛṅmāṃsādīni tadvadidamapi || 13-15 || stanyaṃ rajaśca nārīṇāṃ kāle bhavati gacchati | śuddhamāṃsabhava snehaḥ sā vasā parikīrtitā || 16|| svedodantāstathā keśāstathaivojaśca saptamam| iti dhātubhavā jñeyā ete saptopadhātavaḥ || 17 || ojaḥ sarvaśarīrasthaṃ śītaṃ snigdhaṃ sthitaṃ matam | somātmakaṃ śarīrasya balapuṣṭikaraṃ matam || 18 | Dī. idānīmupadhātūnāmapi vivaraṇaṃ darśayannāha - stanyamiti | stanyādayaḥ saptopadhātavo dhātubhavā boddhavyāḥ | stanyaṃ kṣīraṃ rasasyopadhātuḥ, rajaścārtavo dhātuḥ etadvayaṃca strīṇāṃ kāle samaye bhavati gacchati ca | tathāca romarājyādayaścāviśeṣā nārīṇāṃ kālāntareṇābhivyaktiṃ gacchanti iti saṃbandhaḥ | atrādiśabdāt stanyārtavādayo gṛhyante | ārtavamapi tantrāntare yathā - ‘rasādeva striyā raktaṃ rajaḥsaṃjñaṃ pravartate | tadvarṣāddvādaśādūrdhvaṃ yāti pañcāśataḥ kṣayam ||’ iti | śuddhamāṃsabhavaḥ sneho māṃsasyopadhātu eṣaḥ eva vasā kathitā śuddhamāṃsasthūlabhāvaprāptamāṃsamiti bhāvaḥ | tatrastho yaḥ snehaḥ sa eva ca vasāśabdavācyaḥ | ‘māṃsasneho vasā matā’ iti vacanāt | svedo medasa upadhātuḥ, svedaḥ prasvedaḥ | dantā asthnāmupadhātuḥ, keśā majjopadhātuḥ, ojaḥ śukrasyopadhātuḥ | ojaso lakṣaṇametasyāgre paṭhanti kecit tadyathā - āja ityādi | dhātūdbhavā iti dhātūtpannā teṣāṃ paripākaviṣayatvāt kutracidete tu malāntarbhūtatvena tatraiva gaṇitāḥ | etāḥ saptopadhātavaḥ ityanena saptopadhātavaḥ niyatā jñeyāḥ | anyatrā'pyuktaṃ ‘rasāt stanyaṃ tato raktamasṛjaḥ snāyukaṇḍarāḥ | māṃsādvasā tvacaḥ svedo medasaḥ snāyusandhayaḥ | asthno dantāstathā majjñaḥ keśā ojaśca saptamāt | dhātubhyaścopajāyante tasmātte upadhātavaḥ’ iti || 16-18 || Gū. atha saptopadhātavaḥ - nārīṇāṃ stanyaṃ dugdhaṃ rajaśca kāle svasamaye bhavati gacchati ca rasopadhātuḥ stanyaṃ raktopadhātū rajaḥ | nanu nārīṇāṃ kathitāvetau dvāvupadhātū kāle bhavatāṃ vā gacchatāṃ vā, atra puṃsāṃ rasaraktayorupadhātuḥ kaḥ, yadyevaṃ vācyaṃ rasaraktayorupadhātuḥ strīṇāmeva bhavati na nṛṇāṃ tarhi, nṛṣu rasaraktānyapi no syātāṃ, nahi, tau tu bhavataḥ tarhi yatra rasaraktau tatra tayorupadhātuḥ sambhavatyevetyāśaṅkya rasopadhātumāha - apakvo vikṛtimāpanno raso yadā nirgacchati sa eva puṃsāṃ rasopadhātuḥ vikṛtimāpanno raktaḥ yadā pittaprakopata ūrdhvaṃ gacchati sa eva raktopadhāturnānyaḥ | upadhātorarthaṃ vivṛṇoti | upagataḥ vaikṛtyaṃ prāpto dhātuḥ upadhātuḥ, śuddhamāṃsabhava utpanno yaḥ snehaḥ sā vasā saṃkīrtyate iti tṛtīyaḥ, sopadhātuḥ medopadhātuḥ svedaḥ, asthyupadhāturdantāḥ majjopadhātuḥ keśāḥ, śukropadhātuḥ saptamaṃ nāma ojaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ tatsarvaśarīrasthaṃ punaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ snigdhaṃ, sacikkaṇaṃ, punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ śītaṃ uṣṇaṃ na, punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ sitaṃ śubhraṃ, punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ somātmakaṃ sṛṣṭyutpādakatvāt, punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ śarīrasya balapuṣṭikaraṃ malaṃ khyātam | iti korthaḥ, dhātubhavāḥ saptopadhātavo jñeyāḥ || 17 || 18 || jñeyāvabhāsinī pūrvaṃ sidhmasthānaṃ ca sā matā | dvitīyā lohitā jñeyā tilakālakajanmabhūḥ ||19|| śvetā tṛtīyā saṃkhyātā sthānaṃ carmadalasya ca | tāmrā caturthī vijñeyā kilāsaśvitrabhūmikā || 20|| pañcamī vedanī khyātā sarvakuṣṭhodbhavastataḥ | vikhyātā rohiṇī ṣaṣṭhī granthigaṇḍāpacīsthitiḥ ||21|| sthūlā tvaksaptamī khyātā vidradhyādeḥ sthitiśca sā | iti sapta tvacaḥ proktāḥ sthūlā vrīhidvimātrayā ||22|| Dī. jñeyā'vabhāsinīti | iti vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa | vrīhidvayamātrayā yavadvayaparimāṇena sthūlā sotsedhāḥ sapta- tvaco jñeyāḥ | kathaṃ yathā ? tat prakāramāha - tatra pūrvaṃ avabhāsinī nāma avabhāsayati parājayatīti bhrājakāgninā savarṇāṃ pañcavidhāṃ chāyāṃ prakāśayati | saiva sidhmasthānaṃ kathitam | cakārāt padmakaṇṭakādhiṣṭhānamapi jñeyaṃ sā vrīheraṣṭādaśabhāgapramāṇā | dvitīyā lohitā jñeyā ityādi dvitīyā tvak lohitā nāma kathitā | sā tilakālakajanmabhūrjñeyā | tilakālakagrahaṇenaiva nyacchavyaṅgādayo'pi gṛhyante | tilakālakaprabhṛtayaśca kṣudraroge paṭhitāḥ, saiva vrīheḥ ṣoḍaśabhāgapramāṇā boddhavyā | śvetā tṛtīyā saṃkhyātetyādi | tṛtīyā tvak śvetā nāma kathitā, sā carmadalasya sthānam | carmadalaḥ kuṣṭhabhedaḥ | cakārānmaśakājagallīprabhṛtīnāṃ sthānaṃ sā vrīherdvādaśabhāgapramāṇā | tāmrā caturthī vijñeyetyādi | caturthī tvak tāmrā nāma vijñeyā, sā kilāsaśvitrabhūmikā kathitā | kilāsaḥ kuṣṭhabhedaḥ, śvitraṃ prasiddhaṃ, saiva vrīheraṣṭabhāgapramāṇā | pañcamī tvak vedanī nāma khyātā sā sarvakuṣṭhodbhavā jñeyā sarvakuṣṭhānyaṣṭādaśasaṃkhyākāni, tata iti grahaṇena visarpādīnāmadhiṣṭhānā, saiva vrīheḥ pañcabhāgapramāṇā vikhyātā | lohitā ṣaṣṭhīti | ṣaṣṭhī tvak lohitā nāma vikhyātā sā granthigaṇḍāpacīsthitiḥ kathitā | granthyādayaḥ kaphamedaḥ pradhānāḥ ataḥ sādharmyāt ślīpadārbudādīnāmapi sthānaṃ sā ca vrīhipramāṇā | sthūlā tvak saptamī khyātā ityādi saptamī tvak sthūlā nāma kathitā sā vidradhyādeḥ sthitirbhavati | ādigrahaṇāt bhagandarārśaso grahaṇaṃ | saiva vrīhidvayapramāṇena boddhavyā māṃsamaleṣu mānamidaṃ na lalāṭasūkṣmāṅgulyādiṣu yato vakṣyatyudareṣu vrīhimukhenāṅguṣṭho- darapramāṇamavagāḍhaṃ vidhyediti || 19-22 || Gū. idānīṃ saptatvaco nidarśayannāha - tāsāṃ madhye avabhāsinīnāmnī tvak pūrvaṃ jñeyā, sāvabhāsinī sidhmasthānaṃ matā sidhmanāmutpattisthalaṃ kathitā; dvitīyā tvak lohitā jñeyā, kiṃviśiṣṭā sā tilakālakajanmabhūḥ tilakālako liṅgārśaḥ tasya janmabhūḥ utpattibhūmiḥ; tṛtīyā tvak śvetā saṃkhyātā, sā tvak carmadalasya kuṣṭhamedasya sthānaṃ; caturthī tvak tāmrā vijñeyā sā kilāsaśvitrayoḥ bhūmikā utpattisthānā, kilāsaṃ sidhmabhedaṃ; pañcamī tvak vedanī khyātā tataḥ sarvakuṣṭhodbhavaḥ; ṣaṣṭhī tvak lohitā khyātā, sā granthigaṇḍāpacīsthitiḥ granthigaṇḍāpacīnāṃ sthitiḥ sthānabhūtā; sthūlā nāmnī tvak saptamī khyātā, kiṃviśiṣṭā sā vidradhyādeḥ rogāṇāṃ sthitiḥ sthānabhūtā | kiṃviśiṣṭāḥ saptatvacaḥ vrīhidvimātrayā sthūlā: dviyavapramāṇasthūlā ityartha iti saptatvaco vyākhyātāḥ | iti ko'rthaḥ, proktāḥ saptatvacaḥ samāptāḥ | itipadaṃ samāptyarthaṃ dyotayati || 19-22 || vāyuḥ pittaṃ kapho doṣā dhātavaśca malā matāḥ | tatrāpi pañcadhā khyātāḥ pratyekaṃ dehadhāraṇāt ||23|| (śarīradūṣaṇāddoṣā dhātavo dehadhāraṇāt | vātapittakaphā jñeyā malinīkaraṇānmalāḥ || 24 ||) pittaṃ paṅgu kaphaḥ paṅguḥ paṅgavo maladhātavaḥ | vāyunā yatra nīyante tatra gacchanti meghavat ||25|| pavanasteṣu balavānvibhāgakaraṇānmataḥ | rajoguṇamayaḥ sūkṣmaḥ śīto rūkṣo laghuścalaḥ ||26|| malāśaye caretkoṣṭhe vahnisthāne tathā hṛdi | kaṇṭhe sarvāṅgadeśeṣu vāyuḥ pañcaprakārataḥ || 27 || apānaḥ syātsamānaśca prāṇodānau tathaiva ca | vyānaśceti samīrasya nāmānyuktānyanukramāt ||28|| Dī. atha doṣāṇāṃ vivaraṇamāha - vāyuriti | vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaśca trayo doṣāḥ prasiddhāḥ | ata eva dehadhāraṇāt dhātavaḥ kathitāḥ | dhātūnāṃ malinīkaraṇāt malāśca matāḥ kathitāḥ | tatrāpi dehadhāraṇatvena pratyekaṃ pañcadhā pañca prakārā vyākhyātāḥ | taduktaṃ suśrute ‘tatra prasyandanodvahanapūraṇavivekadhāraṇalakṣaṇo vāyuḥ pañcadhā pravibhaktaḥ śarīraṃ dhārayati, rāgapaktyojastejomedhoṣmakṛt pittaṃ pañcadhā pravibhaktamagnikarmaṇā'nugrahaṃ karoti vṛddhisandhiśleṣaṇa- snehanaropaṇapūraṇaiḥ pañcadhā pravibhaktaḥ śleṣmā
