udakakarmaṇā'nugrahaṃ karotī’ti | idānīṃ teṣu vātaprādhānyapūrvakaṃ tatsvarūpamāha - pavana iti | teṣu vātādidoṣeṣu pavano vāyuḥ vibhāgakaraṇātpṛthakkaraṇatve balavān mataḥ | taduktam ‘pittaṃ paṅgu kaphaḥ paṅguḥ paṅgavo maladhātavaḥ | vāyunā yatra nīyante tatra gacchanti meghavat’ iti | tatsvarūpamāha -rajoguṇamaya ityādi | anilo rajoguṇamayo rajoguṇabhūyiṣṭha iti bhāvaḥ | sūkṣma iti srotaḥ - praveśitvāt | śītaḥ śītasvabhāvāt | rūkṣo rūkṣaguṇayogāt, laghuraguruḥ, calo naikatrasthitiśīlaḥ | sa evoktasthāneṣu cānugacchan vāyuḥ pañcaprakāro jñeyaḥ | keṣvityāha - malāśaya ityādi | malāśaye pakvāśaye, koṣṭhavahnisthāna iti koṣṭhāgnisthāne koṣṭhagrahaṇaṃ dhātvagninirāsārtham | hṛdi uraḥsthāne, kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhadeśe, sarvāṅgadeheṣviti sarvāṃṅgayukto dehaḥ | tānyaṅgāni ṣaṭ prasiddhāni | nanu - dehagrahaṇenaivāṅgānyeva prāpyante tat kathaṃ pṛthag grahaṇaṃ ? ucyate -aṅgagrahaṇamatra pratyaṅgadīnāṃ nirāsārtham | teṣu pratyaṅgeṣu vātasya viśeṣasthānaṃ na pratipāditam | tasmādviśeṣasthānatvena sarvāṅgadehagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamityadoṣaḥ | tathaivāsyānuktanāmāni yathā apāna ityādi | apāno vātaviśeṣaḥ | samāno nābhideśe syāt | samāno vrahnisthāne prāṇo hṛdi udānaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe vyānaḥ sarvaśarīreṣviti | taduktam - ‘hṛdi prāṇo gude'pānaḥ samāno nābhisaṃsthitaḥ | udānaḥ kaṇṭhadeśastho vyānaḥ sarvaśarīragaḥ’ iti | kecidanilanāmānyanyānyapi paṭhanti tadyathā - ‘nāgaḥ kūrmo'tha kṛkalo devadatto dhanañjayaḥ’ iti | ete tvanyatra pradhānanāḍīṣu jñātavyāḥ || Gū. vāyuḥ pittaṃ kapha ete trayo doṣāḥ paryāyaśabdena dhātavaḥ ākhyātāḥ, malāścākhyātāḥ, tatrāpi dhātumalasaṃjñākathanānantaraṃ pañca dehadhāraṇātpratyekaṃ sthānaṃ sthānaṃprati ekaṃ pratyekaṃ, sthānādhikaṃ kṛtvā pañcadhā khyātāḥ kathitāḥ | anyatrāpyuktaṃ ‘śarīradūṣaṇāddoṣā dhātavo dehadhāraṇāt | vātapittakaphā jñeyā malinīkaraṇāt malāḥ’ | doṣāṇāṃ paryāyaśabdāstadrūpāḥ teṣu doṣeṣu vibhāgakaraṇāt doṣakopapracaye sāhāyyakaraṇāt anena pavanena vinā teṣāṃ na kāpi śaktirityarthaḥ | tadāha granthāntare ‘pittaṃ paṅgu, kaphaḥ paṅguḥ, paṅgavo maladhātavaḥ | vāyunā yatra nīyante tatra varṣanti meghavat’ | kīdṛśaḥ guṇamayaḥ, punaḥ kīdṛśaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvavyāpī, punaḥ śītaḥ, punaḥ rūkṣaḥ laghuḥ, punaścalaḥ sthiro na | adhunā vāyūnāṃ pūrvoktapañcasthalānyāha - pañcaprakārataḥ vāyūnāṃ madhye apānavāyuḥ malāśraye caret vyānavāyuḥ sarvāṅgadeśeṣu caret sarvāṅgagāmī bhūtvā vicaret ityarthaḥ | adhunā pañcavāyūnāṃ nāmānyāha - pañcānāṃ madhye eka apānaḥ apānavāyuḥ syāt, dvitīyaḥ samānaḥ syāt, tṛtīyaḥ prāṇaḥ syāt, caturthaḥ udānaḥ syāt, pañcamo vyānaḥ syāt | iti ko'rthaḥ anukramāduktāni samīrasya pañca nāmāni || 23-28 || pittamuṣṇaṃ dravaṃ pītaṃ nīlaṃ sattvaguṇottaram | kaṭutiktarasaṃ jñeyaṃ vidagdhaṃ cāmlatāṃ vrajet || 29 || agnyāśaye bhavetpittamagnirūpaṃ tilonmitam | tvaci kāntakaraṃ jñeyaṃ lepābhyaṅgādipācakam||30|| dṛśyaṃ yakṛti yatpittaṃ tadrasaṃ śoṇitaṃ nayet | yatpittaṃ netrayugule rūpadarśanakāri tat || 31 || yatpittaṃ hṛdaye tiṣṭhenmedhāprajñākaraṃ ca tat | pācakaṃ bhrājakaṃ caiva rañjakālocake tathā || 32 || sādhakaṃ ceti pañcaiva pittanāmānyanukramāt | Dī. idānīṃ pittavivaraṇamāha -- pittamiti | pittamuṣṇamityuṣṇayogāt, dravamakaṭhinaṃ, pītaṃ varṇataḥ, nīlaṃ ca tannīlavarṇaṃ sāmā'vasthāyāṃ bhavati pītaṃ nirāmā'vasthāyāṃ ca | sattvaguṇottaraṃ sattvaguṇabahutvaṃ, kaṭutiktarasaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ prasiddham | yadā vidagdhaṃ tadāmlatāṃ vrajediti vahniguṇatvāt, taduktaṃ ‘pittaṃ vidagdhatāmamlatāmupaiti āgneyatvāt’ iti | ata evāha kaścit -‘vidagdhājīrṇasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ punaramlarasaṃ bhavet’ iti | vidagdhaṃ pittaṃ punaramlapittamiti romaviśeṣamapare pratipādayanti iti| tatsthānāni yathā - agnyāśaye pittamagnirūpaṃ tilonmitaṃ ca jñeyaṃ, pakvāmāśayamadhye agnyāśayamiti vācyam | tatrasthaṃ caturvidhamannapānaṃ pacati na kevalaṃ tilonmitamanyarūpaṃ ca vadantyeke | tadyathā - ‘sthūlakāyeṣu sattveṣu yavamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ| hrasvamātreṣu sattveṣu tilamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ || kṛmikīṭapataṅgeṣu vālamātraṃ hi tiṣṭhati ||’ iti || yat pittaṃ tvacyasti tat kāntikaraṃ jñeyaṃ lepābhyaṅgādipācakaṃ ca bhavati taduṣṇaguṇayogāt | ūṣmā śarīrasyoṣṇatvam | lepābhyaṅgādītyādigrahaṇāt snānāvagāhanādīnāṃ grahaṇam | tvagatra avabhāsinī nāma jñeyā bāhyatvagityabhiprāyaḥ | yat pittaṃ yakṛti kālakhaṇḍe dṛśyaṃ dṛṣṭigocaraṃ tadrasaṃ śoṇatāṃ nayet karotītyarthaḥ | tādṛśamiti yādṛk plīhāsthāne'sti tādṛk bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | yat pittaṃ netrayugale'sti tadrūpadarśanakāri bhavati rūpaṃ pītaśuklādikam| yat pittaṃ hṛdaye cetanāsthāne'sti tanmedhāprajñākaraṃ boddhavyam | kasmāt hṛdayasthakaphatamopanodanavispaṣṭīkṛtatvāt | medhā dhīrdhāraṇā buddhiḥ, prajñā anāgatopadeśarūpā matiḥ | cakārādabhiprārthitamanorathasādhanakṛdityuktam | pittanāmānyāha - pācakamityādi | pittanāmāni kramāt pañcaiva jñātavyāni kramo yathā - pācakamagnisthāne, bhrājakaṃ tvaci, rañjakaṃ yakṛti, ālocakaṃ netrayoḥ, sādhakaṃ hṛdīti || 29-32 || Gū. adhunā pañca pittasya guṇānāha - nanu ‘miṣṭaḥ paṭuśca madhuramalomlaṃ pacyate rasaḥ | kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ pākaḥ syāt prāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ’ iti rasaviśeṣāṇāṃ vipākaviśeṣā uktāḥ kathitāḥ | ṣaḍrarasānapyāha - āhāro mādhuryaṃ labhate pācakapittena vidagdhomlatāṃ vrajet grahaṇyāṃ pācitaḥ kaṭurbhavatīti kathaṃ saṃgacchate ? ucyate miṣṭarasaḥ paṭurasaścāhāra āmāśaye pūrvaṃ madhuraraso bhavati tataḥ pācakapittena vidagdho'mlatāṃ vrajet grahaṇyāṃ pācitaḥ kaṭuraso bhavati kaṭutiktakaṣāyā madhurā amlā: kaṭavaśca bhūtvā kaṭava eva bhavanti | atra kecidācāryāḥ prāhuḥ ṣaṇṇāmapi rasānāṃ vipākāt ta evāpi rasā atiśayena bhavanti yathā āmaṃ dugdhamadhuraṃ tatpakvaṃ sat viśeṣato madhuraṃ bhavati evaṃ pittamuṣṇaṃ dravaṃ pītam | asyārthaḥ pittam uṣṇam uṣṇaguṇaṃ, dravaṃ dravarūpaṃ, pītaṃ pītavarṇaṃ, nīlaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ, satvaṃ satvaguṇottaram adhikaṃ yasmin tat kaṭu kaṭurasaṃ tiktaṃ tiktarasaṃ vidagdhaṃ atipakvaṃ amlatāṃ vrajet | tasya pañcasthānānyāha - agnyāśayetyādi | agnyāśaye yatpittaṃ bhavet tatpācakaṃ jñeyam | kiṃbhūtaṃ agnirūpam, punaḥ kiṃbhūtaṃ tilonmitaṃ tilapramāṇaṃ tvaci bhrājakaṃ jñeyam | kiṃbhūtaṃ, kāntikaram | punaḥ kiṃbhūtaṃ lepābhyaṅgādipācakaṃ pākakāri | yattu tvaci pittaṃ tasya bhrājako'gniriti saṃjñā so'pyabhyaṅgapariṣekāvagāhalepādīnāṃ kriyādravyāṇāṃ paktā iti suśrutaḥ, ayamarthaḥ prakṛtiryatpittaṃ darśanīyaṃ rañjakākhyaṃ tadrasaṃ śoṇatāṃ nayet darśanīyaṃ dṛśyātmakam | bhrājakamityādinā yadyasya darśanayogyaṃ kāntikaratvāt pūrvabhrājakena sambadhyate cettadā ayamarthaḥ | tatra samyak kāntikaramityanena darśanīyārthatā prāptā tasmādādya evārthaḥ, prakṛtidṛśyaṃ darśanayogyaṃ yatpittaṃ tadrañjakaṃ rañjakākhyaṃ jñeyam | kiṃbhūtaṃ tadrasaṃ śoṇitatāṃ raktatāṃ nayet yatpittaṃ netrayugale tadālocakaṃ ālocakākhyaṃ caturtham | kiṃbhūtaṃ rūpadarśanakāri yatpittaṃ hṛdaye tiṣṭhet tatsādhakaṃ pañcamam | kiṃbhūtaṃ, medhāprajñākaraṃ medhāprajñe buddhiviśeṣau | evaṃ kramātpañca pittanāmāni jñeyāni| iti pittavibhāgaḥ || 29 || 32 || kaphaḥ snigdho guruḥ śvetaḥ picchilaḥ śītalastathā ||33|| tamoguṇādhikaḥ svādurvidagdho lavaṇo bhavet | kaphaścāmāśaye mūrdhni kaṇṭhe hṛdi ca saṃdhiṣu || 34 || tiṣṭhankaroti deheṣu sthairyaṃ sarvāṅgapāṭavam | kledanaḥ snehanaścaiva rasanaścāvalambanaḥ || 35 || śleṣmakaśceti nāmāni kaphasyoktānyanukramāt | Dī. idānīṃ kaphasya vivaraṇaṃ darśayitumāha - kapha iti | kaphasyoktānyanukramāditi kapho'pi īdṛśaḥ | kīdṛśaḥ tamāha - snigdha iti snehaguṇayogāt | gururalaghuḥ śveto varṇataḥ, picchila iti mṛdyamānaḥ sannaṅgulagrāhī śītalo'nuṣṇaḥ saumyatvāt | tamoguṇapradhānastamoguṇabahulaḥ, svādurmadhuraḥ madhuratvamatrāvidagdhatvāt, vidagdhastu lavaṇo bhavediti taduktam -‘prakṛtistho'vidagdhaścāpradruṣṭo madhuraḥ kaphaḥ | vidagdho vikṛtasya syāt praduṣṭo lavaṇastathā’ iti | yadvā vidagdhāmlapākāllavaṇaḥ | sthānāni yathā kapha ityādi | kapho'pyeteṣu sthāneṣu tiṣṭhan deheṣu sthairyaṃ karoti sarvāṅgapāṭavaṃ karoti | kathamityāha - āmāśaye caturvidhasyāhārasyādhāro mādhuryāt picchilatvāt | prakle- ditvānmadhuraśītalo'pi svaśaktyā śleṣmasthānānāṃ śarīrasya udakakarmaṇā kṛtvopakāraṃ karoti | mūrdhni śirasi sthitaḥ snehena tarpaṇādhikṛtatvādindriyāṇāṃ svakāryasāmarthyaṃ janayati | kaṇṭhe jihvāmūle sthitaḥ saumyatvājji- hvendriyasya rasajñānājñānayorvartate | hṛdi urasi sthitaḥ śiro bāhudvayasandhānasthānasya sandhāraṇaṃ prākṛtaguṇena sahitena hṛdaye svakāryasāmarthyaṃ karoti | sandhiṣu saṃsthitaḥ sarvasandhisaṃśleṣādanugrahaṃ karoti | atha nāmā- nyanukramāduktāni - tāni kānītyāha | kledana āmāśaye tadatra sodakairguṇairāhāraḥ praklinno bhinnasaṃghātaḥ sukhakaro bhavatīti kledanasyābhiprāyaḥ | snehano mūrdhni bhavati tatra sthitasya snehaviṣayasya santarpaṇaṃ karotīti tātparyārthaḥ | snehaguṇasādharmyāt | rasanaḥ kaphaparyāyaḥ, kaṇṭhe'sti sa ca rasajñāne vartate | avalambano hṛdi vartate | sa ca hṛdayāvalambanaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | śleṣmakaḥ sandhiṣviti sa ca sandhisaṃśleṣaṇakṛdbhavati sandhisandhānaṃ karotītyabhiprāyaḥ || 3 3- 35 || Gū. atha kaphasya guṇasthānanāmānyāha - kapha ityādi | kaphaḥ snigdhaḥ sacikkaṇaḥ ,gudaḥ mātrāguruḥ, śvetaḥ śuklavarṇaḥ, picchilaḥ āmasadṛśaḥ, śītalaḥ śītaguṇaḥ tamoguṇādhikaḥ tamoguṇapradhānaḥ, svādurmadhurasaḥ, vidgdha īṣattyakta:, yadvā viśeṣeṇa dagdhakatāṃ prāptaḥ lavaṇo lavaṇaraso bhavati | idānīṃ kaphasya sthānanāmānyāha - āmāśaye kledanaḥ kaphaḥ, mūrdhni snehana:, kaṇṭhe rasanaḥ, hṛdi ālambanaḥ, sandhiṣu śleṣmakaḥ | eṣu sthāneṣu tiṣṭhan dehasya sthairyaṃ sarvāṅgapāṭavaṃ ca kramātkarotīti yojanā iti śleṣmavibhāgaḥ, doṣanirūpaṇam || 33-35 || snāyavo bandhanaṃ proktā dehe māṃsāsthimedastam||36|| sandhayaścāṅgasandhānāddehe proktāḥ kaphānvitā: | ādhāraśca tathāsāraḥ kāye'sthīni budhā viduḥ||37|| marmāṇi jīvādhārāṇi prāyeṇa munayo jaguḥ | Dī. idānī snāyūnāṃ vivaraṇaṃ darśayannāha - snāyava iti | snāyavo navaśatasaṃkhyākāste tu pratānavanto vṛttāḥ pṛthavaḥ, śuṣirāśca dehe māṃsāsthi medasāṃ bandhanaṃ proktāḥ kathitā ityarthaḥ | tadyathā śākhāsu ṣaṭśatāni tāḥ pratānavatyo vṛttāśca bisamṛṇālasadṛśāḥ pratānavatyaḥ vṛttāḥ vartulā mahāsnāyava ityarthaḥ | dve śate triṃśacca koṣṭhe tāḥ śuṣirāḥ pṛthulāśca, grīvāṃ pratyūrdhvasaptatiḥ tā api pṛthulāḥ, śuṣirāśca evaṃ navaśatasaṃkhyā: snāyavo vyākhyātāḥ | bandhanamiti sarvaśarīrāvayavanibandhanaṃ taduktaṃ - ‘nauryathā phalakāstīrṇā bandhanairbahubhiryutā | bhārakṣamā bhavedatsu nṛyuktā susamāhitā || evameva śarīre'smin yāvantaḥ sandhayaḥ smṛtāḥ | snāyubhirbahubhirbaddhāstena bhārasahā narāḥ’ iti | sandhilakṣaṇamāha - sandhaya iti | aṅgagrahaṇena pratyaṅgānyapi gṛhyante | sandhayo dvividhāścalā acalāśca | yaduktaṃ - ‘hanvoḥ kaṭyāṃ ca śākhāsu sandhayastu calāḥ smṛtāḥ | śeṣāstu sandhayaḥ sarve vijñeyā acalā budhaiḥ’ kaṭyāṃ ceti cakārādgrīvāyāmapi calā jñeyāḥ| kecidatra sandhilakṣaṇapade dvayaṃ paṭhanti | tān sandhīnasthnāśritā nava manyante | athāsthilakṣaṇamāha - ādhāraśceti | asthīni pañcavidhāni bhavanti kapālarucakavalayataruṇanalakasaṃjñāni | kāye ādhāraḥ śarīradhāraṇaviṣayaḥ taduktam-‘māṃsānyatra nibaddhāni śirābhiḥ snāyubhistathā | asthīnyālambanaṃ kṛtvā na śīryante patanti ca’ iti | tathā sāra iti | asthīni śarīre sārabhūtaḥ kathitaḥ yathā ‘ābhyantaragataiḥ sārairnūnaṃ tiṣṭhanti bhūruhāḥ | asthisāraistathā dehā dhriyante dehināṃ dhruvam | tasmācciravinaṣṭeṣu tvaṅmāṃseṣu śarīriṇām | asthīni na vinaśyanti sārāṇyetāni dehinām’ iti | idānīṃ marmāṇi nidarśayannāha - marmāṇīti | marmāṇi saptottaraśatasaṃkhyāni prāyeṇa bāhulyena jīvādhārāṇi prāṇādhārāṇi jaguḥ, munaya iti śeṣaḥ | tāni marmāṇi pañcaprakārāṇi bhavanti | tadyathā - māṃsamarmāṇi tānyekādaśa saṃkhyāni, śirāmarmāṇi ekacatvāriṃśat, snāyumarmāṇi saptaviṃśatiḥ | asthimarmāṇi aṣṭau | sandhimarmāṇi viṃśatiśceti | etānyapi sadyaḥ prāṇaharāṇi kālāntaraprāṇaharāṇi viśalyaghnāni vaikalyakarāṇi rujākarāṇīti kathitāni, eteṣāṃ svarūpaṃ na likhitamatra vistarabhayāt | jīvādhārāṇīti jīva ātmā tasyādhārāṇītyarthaḥ | taduttam - ‘somamārutatejāṃsi rajaḥsattvatamāṃsi ca | marmasu prāyaśaḥ puṃsāṃ bhūtātmā cāvatiṣṭhate || marmasvabhihitāstasmānna jīvanti śarīriṇaḥ’ iti ||36||37|| Gū. atha snāyavaḥ | navaśataṃ snāyūnāmiti pūrvoktatvāt | saṃkhyā tu etenaivoktā | idānīṃ snāyūnāṃ karmāṇyāha - dehe māṃsāsthimedasāṃ bandhanaṃ snāyava eva proktāḥ idamevaitāsāṃ prayojanam | nanu śārṅgadhareṇa snāyūnāṃ svarūpaṃ aṅgavibhāgaśca noktastatkathaṃ jñāyate tadvodhārthaṃ granthāntarāllikhyate | atha snāyoḥ svarūpamāha - ‘medasaḥ sāramādāya śirā snāyutvamāpruyāt | śirāṇāṃ hi mṛduḥ pākaḥ snāyūnāṃ tu tataḥ kharaḥ ||’ tāsāṃ saṃkhyāmāha - ‘śatāni nava jāyante śarīre snāyavo nṛṇām | tāsāṃ vivaraṇaṃ brūmaḥ śiṣyā: śṛṇuta yatnataḥ | śākhāsu ca śatāni syu:, koṣṭhe triṃśacchatadvayam|| grīvāyā ūrdhvadeśe tu snāyūnāṃ saptatiḥ smṛtā | evameva śarīre'smin yāvantaḥ sandhayaḥ smṛtāḥ | snāyubhirbahubhirbaddhāstena bhārasahā narāḥ’ iti snāyunirūpaṇam | asthīni asthnāṃ ca triśataṃ matamiti saṃkhyā pūrvoktaiva teṣāṃ prayojanamāha - tānyeva śatatrayasaṃkhyākānyasthīni kāye ādhārastathā sāraśca budhāḥ paṇḍitāḥ jaguḥ ūcuḥ | śārṅgadharānuktatvāt asthnāṃ sthānādinirūpaṇamucyate tadyathā ‘śalyatantre'sthikhaṇḍāntaṃ śatatrayamudāhṛtam | tānyevātra nigadyante teṣāṃ sthānāni yāni tu | saviṃśatiśataṃ tvasthnāṃ śākhāsu kathitaṃ budhaiḥ | pārśvayoḥ śroṇiphalake vakṣaḥpṛṣṭhodareṣu ca | jānīyātsubhiṣak teṣu śataṃ saptadaśottaram | grīvāyā ūrdhvagaṃ vidyādasthnāṃ triṣaṣṭisaṃyutam ||’ asthīni navadhā bhavanti tadapyāha - ‘taruṇāni kapālāni rucakāni bhavanti ca | valayānyapi tāni syurnalakāścaiva pañcadhā ||’ teṣāmapi pañcānāṃ sthānānyāha - ‘akṣakaḥ saśrutighrāṇagrīvāsu taruṇāni hi | śiraḥśaṅkhakapāleṣu tālvaṃśaprothajānuṣu | kapālāni vijānīyāt rucakāni radā matāḥ | pāṇyoḥ pārśvayuge pṛṣṭhe vakṣojaṭharapāyuṣu | pādayorvalayāni syurnalakāni bruve'dhunā || hastapādāṅgulitale kūrce ca maṇibandhayoḥ | bāhujaṅghādvaye cāpi jānīyānnalakāni tu ||’ asthnāṃ prayojanamāha - māṃsānyapabaddhāni śirābhiḥ snāyubhistathā | asthīnyālambanaṃ kṛtvā na śīryante patanti na ||’ ityasthivivaraṇam || atha marmavibhāgaḥ | saptottaraṃ marmaśatamityuktatvāt marmaṇāṃ saṃkhyā proktā teṣāṃ prayojanamāha - marmāṇītyādi | yāvanti marmāṇi tāvanti jīvādhārāṇīti munayo jaguḥ prāyeṇa atiśayenetyarthaḥ | śārṅgadhareṇa marmavibhāgastu viśeṣeṇa noktaḥ ato granthāntarāt kiṃcitsthānādikaṃ procyate - ‘sannipātaśirāsrāyupakṣamāṃsāsthisaṃbhavaḥ | marmāṇi tatra tiṣṭhanti prāṇāsteṣu viśeṣataḥ |’ teṣāṃ saṃkhyāmāha - ‘saptottaraśataṃ santi dehe marmāṇi dehinām |’ teṣāṃ sthānānyāha - ‘tānyekādaśa māṃse syuraṣṭāvasthiṣu santi hi | saṃdhīnāṃ viśatistāni snāyūnāṃ saptaviṃśatiḥ | catvāriṃśattathaikaṃ ca śirāmarmāṇi tatra tu | dvāviṃśatiśastriyuge tāvantyeva bhujadvayoḥ | dvādaśorati kukṣau ca pṛṣṭhadeśe caturdaśa | grīvāyā ūrdhvabhāge tu saptatriṃśanmatāni tu |’ sadyaḥprāṇaharatvādibhedena marmāṇi pañcadhā bhavantīti | bhedamapyāha ‘sadyaḥprāṇaharāṇi syurmarmāṇyekonaviṃśatiḥ | marmadeśāstrayastriṃśatsyuḥ kālāntaramārakāḥ | catvāriṃśacca catvāri vaikalyaṃ janayanti ca | marmāṣṭakaṃ tvacākāri viṣaghnaṃ ca trikaṃ matam |’ iti marmavibhāgaḥ || 36 || 37 || saṃdhibandhanakāriṇyo doṣadhātuvahāḥ śirāḥ || 38 || dhamanyo rasavāhibhyo dhamanti pavanaṃ tanau | Dī. idānīṃ śirālakṣaṇaṃ prakaṭayannāha - sandhīti | śirāśca sthūlasūkṣmabhedena dvividhāḥ tāsāṃ nābhirmūlaṃ tataḥ prasarantyūrdhvamadhastiryak vā | tathāhyuktam - ‘yāvatyastu śirāḥ kāye saṃbhavanti śarīriṇām | nābhyāṃ sarvā nibaddhāstāḥ pratanvanti samantataḥ ||’ iti | tāsāṃ vibhāgamapyuktaṃ yathā - tāsāṃ mūlaśirāścatvāriṃśat, tatra daśa vātavāhinyaḥ, daśa pittavāhinyaḥ, daśa śleṣmavāhinyaḥ, daśaraktavāhinyaḥ iti | tāsāṃ vātavāhinīnāṃ vātasthānagatānāṃ pañcasaptatyadhikaśataṃ bhavanti | tāvantya eva pittavāhinyaḥ pittasthāne, kaphavāhinyaḥ kaphasthāne, raktavāhinyaśca yakṛtplīhnoḥ | sandhibandhanakāriṇya iti | ākuñcanaprasaraṇādibhirviśeṣairityarthaḥ | idānīṃ dhamanīlakṣaṇamāha - dhamanya iti | dhamanādanilapūraṇāt dhamanyaḥ rasavāhinya iti caturviśatisaṃkhyākāḥ | tāsāṃ ca nābhiprabhavāṇāmūrdhvagā daśa, daśa cādhogāminyaścatasrastiryaggāminyo bhavanti | tāstu vātamūtrapurīṣa śukrārtavānyadho vahanti | annapānarasavāhinyo daśordhvagāḥ | tiryaggānāṃ tu catasṛṇāṃ dhamanīnāmekaikā śatadhā sahasradhā cottarottaraṃ vibhajyante | tāstvasaṃkhyeyāstābhiridaṃ śarīraṃ jālakairiva vyāptaṃ tāsāṃ tu mukhāni romakūpapratibaddhāni yaiḥ svedamabhivahanti, rasaṃ cāpi santarpayantyantarbahiśca, taireva cābhyaṅgapariṣekāvagāhāle- panavīryāṇyantaḥśarīramabhipratipadyante || 38 || Gū. atha śirāvibhāgaḥ - śirāṇāṃ śatasaptaketyuktatvācchirāṇāṃ śatasaptakaṃ bhavati | tāsāṃ prayojanamāha - śirāḥ sandhibandhanakāriṇyaḥ | atha ca doṣadhātuvahā idameva prayojanametāsām | atha granthāntarāt śirāṇāṃ viśeṣanirūpaṇamāha -‘sandhibandhanakāriṇyo doṣadhātuvahāḥ śirāḥ | nābhyāṃ sarvāṇi baddhāstāḥ pratanvanti samaṃtataḥ | śarīraṃ sakalaṃ caitat śirābhiḥ poṣyate sadā | praṇālibhirivārāmakulyābhiḥ kṣetradhānyavat || prasāraṇākuñcanābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ satataṃ tanau| śirāṇyevopakurvanti tāḥ syu: saptaśatāni tu | yathā drumadale śākhā dṛśyante pratatāḥ śirāḥ | tathaiva dehināṃ dehe vartante sakale śirāḥ |’ idānīṃ śirāṇāṃ prāṇānāṃ cādhārādheyatvaṃ darśayannāha - ‘nābhisthāḥ prāṇināṃ prāṇāḥ prāṇā nābhiṃ vyavasthitāḥ | śirābhireva tābhiśca cakranābhirivārakaiḥ ||’ suśrutātprāṇināṃ prāṇā nābhisthāḥ ityanena nābhyāṃ cakrasya arā iva sthitāḥ | prāṇavāyuṃ prakarṣeṇa ānanti gacchantīti prāṇāḥ prāṇavāyavaḥ | te prāṇabhedena nāgādibhedena ca daśadhā | kutaḥ ? nābhisthānataḥ prāṇāḥ prāṇavāyuvahāḥ śirā nābhiṃ vyapāśritāḥ | nābhiṃ vyupāśritāḥ kutaḥ ? yataḥ nābhiśabdavācyaḥ ādikaiḥ paribadhyate tadvannābhiḥ śarīramadhyabhāgaḥ śirābhiḥ | vāgbhaṭe tu evaṃ likhitaṃ ‘dhamanyo nābhisaṃbaddhāstriṃśatiśca tanutarāḥ | nābhiḥ paritatastābhiścakranābhirivārakaiḥ |’ ataḥ śārṅgadhareṇa dvayorgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam | śirādhamanyo nābhisthāḥ sarvāṃ vyāpya sthitāstanum| puṣṇanti cāniśaṃ vāyoḥ saṃyogātsarvadhātubhiḥ | ato dhamanyaḥ śirābhedabhinnā | yataḥ suśrute likhitam śirādhamanīsrotasāmavibhāgaḥ, avibhāgaḥ apṛthaktvaṃ ‘śirāvikāra eva dhamanyaḥ śaraṇāt śirā dhamanāt dhamanyaḥ iti nirukteḥ ||’ atha śirāṇāṃ saṃkhyāmāha - suśrutāt ‘tāsāṃ khalu mūlaśirāścatvāriṃśat tāsāṃ daśa vātavahā daśapittavahā daśa śleṣmavahā daśa raktavahāḥ tāsāṃ khalu vātavahānāṃ vātasthānagatānāṃ sapañcasaptaśataṃ bhavati tatra vātavahā ekasminsakthani pañcaviṃśatiḥ, dvitīye pañcaviṃśatiḥ, haste pañcaviṃśatiḥ, dvitīye pañcaviṃśatiḥ, evaṃ śataṃ śākhāsu koṣṭhe catustriṃśattasya vivaraṇaṃ tāsu śroṇyāṃ gudameḍhrāśritā aṣṭau, dve dve pārśve, ṣaṭ pṛṣṭhe, ṣaṭ udare,daśa vakṣasi, evaṃ catustriṃśat| ekacatvāriṃśajjatruṇa ūrdhvaṃ tāsāṃ caturdaśa grīvāyāṃ, catasraḥ karṇayoḥ, nava jihvāyāṃ, ṣaṭ nāsikāyāṃ, aṣṭau netrayoḥ| evaṃ vātavahānāṃ sapañcasaptatiśataṃ bhavati eṣa vibhāgaḥ pittaśleṣmaraktavahānāṃ jñeyaḥ | evaṃ śirāṇāṃ saptaśatāni saṃkhyātāni | tatrāruṇā vātavahāḥ pūrvaṃ te vāyunā śirāḥ | pittāduṣmāccānilāccāsitā gaurāḥ śirāḥ kaphāt | asṛgvahāstu raktāḥ syustathā nātyuṣṇaśītalāḥ ||’ iti śirāvivaraṇam || atha dhamanya āha - caturviṃśati dhamanya iti pūrvoktaṃ tāsāṃ prayojanamāha - ‘dhamanyo rasavāhinyo dhamanti pavanaṃ tanau |’ rasavāhinyaḥ dhamanyaḥ tanau dehe pavanaṃ dhamantīti prayojanam | atha śārṅgadharānuktaṃ dhamanī jñānārthaṃ vivaraṇaṃ granthāntarādāha - ‘dhamanyo nābhito yātāścaturviṃśatisaṃkhyayā | daśordhvagā daśādhogāḥ śeṣāstiryagvarāḥ smṛtāḥ | yathā svabhāvataḥ khāni mṛṇāleṣu bhavanti hi | dhamanīnāṃ tathā khāni raso yairantataścaret | pañcābhibhūtastvatha pañcakṛtvaḥ pañcendriyaṃ pañcasu vartamānā | pañcendriyaṃ pañcasu bhāvayitvā pañcatvamāyānti vināśakāle ||’ asyāyamarthaḥ pañcābhibhūtāḥ pañcavyāptā dhamanyaḥ pañcakṛtvaḥ pañcacārān pañcendriyaṃ karmapuruṣaṃ bhāvayanti yojayanti keṣu ? pañcasu śrotrādiṣvindriyādhiṣṭhāneṣu bhāvayitvā saṃyojya vināśakāle dhamanyo vināśamāyāntīti yojanā | kiṃbhūtāḥ ? dhamanyaḥ pañcasu vartamānāḥ pañcasu ākāśādibhūteṣu vartamānāḥ sthitāḥ pañcābhibhūtā iti pañcabhyo bhūtebhyo'bhisamantato bhūtāḥ śabdasparśa- rasarūpagandhāstaiḥ, yadvā ākāśapavanadahanatoyabhūmibhirvā abhibhūtāḥ vyāptā dhamanyaḥ pañcakṛtvaḥ pañcavārān āyānti āgacchanti kāḥ dhamanyaḥ ? kiṃ tatpañcendriyaṃ indriyapañcakaṃ sūkṣmarūpam | iti dhamanīvibhāgaḥ ||38|| māṃsapeśyo balāya syuravaṣṭambhāya dehinām ||39|| prasāraṇākuñcanayoraṅgānāṃ kaṇḍarā matāḥ | Dī. atha peśīvarṇanamāha - māṃsapeśya iti | māṃsāvayavasaṅghātāḥ parasparaṃ vibhaktāḥ peśya ityucyante | tāstu balāya ojase syuḥ kathitāḥ | ata evāha kaścit - ‘śirāsnāyvasthiparvāṇi sandhayaḥ syu: śarīriṇām | peśībhiḥ saṃvṛtānyatra balavanti bhavantyataḥ’ iti | tāsāṃ tu sthānaviśeṣānnānāsvarūpatvaṃ darśitam | tadyathā - bahalaḥ pelavaḥ sthūlāṇupṛthuvṛttahrasvadīrghasthiramṛduślakṣṇakakaśabhāvaḥ | pratyekalakṣaṇameteṣāṃ ca na likhitamatra granthagauravabhayāt | atha kaṇḍarāḥ - kaṇḍarā mahāsnāyavaḥ | aṅgānāṃ hastapādaśiraḥpṛṣṭhaprabhṛtīnāṃ prasāraṇākuñcane karmaviśeṣau tayorvyāpāro yeṣāṃ te | mūlakaṇḍarāḥ ṣoḍaśa, eteṣāṃ prarohā yathā hastapādagatānāṃ kaṇḍarāṇāṃ nakhā agraprarohāḥ, grīvā hṛdayanibandhinīnāṃ, adhobhāgagatānāṃ meḍhram, śroṇipṛṣṭhanibandhinīnāmadhobhāgagatānāṃ nitambamaṇḍalam mūrdhoruvakṣo'kṣipiṇḍādīnāṃ ca | ṣoḍaśagrahaṇamatra śastravyāpāraniṣedhārtham, tathāhi - ‘jālāni kaṇḍarāścāṅge pṛthak ṣoḍaśa nirdiśet | ṣaṭ kūrcāḥ sapta sīvanyo meḍhrajihvāśirogatāḥ | śastreṇa tāḥ parihareccatasro māṃsarajjavaḥ’ iti || 39 || Gū. atha māṃsapeśyaḥ | pañcaśatāni bhavantītyuktaṃ teṣāṃ prayojanamāha - māṃsapeśyaḥ balāya bhavanti tathā dehināṃ avaṣṭambhāya avasthityartham | idamāsāṃ prayojanaṃ śārṅgadharānuktaṃ ‘māṃsapeśyaḥ samākhyātā nṛṇāṃ pañcaśatāni tu | tāsāṃ śatāni catvāri śākhāsu kathitā yathā || - koṣṭhe ṣaḍgaṇanā ṣaṣṭiḥ kathitā munipuṅgavaiḥ | grīvāyā ūrdhvatastāsu catustriṃśatprakīrtitāḥ | puṃsāṃ peśyaḥ purastādyāḥ proktā mehanamuṣkajāḥ| strīṇāmāvṛtya tiṣṭhanti phalamantargataṃ hi tāḥ | puṃsāṃ mehanamuṣkayoḥ striyāstisro māṃsapeśyaḥ pūrvamuktāstāḥ strīṇāṃ mehanamuṣkābhāvāt phalaṃ garbhāśayaṃ āvṛtya tiṣṭhanti| gayadāsastvāha - strīṇāṃ māṃsapeśyastisṛbhirhīnāni pañcaśatāni | tathā bhojaḥ - ‘pañcapeśīśatānyeva strīvarjaṃ viddhi bhūmipa | ataścatasro hīyante strīṇāṃ mehanamuṣkayoḥ ||’ māṃsapeśīnāṃ karmāṇyāha -‘śiśnadeśe'sthiparvāṇi saṃdhayaśca śarīriṇām | peśībhiḥ saṃvṛtānyeva balavantaṃ bhavanti hi ||’ iti māṃsapeśīvivaraṇam || atha kaṇḍarāḥ | tatra kaṇḍarāścaiva ṣoḍaśetyuktatvāt ṣoḍaśakaṇḍarā bhavanti tāsāṃ prayojanamāha - prasāraṇā- kuñcanayoraṅgānāṃ kaṇḍarā matā | aṅgānāṃ prasāraṇākuñcane tāsāṃ prayojanam | tāsāṃ vivaraṇaṃ śārṅgadharānuktamapi granthāntarādāha - ‘mahatyaḥ snāyavaḥ proktāḥ kaṇḍarāścaiva ṣoḍaśa | prasāraṇākuñcanayordṛṣṭaṃ tāsāṃ prayojanam | catasro hastayostāsāṃ tāvantyaḥ pādayoḥ smṛtāḥ | grīvāyāmapi tāvantyastāvatyaḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśagāḥ’ iti kaṇḍarāvivaraṇam || 39 || nāsānayanakarṇānāṃ dve dve randhre prakīrtite || 40 || mehanāpānavaktrāṇāmekaikaṃ randhramucyate | daśamaṃ mastake proktaṃ randhrāṇīti nṛṇāṃ viduḥ ||41|| strīṇāṃ trīṇyadhikāni syuḥ stanayorgarbhavartmanaḥ | sūkṣmacchidrāṇi cānyāni matāni tvaci janminām||42|| Dī. atha randhrāṇyāha - nāsetyādi | nāsādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ dve dve randhre prakīrtite | tena dve nāsāyāṃ, dve nayanayoḥ, dve karṇayoriti | mehanāpānavakrāṇāmekaikaṃ | mehanaṃ meḍhram, apānaṃ gudasaṃjñam, vakraṃ mukhakuharaṃ, daśamaṃ randhraṃ mastake coktam | tadbrahmarandhramityāhureke, etāni navasrotāṃsi narāṇāṃ bahirmukhāni bhavanti daśamaṃ mastake pracchannamiti | strīṇāmaparāṇi ca trīṇi tāni kāni ? ityāha - strīṇāmiti | dve stanayoḥ kṣīravahe, ekaṃ garbhavartmanaḥ adhastāttadraktavahamityarthaḥ | anyānyapi srotāṃsi santītyāha - sūkṣmacchidrāṇīti | janmināṃ puruṣāṇāṃ tvaci viṣaye anyāni sūkṣmacchidrāṇi matāni kathitānītyarthaḥ | tānyasaṃkhyeyāni yasmāt sūkṣmatvānna dṛśyante ato'ntarmukhāni vadantyanye | cakārādanyānyapi srotāṃsi manyante kecit | tāni tu prāṇā- nnodakarasaraktamāṃsamedomūtrapurīṣaśukrārtavavahāni | eteṣāṃ svarūpamatra bāhulyānna likhitam || 40-42 || Gū. nāsānayanakarṇānāṃ dve dve randhre chidre prakīrtite kathite | mehanam indriyam, apānaṃ gudam, vakraṃ mukham eṣu ekaikaṃ randhraṃ, evaṃ nava randhrāṇi, daśamaṃ mastake proktaṃ kathitam, evaṃ daśa randhrāṇi nṛṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ viduḥ | anyāni sūkṣmacchidrāṇi janmināṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ tvaci matāni kathitāni | ‘srotāṃsi syurmanaḥprāṇā doṣadhātūpadhātavaḥ | dhātūnāṃ ca malā mūtraṃ malamityādayastanau | sañcaranti hi yairmārgaistāni srotāṃsi saṃjaguḥ’ || saṃjaguḥ vadanti tāni saṃkhyayāpi na śakyante bhāṣituṃ, vāgbhaṭe trayodaśa, suśrṛte dvāviṃśatiḥ, kecidagaṇitānyāhuḥ | iti srotovivaraṇam || 40-42 || tadvāme phupphusaplīhau dakṣiṇāṅge yakṛnmatam | udānavāyorādhāraḥ phupphusaḥ procyate budhaiḥ || 43 || raktavāhiśirāmūlaṃ plīhā khyātā maharṣibhiḥ | yakṛdrañjakapittasya sthānaṃ raktasya saṃśrayaḥ || 44 || jalavāhiśirāmūlaṃ tṛṣṇācchādanakaṃ tilam | Dī. phupphusādīnyāha - idānīṃ śārīrakathanaprasaṅgenānyeṣāmapi phupphusādīnāṃ svarūpaṃ nidarśayannāha - tadvāma iti | tadvāme hṛdayasya vāmabhāge phupphusaplīhānau ca bhavataḥ | phupphusaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ śoṇitaphenaprabhavo hṛdayanāḍikālagna: plīhā śoṇitajaḥ svanāmnā prasiddhaḥ | etadvayaṃ ca vāmapārśve sthitamiti bhāvaḥ | dakṣiṇāṅge dakṣiṇapārśve yakṛt kālakhaṇḍaṃ mataṃ etadapi śoṇitajam | atha teṣāṃ śarīre vyāpāramāha - udānavāyorityādi | phupphusaḥ udānavāyoḥ kaṇṭhasthitavāyorādhāraḥ āśrayaḥ procyate budhairiti śeṣaḥ | plīhā raktavāhiśirāmūlamākhyātam | plīheti ‘vunarūvā’ śabdavācyaḥ | yakṛt rañjakasya pittasya sthānaṃ raktasya ca sthānamiti | tilaṃ tu śoṇitakiṭṭaprabhavaṃ dakṣiṇāśritaṃ yakṛtsamīpe klomasaṃjñakaṃ bhavati | tacca jalavāhiśirāmūlaṃ kathitam, ata eva tṛṣṇācchādanakaṃ pratipāditam | tṛṣṇā pipāsā tasyāśchādanaṃ karotītyarthaḥ || 43 || 44 || Gū. tadvāme hṛdayādayo vāmabhāge phupphusaṃ plīhā ca dakṣiṇe yakṛttilaṃ ca | taduktaṃ suśrute - ‘kaphaśoṇitayoścāpi prasādo hṛdayaṃ smṛtam | tasyādho vāmataḥ plīhā dakṣiṇe kloma ucyate ||’ tatraiva yakṛto vidhānāt hṛdayaṃ cetanaṃ smṛtamiti spaṣṭam || plīhāmāha - raktavāhiśirāmūlaṃ (iti) | raktasya saṃśrayaḥ āśrayaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat | tilavṛkkau āhārajalavāhiśirāmūlau, tilaṃ kiṃ bhūtaṃ tṛṣṇācchādanakam || 43 || 44 || vṛkkau puṣṭikarau proktau jaṭharasthasya bhedataḥ ||45 || vīryavāhiśirādhārau vṛṣaṇau pauruṣāvahau | garbhādhānakaraṃ liṅgamayanaṃ vīryamūtrayoḥ || 46|| hṛdayaṃ cetanāsthānamojasaścāśrayo matam | Dī. vṛṣaṇaliṅgayoḥ svarūpamāha - vṛkkau kukṣigolakau tau tu raktamedaḥ prasādasaṃbhavau, prasādaḥ sāraḥ; ata eva jaṭharasthasya medasaḥ puṣṭikarau kathitau tatsaṃbhavatvāt | jaṭharagrahaṇamanyasthānāśritamedoniṣedhārtham | tathāhi - ‘sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tvabhyantarāśritā | athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyate’ iti | vṛṣaṇau aṇḍau tau ca māṃsā'sṛkkaphamedaḥprasādasaṃbhavau vīryavāhināṃ śirāṇāmādhārāvayavāśritāvityarthaḥ | ata eva pauruṣāvahau puruṣasya dharmaḥ pauruṣaṃ puruṣārthakāriṇāvityarthaḥ | yataḥ ‘ākṛṣṭāṇḍasya puṃsaśca strīpraharṣo na jāyate’ iti || garbhādhānakaramiti | liṅgaṃ mehanaṃ tacca grīvayā saha hṛdayanibandhanīnāṃ catasṝṇāṃ kaṇḍarāṇāṃ prarohamiti garbhā- dhānakaraṃ garbhotpādakamityarthaḥ | ata eva śukramūtrayorayanaṃ mārgamiti | taduktaṃ - ‘dvyaṅgule dakṣiṇe pārśve bastidvārasya cāpyadhaḥ | mūtrasrotaḥ pathaḥ śukraṃ puruṣasya pravartate’ iti | hṛdayaṃ kamalamukulākāramadhomukhaṃ tacca śoṇitakaphaprasādajaṃ cetanāsthānamiti | tadviśeṣeṇa caitanyapadaṃ kathitam | sāmānyena tu sakalaśarīrameva cetanāsthānam | taduktaṃ carake -‘cetanānāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ mano dehaśca sendriyaḥ | keśalomanakhāgrāntamaladravaguṇairvinā’ iti | ojasaścāśrayaṃ matamiti | ojo'pi kṛtsnadhātusnehaḥ | yathā kṛtsnaśarīroddhṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ dhātūnāṃ tejaḥśabdenāmananti | yaduktaṃ ‘rasādīnāṃ śukrāntānāṃ dhātūnāṃ snehaḥ| yathā kṛtsnaṃ yat paraṃ tejaḥ tat khalvojastadeva balamityucyate’ | tantrāntare tu oja:śabdena raso'pyucyate | jīvaśoṇitamapi oja:śabdena kathayanti kecit | śleṣmāṇamavikṛtamojaḥśabdenāpare vadantīti || 45||46|| Gū. jaṭharasthasya medasaḥ vṛkkau puṣṭikarau jñeyau, bukkāgramāṃsaṃ vṛkkamiti vaidyāḥ | vṛṣaṇau aṇḍau bījavāhiśirādhārau proktau, bījaṃ vīryaṃ tadvāhinī yā śirā tasyā ādhārau kiṃbhūtau pauruṣāvahau | liṅgaṃ garbhādhānakaraṃ, tadbījamūtrayoḥ ayanaṃ sthānaṃ, bījaṃ śukram | hṛdayaprayojanamāha cetanāsthānaṃ jñānasthānaṃ tathā ojasaḥ āśrayaṃ sthānaṃ ojaḥ sarvadhātūnāṃ sāraḥ | tathā ca vāgbhaṭe ojastejo hi dhātūnāṃ śukrāntam || 45 || 46 || śirā dhamanyo nābhisthāḥ sarvā vyāpya sthitāstanum | puṣṇanti cāniśaṃ vāyoḥ saṃyogātsarvadhātubhiḥ ||47|| Dī. idānīṃ śarīrapoṣaṇavyāpāramāha - śireti | nābhisthā: nābhisthitamūlā: sarvaṃ sakalaśarīraṃ vyāpya sthitāśca matāḥ | śirā dhamanyaḥ saraṇāt sirāḥ, dhamanāddhamanyaḥ, aniśamityaharniśam | tanuṃ śarīraṃ puṣyanti poṣayanti tatra taruṇānāṃ śarīraṃ puṣṇanti | vṛddhānāṃ ca pālayantītyabhiprāyaḥ | cakārādanugṛhṇanti arthāt paripālayantītyarthaḥ | taduktaṃ - ‘sa evānnaraso vṛddhānāṃ paripakvaśarīratvādaprīṇano bhavati’ iti | kutaḥ poṣayantītyata āha - vāyoḥ saṃyogādityādi | vāyoranilasya saṃyogāt prākṛtasahāyāt | tathāhyuktaṃ ‘kriyāṇāmapratighātamamoho buddhikarmaṇām | karotyanyān guṇāṃścāpi svāḥ sirāḥ pavanaścaran’ iti | kaiḥ kṛtvā ityāha - sarvadhātubhiriti | sarve dhātavo rasādyāḥ | etena sarvāsāṃ sāmānyaṃ karma nirdiṣṭam, tathāca - ‘yābhiridaṃ śarīramārāma iva jalahāriṇībhiḥ kedāra iva ca kulyābhirupasnihyate anugṛhyate cākuñcanaprasāraṇādibhirviśeṣairiti’ | nanu - nābhisthā: kathaṃ sakalaśarīraṃ puṣṇantītyāśaṅkya tantrāntarāt samādhānamāha | tadyathā - ‘vyāpnuvantyabhito dehaṃ nābhitaḥ prasṛtāḥ śirāḥ | pratānaṃ padminīkandādbisādīnāṃ yathā jalam’ iti || 47 || nābhistha: prāṇapavanaḥ spṛṣṭvā hṛtkamalāntaram ||48|| kaṇṭhādbahirviniryāti pātuṃ viṣṇupadāmṛtam | pītvā cāmbarapīyūṣaṃ punarāyāti vegataḥ || 49 || prīṇayandehamakhilaṃ jīvayañjaṭharānalam | Dī. atha prāṇānilasya śarīravyāpāramāha - nābhistha iti | prāṇapavanaḥ prāṇānilaḥ prāṇāśrito vāyuriti tātparyārthaḥ | prāṇā agnisomādayaḥ, nābhistha iti kāraṇāt nābhau sthitaḥ sakalaśarīravyāpakatvāt, etena nābhyāvṛtaśirāsvapi sthita iti bhāvaḥ | taduktaṃ -nābhisthāḥ prāṇināṃ prāṇāḥ prāṇānnābhirvyupāśritā | śirābhirāvṛtā nābhiścakranābhirivārakaiḥ’ iti | yathā -‘brahmarandhrānnābhicakraṃ dvādaśāramavasthitam | lūteva tantujālasthā tatra jīvo bhramatyayam || suṣumnayā brahmarandhramārohatyavarohati | jīvaḥ prāṇasamārūḍho rañjakaḥ sphaṭiko yathā’ iti | tasya kāraṇatvaṃ ca tantrāntare'pi kathitam | yathā -‘teṣāmuṣṇatamaḥ prāṇo nābhikandādadhaḥsthitaḥ | caratyāsye nāsikāyāṃ nābhau hṛdayapaṅkaje || śabdoccāraṇaniśvāsocchvāsakāsādikāraṇam |’ iti | evaṃvidhaḥ prāṇānilaḥ hṛtkamalāntaraṃ hṛdayakamalasyābhyantaraṃ spṛṣṭvā prabodhya kaṇṭhādbahirviniryāti | arthāt kaṇṭhamullaṅghya śirasi prāpta iti tātparyārthaḥ | kuta ityāha -viṣṇupadāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ viṣṇupadaṃ brahmarandhrāśritaṃ tatrāśritamamṛtaṃ pīyūṣam | ata evāhurācāryāḥ - ‘cakraṃ sahasrapatraṃ tu brahmarandhre sudhādharam | tatsudhāsāradhārābhirabhivardhayate tanum’ iti | mūlabhārate'pi - ‘brahmarandhre sthito jīvaḥ sudhayā saṃpluto yadā | tuṣṭigītādikāryāṇi saprakarṣāṇi sādhayet’ iti | pītvetyādi | sa evānilaḥ ambarapīyūṣaṃ brahma- randhrāśritamamṛtaṃ pītvā arthāt samādāya punariti tenaiva pathā vegatastatkṣaṇādeva āyāti svasthāna iti śeṣaḥ | tādṛśasya tasya kāryamāha - prīṇayannityādi | akhilaṃ dehaṃ prīṇayan sannāste iti bhāvaḥ | akhilamiti | śikhādicaraṇaparyantaṃ na kevalaṃ dehaṃ puṣṇāti api tu jīvaṃ jaṭharānalaṃ ca | jīvaḥ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātaḥ | sa ca brahmarandhre sthitaḥ jaṭharānalaḥ pācakāgniḥ tasya pācakādiśaktiṃ karotītyabhiprāyaḥ | nanu dehagrahaṇena jīvānalādīnāṃ grahaṇameva tatkathaṃ pṛthaguktaḥ ? ucyate - dehagrahaṇasāmānyenāṅgapratyaṅgavibhāgo'bhihitaḥ | jīvānilau tu viśeṣeṇa tanmūlau | ata eva ‘śarīrādbhinno jīva’ iti śrutiḥ | tasmāt pṛthaguktau na doṣaḥ | yataḥ - ‘āyurvarṇo balaṃ svāsthyamutsāho'pacayaprabhāḥ | ojastejo'gnayaḥ prāṇāścoktā dehe'gnihetukāḥ || śānte'gnau mriyate yukte ciraṃjīvatyanāmayaḥ | rogī syādvikṛte mūlamagnistasmānnirucyate’ iti || 48 || || 49 || Gū. anyadapi vāyoḥ kāryamāha - prāṇapavanaṃ hṛdayastho vāyuḥ viṣṇupadāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ kaṇṭhādbahiḥ viniryāti ambarapīyūṣaṃ pītvā punaḥ vegataḥ āyāti | kiṃ kṛtvā hṛtkamalāntaraṃ spṛṣṭvā nābhisthaḥ san jaṭharānalaṃ jīvayan akhilaṃ dehaṃ prīṇayan punaryātīti yojanā | yadvā nābhisthaḥ prāṇapavana iti pāṭhastatra evamanvayaḥ | prāṇināṃ yaḥ pavano nābhisthaḥ san hṛtkamalāntaraṃ spṛṣṭveti jñeyaṃ; śeṣaṃ tathaiva || nanu - ‘hṛdi prāṇo gude'pānaḥ samāno nābhisaṃsthitaḥ’ ityuktatvāt kathaṃ nābhisthaḥ prāṇapavano bhavatīti dūṣaṇam ? ucyate nābhistho yo'dhaḥ | asya vyākhyā ca prāṇināṃ prāṇā nābhisthāḥ yataḥ prāṇaśirā nābhiṃ vyapāśritāḥ, tatkutaḥ; yataḥ nābhiḥ śirābhirāvṛtā kevalaṃ ārāścakranābhiriveti yojanā | prakarṣeṇa anantīti prāṇāḥ prāṇavāyavastenāṅgādibhedena daśadhā ‘evaṃ daśavidho vāyuḥ prāṇarūpeṇa saṃñcare’dityukteḥ | yadyapi prāṇaśabdena indriyārohī jīvātmādivāyavo gṛhyante tathāpyatra śirāsu gatimattvādvāyoreva grahaṇaṃ daśavidhāḥ prāṇādyā vāyavaḥ pañca tatra prāṇo hṛnnābhipādāṅguṣṭhapravṛttiḥ apānastrikakaṭipṛṣṭhapārśvapādapāyūpasthavṛttiḥ, samāno hṛnnābhisarvasandhipravṛttiḥ, udāno hṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyavṛttiḥ, vyānastvagvṛttiriti pañcavāyavaḥ sāṃkhyenoktā iti bhāvaḥ | vṛttirgamanaṃ striyāṃ ktin | vṛtyate iti vṛttiḥ vāyustasyaiva prāṇasaṃjñeti suśrutābhiprāyaḥ | tathaiva śirāvarṇane śārīre dhanvantarivacanam ‘nābhisthāḥ prāṇināṃ prāṇāḥ prāṇanābhiṃ vyapāśritāḥ | śirābhirāvṛtā nābhiścakranābhirivārakaiḥ’ || prāṇāḥ pañcaprāṇāḥ, yadvā daśa prāṇāḥ daśadhā prāṇavāyurityuktatvāt ‘evaṃ daśavidho vāyuḥ prāṇarūpeṇa sañcare’diti vāsudevānubhavaḥ | tathāca rāvaṇavacanaṃ ‘niyamitaprāṇairmuhurmṛgyate’ niyamitāḥ prāṇā daśadhā prāṇavāyavo yaiste niyamitaprāṇāḥ yoginaḥ taiḥ parameśvaro hṛdi muhuḥ mṛgyate vicāryate ityetasyārthaḥ, tasmānna doṣaḥ || 48 || 49 || śarīraprāṇayoreva saṃyogādāyurucyate || 50 || kālena tadviyogācca pañcatvaṃ kathyate budhaiḥ | na jantuḥ kaścidamaraḥ pṛthivyāṃ jāyate kvacit | ato mṛtyuravārya: syāt kiṃtu rogānnivārayet ||51 || Dī. idānīṃ āyuṣaḥ svarūpamāha -- athāyurlakṣaṇaṃ tadviparītalakṣaṇaṃ cāhaśarīreti | evaṃ pūrvoktābhiprāyāt śarīraprāṇayoḥ saṃyogādāyurucyate kathyate, āyuriti bhūtātmanaḥ śarīranidhanaparyantaṃ dharmādharmanimittakasāṃsārikasukhaduḥkhopabhogasādhanam | tadviparītamāha - kālenetyādi | kālo'pi svayambhūreva kathitaḥ | tathāca - ‘kālo hi nāma svayambhūranādimadhyanidhanaḥ’ ityādi | bhūtāni saṅkalayati saṃharaṇāditi kālaḥ, sukhaduḥkhābhyāṃ bhūtāni yojayatīti vā kālaḥ | athavā kalayati mṛtyusamīpaṃ nayati iti kālaḥ, īdṛgvidhenetyarthaḥ | tadviyogāditi tayoḥ prāṇaśarīrayorviyogāt viśleṣāt pañcatvaṃ maraṇaṃ kathyate budhairiti śeṣaḥ | ata evāha ācāryaḥ - na janturityādi | rogān nivārayet | vaidya iti śeṣaḥ | taduktaṃ vaidyalakṣaṇe - ‘vyādhestattvaparijñānaṃ vedanāyāśca nigrahaḥ | etadvaidyasya vaidyatvaṃ na vaidyaḥ prabhurāyuṣaḥ’ iti | śeṣaṃ subodham || 50 || 51 || Gū. budhaiḥ śarīraprāṇayogādāyuḥ ucyate, kāle āyuṣo niḥśeṣeṇa tadviyogāt prāṇaviyogātpañcatvaṃ kathyate, pañcatvaṃ maraṇam, yataḥ mṛtyoḥ pratīkāro nāsti rogāṇāṃ pratīkārosti ato rugbhyastanuṃ rakṣedityāha na janturiti | avāryo dūrīkartumaśakyaḥ || 50 || 51 || yāpyatvaṃ yāti sādhyastu yāpyo gacchatyasādhyatām | jīvitaṃ hantyasādhyastu narasyā'pratikāriṇaḥ || 52 || Dī. idānīṃ sādhyasya vyādherapratikriyamāṇatvādavasthāntaraprāptimāha - yāpyatvamiti | apratikāriṇo narasyāturasya susādhyo vyādhiryāpyatvaṃ yāti, kintu uktavyādhiḥ sādhyatāṃ prāpya paścādyāpyatvaṃ prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | yāpyo'pyasādhyatāṃ gacchati asādhyo'pi jīvitaṃ hantīti | apratikāriṇa iti rogāpanayanādikakriyārahitasya, ata evotpannamātraṃ eva vyādhiḥ pratikāryaḥ | taduktaṃ - ‘jātamātre cikitsyastu nopekṣyo'lpatayā gadaḥ | vahniśatruvidhaistulyaḥ svalpo'pi vikarotyasau’ iti | yāpya ityasādhyabhedaḥ | tathāca - ‘asādhyo dvividho jñeyo yāpyo yaścāpratikriya:’ iti | tatra tu ‘yāpanīyaṃ tu jānīyāt kriyāṃ dhārayate tu ya: | kriyāyāṃ tu vinivṛttāyāṃ sadya eva vinaśyati ||’ iti | apratikriyaścikitsāvarjitaḥ, niyataprāṇahara ityarthaḥ | sādhyo'pi dvividhaḥ susādhyaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaśca | tatraikadoṣotpanno nirupadravo'cirotpanna ityādilakṣaṇaḥ sukhasādhyaḥ śastrādisādhanaḥ kṛcchra iti || 52 || Gū. roganivāraṇe sādhyādibhedamāha | apratikāriṇaḥ cikitsāmakurvataḥ puruṣasya sādhyo roga: yāpyatāṃ yāti | yāpyaḥ asādhyatāṃ yāti gacchati | asādhyo jīvitaṃ hantīti yojanā || 52 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ śarīraṃ sādhanaṃ yata: | ato rugbhyastanuṃ rakṣennaraḥ karmavipākavit || 53 || Dī. idānīṃ dharmādisādhanaśarīrasya rakṣāṃ nirdiśannāha - idānīṃ dehasya catuḥpadārthasādhanabhūtasya rakṣāṃ nirdiśannāha - dharmeti | yato hetoḥ śarīraṃ dharmādīnāṃ sādhanamasti ataḥ kāraṇāt rugbhyo vyādhibhyastanuṃ śarīraṃ rakṣet | ko rakṣet ? ityāha - naraḥ karmavipākaviditi karma śubhāśubhaṃ tasya vipākaḥ phalaṃ taṃ jānātīti karmavipākavit, etenādṛṣṭajanyaphalaṃ saccintya tatparo bhūtvā kṛtadānapūrvakaṃ karma kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | yata: - ‘pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vyādhirūpeṇa tiṣṭhati | ato dānādikaṃ kuryāt prasamīkṣya vicakṣaṇaḥ ||’ iti ||53|| Gū. yataḥ dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ śarīraṃ sādhanaṃ ataḥ rugbhyo rakṣediti pūrveṇaiva saṃbandhaḥ | ataḥ karmavipākavit narastanuṃ rakṣet karmavipākavittannidānajñaḥ || 53 || dhātavastanmalā doṣā nāśayantyasamāstanum | samāḥ sukhāya vijñeyā balāyopacayāya ca || 54 || Dī. atha doṣādīnāṃ vaiṣamyenāvasthāmāha -- dhātava iti | sukhaṃ svasthatā, balamāṅgikamojaḥsaṃjñakam upacayaṃ śarīrasya vṛddhirūpā santatiḥ | tanmalā iti dhātumalāḥ | samā iti svaparimāṇasthitāḥ iti yadvivaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tatteṣāṃ svabhāvaparimāṇaṃ ca tantrāntarīyavākyena darśayannāha | tadyathā - ‘yaḥ prasādaparo'nnasya paraṃ jīrṇasya sarvaśaḥ | sa raso'ñjalayastasya nava deheṣu dehinaḥ | raktasyāñjalayastvaṣṭau śakṛtaḥ sapta sarvaśaḥ | pittasyāñjalayaḥ pañca ṣaṭ kaphasya pracakṣate || mūtrasya vidyāccatvāro vasāyāścāñjalitrayam | dvāvañjalī medasastu majjña ekāñjalirmataḥ || śukrasyārdhāñjalirjñeyo mastiṣkasyojasastathā | catvāro'ñjalayaḥ strīṇāṃ rajasaḥ prakṛtisthitiḥ || dvāvañjalī prasūtāyā: stanyasyāpi hi yoṣitaḥ | pramāṇametaddhātūnāmaduṣṭānāmudāhṛtam || hīnāḥ syustatpramāṇāttu pravṛddhāścāpi dhātavaḥ | yojayanti vikāreṣu doṣā vṛddhikṣayapradāḥ’ iti | ata evāha vāgbhaṭaḥ – ‘rogastu doṣavaiṣamyaṃ doṣasāmyamarogatā’ iti | anyacca - ‘vikṛtāḥ prakṛtā dehaṃ ghnanti te vardhayanti ca’ iti | tathāca carake'pi - ‘vikāro dhātuvaiṣamyaṃ sāmyaṃ prakṛtirucyate | sukhasaṃjñakamārogyaṃ vikāraḥ svayameva ca’ iti || 54 || Gū. dhātvādīnāmasamatvasamatvābhyāṃ śarīrasya duḥkhasukhe āha - dhātavaḥ rasādyāḥ sapta tanmalāḥ dhātumalāḥ, doṣā vātādaya asamāḥ hīnādhikāḥ tanuṃ nāśayanti samāḥ svapramāṇasthā: sukhā jñeyāḥ tathā balāya dhātuvṛddhau upacayāya sthaulyāya || 54 || iti kālādivivaraṇaṃ samāptam || atha sṛṣṭikramaḥ | jagadyoneranicchasya cidānamdaikarūpiṇaḥ | puṃso'sti prakṛtirnityā praticchāyeva bhāsvataḥ ||55|| Dī. pūrvamuktamādiśabdāt sṛṣṭikramaśārīragrahaṇaṃ atastaṃ darśayannāha --jagadyoneriti | jagadyonerityādiṣu sā nityā prakṛtirasti iti viṣayaḥ | yathā bhāsvato mārtaṇḍasya praticchāyeva pratibimbamiva sā nityā astīti śrutiḥ | prakṛteḥ paryāyamavyaktaṃ nāma kathitam | kīdṛśasya ? tamāha -jagadyoneriti | akhilasya jagato yoni saṃbhavahetustasyeti | yadvā jagacchabdena pṛthivyādayo'bhidhīyante kārye kāraṇopacārāt | teṣāṃ yonirutpattistasyetyarthaḥ | etenābhivyaktihetutvamuktam | punaḥ kīdṛśasya ? anicchasyeti | icchā ahaṃkārasyotpādinī pratipāditā tayā rahitasyetyarthaḥ | etena nirvikāratvamuktam | punaḥ kiṃbhūtasya ? cidānandaikarūpiṇa iti | cit jñānam ānandaṃ parabrahmāvabodhalakṣaṇaṃ dharmaḥ, tadvayamevaikaṃ rūpaṃ yasya | yadvā - cit svarūpānandamevaikaṃ rūpaṃ yasya jñānānandasyetyabhiprāyaḥ | tathāhyuktam - ‘asti brahma cidānandaṃ svayaṃ jyotirnirañjunam| īśvaro liṅgamityuktamadvitīyamayaṃ vibhuḥ || nirvikāraṃ nirākāraṃ sarveśvaramanīśvaram | sarvaśakti ca sarvajñaṃ tadaṃśā jīvasaṃjñakāḥ | anādyavidyopahitā yathāgnervisphuliṅgakāḥ’ iti || 55 || Gū. atha sṛṣṭikramaḥ | āyurvedasya phalaṃ cikitsā puruṣasya, puruṣastu caturviṃśatitattcajīvātmanaśca svarūpa- nirūpaṇāya sṛṣṭikramamāha | puṃsaḥ cidānandanirūpitasya prakṛtiḥ nityā asti | keva bhāsvataḥ sūryasya praticchāyā iva | kathaṃbhūtasya puṃsaḥ | jagadyoneḥ jagadutpādakasya | jagacchabdena pṛthivyādayaḥ | nanu gacchatīti jagat teṣā- mutpatau samavāyikāraṇam | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtasya | anicchasya icchārahitasya | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtasya | cidānandaikarūpiṇaḥ cidānandameva ekaṃ rūpaṃ yasya | anena īśvarasya nityatvāt tairapi nityatvaṃ pratipāditam || 55 || acetanādi caitanyayogena paramātmanaḥ | akarodviśvamakhilamanityaṃ nāṭakākṛti || 56 || Dī. idānīṃ acetaso nāryāḥ prakṛteḥ puruṣasya caitanyayāgena sṛṣṭyutpattimāha - atha kartṛttvanimittatayā pūrvaślokena saṃbandhaḥ | tena sā mūlaprakṛtiḥ paramātmano yogena kṛtvā akhilaṃ viśvamakaroditi tātparyārthaḥ | yogaścittavṛttinirodhalakṣaṇaḥ | akhilaṃ carācarātmakaṃ, kīdṛśaṃ ? tadāha - aceta- nādīti | acetanamavyaktamādiryasya tadacetanādi, caitanyamiti cetanānvitam | nanu kathamacetanasya kāraṇatvaṃ prava- rtate ? tadasaṅgatamiti, satyaṃ - yathā vatsavivṛddhyarthaṃ kṣīrasaṃjñaṃ kāraṇatvena pravartate tadvaditi | anyat savistaraṃ vistarabhayānna likhitam | punaḥ kīdṛśam ? anityamiti vināśighaṭapaṭādivat | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtaṃ ? nāṭakākṛti nāṭakasvarūpaṃ aindrajālikavastuvaditi bhāvaḥ || 56 || Gū. acetanetyādi | acetanā jaḍā api prakṛtiḥ paramātmanaḥ caitanyayogena akhilaṃ viśvam akarot, kibhūtaṃ viśvam | anityaṃ naśvaram, punaḥ kiṃbhūtam | nāṭakākṛti indrajālavat akhilaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamādilakṣaṇaṃ viśvaśabdasya sarvāditvāt triṣu caritatvādatra napuṃsake || 56 || prakṛtirviśvajananī pūrvaṃ buddhimajījanat || 57 || icchāmayīṃ mahadrūpāmahaṅkārastato'bhavat | trividhaḥ so'pi saṃjāto rajaḥsattvatamoguṇaiḥ ||58|| Dī. idānīṃ sṛṣṭyutpattyupakrame prakṛte buddhyādīnāha – idānīmekena kāraṇena sarveṣāṃ kāryāṇāmutpattikramamāha - prakṛtiriti | prakṛtirityavyaktāparaparyāyā pūrvamādau buddhiṃ mahāniti vikārasaṃjñaṃ ajījanadutpādayāmāsa | kīdṛśīm ? icchāmayīṃ, sattvarajastamoguṇa- svabhāvairnānātmikāmityarthaḥ | punaḥ kīdṛśīṃ ? mahudrūpām iti mahāniti rūpaṃ paryāyanāma yasyāḥ sā tathā tāṃ | yadvā nirmalasphaṭikopalaprakhyāṃ sattvasamudrekatvāt| tata iti buddhitattvāt ahaṅkāro'bhimānavyāpāralakṣaṇo'bhavat | sa eva sattvādiguṇaiḥ kṛtvā trividhaḥ sañjātaḥ, trividha iti vaikārikastaijaso bhūtādirityartha: | tatra vaikārikaḥ sāttvikaḥ, taijaso rājasaḥ, bhūtādistāmasa iti || 57 || 58 || Gū. prakṛtītyādi | kiṃbhūtāṃ buddhiṃ icchāmayīṃ | punaḥ mahadrūpāṃ, tataḥ buddheḥ sakāśādabhavaditi yojanā | prakṛtīti prakarṣeṇa kriyate anayā iti prakṛtiḥ guṇānāṃ sāmyaṃ prakṛtiḥ sattvarajastamasāṃ sāmyādyavasthā prakṛtiriti sāṃkhye sā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā bhedabhinnā | tathācoktaṃ suśrute - ‘avyaktaṃ mahānahaṃkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇītyaṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ’ | gītāyāṃ coktam - ‘bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca | ahaṃkāra’ iti pañcabhedabhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā ato buddhyādayo vakṣyamāṇāḥ prakṛterbhedā buddhijñānasvarūpā icchāmayīṃ icchāsvarūpāṃ mahadrūpāṃ bahurūpām | yataḥ gītāyāmuktam - ‘bahuśākhā hyanantāśca buddhayo vyavasāyinā’miti | sa ahaṃkārastrividho bhavatītyāha - so'pyahaṃkāraḥ rajaḥsattvatamoguṇaistrividhaḥ saṃjātaḥ abhavat || 57 || 58 || tasmātsattvarajoyuktādindriyāṇi daśābhavan | manaśca jātaṃ tānyāhuḥ śrotratvaṅnayanaṃ tathā || 59 || jihvāghrāṇavacohastapādopasthagudāni ca | pañca buddhīndriyāṇyāhuḥ prāktanānītarāṇi ca ||60|| karmendriyāṇi pañcaiva kathyante sūkṣmabuddhibhiḥ | Dī. tasmādindriyāṇi bhavantītyāha - atha trividhasyāpi tasya kāryamāha - tasmāditi | tasmādityahaṅkārāt daśendriyāṇyabhavan na kevalaṃ daśasaṃkhyākāni - mano'pi indriyasaṃjñamutpannam | kīdṛśādahaṅkārādityāha - sattvarajoyuktāditi | sattvarajograhaṇāt tamo'pi prāptameva yataḥ sāttvikādahaṅkārāt rājasasahāyāt tamomātrayānuviddhādekādaśendriyāṇyutpadyanta iti bhāvaḥ | eke tasmādityasya sthāne'tra sattvarajoyuktāditi paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca tānīndriyāṇi ca | sāṃkhye tu ahaṅkārāṇi kathitāni vaidyake bhautikānītyabhiprāyaḥ | tatra pañca prāktanāni śrotrādīni buddhīndriyāṇyāhuḥ | buddherāśrayatvāt | prāktanāni pūrvapaṭhitāni itarāṇyavaśiṣṭāni pañca karmendriyāṇi kathyante teṣu karmaṇāmāśrayatvāt | pūrvāṇi pañca śrotratvaṅnayanajihvāghrāṇāni itarāṇi ca pañca vacohastapādopasthagudādīni | sūkṣmabuddhibhiriti grahaṇena mano'pyubhayātmakaṃ sūcyate | buddhyātmakakarmātmakamityarthaḥ | buddhīndriyāṇāṃ karmendriyāṇāṃ ca manodhi'ṣṭhānānāmeva pravṛtteḥ || 59 || 60 || Gū. tasmātsattvarajoyuktādahaṃkārāt daśa indriyāṇi abhavan, ekādaśaṃ manaḥ | teṣāṃ nāmānyāha mana ekādaśaṃ tāni daśa śrotraṃ karṇadvayaṃ tvak tvacā, nayanaṃ netrayugmaṃ jihvā prasiddhā, ghrāṇaṃ nāsārandhre vaco vadanaṃ hastau dvau, pādaṃ dve upasthaṃ meḍhraṃ yoniśca gudaṃ prasiddham | daśendriyāṇāṃ madhye pañca buddhīndriyāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇi bhavanti tayorbhedamāha - pañca buddhīndriyāṇyāhuḥ proktāni tānītarāṇi ceti prāktanāni śrotrādīni pañca buddhīndriyāṇi buddhirāśrayatvāt itarāṇi vācaḥprabhṛtīni pañca karmendriyāṇi karmāśrayatvāt sūkṣmabuddhibhiretāni kathyante iti yojanā ||59||60|| rajaḥsattvaguṇotkṛṣṭādahaṅkārādathābhavat || 61 || tanmātrapañcakaṃ tasya nāmānyuktāni sūribhiḥ | śbdatanmātrakaṃ sparśatanmātraṃ rūpamātrakam || 62 || rasatanmātrakaṃ gandhatanmātraṃ ceti tadviduḥ | tanmātrapañcakāttasmātsaṃjātaṃ bhūtapañcakam || 63 || vyomānilānalajalakṣoṇīrūpaṃ ca tanmatam | Dī. trividhāhaṃkārāttanmātrāpañcakaṃ bhavati atastadāha - raja ityādi | athānantaram, ahaṃkārāditi ahaṃkāro bhūtādisaṃjñā tasmāditi tāmasarūpādityabhiprāyaḥ | kīdṛśādityāha - rajaḥsattvaguṇotkṛṣṭāditi rājasasahāyāt sattvamātrayā'nuviddhāt tāmasādahaṅkārādityarthaḥ | īdṛśāttanmātrapañcakaṃ bhavatīti tātparyārtha: | sā sā mātrā yasmin tattanmātraṃ taccānudbhūtasvabhāvaṃ bāhyendriyāgrāhyaṃ vakṣyamāṇaśabdādīnyeva pañcatanmātrāṇīti | tacca yogibhireva grāhyam | tanmātrapañcakāditi | tasmātpūrvoktāttanmātrapañcakāt, śabdāderbhūtapañcakaṃ vyomādikaṃ sañjātaṃ samyak prakāreṇotpadyata iti | samyak prakāragrahaṇenaikottaraparivṛddhiḥ sūcyate | tadyathā śabdatanmātrācchabdatadguṇaṃ vyoma, śabdatanmātrasahitāt sparśatanmātrāt śabdasparśaguṇo vāyuḥ, śabdasparśatanmātrasahitāt rūpatanmātrācchabdasparśaguṇaṃ tejaḥ, śabdasparśarūpa- tanmātrasahitādrasatanmātrāt śabdasparśarūparasaguṇā āpaḥ, śabdasparśarūparasatanmātrasahitāt gandhatanmātrāt śabdasparśarūparasagandhaguṇā pṛthivī | patañjalimatānusāriṇaśca śabdādibhyo vyomādīnāmutpattimicchanti ||61-63|| Gū. tamaḥsattvaguṇotkṛṣṭādahaṃkārāttanmātrapañcakamabhavat, tasya nāmāni sūribhiḥ uktāni tāni nāmānyāha -śabdatanmātrakaṃ śrotrasvarūpam, sparśatanmātrakaṃ tvagmātrakaṃ tvaksvarūpam; rūpatanmātrakaṃ nayanamātrakaṃ nayanasvarūpam; rasatanmātrakaṃ jihvāmātrakaṃ jihvāsvarūpam, gandhatanmātraṃ ghrāṇamātraṃ ghrāṇasvarūpam, tanmātrapaṃñcakāt bhūtapañcakaṃ jāyata ityāha - tasmāt śrotrādipañcatanmātrāt bhūtapañcakaṃ saṃjātaṃ bhavatītyadhyāhāraḥ | tadbhūtapañcakaṃ vyomānilānalajalakṣoṇīrūpaṃ mataṃ kathitaṃ vyoma ākāśaṃ, anilo vāyu:, analo'gniḥ, jalaṃ prasiddhaṃ, kṣoṇī pṛthivī, tadrūpaṃ teṣāṃ svarūpam || 61-63 || śabda: sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca rasagandhāvanukramāt ||64|| tanmātrāṇāṃ viśeṣāḥ syuḥ sthūlabhāvamupāgatāḥ | Dī. idānīṃ tanmātrāṇāṃ viśeṣānāha - idānīṃ pañcakānāṃ tanmātrakāṇāṃ viśeṣā ucyante - śabda iti | anubhavayogyaiḥ sukhaduḥkhamo- harūpadharmairviśeṣyanta iti viśeṣāḥ, te śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ | tanmātrāṇi tvaviśeṣāṇi yatastāni anubhavayogyaiḥ sukhādibhirviśeṣaṃ kartuṃ na śakyate sūkṣmatvāt | ata eva sthūlabhāgamupāgatā amī viśeṣā ityarthaḥ | kecidamuṃ ślokaṃ tanmātrapañcakādanantaraṃ paṭhanti saṅgatatvāt || 64 || Gū. śabdaḥ śrotraviśeṣabhāvaḥ, rūpaṃ netraviśeṣabhāvaḥ, raso jihvāviśeṣabhāvaḥ; gandhaḥ ghrāṇaviśeṣabhāvaḥ ete tanmātrāṇāṃ viśeṣāḥ syu:| kiṃbhūtā sthūlabhāvatvaṃ prāptāḥ | ete śabdādayaḥ || 64 || buddhīndriyāṇāṃ pañcaiva śabdādyā viṣayā matāḥ||65|| karmendriyāṇāṃ viṣayā bhāṣādānavihāritāḥ | ānandotsargakau caiva kathitāstattvadarśibhiḥ || 66|| Dī. athendriyāṇāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ viṣayān darśayannāha - buddhīndriyāṇāmiti | śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇānāṃ śabdādyā iti śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ ete tu teṣāmanukrameṇa boddhavyāḥ | karmendriyāṇāmiti vacohastapādopasthagudānāṃ yathākramaṃ bhāṣādānavihārānandotsargā viṣayāḥ kathitāḥ, bhāṣā vacanaṃ, ādānaṃ grahaṇam, vihāro'tra calanādikam, ānando harṣaḥ, utsargo malaparityāgaḥ, iti tattvadarśibhiḥ puruṣaiścaturviṃśatitattvarahasyajñāpakairityarthaḥ ||65||66 || Gū. pañcajñānendriyāṇāṃ viṣayāḥ kathitāḥ, tatra śabdaḥ śrotraviṣayaḥ, sparśaḥ tvagviṣayaḥ, rūpaṃ netraviṣayaḥ; rasaḥ jihvāviṣayaḥ, gandhaḥ ghrāṇaviṣayaḥ; karmendriyāṇāṃ bhāvādayo viṣayāḥ kathitāḥ | viśeṣā anubhavāḥ; pakṣe sukhaduḥkhamoharūpairdharmairviśeṣyanta iti viśeṣāḥ atra karmaṇi ghañ pratyayaḥ | tanmātrāṇi tvagviśeṣāṇi patyastānyanubhavayogyaiḥ mukhādibhirviśeṣeṣu na śakyante sūkṣmatvāt | tataḥ vacasaḥ bhāṣā bhāṣaṇaṃ, jihvayā adanaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ, pādasya vihāratā gamanāgamanam, upasthasya yoniliṅgayoḥ ānandaḥ strīpuruṣasaukhyaviśeṣaḥ, gudasya visarjaḥ purīṣatyāgaḥ || 65-66 || pradhānaṃ prakṛtiḥ śaktirnityā cāvikṛtistathā | etāni tasyā nāmāni śivamāśritya yā sthitā || 67 || Dī. idānīṃ mūlaprakṛteḥ paryāyanāmānyāha - pradhānamiti | pradhānaṃ prakṛtiriti mūlaprakṛtiḥ śaktiriti kāraṇarūpā, nityā avināśinī, avikṛtirvikārarahitā, tasyāḥ prakṛteḥ, śivamiti parabrahmalakṣaṇam āśritya yā sthitā sūryasya pratibimbavat sā ca sattvarajastamaḥsvarūpā bhavati | taduktaṃ - ‘sarvabhūtāni kāraṇamakāraṇaṃ sattvarajastamolakṣaṇamaṣṭarūpamakhilasya jagataḥ saṃbhave heturavyaktaṃ nāma’ iti || 67 || Gū. atha prakṛtivivaraṇam ( tatra) prakṛternāmānyāha - yā prakṛtiḥ śaktiḥ śivaṃ parameśvaram āśritya sthitā tasyā etāni nāmāni bhavantīti yojanā | evaṃ prakṛteḥ pradhānaṃ nāma ekaṃ prakṛtiḥ ekā śaktiḥ ekā nityā ekā avikṛtiḥ | suśrutamate avyaktaṃ ca prakṛternāma | na vyajyate sma ityavyaktaṃ mūlaprakṛtiparyāyā iti ḍallaṇaḥ || 67 || mahānahaṅkṛtiḥ pañcatanmātrāṇi pṛthakpṛthak | prakṛtirvikṛtiścaiba saptaitāni budhā jaguḥ || 68 || daśendriyāṇi cittaṃ ca mahābhūtāni pañca ca | vikārāḥ ṣoḍaśa jñeyāḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya jagatsthitāḥ || 69 || evaṃ caturviṃśatibhistattvaiḥ siddhe vapurgṛhe | jīvātmā niyato nityo vasati svāntadūtavān || 70 || sa dehī kathyate pāpapuṇyaduḥkhasukhādibhiḥ | vyāpto baddhaśca manasā kṛtrimaiḥ karmabandhanaiḥ || 71 || Dī. idānīṃ caturviṃśatike tattvarāśau prakṛtitvaṃ nirasyan kathitamupasaṃharannāha - mahāniti | etāni sapta mahadādīnyeva prakṛtirvikṛtiśca bhavantīti piṇḍārthaḥ | prakṛtirityapareṣāṃ kāraṇabhūtā, vikṛtiriti mūlaprakṛteḥ kāryarūpā, atra yadavyaktagrahaṇaṃ na kṛtaṃ tadvikṛtipadagrahaṇāt, avyaktaṃ tu kevalaṃ hetubhāvena prakṛtireva | mahadādayaḥ sapta kāryatvena vikṛtayo'pi jñeyāḥ | pañcatanmātrāṇīti śabdādīni | ityevaṃ budhāḥ paṇḍitā jaguḥ kathitavantaḥ | idānīṃ ṣoḍaśavikārān darśayannāha - daśendriyāṇīti | ṣoḍaśa vikārāḥ kāryāṇi te vikārāḥ daśendriyāṇīti śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇavāghastopasthapāyupādāni, cittaṃ ceti mano'pīridrayabhūtamiti bhāvaḥ | mahābhūtāni ākāśapavanadahanatoyabhūmaya iti | evaṃ ṣoḍaśa vikārāḥ, ete tu sarvaṃ carācarātmakaṃ jagat saṃsāraṃ vyāpya sthitā ityarthaḥ | evamiti pūrvottāprakāreṇa | caturviṃśatibhistattvairiti avyaktaṃ mahānahaṅkāraḥ, śabdatanmātraṃ, sparśatanmātraṃ, rūpatanmātraṃ, rasatanmātraṃ, gandhatanmātraṃ, śrotraṃ, tvak, cakṣuḥ, ghrāṇaṃ, rasanā, tvak, hastapādam, upasthaṃ, pāyuḥ, manaḥ, pṛthivī, āpaḥ, tejaḥ, vāyuḥ, ākāśaṃ, caturviṃśatikatattvāni pṛthagdarśitāni, ebhiḥ saha jīvātmā liṅgaśarīraṃ nityamavināśi niyataḥ sarvakālaṃ vapurgṛhe sthūlaśarīre vasati tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ | kīdṛśastamāha - svāntadūtavāniti | svāntaṃ manastadeva dūto yasya sa tathā manodūta ityarthaḥ | ‘svāntaṃ hṛnmānasaṃ manaḥ’ ityabhidhānāt | sa dehī kathyate iti | sa jīvātmā dehī puruṣavyaktiḥ | dehaṃ mahadādikṛtasūkṣmaliṅgaśarīramucyate tadasyāstīti dehī kathyate | so'pi karmapuruṣo vācyaḥ pañcaviṃśatitamaḥ kathitaḥ | ata eva pāpapuṇyasukhaduḥkhādibhirvyāptaḥ | manasā kṛtrimaiḥ karmabandhanaiśca baddhaḥ, etena karmapuruṣasya śarīrātmanoḥ saṃyogakārakeṇa manasā saṃyoge pāpapuṇyaṃ sukhaduḥkhādayo guṇā utpadyanta iti bhāvaḥ | ādiśabdāt icchādveṣaprayatnaprāṇāpānonmeṣabuddhimanaḥsaṅkalpavicāraṇāsmṛtivijñānādhyavasāyaviṣayopalabdhiguṇā jñātavyāḥ | nanvavikṛto jīvātmā kathaṃ vikārivastvabhivyāptaḥ ? satyaṃ, nirvikārasyāpi vikāravastusaṃyogena vikāritvaṃ syāt yathā sandhyārāśigirivikārinikarasaṃyogādaruṇaṃ gaganatalaṃ tadopamaṃ bhavati tadvadityabhiprāyaḥ | tat liṅgaśarīre vikārāḥ pratibimbito iva tiṣṭhantītyeke bhāṣante | yathā taḍāgodake pratibimbito drumastaḍāgodakaprakampeṇa prakampātmakaḥ kathyate iti || 68-71 || Gū. idānīṃ caturviṃśatitattvānāṃ samāptikāmaḥ kathyate -- mahānityādi | mahānbuddhiḥ ahaṃkṛtirahaṃkāraḥ, pañcatanmātrāṇi śabdādīni etāni sapta budhāḥ prakṛtiṃ vikṛtiṃ ca jaguḥ | prakṛtiḥ kāraṇaṃ na tu kasyacitkāryamityarthaḥ | mahattattvādayaḥ sapta mahānahaṃkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇīti śaktiprakṛtervikṛtervikṛtāpakāryāṇīti suśrutaḥ | tathāca granthāntare ‘indriyāṇāṃ saṃbhūtīnāṃ kāraṇatvānmaharṣibhiḥ | mahattattvādayaḥ sapta proktā vikṛtayo'pi ca |’ atha ṣoḍaśa vikārānāha - daśendriyāṇi śrotrādīni, cittaṃ manaḥ mahadbhūtāni pañca pṛthivyādīni ete ṣoḍaśa vikārāḥ jagadvyāpya sthitāḥ | vikārāḥ kāryāṇi | evaṃbhūte gṛhe jīvātmā vasatītyāha - evamamunā prakāreṇa caturviṃśatibhistattvaiḥ siddhe vapurgṛhe jīvātmā vasati | kiṃbhūtaḥ ? niyateḥ śubhāśubhakarmaṇaḥ, nighraḥ āpannaḥ | punaḥ kiṃbhūtaḥ ? svāntastavān svāntaṃ mana eva dūto yasya saḥ manodūtayukta ityarthaḥ | sa jīvātmā dehī kathyate ityāha - sa jīvātmā pāpādibhiḥ manasā kṛtrimaiḥ karmabandhanairvyāpto baddhaśca dehī kathyate | deho'syāstīti dehī jīvātmā ||68-71 || kamākrodhau lobhamohāvahaṅkāraśca pañcamaḥ | daśendriyāṇi buddhiśca tasya bandhāya dehinaḥ ||72|| Dī. karmabandhanairbaddhaśceti yaduktaṃ tadidānīṃ tasya bandhanānyāha - kāmakrodhāviti | tasya dehina iti pūrvoktasya puruṣasya kāmādayo bandhanāya bhavantītyarthaḥ | kāmo manasaḥ saṃkalpaviśeṣaḥ, taduktaṃ - ‘strīṣu jāto manuṣyāṇāṃ strīṇāṃ ca puruṣeṣu vā | parasparakṛtaḥ snehaḥ kāma ityabhidhīyate’ iti | krodhastu manaso vyādhirūpo hiṃsātmakaḥ | tathāhi ‘yadūṣmā hṛdayāñjantoḥ samuttiṣṭhati vai sakṛt | parahiṃsātmakaḥ kleśaḥ krodha ityabhidhīyate iti | lobho gardhaḥ tṛṣṇā | tathācoktaṃ - ‘parārthaṃ parabhogāṃśca parasāmarthyameva ca | dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca yā tṛṣṇā jāyate lobha eva saḥ’ iti | mohastu mithyāvabodhaḥ sarvapāpastvaṃ yathā - ?aśreyaḥśreyasormadhye bhramaṇaṃ saṃśayo bhavet | mithyājñānaṃ tu taṃ prāhurahite hitadarśanam iti | ahaṅkāro'bhimānavyāpāralakṣaṇaḥ | yathā - ‘ahamityabhimānena yaḥ kriyāsu pravartate | kāryakāraṇayuktasta tadahaṅkāralakṣaṇam’ iti | daśendriyāṇi prasiddhāni buddhiśceti manovyāpāraḥ || 72 || Gū. tasya dehino yāni bandhāya bhavanti tānyāha - tasya dehino jīvasya kāmādayo bandhāya bhavantīti yojanā || 72 || āpnoti bandhamajñānādātmajñānācca mucyate | taddu:khayogakṛdvyādhirārogyaṃ tatsukhāvaham || 73 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ kalādikākhyānādhyāyaḥ || 5 || Dī. yena baddho muktaśca bhavati sukhaduḥkhe ca bhavatastatprakāramāha - idānīṃ bandhanamāha - prāpnotīti | ajñānāditi mohādbandhanaṃ kleśamāpnotīti puruṣa iti śeṣaḥ, sa eva puruṣa ātmajñānāddharmādharmavicāraṇānmucyate bandhanādeva, kaivalyaṃ prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | ata eva vyādhistu duḥkhayogakṛdbhavati tat sukhāvarohamārogyamiti tadduḥkhayogakṛditi tat tayoḥ śarīraśarīriṇoḥ śarīramanasoriti kecit, duḥkhasaṃyogakṛditi duḥkhaṃ tu svabhāvataḥ pratikūlavedanīyam | sukhaṃ tu svabhāvato'nukūlavedanīyam | ārogyaṃ svāsthyavyāpāralakṣaṇam | iti sṛṣṭikramaśārīram || 73 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajena āḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ prathamakhaṇḍe kalādikākhyānaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || Gū. ajñānātkarmādibhirvyāptaḥ bandhaṃ prāpnoti | ātmajñānāt tattvajñānāt mucyate janmādibhiriti śeṣaḥ | title: 6. athāhārādigatiradhyāyaḥ
text: ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ | athāhārādigatiradhyāyaḥ | yātyāmāśayamāhāraḥ pūrvaṃ prāṇānilerita: | mādhuryaṃ phenabhāvaṃ ca ṣaḍraso'pi labheta saḥ || 1 || Dī. idānīmāhārādigatiradhyāyaḥ pūrvaṃ darśitastamāha - atheti | yātītyādi | āhāraḥ pāñcabhautikasvarūpo'śanamityarthaḥ | taduktaṃ suśrute - ‘pañcabhūtātmake dehe āhāraḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ’ iti | evaṃvidhaḥ sa āhāraḥ pūrvamādau āmāśayaṃ yāti prāpnotītyarthaḥ | āmāśayaṃ ca nābhistanāntare koṣṭhaviśeṣamāhuḥ, yathā - ‘nābhistanāntare jantorāhurāmāśayaṃ budhāḥ’ iti | kīdṛśastamāha -prāṇānilerita iti | prāṇavāyunā prerita iti bhāvaḥ | ‘hṛdi prāṇānilo mataḥ’ iti vacanāt | tatra ṣaḍrasayukto'pi sa āhāro mādhuryaṃ madhurarasabāhulyaṃ phenabhāvaṃ ca labhate prāpnoti kaphasthānagatatvāt, kapho'pi madhura iti prasiddhaḥ; ata evāha tantrāntare - bhuktvādau kaphasya vṛddhiriti rasasādharmyāt asyaivāmājīrṇasaṃjñā, yataḥ ‘mādhuryamannaṃ smṛtamāmasaṃjñam iti || 1 || Gū. yadā śarīrī jātastadā āhārāpekṣā jātā, ata āhārapākakramamāha - yātītyādi | pūrvaṃ prathamataḥ prāṇānileritaḥ prāṇavāyupreritaḥ āhāraḥ coṣmādipañcavidhalakṣaṇaḥ āmāśayaṃ yāti nābhistanāntaramāmāśayaḥ tatra gatvā mādhuryaṃ madhurabhāvaṃ phenabhāvaṃ ca labhate | kiṃbhūtaḥ āhāraḥ ṣaḍrasaḥ | vāgbhaṭe caivaṃ ‘ādau ṣaḍarasamapyannaṃ madhurībhūtamīrayet| phenabhāvaṃ rasaṃ jātaṃ vidāhi hyamlatāṃ gatam’ iti || 1 || atha pācakapattena vidagdhaścāmlatāṃ vrajet | tataḥ samānamarutā grahaṇīmabhinīyate || 2 || Dī. atha sthānāntaraprāptimāha - atha pācaketi | athānantaram sa evāmāśayasthitāhāraḥ pācakapittena pācakāgnitejasā vidagdhaḥ san pacyamānā'bhimukhaḥ sannamlatāṃ vrajet, yato'mlātpittaṃ jāyate tatrāvasthāyāṃ vidagdhājīrṇasaṃjñaṃ gatamamlabhāvamiti | āmāśayāccalito'prāptagrahaṇīpado yadā bhavati tatra sthānāntaraṃ vadantyeke, naivaṃ sarvamataṃ, kintu pācakāgnisthānasamīpavartī yadā bhavati tadā vidagdho bhavatītyeke bhāṣante | svamate tu āmāśayāvasthāyāmeva pittavaidagdhyādamla eva syāt yataḥ pittavidagdhamamlatāmupaiti | idānīṃ tṛtīyāvasthāgatasya kāryamāha - tata ityādi | tatastasmātsthānāt samānamarutā nābhigatavāyunā kṛtvā grahaṇīṃ vahnisthānamabhinīyate prāpyate āhāra iti śeṣaḥ | etat sthānaṃ kalāśabdena vācyaṃ yataḥ ‘ṣaṣṭhī pittadharā nāma yā kalā parikīrtitā | pakvāmāśayamadhyasthā grahaṇī sā prakīrtitā |’ iti | grahaṇyāmapi koṣṭhavahninā kṛtvā pācyate, koṣṭhagrahaṇaṃ dhātvagninirāsārtham | tasmātkaṭuko jāyate iti tātparyārthaḥ | yatkaṭukājjāyate vāyuriti tadviṣṭabdhājī- rṇanāhurityeke | yaduktaṃ ‘kiñcidvipakvaṃ bhṛśatodaśūlaṃ viṣṭabdhamānaddhaviruddhavātam’ iti || 2 || Gū. amlatvaṃ ca prāpnotītyāha -- athetyanantaraṃ pācakapittena vidagdhaḥ amlatāṃ vrajet tataḥ samānamarutā grahaṇī abhinīyate prāpyate | grahaṇī kalā | grahaṇyāṃ kiṃ bhavatītyāha - koṣṭhavahninā yadā grahaṇyāṃ pacyate tadā kaṭurjāyate tadvidho bhavati saṃpakvātsamyak pakvāt rasaḥ bhavati apakvādāmasaṃbhavo bhavatīti yojanā || 2 || (ṣaṣṭhī pittadharā nāma yā kalā parikīrtitā | pakvāmāśayamadhyasthā grahaṇītyabhidhīyate || 3 || grahaṇyāṃ pacyate koṣṭhavahninā jāyate kaṭuḥ | raso bhavati saṃpakvādapakvādāmasaṃbhavaḥ || 4 || vahnerbalena mādhuryaṃ snigdhatāṃ yāti tadrasaḥ | puṣṇāti dhātūnakhilānsamyakpakvo'mṛtopamaḥ ||5|| mandavahnividagdhaśca kaṭuścāmlo bhavedrasaḥ | viṣabhāvaṃ vrajedvāpi kuryādvā rogasaṃkaram || 6 || Dī. atha tādṛśasyāhārasya dvividhāmavasthāṃ vaktumāha - rasa iti | vahnisthāne sthitasyāhārasya samyak pākādraso bhavati | asamyak pākādāmaḥ sambhavati iti | rasa iti samāgniparipācitatvāt sārabhūto yo dravāṃśaḥ sa rasa ityucyate, āmaśca aparipākādbhavati | taduktaṃ ‘jaṭharānaladaurbalyādavipakvastu yo rasaḥ | sa āmasaṃjñako dehe sarvadoṣaprakopakaḥ’ iti | idānīṃ tayo rasāmayorvyāpāraṃ darśayannāha - vahneriti | tadrasa iti pūrvoktaḥ, vahnerbaleneti rasagatā'gniprābalyāt madhuratāṃ snigdhatāṃ ca yāti prāpnoti sapta vākhilān raktādīn dhātūn puṣṇāti tasmāt samyak pakvo rasaḥ amṛtopamaḥ syāt | yathā ‘amṛto jīvano madhurādiguṇayuktaḥ’ iti śrutiḥ | tathāyamapi jīvanadhāraṇatarpaṇādiguṇayukta ityabhiprāyaḥ saumyatvāt | taduktaṃ suśrute - ‘sa khalu dravonusārī snehanajīvanatarpaṇadhāraṇādiviśeṣaiḥ saumya ityavagamyate’ iti | asyaiva svarūpāntaramāha - mandavahnividagdha ityādi | sa eva raso yadā mandavahnividagdho bhavati agnermāndyenāsamyak pakva iti bhāvaḥ, tadā kaṭuramlo vā bhūtvā viṣabhāvaṃ māraṇaṃ māraṇātmakarūpatāṃ vrajet prāpnoti | vā yadi māraṇātmako na bhavati alpatvāttadā rogasaṅkaraṃ rogasastaṃ kuryāt doṣadūṣitatvāt na tu svayameva, yataḥ snehadagdhavyapadeśavat, taduktaṃ ‘rasādistheṣu doṣeṣu vyādhayaḥ saṃbhavanti ye | te jñāyanta ityupacāreṇa tānāhurghṛtadagdhavat’ iti ||3-6|| Gū. punaḥ vahninā pakvaḥ kiṃ bhavatītyāha - punaḥ vahnerbalena pakvaḥ mādhuryaṃ snigdhatāṃ ca yāti, cet samyak pakvaḥ tadā akhilān dhātūn puṣṇāti | mandavahnipakve doṣamāha - viṣabhāvaṃ viṣasvarūpaṃ vrajet viṣūcyādibhirmāraṇātmakatvāt | rogasaṃkaraṃ bahurogasamūhaṃ vā kuryāt || 3-6 || āhārasya rasaḥ sāraḥ sārahīno maladravaḥ | śirābhistajjalaṃ nītaṃ bastau mūtratvamāpnuyāt ||7|| tatkiṭṭaṃ ca malaṃ jñeyaṃ tiṣṭhetpakvāśaye ca tat | valitritayamārgeṇa yātyapānena noditam || 8 || pravāhiṇī sarjanī ca grāhiketi valitrayam | Dī. athāhārasya rasasāratvaṃ nirūpya nirasasya niḥsāratvaṃ darśayannāha - āhārasyeti | āhārasya pūrvapratipāditasya yo raso viditasvarūpaḥ sa sāra ityabhihitaḥ, sāro mukhyatvena tarpaṇādikṛtatvāt sārahīna iti rasarahita āhārasyāṃśo vartate sa maladravasaṃjñaḥ | malaṃ purīṣaṃ dravaṃ mūtraṃ | tayorbhinnagamanasthānaviśeṣamāha - śirābhirityādi | tajjalamiti purīṣaniḥsṛtaṃ dravaviśeṣaṃ śirābhirmūtravāhinībhiḥ kṛtvā bastau mūtrādhāre nītaṃ tadeva mūtrattvamāpnuyāditi bhāvaḥ | tat kiṭṭaṃ malamiti mūtrāvaśiṣṭaṃ malaṃ kiṭṭasaṃjñakaṃ jñeyaṃ nirdravatvāt tacca pakvāśaye tiṣṭhediti tātparyārthaḥ || atha pakvāśayasya sthitasya tādṛśasya tasyādhogamanaśīlatvaṃ darśayannāha - valīti | apānena gudasthitavāyunā noditaṃ preritaṃ malamiti śeṣaḥ, tacca valitritayamārgeṇa kṛtvā yāti bahirniḥsaratītyarthaḥ | valitritayanāmānyāha -pravāhiṇītyādi | pravāhiṇī sarjanīgrāhiketi tāsāṃ nāmabhirevākṛtayo boddhavyā: | valayastu gudasyāvayavabhūtāstāstisro valaya uparyuparivyavasthitāḥ śaṅkhavartanibhā iti || 7 || 8 || Gū. āhārasya kaḥ sāraḥ kiṃ ca malamityāha - āhārasya sārabhūto rasaḥ sārahīno yaḥ sa maladravo bhavati tajjalaṃ śirābhiḥ bastau nītaṃ mūtratvaṃ āpnuyāt tatkiṭṭaṃ malaṃ bhavati | tasya vyavasthāmāha - tatkiṭṭaṃ tasyāhārapakvaṃ yatkiṭṭaṃ tanmalaṃ jñeyam ? tatpakvāśaye tiṣṭhet | tat apānena noditaṃ valitrayamārgeṇa yāti | tasya valitritayasya nāmānyāha - atra pramāṇaṃ noktaṃ tadgranthāntarādviśeṣato likhyate | tadyathā ‘gudasya mānaṃ sarvasya sārdhaṃ syāccaturaṅgulam | tetra syurvalayastisraḥ śaṅkhavartanibhāstu tāḥ || pravāhaṇī bhavet pūrvā sā sārdhāṅgulasaṃmatā | utsarjanī tu tadadhaḥ sāsārdhāṅgulasaṃmitā || tasyā adhaḥ saṃvaraṇī syādekāṅgulasaṃmitā | ardhāṅgulapramāṇaṃ tu budhairgudamukhaṃ matam | malotsargasya mārgo'yaṃ pāyurdehavinirmitaḥ ||7||8|| rasastu hṛdayaṃ yāti samānamaruteritaḥ || 9 || rañjitaḥ pācitastatra pittenāyāti raktatām | raktaṃ sarvaśarīrasthaṃ jīvasyādhāramuttamam || 10 || snigdhaṃ guru calaṃ svādu vidagdhaṃ pittavadbhavet | Dī. idānīṃ maladravaṃ nirūpya sārabhūtasya rasasyāpi kāryatvena sthānāntaraprāptimāha - rasastviti | sa rasaḥ samānamarutā nābhigatavāyunā kṛtvā īritaḥ ūrdhvaṃ prerito hṛdayaṃ yāti prāpnoti, etena kimuktam ? sārabhūto raso grahaṇīsthānāt hṛdayamāgacchatīti bhāvaḥ | sakalaśarīragamanaśīlatvāt | taduktaṃ suśrute - ‘sarvadehānusāritve'pi tasya hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ sa hṛdayāccaturviṃśatidhamanīranupraviśyordhvagā daśa daśa cādhogāminya- ścatasrastiryaggāstāḥ kṛtsnaṃ śarīramaharahastarpayanti, vardhayanti, dhārayanti, yāpayanti, jīvayanti cādṛṣṭahetukena karmaṇā tasya śarīramanudhāvato'numānādgatirupalakṣayitavyā’ iti | hṛdayaśabdopalakṣitamojaḥsthānamucyate | tatra so'pi rasaḥ pittena rañjakapittena kṛtvā pācitaḥ ata eva rañjitaḥ rāgaṃ prāptaḥ san raktatāṃ yāti prāpnoti | yato rasādraktaṃ bhavatīti vacanāt | raktasya bhāvo raktatā | tena ādāvīṣadraktabhāvaṃ prāpya paścātkrameṇa āraktaḥ syāt | taduktaṃ - ‘rasaḥ saptāhādarvāk parivartamānaḥ śvetakapotaharitahāridrapadmakiṃśukālaktakarasaprakhyaścāyaṃ yathākramaṃ divasaparivartādvarṇaparivartamāpadyamānaḥ pittoṣmoparāgāt śoṇitatvamāpadyate’ iti || atha raktaprādhānyaṃ darśayannāha - raktamiti | tadraktaṃ sarvaśarīrasthitaṃ bhavati pāñcabhautikatvāt, yataḥ ‘visratā dravatā rāgaḥ syandanaṃ laghutā tathā | bhūmyādīnāṃ guṇā hyete dṛśyante cātra śoṇite’ iti | jīvasyottamamādhāraśceti dehamūlatvāt | taduktaṃ - dehasya rudhiraṃ mūlaṃ rudhireṇaiva dhāryate | tasmādyatnena saṃrakṣyaṃ raktaṃ jīva iti sthitiḥ iti | punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ tadāha - snigdhamityādi | snigdhamarukṣaṃ, guru alaghu, calaṃ naikatrasthitiśīlaṃ dravatvāt | svādu madhuraṃ svabhāvāt yadā vidagdhaṃ tadā pittavadbhavet iti | yadā vidagdhaṃ pittamapyamlatāṃ vrajet kaṭukaṃ ca bhavet tathedamapīti bhāvaḥ | uktamanyatrā'pi ‘anuṣṇaśītaṃ madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ raktaṃ ca varṇataḥ | śoṇitaṃ guru visraṃ syādvidāhaścāsya pittavat ? iti | kāryatvenā'pi tasya laghutā ca darśitā iti na doṣaḥ || 9 || 10 || Gū. iti pakvo rasaḥ kutra sthitvā raktādīn karotītyāha -- samānamaruteritarasaḥ ādau hṛdayaṃ yāti tatra pittena rañjitaḥ pācitaśca raktatāṃ yāti tatrobhayoḥ sthāne raktasya hṛdayapāke dūṣaṇaprasaṅgāt | tathācoktaṃ suśrute - ‘sa khalvāpyo raso yakṛtplīhānau prāpya rāgamupaitī’tyuktatvāt || 9 || 10 || pācitāḥ pittatāpena rasādyā dhātavaḥ kramāt ||11 || śukratvaṃ yānti māsena tathā strīṇāṃ rajo bhavet | Dī. idānīṃ dhātūnāmutpattiparamparāpūrvakaṃ śukrasyāpi viṣayaṃ darśayannāha - pācitā iti | pittatāpena pittatejasā pācitāḥ paripācitā rasādyā dhātavaḥ krameṇa śukratvaṃ māsena yānti prāpnuvanti | rasādyā ityatra rasagrahaṇāt rasa eva śukratvaṃ prāpnoti | ata eva yātītyekavacanaṃ kṛtam | ādigrahaṇāt raktamāṃsamedomajjāsthīnīti | eke rasādyā dhātavo māsena śukratvaṃ yāntīti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca, teṣāṃ mate tu kāryakāraṇayorabhedopacārāt na kevalaṃ śukratvaṃ strīṇāmapi rajo bhavet | taduktaṃ ‘rasādeva striyā raktaṃ rajaḥsaṃjñaṃ pravartate | tadvarṣādvādaśādūrdhvaṃ yāti pañcāśataḥ kṣayam iti | tatheti grahaṇāt śukratvamapi strīṇāmeva bhavati | yato dṛśyate hi tatsrāvaṇādibhiḥ prayogaiḥ, anyathā tāsāṃ saṃharṣaḥ kathaṃ syāditi | taduktaṃ - saumyaṃ tvagāśrayaṃ svacchaṃ snigdhaṃ yonimukhodgamam | strīṇāṃ śukraṃ na garbhāya bhavedgarbhāya cārtavam’ iti | māseneti | triṃśaddinairiti bhāvaḥ | triṃśaddinavivaraṇaṃ suśrutācāryeṇoktaṃ tadyathā - ‘sa khalu trīṇi trīṇi kalāsahasrāṇi pañca daśa ca kalā ekaikasmin dhātavastiṣṭhante, evaṃ māsena rasaḥ śukrībhavati strīṇāṃ cārtavam’ iti | uktamapi samuccayena darśayati - ‘aṣṭādaśa sahasrāṇi saṃkhyā yasmin samuccaye | kalaikā navatiścoktā svatantraparatantrayoḥ ||’ iti viṃśatikalo muhūrtaḥ kalā daśabhāgaścetyādinā māsasaṃkhyā jñātavyā | etena kimuktaṃ rasaḥ kilaikāhenaiva sampadyate anye ye dhātavaste pañcabhiḥ pañcabhirahobhiḥ sampadyanta iti bhāvaḥ || 11|| Gū. raktaprasaṅgena anyeṣāṃ dhātūnāṃ pakvakramamāha - pittatāpena pācitā rasādyā dhātavaḥ māsena śukratvaṃ yāntīti yojyam | tathā retaḥprakāreṇa strīṇāṃ rajaśca māsena bhavet | viśeṣapākakramastu dhātuvicāraṇe proktaḥ || 11 || kāmānmithunasaṃyoge śuddhaśoṇitaśukrajaḥ ||12|| garbhaḥ saṃjāyate nāryāḥ sa jāto bāla ucyate | ādhikye rajasaḥ kanyā putraḥ śukrādhike bhavet||13|| napuṃsakaṃ samatvena yathecchā pārameśvarī | Dī. garbhotpattimāha - kāmāditi | śuddhaśoṇitaśukrajo garbho nāryāḥ striyāḥ saṃjāyata iti, kutaḥ ? kāmāt, kāmo'bhilāṣaḥ, kva ? mithunasaṃyoge, mithunaṃ dvandraṃ strīpuruṣaviṣayaṃ tasya saṃyogo melanaṃ tasmin sati | śuddhaśoṇitaśukrayorlakṣaṇaṃ ca tantrāntare yathā - ‘śaśāsṛkpratimaṃ yacca yadvā lākṣārasopamam | tadārtavaṃ praśaṃsanti yadvāso na virañjayet || dinatrayaṃ pravṛttiśca kurute śoṇitaṃ striyāḥ | vyavāyasrutaśukreṇa garbhastasyāstato bhavet || tadevā'tiprasaṅgena pravṛttamanṛtāvapi | asṛgdaraṃ vijānīyādatonyaduktalakṣaṇāt’ iti || śuddhaṃ śukraṃ yathā - ‘sphaṭikābhaṃ dravaṃ snigdhaṃ madhuraṃ madhuragandhi ca | śukramicchanti kecittu tailakṣaudranibhaṃ tathā’ iti | ‘vātādidūṣitaṃ pūti kuṇapaṃ granthirūpi ca | kṣīṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣābhyāṃ gandhiśukraṃ tu niṣphalam’ iti | garbha iti | śukraśoṇitaṃ garbhāśayasthamātmaprativikārasaṃmūrcchitaṃ garbha ityucyate | sa jāto bāla ucyate iti | sa garbho yadā jāto bahirniḥsarati tadā bāla ityucyate | bālaśabdaḥ kanyāpuruṣanapuṃsakeṣvapi vartate | ata evāhācāryaḥ - ādhikya iti | tatra ca garbhāśaye yadā rajasa ārtavasya ādhikyaṃ bhavati tadā kanyā jāyate utpadyate ārtavādhikaśukrādityabhiprāyaḥ | yadi śukādhikastarhi putraḥ śukrādhikārtavādityarthaḥ | samatveneti śukraśoṇitayoḥ sāmyena samabhāgena kṛtvā napuṃsakaṃ syāt | yathā pārameśvarīcchāsti tathaiva bhavati nātra vicāraḥ kartavya iti bhāvaḥ | icchetyanenaiva yamalajātamapi sūcitam | tadyathā - ‘bīje'ntarvāyunā bhinne dvau jīvau kukṣimāgatau | yamāvityabhidhīyete dharmetarapuraḥsarau’ iti|| 12 || 13 || Gū. śuddhaśoṇitaśukrādgarbho bhavatītyapi saṃkṣepeṇāha -- yataḥ aśuddhaśukraśoṇitayorapi garbho bhavati ata āha - kāmāditi | śuddhaśoṇitaśukrajaḥ śuddhagarbhaḥ yato vātādiduṣṭaretasaḥ prajotpādane na sāmarthyam iti suśrutaḥ | atra śuddhaprajotpādane na sāmarthyaṃ iti boddhavyam rogādinā aśuddhāstu prajā vātādiduṣṭaśukre'pi janayanti janmāndhabadhirapaṃgvādisaṃbhavāt | idānīṃ rajaḥśukrādhikyena kiṃ bhavatītyāha – rajasaḥ kanyā bhavati adhike śukre vīrye puruṣaḥ bhavet dvayoḥ sāmyena napuṃsakaṃ bhavet ataḥ paraṃ pārameśvarī icchā adṛṣṭasya balavattvāt ||12-13|| bālasya prathame māsi deyā bheṣajaraktikā || 14 || avalehīkṛtaikaiva kṣīrakṣaudrasitāghṛtaiḥ | vardhayettāvadekaikāṃ yāvadbhavati vatsaraḥ ||15|| māṣairvṛddhistadūrdhvaṃ syādyāvatṣoḍaśavatsaraḥ | tataḥ sthirā bhavettāvadyāvadvarṣāṇi saptatiḥ || 16 || tato bālakavanmātrā hāsanīyā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | mātreyaṃ kalkacūrṇānāṃ kaṣāyāṇāṃ caturguṇā || 17 || Dī. idānīṃ bālasya prathamamāsādārabhya bheṣajakriyāṃ darśayannāha - bālasyeti | bālasya prathame māsi bheṣajaraktikā deyā | bālo'tra kṣīrādaḥ yatastrividho bāla āṣoḍaśavarṣādbhavati | tatra kṣīrādaḥ | kṣīrānnādaḥ annāda iti | ata eva kṣīrakṣaudrasitāghṛtairiti bahavo'nupānādayo darśitāḥ yathāsambhavopayogitvena | bheṣajamatra suvarṇarajataśilājatvādikaṃ, raktikā guñjā tatparimāṇamityarthaḥ | prathame māsīti prathamagrahaṇaṃ jātadinamārabhya bheṣajaṃ dadyādityabhiprāyaḥ | tathāca suśrute - ‘atha kumāraṃ śītābhiradbhirāśvāsya jātakarmaṇi kṛte madhusarpiranantacūrṇamiśramaṅgulyanāmikayā lehayet’ iti | anantacūrṇaṃ suvarṇacūrṇaṃ, ‘bheṣajaraktiketi sāmānyabheṣa- jagrahaṇena granthāntaroktamapi yogacatuṣṭayamatra boddhavyam | tadyathā - ‘sauvarṇaṃ sukṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ kuṣṭaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ vacā | matsyākhyakaḥ śaṅkhapuṣpī madhu sarpiḥ sakāñcanam || arkapuṣpī ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ cūrṇitaṃ kanakaṃ vacā | hemacūrṇāni vaidūryai: śvetadūrvā ghṛtaṃ madhu || catvāro'bhihitāḥ prāśāḥ ślokārdheṣu caturṣvapi | kumārāṇāṃ vapurmedhābalabuddhivivardhanāḥ’ iti | eke prāktanāṃ mātrāmanicchatāmāmananti tanmate tu viśvāmitroktā mātrā pracarati | tadyathā - ‘viḍaṅgaphalamātraṃ tu jātamātrasya bheṣajam | etenaiva pramāṇena māsi māsi pravardhitam || kolā'sthimātraṃ kṣīrāde dadyādbhaiṣajyakovidaḥ | kṣīrānnāde kolamātramannāde (u)dumbaropamam’ iti | avalehīkṛtaikaivetyādi | ekaiva raktikā avalehīkṛtā, kaiḥ kṛtvetyāha - kṣīrakṣaudrasitāghṛtairiti | etena kṣīrādibhirvyastairyathāyogyaṃ samplāvyāvacārayedityabhiprāyaḥ | kṣīraṃ strīsambhavam, ājaṃ vā | ghṛtamatra gavyam || atha meṣajasyāsya vṛddhihrāsatvamapyāha - vardhayettāvadekaikāmityādi | sā bheṣajaraktikā tāvadekaikāṃ vardhayedyāvat vatsaro bhavati | etena pratimāsavṛddhāḥ dvādaśamāseṣu dvādaśaiva raktikā bhavantītyaryaḥ | anyadapyāha - tadūrdhvamiti | vatsarādupari tāvanmāṣakairvṛddhiryāvat ṣoḍaśavatsaro bhavati; etena prativarṣavṛdhdyā ṣoḍaśamāṣakā bhavantītyarthaḥ | māṣo'tra māgadhaparibhāṣoktaḥ ṣaḍguñjāparimitaḥ | tata iti ṣoḍaśavarṣādupari tāvat sthirā syādyāvat saptativarṣāṇi bhavanti | sthireti ṣoḍaśamāṣakā na tu vṛddhiḥ | tata iti saptaterūrdhvaṃ saiva mātrā bālavacchanaiḥ śanairhrāsanīyā tena sā mātrā yathaiva pūrvaṃ vardhitā tathaivāpakarṣaṇīyā ityabhiprāyaḥ | ata eva bālavṛddhayoḥ sāmyakriyā kāryeti na tu sarveṣām | kalkacūrṇādīnāmiyameva mātrā sammatā kimutānyā vā tadāha - mātreyamityādi | iyaṃ pūrvoktā mātrā kalkacūrṇānāṃ tadyogānāṃ ca, kaṣāyāṇāṃ caturguṇā vijñeyā | etena kimuktaṃ raktiparimāṇe catvāri raktikāḥ kāryāḥ, māṣakaparimāṇe caturmāṣaka iti || 14-17 || Gū. bālasya bheṣajapramāṇādyuttarāṃ kriyāmāha - bālasya prathame māsi ekaiva bheṣajaraktikā deyā | kiṃbhūtā bheṣajamātrā kṣīrakṣaudrasitāghṛtaiḥ avalehīkṛtā | yāvadvatsaro bhavettāvadekāmekāṃ raktikāṃ māsi māsi vardhayet | vatsarādūrdhvaṃ bheṣajapramāṇamāha - tadūrdhvaṃ vatsarādūrdhvaṃ māṣairvṛddhiḥ syāt yāvatṣoḍaśa vatsaro bhavati tāvat, ṣoḍaśānantaraṃ sthirā mātrā bhavet yāvatsaptati na vardhanamityarthaḥ | vardhanakramamabhidhāya hrāsakramamāha - tato bālakavat ekā raktikādimātrāvat mātrā hrāsanīyā ūnā kartavyā | iyaṃ mātrā kalkacūrṇānāṃ, kaṣāyāṇāṃ etanmātrātaścaturguṇā || 14-17 || añjanaṃ ca tathā lepaḥ snānamabhyaṅgakarma ca | vamanaṃ pratimarśaśca janmaprabhṛti śasyate || 18 || kavalaḥ pañcamādvarṣādaṣṭamānnasyakarma ca | virekaḥ ṣoḍaśādvarṣādviṃśateścaiva maithunam || 19 || Dī. idānīṃ tasya bālakasyāñjanādikaṃ karma nidarśayannāha - añjanamiti | bālakasyāñjanādi pratimarśaparyantaṃ janmaprabhṛtireva praśasyate, janmadinādārabhya yadyatra vihitaṃ tat tatra kuryāditi bhāvaḥ | añjanaṃ sauvīrāñjanādikaṃ, lepamudvartanaprabhṛtikaṃ, snānaṃ pariṣekaḥ, abhyaṅgaṃ abhyañjanam, vamanaṃ vāntiḥ, pratimarśena bṛṃhaṇamiti | aparāṇyāha - kavala ityādi | kavalo gaṇḍūṣabhedaḥ, sa tu pañcamādvarṣādupari kāryo na tu tadarvāk | nasyakarmeti | nāsāyāṃ yaddīyate tannasyamiti, tasya karma kriyā caturthe, taccāṣṭamādvarṣādupari kāryaṃ, ṣoḍaśavarṣādupari vireko deyaḥ, viśeṣeṇa reko vireka ityanena apūrṇavīryasya koṣṭhasya recanasya niṣedhaḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣābhyantare bhavati | na tu mṛdurecanasya niṣedhaḥ | taduktaṃ ‘agnikṣāravirekaistu bālavṛddhau vivarjayet |’ tat sādhyeṣu vikāreṣu ‘mṛdvīṃ kuryāllaghukriyām’ iti | viṃśateścaiva maithunamiti | maithunaṃ strīpuruṣasaṃyogalakṣaṇaṃ tacca viṃśativarṣādupari samānavīryatvaṃ syādityāha | tathāca - ‘pañcaviṃśatitame varṣe pumān nārī tu ṣoḍaśe | samatvāgatavīryau tu jānīyāt kuśalo bhiṣak’ iti || 18 || 19 || Gū. añjanādīnāmapi kartavyatāyāṃ vidhānamāha - etadañjanādyaṃ bālānāṃ janmaprabhṛti śasyate pratimarśo nasyabhedaḥ mṛdu na tu tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇasya aṣṭamā- bdādabhidhānāt | idānīṃ kavalādīnāṃ vidhānamāha - kavalaḥ gaṇḍūṣaḥ, pañcamādvarṣātkartavyaḥ tasya karma aṣṭamātkaryavyaṃ virekaḥ ṣoḍaśādvarṣātkartavyaḥ, maithunaṃ strīprasaṅgaḥ viṃśateḥ kartavyaḥ || 18 || 19 || bālyaṃ vṛddhiśchavirmedhā tvagdṛṣṭiḥ śukravikramau | buddhiḥ karmendriyaṃ ceto jīvitaṃ daśato hraset||20|| Dī. atha bālyaprabhṛtijīvitāvasānaṃ varṣasaṃkhyayā hrāsatvamāha - bālyamiti | tadbālyaprabhṛtikaṃ daśata iti daśavarṣādupari hraset hāniṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ | etena kimuktaṃ bālyāvasthā daśavarṣādupari, vṛddhirvardhanaṃ triṃśadvarṣādupari, śarīraṃ catvāriṃśadvarṣādupari, medhā tu granthākarṣaṇasāmarthyarūpā pañcāśadvarṣādupari, tvak sā śaithilyarūpā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | ṣaṣṭivarṣādupari dṛṣṭiḥ, saptativarṣādupari vikramaṃ tacca sāhasādirūpaṃ parākramasaṃjñam | navativarṣādupari buddhiḥ, śatavarṣādupari karmendriyam, daśādhikaśatavarṣādupari cetaścetanasthānaṃ, viṃśatyadhikaśatavarṣādupari jīvitaṃ prāṇamiti| tena viṃśatyadhikaśataṃ paramāyurmanujānāṃ bhavatīti tātparyārthaḥ | taduktaṃ - ‘samāḥ ṣaṣṭirdvighnā manujakariṇāṃ pañca ca niśā, hayānāṃ dvātriṃśatkharakarabhayoḥ pañcakakṛtiḥ | virūpā satyāyurvṛṣamahiṣayordvādaśa śunaḥ smṛtaṃ chāgādīnāṃ daśakasahitaḥ ṣaṭ ca paramam || 20 || Gū. bālyāvasthādīni kiyatparyantaṃ bhavanti tadapyāha - bālyādikaṃ jīvitāntaṃ daśataḥ hraset hīno bhavet; bālyaṃ daśavarṣaparyantaṃ; vṛddhiḥ viśatiparyantaṃ, chavi: triṃśatparyantaṃ, medhā catvāriṃśatparyantaṃ, tvakdāryaṃ(dārḍhyaṃ) pañcāśatparyantaṃ, dṛṣṭiḥ ṣaṣṭiparyantaṃ hīnā bhavati, śukraṃ saptatiparyantaṃ, vikramaḥ aśītiparyantaṃ, śuddhiḥ navatiparyantaṃ, karmendriyaṃ śataparyantaṃ, ceto manaḥ, smṛtirdaśottaraparyantaṃ, jīvitaṃ jīvitapramāṇaṃ viṃśottaraśataparyantam | [ nanu śārṅgadhareṇa ‘bālyasya prathame māsi deyā bheṣajaraktike’ti janmottarakāle vidhānaṃ likhitaṃ, tatkiṃ asvasthaviṣayaṃ vā svasthaviṣayaṃ vā ? asvasthaviṣayaṃ cettadā bālacikitsāyāmeṣa prasaṅgaḥ syāt, svasthaviṣayaṃ cettadā svasthe rogaṃ vinā auṣadhadānāsaṃbhavādvyarthametadvidhānam ? ucyate, stanyāvataraṇe doṣakopo bhavati tannivāraṇārthaṃ, yadvā prakṛtyārambhakadoṣaduṣṭanivāraṇārthaṃ vā etadvidhānaṃ doṣakopāt | tathāca - sadyaḥprasūtānāṃ kṣīraṃguṇe ’kṣīraṃ sadyaḥprasūtānāṃ virasaṃ doṣakārakam | tasmātsadyaḥprasūtānāṃ jāyate ślaiṣmikaṃ payaḥ iti | ato yaduktaṃ vidhānaṃ tadavaśyamatraivocitam | tathāca suśrute likhitaṃ tasmātprathame'hani madhusarpiranantamiśraṃ mantrapūtastrikālaṃ pāyayet, dvitīye lakṣmaṇāsiddhaṃ sarpiḥ, tṛtīye ca tataḥ prāgnivāritastanyaṃ madhusarpi: svapāṇitalasammitaṃ dvikālaṃ pāyayet | anantaḥ keśarañja(kaṃ) suvarṇaṃ vā | vṛddhavāgbhaṭe tu ‘anantāmiśre madhusarpiṣī ? iti pāṭhaḥ | tatra cānantā dūrvā vyākhyātā, tatra rāktikāmātraṃ deyaṃ | anye ca prayogāḥ - ‘sauvarṇaṃ sukṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ madhughṛte vacā | matsyākṣakaḥ śaṅkhapuṣpī madhusarpiḥ sakāñcanam || arkapuṣpī ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ cūrṇitaṃ kanakaṃ vacā | hemacūrṇāni vaiduryaḥ śvetā dūrvā ghṛtaṃ madhu | catvāro'bhihitāḥ prāśāḥ ślokārdheṣu caturṣvapi | kumārāṇāṃ vapurmedhābalapuṣṭivivardhanāḥ ||’ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvadete yogāḥ sevyāḥ, anye dvādaśavarṣāṇyāhuḥ | suśrutādetat | uktatyauṣadhāni vyākhyāyante | sauvarṇacūrṇaṃ nāgakeśaracūrṇaṃ yadvā kuṃkumacūrṇaṃ, matsyākṣakaḥ macheṃchī, brāhmī ca, arkapuṣpī payasyā yadvā arkapuṣpī īśalatā, śvetā dūrvā, śvetetiviśeṣaṇam, yadvā kecidvacāmāhuḥ, vaiduryaḥ niṃmbaḥ, kanakavācakaṃ sarvatra keśarameva | mātrāpi likhyate ‘viḍaṅgaphalamātraṃ tu jātamātrasya bheṣajam | etenaiva pramāṇena māsimāsi vivardhanam || kolamātraṃ ca kṣīrāderdadyādbhaiṣajyakovidaḥ | kṣīrānnādeḥ kolamātramanne codumbaropamam |’ iti kumārapoṣaṇavidhānam || 20 || alpakeśaḥ kṛśo rūkṣo vācālaścalamānasaḥ | ākāśacārī svapneṣu vātaprakṛtiko naraḥ || 21 || Dī. idānīṃ prakṛtilakṣaṇamāha - alpetyādi | vātaprakṛtiko nara īdṛśo bhavati kīdṛśastamāha - alpakeśa iti | tucchakeśaḥ adīrghakeśa ityanye, yato vātasyātiraukṣyatvena tvakpāruṣyādalpakeśatvam | punaḥ kīdṛśaḥ ? kṛśo durbalaḥ, vātasya śoṣakatvāt rūkṣaguṇatvādasnigdhaḥ, vācāla iti pravacanaśīlaḥ, calamānasa iti cañcalacittaḥ, vātasya calaguṇatvāt svapneṣvapi ākāśacārī bhavatīti yathā vāyurākāśe caratīti svabhāvāt | prakṛtistu svabhāva evetyāhurācāryāḥ, yataḥ - ‘śukraśoṇitasaṃyoge yo bhaveddoṣa utkaṭaḥ | prakṛtirjāyate tena tasyā me lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu’ iti ||21|| Gū. atha prakṛterapi śarīrāṅgatvāt śārīre prakṛtivivaraṇamāha - nanuprakṛtistu pūrvoktā jagatkartrī, ityāśaṃkya kathamatra na punaruktidoṣaḥ, ucyate, iyaṃ tu śarīrasvabhāvalakṣaṇā prakṛtiḥ śukārtavasaṃyoge doṣotkṛṣṭajanyā saptavidhā | tathāca suśrute likhitaṃ - ‘śukaśoṇitasaṃyoge yo bhaveddoṣa utkaṭaḥ| prakṛtirjāyate tena tasyā me lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu ||’ vāgbhaṭe ca ‘śukrāsṛkgarbhiṇībhojyaceṣṭāgarbhāśayārtiṣu | yaḥ syāddoṣo'dhikastena prakṛtiḥ saptadhoditā |’ saptadhā prakṛtirityuktervātaprakṛtimāha - alpakeśa iti | evaṃbhūto naraḥ vātaprakṛtiko bhavatīti yojanā | rūkṣaḥ rūkṣāṅgaḥ, vācālaḥ bahujalpakaḥ, calamānasaḥ calacittaḥ, svapneṣu ākāśacārī ākāśabhramaṇaśīlaḥ, naraśabdo'tra sāmānyamanuṣyavācakaḥ strīpuṃviṣayaḥ | yataḥ strīṇāṃ bhinnā prakṛtirnoktā || 21 || akālapalitairvyāpto dhīmānsvedī ca roṣaṇaḥ | svapneṣu jyotiṣāṃ draṣṭā pittaprakṛtiko naraḥ || 22 || Dī. atha pittaprakṛtimāha - akālapalitairiti | pittaprakṛtiko nara īdṛśo bhavati | kīdṛśastamāha - akālapalitairvyāpta iti | akāle asamaye palitairvārdhakyairvyāptaḥ pittasyoṣmaguṇatvāt | taduktaṃ - ‘krodhaśo- kaśramakṛtaḥ śarīroṣmā śirogataḥ | pittaṃ ca keśān pacati palitaṃ tena jāyate’ iti | punaḥ kīdṛśaḥ ? dhīmān buddhimān sattvaguṇabāhulyāt, svedīti | prasvedayukta:, pittasyoṣmamayatvāt dravaguṇatvācca | roṣaṇa iti | roṣayuktaḥ pittasya tīkṣṇatvāt svapneṣvapi jyotiṣāmagnyādīnāṃ tārakādīnāṃ ca draṣṭā avalokaka: yattatpittamuṣṇamuktaṃ tattadguṇatvāt || 22 || Gū. atha pittaprakṛtimāha - akāleti | evaṃbhūto naraḥ pittaprakṛtiko bhavatīti yojyam | akāle taruṇāvasthāyāṃ palitaiḥ śvetaiḥ, ( vyāptaḥ) dhīrdhāraṇāvatī buddhistadyuktaḥ, svedī prasvedabahulaḥ, roṣaṇaḥ krodhāluḥ, svapneṣu jyotiṣāṃ jyotīrūpāṇām (draṣṭā) || 22 || gambhīrabuddhiḥ sthūlāṅgaḥ snigdhakeśo mahābalaḥ | svapne jalāśayālokī śleṣmaprakṛtiko naraḥ || 23 || jñātavyā miśracihnaiśca dvitridoṣolbaṇā narāḥ | Dī. atha kaphaprakṛtiko nara īdṛśo bhavati, kīdṛśastamāha - gambhīrabuddhiriti | gambhīrabuddhiḥ gambhīrā atalasparśā sarvakāryakṣamā buddhiryasya sa tathā | kaphasya tamoguṇādhikatvāt sthūlāṅga: sthūlaśarīraḥ, medo'dhikatvāt, yataḥ kaphastu medovṛddhermūlameva | snigdhakeśa iti | tasya snehaguṇatvāt, mahābala iti ojasā śarīre karmasāmarthyam, yataḥ dhātūnāṃ yatparaṃ tejastattvojastadeva balamityucyate, ata eva kaphabāhulyācchukraṃ śukrāyattaṃ balamiti vacanam | svapne jalāśayālokīti | jalāśayaṃ nadīnadataḍāgādikaṃ kaphasya saumyaguṇatvāt || idānīṃ dvidoṣajatridoṣajaprakṛterlakṣaṇāni darśayannāha - jñātavyā iti | miśracihnairmilitalakṣaṇaiḥ kṛtvā dvitridoṣolbaṇā narā boddhavyāḥ, tena pūrvoktayordoṣayormilitalakṣaṇairdvidoṣajā prakṛtirjñeyā ityabhiprāyaḥ, trayāṇāṃ doṣāṇāṃ militalakṣaṇaistridoṣajā prakṛtiravagantavyeti bhāvaḥ || 23 || Gū. atha śleṣmaprakṛtimāha -- gambhīrabuddhiriti | evaṃbhūto naraḥ śleṣmaprakṛtiko bhavatītyatrāpi yojanā | kiṃbhūtaḥ ? gambhīrabuddhiḥ gambhīrā acañcalā buddhiryasya, jalāśayā'lokī jalasthāne ālokayatīti saḥ | atha dvidoṣatridoṣaprakṛtimāha -miśradoṣairdvidoṣacihnaiḥ dvandvajāstrayaḥ tridoṣaja ekaḥ, evaṃ saptaprakṛtayaḥ | iti prakṛtibhāgaḥ | vātā- diprakṛtivatsatvādayo'pi sapta prakṛtaya ityeke | tathāca vāgbhaṭe -
