‘śaucāstikyādibhiścaiva guṇairguṇamayīṃ vadet|’ tathāca suśrute - ‘mahatprakṛtayastvanyāstamaḥsatvarajaḥkṛtā: | proktā lakṣaṇataḥ samyak bhiṣak tāśca vibhāvayet || tā āha - ‘sātvikāḥ sapta vikhyātā rājasāḥ ṣaṭ prakīrtitāḥ | tisrastu tāmasāḥ proktāstāsāṃ lakṣaṇamucyate || vāgbhaṭena puna‘rhīnamadhyottamaśreṣṭhanindya’ ityevaṃ bhedabhūtā api uktāḥ | tadyathā - ‘śukrārtavasya janmādau viśeṣeṇa (ca) vikramaḥ | tāśca prakṛtayastisro hīnamadhyottamāḥ pṛthak ||’ samadhātuḥ samastāstu samadhātuḥ samadoṣaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ, dvidoṣajā nindyā: | nanu prakṛtistu rajaḥśukrasaṃyoge doṣādhikyena bhavatīti | atha ca ekā sannipātajā bhavati tebhyo maraṇaṃ kathaṃ na syādityata āha - ‘viṣajāto yathā kīṭo na viṣeṇa vipacyate | tadvatprakṛtayo martyaṃ śaknuvanti na bādhitum || idaṃ tu vāgbhaṭe likhitaṃ, suśrute tu - ‘prakopo vā'nyabhāvo vā kṣayo vā nopajāyate | prakṛtīnāṃ svabhāvo'yaṃ jāyate gurutāyuṣaḥ ||’ iti prakṛtivivaraṇaṃ samāptam || 23 || tamaḥkaphābhyāṃ nidrā syānmūrcchā pittatamobhavā||24|| rajaḥpittānilairbhrāntistandrā śleṣmatamonilaiḥ | Dī. adhunā śarīravicāraprasaṅgena nidrādīnāmapi viśeṣotpattimāha - tama iti | nidrā svapnaḥ sā tamaḥkaphābhyāṃ syāt tamoguṇakaphasaṃsargeṇa bhavatītyarthaḥ | pittatamobhavā mūrcchā, mūrcchā ca rūpādyavijñānaṃ mohasaṃjñakaṃ acetanarūpetyarthaḥ | yadyapi vātādibhistribhirdoṣai: śoṇitena, madyena, viṣeṇa ca mūrcchābhimatā, tathāpi tasyāḥ pittapradhānatvena darśitatvāt | taduktam - ‘vātādibhiḥ śoṇitena madyena ca viṣeṇa ca | ṣaṭsvapyetāsu pittaṃ tu prabhutvenāvatiṣṭhate’ iti | rajaḥpittānilaiḥ kṛtvā bhrāntiḥ bhramaṇaṃ, taduktam - ‘yonāyāsaḥ śramo dehe pravṛddhaḥ śvāsavarjitaḥ | bhramaḥ sa iti vijñeya indriyārthaprabādhakaḥ’ iti | śleṣmatamonilaiḥ kṛtvā tandrā syāt | tandrā nidrābhramaḥ, taduktam, - ‘indriyārtheṣvasamprāptigauravaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ klamaḥ| nidrārtasyeva yasyehā tasya nidrāṃ vinirdiśet’ iti ||24|| Gū. nidrādayo'pi śarīrasambhavā ataḥ śārīraprakaraṇe tamaḥkaphābhyāṃ nidrā syādbhavet | pittatamobhavā mūrcchā syāt| rajaḥpittānilaiḥ bhrāntiḥ syāt | bhrāntirbhramaḥ śleṣmatamonilaistandrā syāditi yojanā | atrānukrameṇāpi nidrālakṣaṇamāha - ‘indriyāṇāṃ ca manaso moho nidrābhidhīyate’ | carake ca ‘yadā tu manasi krānte sarvātmānaḥ kramānvitāḥ | viṣayebhyo nivartante tadā svapiti mānavaḥ ||’ suśrute ca ‘hṛdayaṃ cetanāsthānamuktaṃ suśruta ! dehinām | tamo'bhibhūte tasmiṃstu nidrā viśati dehinam || nidrāhetustamaḥ satvaṃ bodhane heturucyate |’ iti nidrā | mūrcchā rūpādyavijñānam | tathāca tantrāntare - ‘saṃjñopadhāturmūrcchā syānmūrcchitaṃ’….tathā | kaśmalaṃ pralayo mohaḥ, saṃnyāsastu mṛtopamaḥ’ iti mūrcchā | bhrāntirbhramaḥ | tallakṣaṇam bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva viparītapadārthajñānaṃ ca bhramaḥ || atha tandrālakṣaṇaṃ granthāntarāt-‘indriyāṇāṃ ca manaso mohastandreti kathyate’ | suśrute vāgbhaṭe ca tandrālakṣaṇaṃ-‘kapholbaṇo vāyunoddhūto dhamanī saṃnirudhya ca | kuryātsaṃjñāpahā tandrā dāruṇā mohakāriṇī | unmīlitavinirbhugne parivartitatārake | bhavatastatra nayane lulite calapakṣmaṇī | arvāk trirātrātsādhyā sā na sādhyā tu tataḥ param |? iti tandrālakṣaṇam || 24 || glānirojaḥkṣayādduḥkhādajīrṇācca śramādbhavet || 25 || yaḥ sāmarthye'pyanutsāhastadālasyamudīryate | Dī. atha glānimāha - glāniriti | glānistu klamāparaparyāyavācako harṣakṣaya ityarthaḥ | sa ca kāraṇa- catuṣṭayādbhavati, kiṃ tat kāraṇacatuṣṭayam ? ojaḥkṣayādityādi | ojaḥ śukram aśeṣadhātudhāmābhiśabditamoja ityeke, tasya kṣayādbalakṣayāditi spaṣṭārthaḥ | duḥkhāditi | mānasodvegādikarmaṇaḥ | tacca duḥkhaṃ trividhamiti suśrutaḥ, ādhyātmikamādhidaivikamādhibhautikamiti, eṣāṃ vivaraṇaṃ na likhitamatra vistarabhayāt | ajīrṇādityaparipakvānnasvarūpāt | etadapi trividhaṃ caturvidhaṃ vā | trividhamannajaṃ viṣṭabdhādisaṃjñaṃ caturthaṃ rasaśeṣamiti | śramāditi | śarīrāyāsajananakarmaṇaḥ | sa ca vyāyāmāparaparyāyavācakaśabdena kathitaḥ, ‘śarīrāyāsajananaṃ karma vyāyāma ucyate’ iti | glānilakṣaṇaṃ tu prasaṅgāttantrāntarīyoktam - ‘vakre madhuratā tandrā hṛdayodveṣṭanaṃ klamaḥ | na cānnamabhikāṅkṣeta glāniṃ tasya vinirdiśet’ iti | (prasaṅgāt tantrāntarīyoktaṃ klamalakṣaṇaṃ yathā - ‘yo'nāyāsaḥ śramo dehe pravṛddhaḥ śvāsavarjitaḥ | klamaḥ sa iti vijñeya indriyārthaprabādhakaḥ’ iti |) athā'lasyamāha - ya iti | sāmarthye karmaṇi sāmarthye sati yo'nutsāho'praharṣaḥ sa ālasyaśabdena vācyaḥ | lakṣaṇamasyoktaṃ yathā - ‘sukhasparśaprasaṅgitvaṃ duḥkhadveṣaṇalolatā | śaktasya cāpyanutsāhaḥ karmaṇyālasyamucyate’ iti || 25 || Gū. atha glānilakṣaṇamāha -- ojaḥkṣayādyairglānirbhavediti yojanā | glāniśabdastu klamavācakaḥ, ‘klamu glānau’ iti dhātorarthatvāt | tallakṣaṇaṃ yathā - ‘yo jāyate śramo dehe pravṛddhaḥ śvāsavarjitaḥ | klamaḥ sa iti vijñeya indriyārthaprabādhakaḥ’ iti klamaḥ| athālasyalakṣaṇamāha - sāmarthye'pi yaḥ anutsāhaḥ tadālasyaṃ udīryate iti yojyam | ityālasyalakṣaṇam || 25 || caitanyaśithilatvādyaḥ pītvaikaṃ śvāsamudvamet ||26|| vidīrṇavadanaḥ śvāsaṃ jṛmbhā sā kathyate budhaiḥ| udānaprāṇayorūrdhvayogānmaulikaphasnavāt || 27|| śabda: saṃjāyate nasta: kṣutaṃ tatkathyate budhaiḥ | Dī. idānīṃ jṛmbhālakṣaṇamapyāha - caitanyeti | puruṣaścaitanyaśithilatvāt caitanyaśithilībhāvāt caitanyasya jñānalakṣaṇasya śithilībhāvaṃ kiṃcinnyūnatāmanubhūya iva sthitaḥ san vidīrṇavadano vyāttamukho bhūtvā ekaṃ śvāsamūrdhvagataṃ pītvā aparaṃ śvāsamadhogataṃ yaduddharet tyajet sā budhaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ suśrutādibhirjṛmbhā iti kathyate | jumbhākāle udveṣṭanaṃ netrāśrusravaṇaṃ ca boddhavyam, yaduktaṃ suśrutena - ‘pītvaikamanilaṃ śvāsamudveṣṭan vivṛtānanaḥ | yanmuñcati sanetrāmbhaḥ sa jṛmbha iti kīrtitaḥ || cittasya viṣayāntaravyāsaktivinivṛttaye jṛmbhākāle choṭikādānaṃ laukikaṃ siddham, vacanaṃ hi - ‘kṣudutpatanajṛmbhāsu jīvatiṣṭhāṅgulidhvaniḥ’ iti || atha chikkālakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha -udāneti | ya udānaprāṇayorūrdhvayogāt mūrdhni srotaḥpathasthitāt kaphasravācca yaḥ śabdaḥ saṃjāyate utpadyate tena śabdena kṣutaṃ chikkā kathyate budhairiti śeṣaḥ | teneti sthāne nasta iti paṭhantyeke, tatra nasto nāsikātaḥ | anyatrāpyuktaṃ ‘prāṇodānau ca tau syātāṃ mūrdhni srota:pathasthitau | nastaḥ pravartate śabdaḥ kṣutaṃ tadabhinirdiśet iti || 26 || 27 || Gū. atha jṛmbhālakṣaṇam - yaḥ vidīrṇavadanaḥ caitanyaśithilatvāt cetanābhūtā vā dehaceṣṭā tasyāḥ śithilabhāvāt | iti jṛmbhālakṣaṇam | atha kṣullakṣaṇam - maulikaphasravāt udānaprāṇayorūrdhvayogādyaḥ nastaḥ nāsikātaḥ śabdaḥ saṃjāyate tatkṣutaṃ budhaiḥ kathyate iti yojanā | maulikaphasravāt mastakakaphasravāt, udānakaṇṭhastho vāyuḥ tayorūrdhvagamanāt, kṣutamiti chikkāsaṃjñitam | itikṣullakṣaṇam || 26 || 27 || udānakopādāhārasvasthitatvācca yadbhavet ||28|| pavanasyordhvagamanaṃ tamudgāraṃ pracakṣate | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ śārīre āhārādigatiradhyāyaḥ || 6 || Dī. athodgāramāha - udānakopāditi | āhārasvasthitatvācceti āhāro'śanaṃ tasya svasthāne yadā sthitirbhavati tasmādityarthaḥ | pavanasya vāyoryadūrdhvagamanaṃ bhavet tamudgāraṃ pracakṣata iti bhāvaḥ | udānavāyoreva prakopaḥ | prakopādeva tasyaivordhvagamanamityācakṣate | samānavāyorūrdhvagamanamityeke || 28 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ prathamakhaṇḍe āhārādigatirnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || Gū. athodgāralakṣaṇam - udānakopāt pavanasya yadūrdhvagamanaṃ bhavet tamudgāraṃ (pra)cakṣate iti yojanā | kasmādāhārasya susthitatvāt || 28 || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāmāhārādigatiradhyāyaḥ || 6 || Editor's notes 1 ‘caturdhā ṣaḍrasopeto'nekavidhyupayuktakaḥ | dvividhoṣṭavidho bījairāharaḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ iti ‘ka’ pā. | ↩ 2 prakṣiptamidam | ↩ 3 ‘rasaḥ kilaikāhenaiva sampadyate dvitīye varṇābhaḥ pittasthāneṣu tiṣṭhati divase tṛtīye caturthe vā yaḥ pravarṇo bhavet pañcame'hani ṣaṣṭhe vā kiṃśukābhaḥ saptame'hani saṃprāpte śakragopakābhaḥ evaṃ saptāhādrasādraktaṃ bhavati’ pā. | 2 ↩ 4 ‘tasmādrakṣedbhi rudhiraṃ rudhiraṃ jīvamucyate’ iti pāṭhāntaram | ↩ 5 yadyapi koṣṭakāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ 14 ślokasya ṭīkārūpaḥ atastatraiva mudrayitumupayuktastathāpi madṝṣṭamātṛkāṃsvatraiva likhitatvāttathaivehāpi mudritaḥ | ↩ 6 ādhyātmikaṃ dvividhaṃ śārīraṃ mānasaṃ ca | śārīraṃ vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ vaiṣamyanimittaṃ, mānasaṃ - kāmakrodhalobhamohabhayerṣyāviṣādaviṣayā- viśeṣādarśananibandhanam | antaropāyasādhyamidam | bāhyopāyasādhyaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ dvedhā ādhibhautikamādhidaivikaṃ ca | ādhibhautikaṃ - mānuṣapaśupakṣisarīsṛpa- sthāvaranimittam | ādhidaivikaṃ ca yakṣarākṣasavināyakagrahāveśanibandhanam | tadetatpratyātmavedanīyaṃ duḥkhaṃ rajaḥpariṇāmabhedo na śakyate pratyākhyātum || ↩ 7 bandhanīdhṛtaḥ pāṭho nāsti ‘ka’ pustake | ↩ 8 ‘tena’ ka | ↩

title: 7. atha rogagaṇanādhyāyaḥ
text: atha rogagaṇanādhyāyaḥ | rogāṇāṃ gaṇanā pūrvaṃ munibhiryā prakīrtitā | mayātra procyate saiva tadbhedā bahavo matāḥ || 1 || Dī. pūrvamuktaṃ rogāṇāṃ gaṇanā ceti, atastāmapi darśayannāha - rogāṇāmiti | rogāṇāṃ jvarādīnāṃ gaṇanā saṃkhyākaraṇaṃ pūrvamādau(yā) prakīrtitā kathitā muni- bhistraikālikajñānadarśibhiḥ saiva gaṇanā mayā atrāsmin granthe procyate kathyate ācāryeṇeti śeṣaḥ | tadbhedā rogabhedā bahavo matāḥ kathitāḥ, atrāpi munibhiriti śeṣaḥ | rogajñena rogāṇāṃ saṃkhyāmātramatra grāhyaṃ nānyadi- tyabhiprāyaḥ | saṃkhyāmātramapi prayojanārthaṃ nidānādipañcakaṃ rogajñāpakaṃ darśitaṃ tatra samprāptistu kathitā tasyāḥ saṃkhyāparyāyaṃ nāmeti | taduttā ‘saṃkhyāvikalpaprādhānyabalakālaviśeṣataḥ | sā bhidyate yathā'traiva vakṣyante'ṣṭau jvarā iti’ iti nyāyāt saṃkhyāmātramapi nātra nirarthakam || 1 || Gū. atha rogagaṇanā'dhyāyo vyākhyāyate | pūrvaṃ rogāṇāṃ jvarādīnāṃ gaṇanā yā munibhiḥ prakīrtitā kathitā saiva gaṇanā mayā śārṅgadhareṇa procyate | yatastadbhedāstasyā gaṇanāyā bahavaḥ bhedā matāḥ bahumunipraṇītatvāt || 1 || pañcaviṃśatiruddiṣṭā jvarāstadbheda ucyate | pṛthagdoṣaistathā dvandvabhedena trividhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 2 || ekaśca sannipātena tadbhedā bahavo matāḥ | prāyaśaḥ sannipātena pañca syurviṣamajvarāḥ || 3 || santataḥ satataścaiva anyedyuṣkastṛtīyakaḥ | cāturthakaśca pañcaite kīrtitā viṣamajvarāḥ || 4 || tathāgantujvaro'pyekastrayodaśavidho mataḥ | abhicāragrahāveśaśāpairāgantukastridhā || 5 || śramācchedātkṣatāddāhāccaturdhā ghātajo jvaraḥ | kāmādbhīteḥ śuco roṣādviṣādauṣadhagandhataḥ || 6 || abhiṣaṅgajvarāḥ ṣaṭ syurevaṃ jvaraviniścayaḥ | Dī. idānīṃ saṃkhyāmātraṃ prakaṭayannāha - pañcaviṃśatīti | jvarāḥ pañcaviṃśatiruddiṣṭāḥ kathitāḥ | pañcaviṃśatirevātra hetujvareṇaiva darśitāḥ | santāpalakṣaṇo jvara iti | taduktaṃ - ‘krodhātpittamevāgnistadūṣmā jvaraḥ’ iti | ata evāha kaścit ‘dakṣāpamānasaṃkruddho rudraniśvāsasambhavaḥ jvaro'ṣṭadhā pṛthagdvandvasaṃghātā'gantujaḥ smṛtaḥ’ iti | aṣṭaprakārasyaiva pañcaviṃśatibhedā darśitāḥ | atha pañcaviṃśativivaraṇamāha - pṛthagdoṣairityādi | pṛthagdoṣaiḥ kṛtvā trayo bhedāstena vātena pittena kaphene tyarthaḥ | dvandvabhedenāpi trividhaḥ, dvandvabhedena dvidoṣamilitena, tena vātapittābhyāṃ , vātaśleṣmabhyāṃ , śleṣmapittābhyāmiti | eko bhedastu sannipātena militadoṣatrayeṇa bhavati | tadbhedā bahavaḥ smṛtā iti | tasya sannipātasya jvarasya bahavo bhedāstrayodaśavidhā: smṛtā: kathitā:| testu nātra gaṇitā: | yato sannipātajvara eka eva nidānadvāreṇa pūrvācāryairdarśitaḥ bhedāstu doṣāṇāṃ hīnamadhyādhikabhāvena kathitāḥ tathāhi ‘dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇaiḥ ṣaṭ ca hīnamadhyādhikāśca ṣaṭ | samairako vikārāṇāṃ sannipātāstrayodaśa’ iti | pañca viṣamajvarāstu sannipātenaiva syu: | ( te ca) ‘santataḥ satato'nyedyuspṛtīyakacaturthakau’ iti yaduktaṃ - ’jvarāśca viṣamāḥ sarve sannipātasamudbhavāḥ’ iti vacanāt | eke ‘catvāraḥ santataṃ hitvā jñeyāste viṣamajvarāḥ iti vadanti tanmate tu vivāde savistaraṃ tannātra likhitaṃ vistarabhayāt yatastajjñaistajjñātavyameva | āgantuko'pyekaḥ sa ca trayodaśavidho bhinnahetutvāt | tadyathā trayo'bhicārādijanitāḥ, catvāra āghātajāḥ ṣaḍabhiṣaṅgajāśceti | abhicārādīnāmapi vyākhyā likhyate yathā - abhicāro mantrādibhirmāraṇaprayogaḥ | grahāveśo duṣṭagrahāveśaḥ, bhūtādīnāṃ ca sambandhenāveśo vā, śāpo brāhmaṇaguruvṛddhasiddhānāmaniṣṭābhiśapanam | śrama iti | śarīrāyāsajananavyāpāralakṣaṇaṃ karma tadvyāyāma śabdena vācyaṃ, dāho'gnyādisambhavaḥ | kṣataḥ prahāraḥ sa ca loṣṭhaśastralaguḍādijanitaḥ, chedo'straprabhṛtibhiḥ, kāmo'bhilāṣaḥ sa cābhimatakāminyādyaprāptinimittaḥ, bhītirbhayam, sā ca prabhunimittādikā, śuk śokaḥ sa ca dhanabandhunāśādinimittaḥ, roṣaḥ krodhaḥ sa tu parābhidrohādilakṣaṇaḥ, viṣaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamādirūpastajjanita ityarthaḥ| auṣadhagandhata iti | tīvrauṣadhigandhāghrāṇajatvāditi bhāvaḥ | evamityanena prakāreṇa jvaraviniścayaḥ kathitaḥ, jvarāṇāṃ viniścayo jñānaṃ jvarasaṃkhyāyāmeva jñānamityarthaḥ | yataḥ saṃkhyāvikalpetyādinā | nanu kathamādau jvara eva prokto nānye rogāḥ ? satyaṃ - jvarastu sarveṣāṃ pradhānatamaḥ | taduktam - ‘dehendriyamanastāpī sarvarogāgrajo balī | jvaraḥ pradhānaṃ rogāṇāmukto bhagavatā purā’ iti || 2-6 || Gū. tatrādau sarvarogeṣu jvarasyaiva prādhānyājjvarāṇāṃ nāmānyāha - uktāḥ pañcaviṃśatirjvarāsteṣāṃ saṃkhyā kriyate | pṛthagdoṣairvātapittakaphaistrayaḥ, dvandvabhedena dvidvidoṣeṇa trayaḥ, sannipātena ekaḥ, tadbhedāḥ sannipātena bahavaḥ, sandhikādayaḥ ekonapañcāśat vṛddhasuśrutoktabāhulyāt; yadvā ekasminneva sannipāte sarvalakṣaṇāntarbhūtatvānnoktaḥ; mādhavenāpi eka eva sannipātajvaro likhitaḥ | santatādayaḥ pañca viṣamajvarā eka evāgantukajvarastrayodaśavidhaḥ | evaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ | eṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni nidāne vijñeyāni vicārastu madhukośe | nanu suśrutādinidāne'ṣṭavidho jvaraḥ kathitaḥ tathoktaṃ - ‘dakṣāpamānasaṃkruddho rudraniḥśvāsasaṃbhavaḥ | jvaro'ṣṭadhā pṛthak dvandrasaghātāgantukaḥ smṛta’ iti, kathamatra pañcaviṃśatiḥ ? ucyate, aṣṭavidhajvarasyaiva pañcaviśatividho vistāraḥ, pañcavidhaviṣamajvarasya sannipāte'ntarbhūtatvāt | ekavidhasyāgantorapi trayodaśadhā bhinnatvāt || 2-6 || pṛthaktridoṣaiḥ sarvaiśca śokādāmādbhayādapi || 7 || atīsāraḥ saptadhā syādgrahaṇī pañcadhā matā | pṛthagdoṣaiḥ sannipātāttathā cāmena pañcamī || 8 || pravāhikā caturdhā syātpṛthagdoṣaistathāsrataḥ | Dī. idānīmatīsārādīnāṃ rogāṇāṃ bhedān darśayannāha - pṛthagiti | atīva saratītyatīsāro gudena | sa ca sapta prakāro bhavati | tadyathā pṛthagdoṣairityādi | pṛthagdoṣairityanena vātena pittena kaphena trayaḥ, sarvairiti militadoṣatrayeṇaikaḥ, śokāditi iṣṭādiviyoganimittāt, āmādaparipakvarasāt, āmājīrṇādvā, ajīrṇamapakvaṃ ca varṣādinā, bhayādbhīteḥ | nanu mādhavena ṣaḍvidhotīsāro,nigadito yathā - ‘ekaikaśaḥ sarvaśaścāpi doṣaiḥ śokenānyaḥ ṣaṣṭha āmena coktaḥ’ iti tat kathamatra saptavidha iti ?, ucyate, nidānaṃ tu niyatāniyatabhedena dvividhaṃ śokājīrṇādibhyo'pi kadācidatīsāra utpadyate | bhayanidānenāpyāvaśyakamatīsāro bhavatītyadoṣaḥ | yato dṛśyate hi sabhayapuruṣasya tatkṣaṇameva dravasaraṇaṃ gudeneti | tasmādatra niyatahetuko nāma saptamo bhayāt pratipādita ityarthaḥ | iti saptadhā pratipāditaḥ | grahaṇī pañcadhā matetyādi | grahaṇī vahnisthānaṃ tadāśrito doṣa eva saṃgrahaṇīśabdavācyaḥ| kutracidgrahaṇīdoṣa ityupadarśanāt, taduktam - ‘ṣaṣṭhī pittadharā nāma yā kalā parikīrtitā | pakvāmāśayamadhyasthā grahaṇī sā prakīrtitā’ iti | grahaṇādgrahaṇī matetyapi | yataḥ - ‘agnyadhiṣṭhānamannasya grahaṇādgrahaṇī matā’ iti | pañcadhā pañcaprakārā | tathā cāmena pañcamīti | āmena āmavātenetyarthaḥ | pravāhikā caturdhā syādityādi | saśabdaṃ kaṇṭhabalena vāyorapānamārgeṇa bahirniḥsaraṇaṃ pravāhikā | asyāḥ paryāyanāmāni tantrāntarapratipāditāni | yathā kecana visraṃsīti nāmnā kathayanti, eke cāntargranthiriti, ke'pi niścāraṃ, nivāhikāmityapare | caturdheti | vātapittakaphai raktajaśca | asraṃ rudhiram | nanu pravāhikā'tīsārayoḥ ko bhedaḥ yasmāddravasaraṇatvenā- pakvalakṣaṇayogātsādharmyaṃ tat kathaṃ bhedaḥ ? ucyate - nānādravadhātusaraṇamatīsāraḥ | pravāhikāyāṃ tu kevalaṃ kaphasaraṇamayamatra bhedaḥ || 7 || 8 || Gū. athātisārasaṃkhyāmāha - pṛthak tridoṣaiḥ vātapittakaphaiḥ trayaḥ, sarvaiḥ tribhirmilitvā ekaḥ, ekaḥ śokāt, ekaḥ āmāt, evaṃ saptadhāsāraḥ | nanu suśrutādau ṣaḍvidho'tīsāraḥ paṭhitaḥ tatkathaṃ na virodhaḥ tathācoktaṃ ‘saratyatīvātisāraṃ tamāhurvyādhi ghoraṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ taṃ vadanti | bhayajasya suśrute vātikātīsārāvaruddhatvāt ṣaḍvidhaḥ carakamate bhayajasya likhitatvāt, atra saptavidhaḥ kṛtaḥ ato na doṣaḥ | atīva saratītyatīsāra iti niruktiśca || grahaṇīsaṃkhyāmāha - pṛthagdoṣairvātapittakaphaistisraḥ, nnipātādekā, āmena pañcamī, evaṃ pañcadhā nidāne grahaṇī caturdhā likhitā āmajāyā abhāvāt | pravāhikāmāha - pṛthagdoṣaiḥ vātapittakaphaistisrastataḥ sannipātāccaturthī, evaṃ caturdhā pravāhaṇātpravāhikāti sārabhedaḥ || 7 || 8 || ajīrṇaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ viṣṭabdhaṃ vāyunā matam ||9|| pittādvidagdhaṃ vijñeyaṃ kaphenāmaṃ taducyate | viṣājīrṇaṃ rasādekaṃ doṣaiḥ syādalasastridhā || 10|| visūcī trividhā proktā doṣaiḥ sā syātpṛthakpṛthak | daṇḍakālasakaścaika ekaiva syādvilambikā ||11|| Dī. athājīrṇānyāha - ajīrṇamiti | ajīrṇaṃ trividhaṃ proktamiti ajīrṇamityaparipakvānnajanitaṃ trividhamiti vātādibhedena eke ajīrṇaṃ vividhaṃ proktamityapi paṭhanti | tanmataṃ tu mādhavenoktaṃ yathā - ‘āmaṃ vidagdhaṃ viṣṭabdhaṃ kaphapittānilaistribhiḥ | ajīrṇaṃ kecidicchanti caturthaṃ rasaśeṣata: || ajīrṇaṃ pañcamaṃ kecinnirdoṣaṃ dinapāki ca | vadanti ṣaṣṭhaṃ cājīrṇaṃ prākṛtaṃ prativāsaram’ iti | yadrasādekamajīrṇaṃ tadviṣājīrṇamatra pratipāditaṃ viṣavanmāraṇātmakatvāt, rogasaṅkarakaramityanye | nanu āmājīrṇādibhyo rasaśeṣasya ko bhedaḥ ? ucyate-āmāditrayamannajaṃ rasaśeṣastu āhārarasajaḥ | ‘doṣaiḥ syādalasastridhā’ iti | doṣairvātādibhiralasaka iti viṣṭabdhājīrṇādbhavati tasya doṣasthiratvanimittādalasakasaṃjñā | yaduktaṃ - ‘prayāti nordhvaṃ nādhastādāhāro na vipacyate| koṣṭhe sthito'lasībhūtastena cālasakaḥ smṛtaḥ’ iti | nanu viṣṭabdhājīrṇādalasakotpattiḥ viṣṭabdhastu vātenaiva saṃbhavati | yaduktaṃ - ‘ajīrṇamāmaṃ viṣṭabdhaṃ vidagdhaṃ ca yadīritam | visūcyalasakau tasmādbhaveccāpi vilambikā’ iti | kathamalasako vātādibhistribhirdoṣaiḥ syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ - doṣakārye doṣāntaraprakopa eva yathā sāmānyajvaraprakopāt śvāsādyupadravāḥ, athavā - ‘ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvāṇyeva prakopayet’ ityādivacanāt | visūcī trividhā prokteti | doṣairvātapittakaphaiḥ pṛthakpṛthagiti vyastānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ trayo bhedā ityabhiprāyaḥ | sā visūcī tu āmājīrṇādbhavati | viśeṣeṇa sūcībhiriva marmāṇi pīḍayatīti visūcī, taduktam - ‘sūcībhiriva gātrāṇi tudan santiṣṭhate'nilaḥ | yasyājīrṇena sā vaidyairvisūcīti nigadyate’ iti | evaṃ daṇḍakālasakamiti | taccālasakabhedabhinnalakṣaṇatvena pṛthagdarśitam | tadyathā - ‘tiryaggatāstanuṃ doṣā daṇḍavat stambhayanti ye | sa daṇḍālasakastyājyaḥ śīghraṃ dehavināśakṛt’ iti | vilambikāpyekā sāvidagdhājīrṇaprabhavā kathitā iyamapi tridoṣajanitetyuktatvāt | yathā ‘duṣṭaṃ tu bhuktaṃ kaphamārutābhyāṃ pravartate nordhvamadhaśca yasyām | vilambikāṃ tāṃ bhṛśaduścikitsyāmācakṣate śāstravidaḥ purāṇāḥ’ iti | nanu vilambikālasakayorapi vātakaphaprabalayorūrdhvādhopravartanaśīlayostulyatvāt ko bhedaḥ ? ucyate, alasake tīvrāḥ śūlādayo bhavanti, vilambikāyāṃ na bhavantīti bhedaḥ || 9-11 || Gū. ajīrṇamāha - viṣṭabdhaṃ vāyunā pittena vidagdhaṃ kaphenāmaṃ evaṃ trividhamajīrṇaṃ proktam | nidānamate tu ṣaḍvidhamajīrṇaṃ rasaśeṣadinapākādinā | athālasakavisūcīdaṇḍakavilambikānāṃ saṃkhyāmāha - alaso roga: sarvājīrṇabhedaḥ alasākhyaḥ, viṣājīrṇarasāt tridhā syāt | kairdoṣairvātapittakaphairviṣarūpaṃ yadajīrṇaṃ tasmādviṣabhāvaṃ vrajedvāpīti rasapāke uktatvāt | evaṃ visūcī tridhā proktā daṇḍakālasakaṃ ekaikaprakāraṃ tathā ekaprakārā vilambikā tridoṣajanyatvāt || 9-11 || arśāṃsi ṣaḍvidhānyāhurvātapittakaphāsrataḥ | sannipātācca saṃsargātteṣāṃ bhedo dvidhā mataḥ || 12|| sahajottarajanmabhyāṃ tathā śuṣkārdrabhedataḥ | tridhaiva carmakīlāni vātātpittātkaphādapi ||13|| Dī. arśāṃsīti | arivat prāṇān śṛṇanti hiṃsanti ityarśāṃsi apāne māṃsāṅkurarūpāṇītyarthaḥ | ṣaḍvidhānīti | doṣabhedena, tatrāsrato rudhirāt, yadyapi tantrāntare dvandvajāni prakṛtisamasamavāyārabdhatvāt pṛthak na gaṇitāni tathāpi doṣadvayasya nidānamelake lakṣaṇamelake ca dvandvolbaṇāni dvandvajāni pratipāditāni | taduktaṃ -‘hetulakṣaṇasaṃsargādvidyādvandvolbaṇāni ca | sarvo hetustridoṣāṇāṃ sahajairlakṣaṇaiḥ samam’ iti | dvandvolbaṇamityanena sarveṣāmarśasāṃ tridoṣajatvādadhikena tu vyapadeśa iti darśitam | yadāha carakaḥ - ‘arśāṃsi khalu jāyante na sannipatitaistribhiḥ | doṣairdoṣaviśeṣastu viśeṣaḥ kathyate'rśasām’ iti | dvandvajānāmatraikabhedo jātyaikavacanatvāt | teṣāṃ bhedo dvidhā mata iti | teṣāṃ ṣaḍvidhānāṃ dvidheti sahajottarajanmabhyāṃ sūcitaḥ, saha śarīreṇa jātāni gudavalyārambhakavīryabhāgasya doṣadūṣitatvāt kulajānāmityarthaḥ | uttarajanmeti janmottarasaṃbandhīnyarśāṃsi mithyā'hāravihārābhyāmudgatairdoṣarbhavantītyuttarajanmānītyarthaḥ | mādhavena tu sahajārśaḥ ṣaḍvidhasaṃkhyāyāṃ paṭhitameva, tadāha - ‘pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastaistu śoṇitāt sahajāni ca | arśāṃsi ṣaṭprakārāṇi vidyādgudavalitraye’ iti | sahajārśato bhinnalakṣaṇoktatvāt prasaṅgato'pi sahajārśasāṃ lakṣaṇānyāha suśrutaḥ - ‘durdarśanāni paruṣāṇi pāṇḍūni dāruṇānyantarmukhāni ca tairupadrutaḥ kṛśo'lpabhuk śirāsantatagātro'lpaprajaḥ kṣīṇaretāḥ kṣāmasvaraḥ krodhako'lpāgnirghrāṇaśiro'kṣiśravaṇarogī satatamantrakūjāṭopahṛdayopalepāsekaprasṛtibhiḥ pīḍyate’ iti sahajānāṃ lakṣaṇam | śeṣāṇi tūttarajanmaśabdavācyāni na kevalaṃ sahajottarajanyabhyāṃ dvidhā, kintu śuṣkārdrabhedato dvidhā bhavanti tena tu gudāṅkurā eke śuṣkāḥ srāvarahitā bhavanti atyanilatvāt, eke ārdrāḥ srāvayuktāḥ pittaraktāti- prakopatvāt | tridhaiva carmakīlānīti | gudauṣṭhaṃ parityajya kīlasadṛśamarśaḥ kuryāt, tatkīlakamiti tatrā- rśasāmevāsaṃbhavatvādasau bhedaḥ | taduktaṃ - ‘vyāno gṛhītvā śleṣmāṇaṃ karotyarśastvaco bahiḥ | kīlopamaṃ sthirakharaṃ carmakīlaṃ tu tadviduḥ’ ityatrā'pi tvaco bahirityanena gudoṣṭhaṃ vyajyata iti vyākhyānayanti | tadgudoṣṭhaṃ kiyatparimāṇamiti vivakṣāyāṃ suśrutaḥ - ardhapañcāṅgulaparimāṇaṃ gudamiti tasyāvayavabhūtāstisro valaya uparyupari vyavasthitāḥ śaṅkhāvartanibhāḥ pravāhaṇī visarjanī saṃvaraṇī ceti | tatra gudoṣṭhaṃ ardhāṅgulaṃ sārdhayavam, sārdhaikāṅgulīpramāṇā prathamāvalī | ditīyā sārdhaikāṅgulā tṛtīyā'pi sārdhaikāṅgulī evamardhapañcāṅgulamiti | bhoje'pyuktam-‘romāntebhyo yavādardhaṃ gudoṣṭhaṃ paricakṣate | gudoṣṭhādaṅgulaṃ caiva prathamāṃ tāṃ valiṃ viduḥ || sārdhaikāṅgulamānena anye ca parikīrtite ||’ iti || 12-13 || Gū. athārśorogagaṇanā - vātādeḥ ṣaḍvidhānyarśāṃsyāhuḥ | munaya iti śeṣa | vātātpittātkaphādasraṃ raktaṃ tasmātsannipātāt saṃsargādvidoṣasaṃbandhaḥ tasmāt evaṃ ṣaṭ | nanu suśrute tu ṣaṭ saṃsargajāni proktāni bhinnānyeva prakṛtisamavetatvāt pṛthag noktāni | tathācoktaṃ suśrute - ‘arśaḥsu dṛśyate rūpaṃ yadā vai doṣayordvayoḥ | saṃsargatvaṃ vijānīyātsaṃsargaḥ ṣaḍvidhaśca sa’ iti | ucyate - atra saṃsargajāni madhye gaṇitāni sarujāni janmottarāṇi śuṣkārdrāṇi ca carmakīlaṃ ca etānyarśobhedāni bhinnāni bhavanti | tānyāha - sahajottaraṃ janmānantaraṃ tathā śuṣkārdrabhedataḥ teṣāṃ bhedastu dvidhā smṛtaḥ kathitaḥ | dehena sahajātaṃ sahajamucyate | uttarajanma uttaraṃ paścājjanma yasya taduttarajanma janmānantaraṃ jātamityarthaḥ | carmakīlānyapi tadbhedajātibhinnāni bhavanti tāni vātāt pittāt kaphādevaṃvidhāni bhavanti | nanvarśaḥ kimātmakaṃ kiṃsvarūpaṃ bhavatītyāha - arivat śṛṇoti hinastītyarthaḥ | pṛṣodarāditvānniruktiḥ | taduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ’arivatprāṇino māṃsakīlane niviśaṃti yat | arśāṃsi tasmāducyante gudamārganirodhataḥ |’ mādhavanidāne ca - ‘doṣastvaṅmāṃsamedāṃsi saṃdūṣya vividhākṛtīn | māṃsāṅkurā apānādau kurvantyarśāṃsi tāñjaguḥ’ ityarśogaṇanā || 12-13 || evaṃ viṃśatibhedena kṛmayaḥ syurdvidhā ca te | bāhyāstathābhyantarāḥ syusteṣu yūkā bahiścarāḥ ||14|| likṣāścānye'ntaracarāḥ kaphātte hṛdayodakāḥ | antrādā udarāveṣṭāścyuravaśca mahāguhāḥ || 15 || sugandhā darbhakusumāstathā raktāśca mātaraḥ | saurasā lomavidhvaṃsā romadvīpā udumbarāḥ || 16|| keśādāśca tathaivānye śakṛjjātā makerukā: | lelihāśca salūnāśca sausurādāḥ kakerukāḥ || 17 || tathānyaḥ kapharaktābhyāṃ saṃjātaḥ snāyukaḥ smṛtaḥ | vraṇasya kṛmayaścānye viṣamā bāhyayonayaḥ || 18|| Dī. ekaviṃśatiṃbhedeneti | kṛmayastu ekaviṃśatibhedena vikhyātāḥ, te tu bāhyābhyāntarabhedena dvidhā bhavanti | teṣu yūkā bahiścarā iti | teṣu kṛmisamūheṣu yūkā likṣāśca bahiścarā bāhyā bahiḥśarīre jātāḥ | anye avaśiṣṭāstu antaracarā jñātavyā iti śeṣaḥ | antaraṃ koṣṭheṣu carantīti | te cāṣṭādaśaprakārā bhavanti | tadyathā -hṛdayodakādidarbhakusumāntāḥ | saptakaphāditi | kaphaprāyadoṣajāḥ, eteṣāṃ svarūpamapi tantrāntare coktaṃ -‘pṛthubradhnanibhāḥ kecitkecidgaṇḍūpadopamāḥ | rūḍhadhānyāṅkurākārāstanudīrghāstathā'ṇavaḥ || śvetāstāmrāvabhāsāśca nāmataḥ saptadhā tu te’ iti | tathā raktācceti ṣaṭkṛmayo bhavanti, te ca mātaraprabhṛtikeśādaparyantāḥ, ākārādapyete yathā - ‘raktavāhiśirāsthānaraktajā jantavo'ṇavaḥ | apādā vṛttatāmrāśca saukṣmyāt kecidadarśanā:’ ityete ṣaḍbhedāḥ kuṣṭhaikakārakā vijñeyāḥ | tathā'nye pañca kṛmayaḥ śakṛjjātā bhavanti, śakṛt purīṣaṃ, taduktam - ‘pakvāśaye purīṣotthā jāyante'dho visarpiṇaḥ’ iti | te tu makerukādikakerukāntāḥ pañca svarūpato yathā - ‘pṛthuvṛttatanusthūlā: śyāmapītasitā'sitāḥ’ iti | ityevamekaviṃśatikṛmayo vyākhyātāḥ | nanu mādhavena viṃśatikṛmibhedā darśitāḥ, ‘nāmato viṃśatividhā’ ityādivacanāt, tatkathamatraikaviṃśatirnigadyate ? ucyate, mādhavena tu bāhyagatāḥ kṛmayo dvibhedāḥ kathitāḥ, tadyathā - ‘tilapramāṇasaṃsthānavarṇāḥ keśāmbarāśrayāḥ | bahupādāśca sūkṣmāśca yūkā likhyāśca nāmataḥ | dvidhā te koṭhapiḍakākaṇḍūgaṇḍān prakurvate’ iti, atra tu viṃśatiriti saṃjñāvarṇabhedāt sthānabhedācca pṛthaṅna gaṇitā iti na doṣaḥ | anyaḥ snāyukasaṃjñaḥ kṛmireva sa tu kapharaktābhyāṃ saṃjātaḥ | nanu yadyevaṃ tarhi dvāviṃśatikṛmayaḥ kathaṃ na gaṇitāḥ ? satyam - ayamapi kaphajeṣu saptasu kṛmiṣu ye dīrghāsteṣāṃ bheda eva | ata eva kapharaktābhyāṃ saṃjāyata ityuktam | yataḥ, ‘kaphādāmāśaye jātā vṛddhāḥ sarpanti sarvataḥ’ ityādivacanāt snāyukarūḍhitvenā'tra bhinnacikitsārthadarśanācca pṛthak gaṇita iti na doṣaḥ. || 14-18 || Gū. atha kṛmigaṇanāmāha - bāhyābhyantarabhedataḥ dvāviṃśatiprakāreṇa uktāḥ kṛmayaḥ dvidhā bhavanti | te bāhyā dvau, ābhyantarāḥ pañca | tathānyaḥ kapharaktābhyāṃ saṃjātaḥ snāyukaḥ anye vraṇakṛmayaḥ, etau dvau bhedau evaṃ dvāviṃśatiḥ | nanu suśrute tu kṛmayo viṃśatividhā uktāḥ | tathāca suśrute - ‘kṛmayastu dvidhā proktā bāhyābhyantarabhedataḥ | vahnirmalakaphāsṛgviḍjanmabhedāccaturvidhāḥ | nāmato viṃśatividhā bāhyāstatra malodbhavāḥ’ iti kathaṃ atra dvāviṃśati: ? ucyate, kṛmayastu viṃśatividhā eva | atha ca snāyukaiḥ vraṇakṛmibhirmilitvā dvāviṃśatiḥ, te suśrutādau bhinnā uktāḥ ato na doṣaḥ | kṛmijanito rogaḥ kṛmiroga iti niruktiḥ tathāca kṛmijātalakṣaṇam || 14-18 || pāṇḍurogāśca pañca syurvātapittakaphaistridhā | tridoṣairmṛttikābhiśca tathaikā kāmalā smṛtā ||19|| syātkumbhakāmalā caikā tathaikaṃ ca halīmakam | Dī. pāṇḍurogāśceti | pāṇḍurvarṇatvenopalakṣito rogaḥ pāṇḍuroga iti rūḍhiḥ | pañca syuriti pañcaprakārā bhavantītyarthaḥ | te ke vātapittakaphaiḥ kṛtvā vyastāstrayo bhedāḥ, tridoṣairiti militadoṣatrayeṇaiko bhedaḥ | mṛtti- kābhiriti mṛdbhakṣaṇādekaḥ, evaṃ pañca prakārāḥ pāṇḍurogabhedā boddhavyāḥ | mṛttikābhiriti bahuvacanatvena bahavo mṛttikādoṣaprakopaviśeṣeṇa darśitāḥ, tathāhi - ‘mṛttikādanaśīlasya kupyatyanyatamo malaḥ | kaṣāyā mārutaṃ pittamūṣarā madhurā kapham | kopayenmṛdrasādīṃśca raukṣyādbhuktaṃ ca raukṣayet’ iti | prasaṅgato'pi tatsvarūpaṃ suśrutoktamāha - ‘yā pītavarṇā madhurā kaṣāyā kṛṣṇā madhukṣāraguṇopapannā | raktā ca tiktā kaṭukā ca nīlā sitā ca mādhuryaguṇā sahā syāt’ ityuktatvāt| tathaikā kāmalā matetyupekṣitātpāṇḍurogata eva kāmalā bhavati | taduktam -‘pāṇḍurogī ca yo'tyarthaṃ pittalāni niṣevate | tasya pittamasṛṅmāṃsaṃ dagdhvā rogāya kalpate’ iti | rogāya kāmalāsvarūpāyetyabhiprāyaḥ | tasmāt kumbhakāmalā caiketi kumbhakāmalā'pyekā bhavati | kāmalāyā avasthāntaraṃ kumbhakāmaletyucyate, yataḥ - ‘kālāntarāt kharībhūtā kṛcchrā syāt kumbhakāmalā’ ityādivacanāt | ekaṃ halīmakamiti tadapi pāṇḍurogāvasthāyāmeva bhavati | taduktam - ‘yadā tu pāṇḍorvarṇaḥ syāddharitaḥ śyāvapītakaḥ | halīmakaṃ tadā tasya vidyādanilapittataḥ’ iti || 19 || Gū. atha pāṇḍukāmalāhalīmakasaṃkhyāmāha - vātapittakaphaistridoṣairmṛttikābhiśca evaṃ pāṇḍurogāḥ pañca syu: bhaveyuḥ | pāṇḍutvacopalakṣitā rogāḥ pāṇḍurogā iti niruktiḥ | kāmalā ekā ekaprakārā sā pittajanyā, kumbhakāmalā ca ekaprakārā pittajanyā | halīmakaṃ ca ekaṃ ekaprakāraṃ tat anilapittataḥ, ete rogāḥ pāṇḍubhedāḥ || 19 || raktapittaṃ tridhā proktamūrdhvagaṃ kaphasaṃbhavam ||20|| adhogaṃ mārutaṃ jñeyaṃ taddvayena dvimārgagam | Dī. raktapittamiti | raktaṃ ca pittaṃ ceti suśrutaḥ | carake tu rāgaprāptaṃ pittaṃ raktapittamityucyate | yaduktaṃ ‘raktasya pittamākhyātaṃ raktapittaṃ manīṣibhiḥ’ iti | ubhayatrāpi na kaściddoṣaḥ | ūrdhvagamiti nāsāsyakarṇākṣirandhreṣu | adhogamiti meḍhrayonigudamārgeṣu | taddvayena dvimārgamiti | taddvayena kaphavātābhyāṃ, dvimārgagamityūrdhvādhaḥpravartanāt | eke taddvayena vimārgagamiti paṭhanti tatra romakūpeṣvapi tat pravartata iti vyākhyānayanti | taduktam - ‘kupitaṃ romakūpeṣu samastaistatpravartate’ iti || 20 || Gū. atha raktapittasaṃkhyā - ūrdhvādhaḥ mukhanāsāgudadrāvi pravṛttaṃ raktaṃ raktapittamucyate | tattrividhaṃ, ūrdhvagaṃ kaphajaṃ, adhogaṃ mārutānugaṃ, vātena janitaṃ dvimārgagaṃ, dvayena kaphavātenetyarthaḥ || 20 || kāsāḥ pañca samuddiṣṭāste trayastu tribhirmalaiḥ ||21|| uraḥkṣatāñcaturthaḥ syātkṣayāddhātośca pañcamaḥ | Dī. kāsā iti | kasanaṃ kāsaḥ | ‘bhinnasvaraḥ kāsati śuṣkameva’ iti suśrutavacanāt | tathāhi - ‘prāṇo hyudānānugataḥ praduṣṭaḥ saṃbhinnakāṃsyasvanatulyaghoṣaḥ | nireti vakrāt sahasā sa doṣo manīṣibhiḥ kāsa iti pradiṣṭaḥ’ iti | pañceti pañca prakārāḥ te ke prakārā ityata āha - te trayastu tribhirmalairiti | te kāsāḥ tribhirmalaistribhirdoṣaistraya eva kathitāḥ | uraḥkṣatāccaturthaḥ syāditi urasi prahāramiva vedanāviśeṣāduraḥkṣatakāsasaṃjñāḥ, tathāhyuktam - ‘ativyavāyamallādhvayuddhāśvagajanigrahaiḥ | rūkṣasyoraḥkṣataṃ vāyugṛhītvā kāsamāvahet | sa pūrvaṃ kāsate śuṣkaṃ tataḥ ṣṭhīvet saśoṇitam | kaṇṭhena rujatā'tyarthaṃ vibhinnenaiva corasā’ iti | kṣayāddhātośca pañcama iti | dhātavo rasādyāḥ, teṣā kṣayānnāśāt | eke dhātorityekavacanatvena śukrakṣayāditi vyākhyānayanti, tatra pratilomānulomena dhātukṣaya ukta iti na doṣaḥ | taduktam - ‘ativyavāyino vāpi kṣīṇe retasyanantarāḥ | kṣīyante dhātavaḥ sarve tataḥ śuṣyati mānavaḥ’ ityādidarśanāt || 21 || Gū. atha kāsasaṃkhyā - samuddiṣṭāḥ kāsāḥ pañcaviṃśatistānāha - kāsā iti| tribhirmalairdoṣaistrayaḥ, uraḥkṣatāccaturthaḥ, dhāto rasādidhātoḥ kṣayātpañcamaḥ evaṃ pañca kāsāḥ | kasanaṃ kāsa iti nirukti: | kasa gatiśāsanayoriti dhātvarthāt athavā bhagnakāṃsyapātrasvana: kāsa iti || 21 || kṣayāḥ pañcaiva vijñeyāstribhirdoṣaistrayaśca te || 22 || caturthaḥ sannipātena pañcamaḥ syāduraḥkṣatāt | śoṣā: syu: ṣaṭprakāreṇa strīprasaṅgācchuco vraṇāt || 23 || adhvaśramācca vyāyāmādvārdhakyādapi jāyate | Dī. kṣayā iti | upekṣitakāsāt kṣayo bhavatīti | eke ‘kāsāt saṃjāyate kṣayaḥ’ ityuktatvāt kadācit kṣayatvena tu niyatameva | kṣayo'pi rājayakṣmasaṃjñaḥ kathyate | taduktaṃ - ‘rājñaścandramaso yasmādabhūdeṣaḥ kilāmayaḥ | tasmāttaṃ rājayakṣmeti kecidāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ’ iti | pañcamaḥ syāduraḥkṣatāditi | uraḥkṣato rogaviśeṣaḥ sarvatra pratipāditatvāt | śoṣā: syu: ṣaṭprakāreṇeti ‘śoṣo'pi kṣayabhedaḥ syā’diti vacanāt | yataḥ ‘śoṣaṇācca rasādīnāṃ śoṣa ityucyate budhaiḥ| kriyākṣayakaratvācca kṣaya ityabhidhīyate’ iti | ṣaṭprakārā yathā - strīprasaṅgādīti | strīniṣevaṇāt | ayaṃ vyavāyaśoṣī kathitaḥ | śucaḥ śokāt, ayaṃ śokaśoṣī | vraṇāditi śarīrā'gantuvraṇaviśeṣāt | yataḥ ‘raktakṣayādvedanābhistathaivāhārayantraṇāt | vraṇinaśca bhavecchoṣaḥ sa cāsādhyatamo mataḥ’ | adhvaśramāditi | atimārgagamanajanitaśramācca ayamadhvaśoṣī | vyāyāmāditi śarīrāyāsajananakarmasvarūpāt | nanu vyāyāmādhvaśramayorāyāsajananasādharmyāt ko bhedaḥ ? ucyate, vyāyāmo yadākasmādevā'tikriyate tadaiva bhavati | mārgagamanaśīlatvādevādhvaśoṣaḥ syāt | taduktam ‘adhvaśoṣī ca srastāṅgaḥ saṃmṛṣṭaparuṣacchaviḥ’ ityadoṣaḥ | vārdhakyāditi jarābhivyāptaśarīratvāt, ayaṃ jarāśoṣī kathitaḥ | taduktam - ‘jarāśoṣī kṛśo mandavīrya- buddhibalendriyaḥ’ ityādi || 92 || 23 || Gū. atha kṣayasaṃkhyāmāha - nanu suśrute tridoṣeṇa eka eva kṣayaḥ proktaḥ tatkatham ? tathācoktaṃ ‘tridoṣo jāyate yakṣmagade eva catuṣṭayāt’| ucyate udrekātpañcavidhatvam | tathācoktaṃ suśrute ‘eka eva mataḥ śoṣaḥ sannipātātmako gadaḥ | udrekāttasya liṅgāni doṣāṇāṃ nipatanti hi’ iti, ato na doṣaḥ | kṣīyate aneneti kṣaya iti tasya niruktiḥ, tathācoktaṃ saṃśoṣaṇāditi śoṣa ityabhidhīyate kriyākṣayakāritvāt kṣaya ityucyate budhaiḥ | rājayakṣmā śoṣaśca tadbhedau | yakṣmaṇāṃ rājā rājayakṣmā yadvā candramaso jātatvāt rājayakṣmeti niruktiḥ | śoṣamāha - śoṣāḥ ṣaṭ prakārāḥ syuḥ strīprasaṃgādekaḥ, vraṇādekaḥ, adhvā mārgastacchramastasmādekaḥ, vyāyāmo bhallādiyuddhaṃ tasmādekaḥ, vṛddhabhāvādekaḥ, evaṃ ṣaṭ śoṣāḥ | rasādiśoṣaṇāt śoṣāḥ pañca kṣayāḥ ṣaṭ śoṣāḥ evaṃ kovidā ekādaśā āhuḥ || 22|| 23 || śvāsāśca pañca vijñeyāḥ kṣudraḥ syāttamakastathā || 24 || ūrdhvaśvāso mahāśvāsaśchinnaśvāsaśca pañcamaḥ | Dī. śvāsāśceti | śvāsa iti vegavadūrdhvavātatvam | yataḥ ‘śvāsaśca bastikādhmānaṃ samavātordhvagāmitā’ iti | pañceti pañcaprakārāḥ, te ke prakārā ityāha - kṣudra ityādi | duḥkhenāṅgaprabādhako'lpavātajanitaḥ kṣudraśvāsasaṃjñaḥ | pratilomena vāyunā grīvāṃ śiraśca saṃgṛhya tīvravegaṃ karoti sa ca tamasi nimagna iva tiṣṭhati tena tamakaśvāsa iti saṃjñaḥ | yo dīrghaṃ śvasiti ūrdhvadṛṣṭiṃ ca karoti itastato vibhrāntanetra: sa ūrdhvaśvāsārditaḥ kathitaḥ | yaḥ śabdavān duḥkhitaḥ uccaiḥ śvasiti pranaṣṭajñānavijñāno viśīrṇavāk sa mahāśvāsapīḍito'bhihitaḥ | yo vicchinnaṃ śvasiti sarvaprāṇena pīḍita ānāhasvedamūrcchārtaḥ sa chinnaśvāsārdita iti || 24 || Gū. śvāsasaṃkhyāmāha kathitāḥ pañca hikkāstu tāstu kṣudrā'nnajastathā ||25|| gambhīrā yamalā caiva mahatī pañcamī smṛtā | Dī. hikkāmāha - kathitā iti | tvaritaṃ prāṇaharatvena hikkā kathitāḥ | taduktam - ‘kāmaṃ prāṇaharā rogā bahavo na tu te tathā | yathā śvāsaśca hikkā ca harataḥ prāṇamāśu ca’ iti | hikkāsvarūpaṃ tu ghoṣavattvena pratipāditaṃ | yataḥ - ‘muhurmṛhurvāyurudeti sasvano yakṛtplīhāntrāṇi mukhādivākṣipan | sa ghoṣavānāśu hinasti yasmāt tatastu hikketyabhidhīyate budhaiḥ’ iti| pañceti pañcaprakārā:, tān prakārān āha - kṣudreti | yā mandavegaiḥ - kṛtvā jatrumūlādeva pradhāvati sā kṣudrā nāma hikkā kathitā | yāmatiprayuktapānānnaiḥ pīḍito vāyurūrdhvamāgatya hikkayati tāmannajāṃ vidyāt | yā ghorā gambhīranādinī nābhiprabhavā sā gambhīrā jñeyā | yā cireṇa yamalairvegaiḥ kṛtvā pravartate śirogrīvāṃ ca kampamati sā yamalā nāma kathitā | yā satataṃ marmāṇyutpīḍayantīva sarvagātraprakampiṇīva sā mahatī nāma hikkā kathitā || 95 || Gū. atha hikkāsaṃkhyā kathiteti sugamam | hinasti prāṇāniti hikkā || 25 || catvāro'gnervikārāḥ syurviṣamo vātasaṃbhavaḥ || 26 || tīkṣṇaḥ pittātkaphānmando bhasyako vātapittayoḥ | Dī. catvāra iti | agniścātra jaṭharāgniḥ, tajjanito vikāraścātra kupitadoṣavācyaḥ | ata eva samāgnigrahaṇaṃ nātra kṛtaṃ doṣasāmyatvāt, yataḥ ‘samāgni: śreṣṭha ucyate’ iti vacanāt | ke te catvāra ityāha - viṣama ityādi | yo bhuktamannaṃ kadācinna pacati kadācidāśveva pacati sa viṣamaḥ yo mātrā'timātramapyannaṃ sukhaṃ pacati sa tīkṣṇaḥ, ya: svalpamapyannaṃ na pacati sa manda iti) bhasmakastu tīvrāgnisaṃjñaḥ sa ca vātapittajanitaḥ | taduktam - ‘atipravṛddhaḥ pavanānvito'gniḥ kṣaṇādrasaṃ śoṣayati prasahya | bhuktaṃ kṣaṇādbhasma karoti yasmāttasmādayaṃ bhasmakasaṃjñakastu ? | iti || 26 || Gū. athāgnivikārasaṃkhyā - viṣamādayaścatvāro'gnervikārāḥ syu: | nanu nidāne samena saha catvāro'gnervikārāḥ bhasmako bhinna uktaḥ tadatra na doṣaḥ samasya vikārābhāvāt || 26 || pañcaivārocakā jñeyā vātapittakaphaistridhā || 27 || sannipātānmanastāpāt - Dī. pañcaiveti | arocakāstu paryāyanāmabhireva tridhā kathitāḥ, tadyathā satyāmapi bubhukṣāyāmabhyava hārāsāmarthyamatyaruciḥ, abhilaṣitamapyannaṃ dīyamānaṃ nābhyavaharatītyanannābhinandanam; annasya śravaṇasmaraṇa- darśanasparśanairyatrodvijate sa bhaktadveṣaḥ; evaṃ trividho'pi rogaścarakasuśrutābhyāmarocakaśabdena saṃgṛhītaḥ | vṛddhabhojena saṃjñāntarāṇyapi darśitāni | kāni tānyāha - ‘prakṣiptaṃ ca mukhe cānnaṃ janturna svadate muhu: | arocaka: sa vijñeyo bhaktadveṣamatho śṛṇu | cintayitvā tu manasā dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca bhojanam | dveṣamāyāti yo janturbhaktadveṣaḥ sa ucyate || yasya nānne bhavet śraddhā so'bhaktacchanda ucyate | kupitasya bhayārtasya yasya bhakta nirodhaja:’ || 27 || Gū. athārocakasaṃkhyā - manastāpāt śokādermanovikārāt arocako jihvānayanasaṃśritairdoṣairjanyate bībhatsādibhiḥ || 27 || chardayaḥ saptadhā matāḥ | tribhirdoṣaiḥ pṛthaktisra kṛmibhiḥ sannipātataḥ || 28|| ghṛṇayā ca tathā strīṇāṃ garbhādhānācca jāyate | Dī. chardimāha -- chardaya iti | chardirvamanaviśeṣaḥ | vegai: kṛtvā ānanaṃ chādayatīti chardiḥ | taduktam - ‘chādayannānanaṃ vegairardayannaṅgabhañjanaiḥ | nirucyate chardiriti doṣo vakraṃ pradhāvitaḥ’ iti | kṛmibhiriti kṛmirogajanitā, tathācoktam - ‘śūlahṛllāsabahulā kṛmijā ca | viśeṣataḥ | kṛmihṛdrogatulyena lakṣaṇena ca lakṣitā’ iti | sannipātata iti militadoṣatrayāt | ghṛṇayā ceti ghṛṇayā kṛtvā chardirbhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ; ghṛṇā ca pūtyamedhyādigandhāsvādanairutpadyate | ghṛṇayā ceti cakārādbībhatsādyavalokanācca bhavatīti kecit | taduktaṃ - ‘bībhatsairhetubhiścānnairdrutamutkleśito balāt’ iti | tathā strīṇāṃ garbhādhānācca jāyate iti gṛhītagarbhāyāḥ striyaśchardirbhavatīti | yataḥ - ‘nāryāścāpannasattvāyāstathā'tidrutamaśnataḥ’ ityādivacanāt || 28 || Gū. atha chardisaṃkhyā tāḥ sapta bhavantītyāha - pṛthagdoṣairiti sugamam || 28 || svarabhedāḥ ṣaḍeva syurvātapittakaphaistrayaḥ || 29 || medasā sannipātena kṣayātṣaṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | Dī. svarabhedā iti | prakṛtirūpasya svarasyānyathābhāvaḥ svarabhedaḥ; sa ca ṣaḍvidho bhavati, vātādīnāṃ vyastāstrayo bhedāḥ, sannipātena militadoṣatrayeṇa caikaḥ, medasā medovṛddheścaiko bhedaḥ, kṣayāt kṣayarogādekaḥ, dhātukṣayādveti kecit || 29 || Gū. atha svarabhedānāha tṛṣṇā ca ṣaḍvidhā proktā vātātpittātkaphādapi || 30 || tridoṣairupasargeṇa kṣayāddhātośca ṣaṣṭhikā | Dī. tṛṣṇeti | tṛṣṇā pānīyasyābhilāṣaḥ | taduktam - ‘satataṃ yaḥ pibedvāri na tṛptimadhigacchati | punaḥ kāṅkṣati yastoyaṃ taṃ tṛṣṇārditamādiśet’ iti | tridoṣairiti melitadauṣatrayeṇa | upasargaścāgantuka:, sa ca kṣatādiśabdavācyaḥ| tena janitā upasargikā | kṣayāddhātoriti rasādidhātukṣayāt | cakārāt saptamī tu bhuktodbhavā iti manyante kecit | yaduktaṃ -‘snigdhaṃ tathoṣṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca bhuktaṃ gurvannamevāśu tṛṣāṃ karoti’ | apare tvāmasaṃbhavāṃ vadanti| sā doṣajāntargateti manyamānena śārṅgadhareṇa nātra svīkṛtā iti || 30 || Gū. tṛṣṇāmāha - nanu nidānena sapta tṛṣṇāḥ proktāḥ atra ṣaṭ, tatkathaṃ taduktaṃ ‘doṣaiśca tisraḥ kṣatajā caturthī kṣayāttathā- nyāmasamudbhavā ca | bhuktodbhavā saptamiketi tāsāṃ nibodhaliṅgānyanupūrvaśastu | srotaḥsvapāṃvāhiṣu dūṣiteṣu doṣaiśca tṛṭ saṃbhavatīha jantoḥ’, iti ? | ucyate āmajānidāne atra tridoṣajā liṅgasamudbhavā ca ityuktatvātsaṃsargajākṣatajā caivaṃ ṣaṭ | bhuktodbhavā na vikārajā ato noktā || 30 || mūrcchā caturvidhā jñeyā vātapittakaphaiḥ pṛthak ||31|| caturthī sannipātena tathaikaśca bhramaḥ smṛtaḥ | nidrā tandrā ca saṃnyāso glāniścaikaikaśaḥ smṛtāḥ||32 || Dī. mūrccheti | mūrcchā mohasaṃjñā vikhyātā, yataḥ ‘moho mūrccheti tāmāhuḥ’ ityādi vacanāt | sā caturvidhā catuḥprakārā doṣabhedena bhavati | eko bhramaḥ smṛta iti | bhramastu rajaḥpittānilādbhavati sa tu cakrārūḍhasyevārthasaṃvittiḥ | nidrādayaścatvāra ekaikaśaḥ gaṇitāḥ | nidreti svapanam, tathāhi - ‘yadā tu manasi klānte karmātmānaḥ kramānvitāḥ | viṣayebhyo nivartante tadā svapati mānavaḥ? iti | tandrā'pi nidrābhedaḥ, kathaṃ bhinnatvena paṭhyate ? ucyate - nidrāyāmindriyamanomohaḥ, tandrāyāmindriyamoha ityatra bhedaḥ | taduktam -‘indriyārtheṣvasaṃprāptirgauravaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ klamaḥ | nidrārtasyeva yasyehā tasya tandrāṃ vinirdiśet’ iti | saṃnyāsa iti | sa mūrcchādibhyo bhinna eva, yataḥ ‘vāgdehamanasāṃ ceṣṭāmākṣipanti balānmalāḥ | saṃnyasyantyabalaṃ jantuṃ prāṇāyatanamāśritāḥ || sa nā saṃnyāsasaṃnyastaḥ kāṣṭhībhūto mṛtopamaḥ | prāṇairvimucyate śīghraṃ tyaktvā sadyaḥphalāṃ kriyām ||’ iti | glāniriti klamāparaparyāyasaṃjñā | yaduktaṃ - ‘yo'nāyāsaśramo dehe hṛdayodveṣṭanaṃ klamaḥ | na cānnamabhikāṅkṣeta glāniṃ tasya vinirdiśet’ iti | | sa ca hetucatuṣṭayādbhavati | ‘glānirojaḥkṣayādduḥkhādajīrṇācca śramādbhavet’ ityādivacanāt | nanu mādhavena mūrcchā ṣaḍvidhā svīkṛtā yathā - ‘vātādibhiḥ śoṇitena madyena ca viṣeṇa ca | ṣaṭsvapyetāsu pittaṃ tu prabhutvenāvatiṣṭhate’ iti | tatkathamatra caturvidhā ? satyam, pittaprabhutvena śoṇitasya pittakāryatvāt madyaviṣayośca pittakopatvācca pittasambhavāyāmatra śoṇitādīnāṃ mūrcchā jñātavyeti na doṣaḥ | yataḥ - ‘mūrcchā pittatamaḥprāyā’ ityādivacanāt || 31 || 32 || Gū. atha mūrcchāsaṃkhyā - nidāne ṣaḍvidhā mūrcchā vātapittakaphaistisraḥ, śoṇitena madyena viṣeṇa ceti | kathaṃ sannipātajā noktā ? ucyate, suśrutādau tridoṣajā doṣajāntarbhāvātsaṃkhyāyāṃ noktā | agre likhitā tadyathā - ‘sarvākṛtiḥ sanni- pātādapasmāra ivāgatā | sā jantuṃ pātayatyāśu vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitaiḥ’ iti | śoṇitamadyaviṣajā yo doṣaje- ṣvevāntarbhāvātsaṃkhyātirekaḥ cikitsāmedārthabhinna uktaḥ bhramaḥ ekaprakāraḥ raktapittānilādbhrama iti bhramalakṣaṇairapi tribhirebhiḥ eka eva ca bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva viparītapadārthajñānaṃ vā bhrama iti bhramalakṣaṇam | nidrātandrā- glānisaṃnyāsasaṃkhyāmāha - ete ekaikaprakārāḥ | yeṣāṃ niruktistu śārīre uktā || 31 || 32 || madāḥ sapta samākhyātā vātapittakaphaistrayaḥ | tridoṣairasṛjā madyādviṣādapi ca saptama: || 33 || madātyayaścaturdhā syādvātātpittātkaphādapi | tridoṣairapi vijñeya ekaḥ paramadastathā || 34 || pānājīrṇaṃ tathā caikaṃ tathaikaḥ pānavibhramaḥ | pānātyayastathā caiko - Dī. madā iti | cittavismṛtilakṣaṇo madaḥ yathā pūgaduṣṭakodravabhakṣaṇādau citte'navasthitistadvadvidyāditi | tridoṣairmilitadoṣatrayaiḥ, asṛjo'tirudhirakopāt | kopo'sya pittavat | eke asṛjo'sṛgdarāditi vyākhyānayanti | yataḥ - ‘asṛgdaro bhavet sarvaḥ sāṅgamardaḥ savedanaḥ | tasyātivṛttau daurbalyaṃ śramo mūrcchā madastṛṣā’ iti | madyāditi madyapānāt, āsavāriṣṭādīnāṃ pānena madyābhisaṃjño mada ityabhiprāyaḥ| viṣāditi viṣabhakṣaṇāt sarpādiviṣākrāntādityapi| madātyaya ityādi | yathoktavidhiviparyayeṇa sevyamānaṃ madyaṃ vikārāya bhavati sa vikāro madātyayaśabdena vācyaḥ | yataḥ - ‘ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktāste madye'pi pratiṣṭhitāḥ | tena mithyopayuktena bhavatyugro madātyayaḥ’ iti | tridoṣairiti militadoṣatrayeṇa | ekaḥ paramadastatheti | paramadādayaścatvāro madātyayabhedā uktābhinnalakṣaṇāntaratvāt | tathaiveti grahaṇena doṣatrayamedabhinnā ete'pi boddhavyāḥ | lakṣaṇānyapi yathā ‘śleṣmocchrayo'ṅgagurutā virasāsyatā ca viṇmūtraśaktiratha tandrirarocakaśca | liṅgaṃ parasya tu madasya vadanti tajjñāstaṣṇā rujā śirasi sandhiṣu cāpi bhedaḥ || ādhmānamugramatha codgiraṇaṃ vidāhaḥ pāne tvajīrṇamupagacchati lakṣaṇāni | hṛdgātratodakaphasaṃśravakaṇṭhadhūmā mūrcchāvamijvaraśirorujanapradāhāḥ | dveṣaḥ surānnavikṛteṣu ca teṣu teṣu taṃ pānavibhramamuśantyakhilena dhīrāḥ | hīnottarauṣṭhamatiśītamamandadāhaṃ tailaprabhāsyamatipānahataṃ tyajettu’ iti || 33 || 34 || Gū. atha madasaṃkhyā - sugamam | madapūgakodrava iva dhatūrabhakṣaṇena rogaviśeṣaḥ pānātyayaḥ ekaḥ ekaprakāraḥ madātyayaḥ paramadapānāt jīrṇapānavibhramasaṃkhyāmāha | spaṣṭametat || 33 || 34 || dāhā: sapta matāstathā || 35 || raktapittāttathā raktāttṛṣṇāyāḥ pittatastathā | dhātukṣayānmarmaghātādraktapūrṇodarādapi || 36 || Dī. dāhā iti | dahyate iti dāhaḥ, yataḥ ‘tvacaṃ prāptaḥ sapānoṣmā pittaraktābhimūrcchitaḥ | dāhaṃ prakurute ghoraṃ pittavattatra bheṣajam’ iti | tathā raktādityudriktaśoṇitāt | tṛṣṇāyā iti tṛṣṇānirodhādabdhātau kṣīṇe sati tejaḥ samuddhataṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | pittata iti vikṛtapittāt pittajvarasamo dāho bhavatīti | dhātukṣayāditi rasādidhātūnāṃ kṣīṇatvādatīva dāho bhavati | marmaghātāditi marmābhighātājjanito'pi dāho bhavati | raktapūrṇodarāditi | raktena udarapūrṇatvāddāho bhavati | dāhena pīḍitajihvā nikṛṣṭaṃ vepate iti lakṣaṇoktatvāt || 35 || 36 || Gū. dāhasaṃkhyāmāha unmādāḥ ṣaṭ samākhyātāstribhirdoṣaistrayaśca te | sannipātādviṣājjñeyaḥ ṣaṣṭho duḥkhena cetasaḥ || 37 || bhūtonmādā viṃśatiḥ syuste devāddānavādapi | gandharvātkiṃnarādyakṣātpitṛbhyo guruśāpataḥ || 38 || pretācca guhyakādvṛddhātsiddhādbhūtātpiśācataḥ | jalādhidevatāyāśca nāgādvai brahmarākṣasāt || 39 || rākṣasādapi kūṣmāṇḍākūtyāvetālayorapi | Dī. unmādā iti | dhīvibhramasaṃjño vātādinā janitaḥ unmāda iti prasiddhaḥ; taduktaṃ ‘madayantyudgatā doṣā yasmādunmārgamāsthitāḥ | mānaso'yamato vyādhirunmāda iti kīrtitaḥ’ iti | viṣāditi viṣabhakṣaṇā- dyabhivyāptaśarīratvāt | ṣaṣṭho duḥkhena cetasa iti | duḥkhaṃ tu trividham ādhyātmikam, ādhibhautikam, ādhidaivikamiti | nanu taddu:khasaṃyogādvyādhaya ityucyante tatkathaṃ bhūtonmādāḥ kathitāḥ ? duḥkhenaiveti prāptārthatvāt, satyam, duḥkhajanakā anye'pi bhāvāḥ santi yathā dhanabandhunāśādayaḥ, yaduktaṃ -‘caurairnarendrapuruṣairaribhistathānyairvitrāsitasya dhanabāndhavasaṃkṣayādvā | gāḍhaṃ kṣate manasi ca priyayā risaṃsorjāyeta cotkaṭataro manaso vikāraḥ iti | etadabhiprāyeṇa syādadoṣaḥ | bhūtonmādā viṃśatiriti | tadviṃśatervivaraṇamāha - te dānāddānavādapītyādi | dāno devagrahastena gaṇamātrikādayo'pi grāhyāḥ, dānavā asurāḥ pāpabuddhayo devaśatrava ityarthaḥ, gandharvo devagāyakaḥ, kinnarastadbhedā vikhyātāḥ yakṣadhanadādayaḥ, pitaro'gniṣvāttādayaḥ, guravo brāhmaṇā vṛddhādayaḥ, pretāḥ prasiddhāḥ, guhyakā devayonayaḥ, siddhāḥ sanakādayaḥ, bhūtā vikhyātāḥ, piśācāḥ piśitāśanāḥ, jalādidevatāḥ pratītāḥ, nāgāḥ śeṣanāmaprabhṛtayaḥ, brahmarākṣasāḥ rākṣasabhedāḥ, rākṣasā rāvaṇādayaḥ,kūṣmāṇḍo'pi rākṣasabhedaḥ, kṛtyā prasiddhā sā ca mantrādimāraṇātmakarūpā, vetālāśca devayonayaḥ iti | ete grahāstu yadā śarīraṃ praviśanti tadā bhūtonmādā iti saṃjñāyā'bhihitāḥ bhūtaceṣṭākaratvenādṛṣṭatvāt | taduktaṃ - ‘darpaṇādīn yathā chāyā śītoṣṇaṃ prāṇino yathā | svamaṇiṃ bhāskarāṃśuśca yathā dehaṃ ca dehadhṛk | viśanti ye na dṛśyante grahāstadvaccharīriṇām’ iti || 37-39 || Gū. athonmādasaṃkhyā - cetasaḥ manasaḥ duḥkhena kopādinā spaṣṭamanyat || atha bhūtonmādasaṃkhyā - devādiviṃśatirbhūtonmādāḥ dve syuḥ vāgbhaṭe aṣṭādaśabhūtonmādā likhitāḥ | atra anyamatattvādadhike | madayati mano vibhramaṃ karotītyunmādaḥ sa ca doṣajaḥ | yastu bhūtādisambandhādbhavati sa bhūtonmādaḥ | idaṃ lakṣaṇam || 37-39 || apasmāraścaturdhā syātsamīrātpittatastathā || 40 || śleṣmaṇo'pi tṛtīyaḥ syāccaturtha: sannipātataḥ | Dī. apasmāra iti | hatasmṛteḥ puruṣasya tamaḥ - praveśa iva yaḥ saṃrambhaḥ ya cāpasmāra ityabhihitaḥ, tathācoktam -‘tama: praveśaḥ saṃrambho doṣodrekahatasmṛteḥ | apasmāra iti jñeyo gado ghoraścaturvidhaḥ’ iti | caturdhā syāditi | atra samīrāditi anilakopāt, sannipātata iti militadoṣatrayāt ||40|| Gū. athāpasmārasaṃkhyā -- samīrāditaścaturdhā'pasmāraḥ syāt | samīro vāyuḥ | apagataṃ smaraṇaṃ yasmāt sa apasmāraḥ phenavāṃ- śchvāsavāṃśceti tallakṣaṇam || 40|| catvāraścāmavātāḥ syurvātapittakaphaisridhā || 41|| caturthaḥ sannipātena Dī. catvāraścāmavātā iti | āmena duṣṭo vāta āmavātaḥ, yadvā āmasaṃpṛkto duṣṭo vāta āmavātaḥ iti tadvayamasaṅgataṃ kāraṇatvāt kintu duṣṭāmavātayoḥ saṃyogaścāmavāta iti kathita: | yaduktaṃ ‘yugapat kupitāvetau trikasandhipraveśakau | stabdhaṃ vā kurute gātramāmavātaḥ sa ucyate’ iti | eke dvandvajabhedān kathayanti | yataḥ ‘ekadoṣānugaḥ sādhyo dvidoṣo yāpya ucyate | sarvadehacaraḥ śothaḥ sa kṛcchraḥ sānnipātika:’ ityādivacanāt || 41 || Gū. athāmavātasaṃkhyā - vātādibhiścatvāra āmavātāḥ syuḥ | spaṣṭamanyat | āmena yukto vāta āmavātaḥ sa tu śothā- diyuktastrikasandhivedanāvān || 41 || śūlānyaṣṭau budhā jaguḥ | pṛthagdoṣaistridhā dvandvabhedena vividhānyapi || 42 || āmena saptamaṃ proktaṃ sannipātena cāṣṭamam |pariṇāmabhavaṃ śūlamaṣṭadhā parikīrtitam || 43 || malairyai: śūlasaṃkhyā syāttaireva pariṇāmajam | annadravabhavaṃ śūlaṃ jaratpittabhavaṃ tathā || 44 || ekaikaṃ gaṇitaṃ sujñai: Dī. śūlānīti | śūlanirghātavedanājanakatvācchūlasaṃjñā; yataḥ ‘śaṃkusphoṭanavat tasya yasmāt tīvrā ca vedanā | śūlāsaktasya bhavati tasmācchūlamihocyate’ iti | dvandvabhedena dvidoṣajanitenātra trayo bhedāḥ, āmenāparipakvarasena vātakāraṇatvāt yataḥ ‘sarveṣveteṣu śūleṣu prāyeṇa pavanaḥ prabhuḥ’ iti || 42 || dī.- pariṇāmabhavaṃ śūlamiti | pariṇāmakālasambandhi pariṇāmaśūlaṃ taccoktaśūlasaṃkhyākaireva boddhavyam | saṃjñāntarairapyetadeva darśitam | tadyathā - ‘bhukte jīryati yacchūlaṃ tadeva pariṇāmajam | kecidannadravaṃ prāhuranye tat paktidoṣajam || paktiśūlaṃ vadantyeke kecidannavidāhajam’ iti | evaṃ cānnadravabhavaṃ śūlamatra pṛthag gaṇitaṃ lakṣaṇāntarabalāt | taduktaṃ - ‘jīrṇe jīryatyajīrṇe vā yacchūlamupajāyate | pathyāpathyaprayogeṇa bhojanābhojanena vā || na śamaṃ yāti niyamāt so'nnadrava udāhṛtaḥ ||’ iti | piṣṭākṛtirdravarūpo yo mūtramārgeṇa stravet so'nnadravasaṃjña iti kecit | tanna sarvamatam | jaratpittabhavaṃ śūlamiti jaratpittamamlapittam | amlaśūlamityanye || 43 || 44 || Gū. atha śūlasaṃkhyā - gū.- pṛthagdoṣairityādibhiḥ śūlamaṣṭadhā mataṃ evamevāṣṭadhā pariṇāmabhavam atra upadravaṃ jvarapittam (śūlam) ekadhā ekamekaprakāraṃ matam | ete sarvaśūlabhedāḥ | śūlanipātavadvedanāviśeṣāt śūlamucyate ||43||4-8|| udāvartāstrayodaśa | ekaḥ kṣunnigrahātproktastṛṣṇārodhāddvitīyakaḥ || 45 || nidrāghātātṛtīyaḥ syāccaturthaḥ śvāsanigrahāt | chardirodhātpañcamaḥ syātṣaṣṭhaḥ kṣavathunigrahāt ||46|| jṛmbhārodhātsaptamaḥ syādudgāragrahato'ṣṭamaḥ | navamaḥ syādaśrurodhāddaśamaḥ śukradhāraṇāt || 47 || mūtrarodhānmalasyāpi rodhādvātavinigrahāt | udāvartāstrayaścaite ghoropadravakārakāḥ || 48 || Dī. udāvartā iti | udbhūtena vegavidhāraṇenāvṛtasya vāyorvartanamityudāvartaḥ | athavā vāyorūrdhvamāvarto gamanami- tyudāvartaḥ | yataḥ sarveṣu vāyureva kāraṇam | taduktam - ‘sarveṣveteṣu vidhivadudāvarteṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ | vāyoḥ kriyā vidhātavyā svamārgapratipattaye’ iti | trayodaśavidhānāṃ vivaraṇamāha - ekaḥ kṣunnigrahādityādi | kṣud bhojanecchā tasyā nigraho dhāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ tṛṣṇā pānīyasyābhilāṣaḥ, nidrā svaprecchā, śvāsaḥ ucchvāsaḥ, chardirvamanaṃ, kṣavathuśchikkā, jṛmbhā jṛmbhaṇaṃ prasiddham, udgāro vātodgiraṇam, aśru netrāmbusaṃjñaṃ, śukraṃ retaḥ, mūtraṃ prasiddhaṃ, malaṃ purīṣaṃ, vātavinigrahāditi adhovātarodhāt | evaṃ trayodaśa vyākhyātāḥ | eteṣāṃ madhye ye mūtravinigrahādayaste ghoropadravakārakā jñātavyā: | ghoropadravakārakā ityanena māraṇātmakarūpā ityabhiprāyaḥ | nanu caturdaśavidhā udāvartā anyatra pratipāditāḥ | tathāhi - ‘vegānna dhārayedvātaviṇmūtrakṣavatṛṭkṣudhām | nidrākāsaśramaśvāsajṛmbhāśrucchardiretasām’ ityādinā tatkathamatra trayodaśa bhedāḥ? ucyate śrameṇa śvāsa utpadyate tasya dhāraṇamiti vyākhyāyāḥ śvāsāntargata eva śramabhedo'tra darśitaḥ | udgārasthāne kāsa iti kecit vātakāraṇatvāditi || 45-48 || Gū. udāvartasaṃkhyāmāha - udāvartāstrayodaśa iti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | te kṣunnigrahādayaḥ, spaṣṭamanyat | ut ūrdhvam āvartayatītyudāvarta iti niruktiḥ || 45-48 || ānāho dvividho jñeya ekaḥ pakvāśayodbhavaḥ | āmāśayodbhavaścānyaḥ pratyānāhaḥ sa kathyate || 49 || Dī. ānāha iti | ānāha udarapūraṇalakṣaṇaḥ sa ca vātotkaṭadoṣairjanitaḥ āmāśayodbhavatvāt na svatantreṇa vāyunā, anyathā pratyānāhe tṛṣṇāpratiśyāyaśirovidāhādayaḥ kathaṃ saṃbhavanti | tathācoktaṃ ‘tasmin bhavantyāmasamudbhave tu tṛṣṇāpratiśyāyaśirovidāhāḥ | āmāśaye śūlamadhogurutvaṃ hṛtstambha udgāravighātanaṃ ca’ iti vadanti | ‘ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvāneva prakopayet’ ityabhiprāyeṇa vātakopena pittakaphāvapi prakupitau bhavata iti|| 49 || Gū. athānāhasaṃkhyā - ānāhādhmānabhedaḥ sa dvividhaḥ vikāra: ||49|| urograhastathā caiko - Dī. urograha iti | urogṛhītamiva manyate, tat kaphamārutādbhavati, tathāhi - ‘sāsraṃ māṃsaṃ yakṛtplīhoḥ sadyo vṛddhaṃ yadā gatau | urograhaṃ tadā kukṣau kuruta: kaphamārutau’ iti || 49 || Gū. urograhaḥ hṛdrogasaṃkhyāta urograhaḥ bhinno rogaḥ sa ekaḥ ekaprakāraḥ vātakaphajanyaḥ vāgbhaṭoktatvāt tadyathā -‘sāsramāṃsaṃ yakṛtplīhau sadyo viddhi yadāgatau | urograhaṃ tadā kukṣau kurutaḥ kaphamārutā’viti || 49 || hadrogāḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ | vātadibhistrayaḥ proktāścaturthaḥ sannipātataḥ || 50 || pañcamaḥ krimisaṃjātaḥ - Dī. hṛdrogāḥ pañca kīrtitā iti | hṛdi rogo hṛdrogaḥ, hṛdi bādhetyanye; yaduktaṃ ‘dūṣayitvā rasaṃ doṣā viguṇā hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ | hṛdi bādhāṃ prakurvanti hṛdrogaṃ taṃ pracakṣate’ iti | pañcamaḥ kṛmisaṃjāta iti kṛmirogāt pañcamo hṛdrogo bhavatītyarthaḥ | tatroktatvāt | tadyathā - ‘jvaro vivarṇatā śūlaṃ hṛdrogaṃ sadanaṃ bhramaḥ | bhaktadveṣo'tisāraśca saṃjātakrimilakṣaṇam’ iti || 50 || Gū. atha hṛdrogasaṃkhyā - hṛdrogāḥ pañca, te vātādibhiḥ || 50 || tathāṣṭāvudarāṇi ca | vātātpittātkaphāttrīṇi tridoṣebhyo jalādapi || 51 || plīhna: kṣatādbaddhagudādaṣṭamaṃ parikīrtitam | Dī. tathāṣṭāvudarāṇi ceti | atrodarastho rogo'pyudaraśabdena vācyastadgatatvāt, yataḥ - ‘tātsthyāttaddharmatābhyāṃ ca tatsamīpatayā'pi ca | tatsāhacaryācchabdānāṃ vṛttireṣā caturvidhā’ iti | tatra vātādīnāṃ pṛthak trayo bhedāstena vātodaraṃ pittodaraṃ śleṣmodaraṃ ca | tridoṣebhya iti militadoṣatrayāccaturthaḥ | asya sannipātodarasya dūṣyodaraṃ nāmāntaraṃ vadantyeke | taduktaṃ–‘striyo'nnapānaṃ nakharomamūtraviḍārtavairyuktamasādhuvṛttā | yasmai prayacchantyarayo garāṃśca duṣṭāmbudūṣīviṣasevanādvā || tenāśu raktaṃ kupitāśca doṣāḥ kuryuḥ sughoraṃ jaṭharaṃ triliṅgam | sa cāturo muhyati hi prasaktaṃ dūṣyodaraṃ kīrtitametadeva’ iti | jalādapi jalapānāt apraśastajalapānādityabhiprāyaḥ | asyāpi dakodarasaṃjñāṃ pravadanti; yaduktam — ‘yaḥ snehapīto'pyanuvāsito vā vānto virikto'pyathavā nirūḍhaḥ | pibejjalaṃ śītalamāśu tasya srotāṃsi duṣyanti hi tadvahāni || snehopalipteṣvathavāpi teṣu dakodaraṃ pūrvavadabhyupaiti’ iti | plīha iti plīhavṛddheḥ plīhodarasaṃjñā, plīhā ‘sanahavā’ śabdavācya asya bhedo yakṛddālyudaraṃ tathaiveti | kṣatāditi | prahārarūpādantrādiṣu tataḥ parisrāvyudaramiti saṃjñā | yaduktaṃ - ‘śalyaṃ tathā'nnopahitaṃ yadannaṃ phalaṃ bhinattyāgatamanyathā vā | tasmāt sruto'ntrāt salilaprakāśaḥ srāvaḥ sravedvai gudatastu bhūyaḥ | nābheradhaścodaravṛddhimeti nistudyate dālyati cātimātram | etat parisrāvyudaraṃ pradiṣṭaṃ dakodaraṃ kīrtayato nibodha iti | baddhagudāditi | aṣṭamamudaraṃ ca baddhodarasaṃjñamiti | baddhagudodaramityanye, yataḥ - ‘yasyāntramannairupalepibhirvā bālāśmabhirvā pihitaṃ yathāvat | saṃcīyate yasya malaḥ sadoṣaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ saṅkaravacca nāḍyām | nirudhyate tasya gude purīṣaṃ nireti kṛcchrādapi cālpamalpam || hṛnnābhimadhye parivṛddhimeti tasyodaraṃ baddhagudaṃ vadanti’ iti ‘tadvāmapārśve parivṛddhimeti plīhāmayaṃ taṃ jaṭharaṃ vadanti | satyānyapārśve yakṛti praduṣṭe jñeyaṃ yakṛddātyudaraṃ tadeva’ || iti || 51 || Gū. athodaranāmāni gulmāstvaṣṭau samākhyātā vātapittakaphaistrayaḥ || 52|| dvandrabhedāstrayaḥ proktā: saptamaḥ sannipātataḥ | raktādaṣṭamakaḥ khyāto Dī. gulmāstviti | koṣṭhāntargranthirūpiṇaṃ guṭikākāraṃ golamiti prasiddham | yaduktam - ‘hṛnnābhyorantare granthiḥ sañcārī yadi vā'calaḥ | vṛttaścayopacayavān sa gulma iti kīrttitaḥ’ iti | te tu vātādibhedena pṛthak trayo gaṇitāḥ| dvandvabhedādidvidoṣajanitāstrayaḥ | saptamaḥ sannipātata iti saptamo gulmo militadoṣatrayādbhavati | raktādaṣṭamaka iti | duṣṭarudhirādaṣṭamo gulmo bhavatītyarthaḥ | sa ca prāyaśaḥ strīṇāṃ prasūtyanantaraṃ bhavati | taduktaṃ - ‘navaprasūtā- 'hitabhojanā yā yā cāmagarbhaṃ visṛjedṛtau vā | vāyurhi tasyāḥ parigṛhya raktaṃ karoti gulmaṃ sarujaṃ sadāham’ iti | nanu mādhavena pañcadhā gulmaṃ likhitaṃ, tatkathamatrāṣṭavidham ? satyam, mādhavena tu pañcasthānaviśeṣeṇa pañcadhā kathitam | tathāhi - ‘duṣṭā vātādayotyarthaṃ mithyā''hāravihārataḥ | kurvanti pañcadhā gulmaṃ koṣṭhāntargranthirūpiṇam || tasya pañcavidhaṃ sthānaṃ pārśvahṛnnābhibastayaḥ’ iti | atra tu cikitsārthaṃ dvandvabhedāstrayo gaṇitā ityadoṣaḥ | yataḥ -‘nimittaliṅgānupalabhya gulmo dvidoṣajo doṣabalābalaṃ ca | vyāmiśraliṅgānaparāṃśca gulmāṃstrīnādiśedauṣadhakalpanārtham’ iti || 52 || Gū. gulmasaṃkhyāmāha - vātādibhiḥ aṣṭau gulmā: samākhyātāḥ kathitāḥ | nanu nidāne pañca gulmā uktāḥ tatkathamaṣṭau tadyathā - ‘tasya pañcavidhaṃ sthānaṃ pārśvahṛnnābhibastayaḥ | vṛtaścayopacayavānsa gulma iti kirtitaḥ’ ucyate, tribhirdvandvajaiḥ saha aṣṭau suśrutādau coktatvāt ‘trīnādiśedauṣadhakalpanārthami’tyukte: || 52 || mūtrāghātāstroyodaśa || 53 || vātakuṇḍalikā pūrvaṃ vātāṣṭhīlā tataḥ param | vātabastistṛtīyaḥ syānmūtrātītaścaturthakaḥ || 54 || pañcamaṃ mūtrajaṭharaṃ ṣaṣṭho mūtrakṣayaḥ smṛtaḥ | mūtrotsargaḥ saptamaḥ syānmūtragranthistathāṣṭamaḥ || 55 || mūtraśukraṃ tu navamaṃ viḍghāto daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ | mūtrāsādaścoṣṇavāto bastikuṇḍalikā tathā ||56|| trayo'pyete mūtraghātāḥ pṛthagghorāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | Dī. mūtrāghātā iti | mūtrasyābhighāto mūtrāghātaḥ | āghāto vedanāviśeṣavān mūtranirodha ityapare, sa ca vātādidoṣajanitaḥ | trayodaśa ityasya vivaraṇamāha - vātakuṇḍalikā pūrvamityādi | pūrvaṃ prathamaṃ vātakuṇḍalikā kathitā | tadyathā - yatra savedano vāyurbastau mūtramāviśya kuṇḍalavadviguṇo bhūtvā saṃcarati sā vātakuṇḍalikā jñeyā | vātāṣṭhīlā tataḥ paramiti | tataḥ paraṃ dvitīyaṃ; yatrānilaḥ pāṣāṇagranthivadvastau vṛttamunnataṃ mūtraviṇmārgarodhinaṃ vyādhiṃ kuryāt so'ṣṭhīlāśabdavācyaḥ | ayaṃ tu vātaroge paṭhitāṣṭhīlāyāstu bastigatatvādbhinnaḥ | bastikukṣinipīḍito yatra mūtrasaṅgo bhavet sa vātabastiḥ | yatra mūtraṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhati śīghraṃ na pravartate mandaṃ vā pravartate sa mūtrātītaḥ, yatra nābhera- dhastāt tīvravedanamādhmānaṃ bhavati tanmūtrajaṭharaṃ jñeyam | yatra bastisthau pittamārutau sarugdāhaṃ mūtrakṣayaṃ kurutaḥ sa mūtrakṣayo jñeyaḥ | yatra śanairalpamalpaṃ sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ vā mūtraṃ sravet sa mūtrotsargaḥ | yatrāntarbastimukhe tu sthiro'lpavṛtto granthi:, atra tu aśmarītulyarugbhavati sa mūtragranthiḥ | aśmarī tu bhinnadoṣadūṣitatvāt | yatra bhasmodakapratīkāśaṃ sthānāccyutaṃ śukraṃ mūtrayetprāk paścādvā pravartate tanmūtraśukramityucyate | yatra tu viṭsaṃsṛṣṭaṃ viḍgandhaṃ kṛcchānyamūtrayet sa viḍghāta iti | yatra sadāhaṃ rocanāśaṅkhacūrṇavarṇaṃ samastavarṇaṃ vā mūtrayet sa mūtrāsādaḥ | yatra kṛcchrāt punaḥpunaśca hāridramathavā raktaṃ mūtraṃ mūtrayet sa coṣṇavātaḥ | yaḥ śūlaspandanadāhārto binduṃ binduṃ mūtrayet pīḍitastu dhārā sravettasya bastikuṇḍalikā kathitā | trayo'pyete mūtrāghātā iti | prāyastu mūtrāsādādayaḥ pratyākhyeyāḥ te tu ghorā bahuduḥkhakarā ityarthaḥ || 53-56 || Gū. mūtrāghātasaṃkhyāmāha - mūtrāghātāstrayodaśeti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | tato vātakuṇḍalikādayaḥ | mūtrasya āghātaḥ mūtrāghātaḥ | ghātaśabdo'tra vibandhaparolpakṛcchra idaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ mūtrakṛcchre bahukṛcchtā vibandhālpateti bhedāḥ || 53-56 || mūtrakṛcchāṇi cāṣṭau syurvātapittakaphaistridhā || 57|| sannipātāccaturthaṃ syācchukrakṛcchraṃ ca pañcamam | viṭkṛcchraṃ ṣaṣṭhamākhyātaṃ ghātakṛcchraṃ ca saptamam||58|| aṣṭamaṃ cāśmarīkṛcchraṃ - Dī. mūtrakṛcchrāṇīti | mūtrasya kṛcchreṇa mahatā duḥkhena pravṛtirmūtrakṛcchram | taccāṣṭavidhaṃ bhavati vātādibhiḥ pṛthak trayo bhedāḥ, sannipātāccaturthaḥ | yatra tu bastimehanaśūlaṃ bhavati sa śukraṃ mūtrayet tattu śukrakṛcchram| yatra purīṣāghātādviguṇatāṃ gato vāyurādhmānaśūlau karoti tadviṭkṛcchram | yatra śalyena mūtravāhisrotaḥ svabhihateṣu satsu bhṛśaṃ dāruṇaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ bhavati tadghātakṛcchraṃ jñeyam | aśmarīvadaśmarīkṛcchraṃ tadbastimehanaśūlānvitaṃ bhavati | aśmarībhedo'pi śarkareti kecit, yataḥ - ‘aśmarī śarkarā caiva tulyalakṣaṇa'sambhave | viśeṣaṃ śarkarāyāśca śṛṇu kīrtayato mama || pacyamānā'śmarī pittāt śoṣyamāṇā ca vāyunā | vimuktakaphasandhānā kṣarantī śarkarā matā’ iti | nanu mūtrakṛcchramūtrāghātayorbastigatadoṣasādharmyāt ko bhedaḥ ? ucyate - mūtrakṛcchre kṛcchratvamadhikaṃ vibandhaścālpaḥ, mūtrāghāte tu vibandho balavān kṛcchratvamalpaśceti bhedaḥ || 57 || 58 || Gū. mūtrakṛcchrasaṃkhyāmāha - vātādaṣṭau mūtrakṛchrāṇi syuḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 57 || 58 || caturdhā cāśmarī matā | vātātpittātkaphācchukrāt -- Dī. caturdhā aśmarī mateti | yā bastigatā pāṣāṇaguṭikāvadbhavati sā aśmarīśabdavācyā | taduktaṃ -‘viśoṣayedbastigataṃ saśukraṃ mūtraṃ sapittaṃ pavanaḥ kaphaṃ vā | yadā tadā'śmaryupajāyate tu krameṇa pitteṣviva rocanā goḥ’ iti | krameṇeti kramamātraṃ prasaṅgato'pi likhyate | yathā ‘apsu svacchāsvapi yathā niṣiktāsu nave ghaṭe | kālānteraṇa paṅkaḥ syādaśmarī saṃbhavettathe’ti | sā aśmarī catu: prakārā bhavati | vātapittakaphāt | śukrāditi vātādīnāṃ pṛthak trayo medāḥ | vātapittakaphādityanena tridoṣasaṃbhavetyapare | yataḥ ‘naikadoṣāśrayāḥ sarvāḥ’ ityādivacanāt | śukrāditi śukradhāraṇāt, śukrāśmarī bhavatītyucyate ‘śukrāśmarī tu mahatāṃ jāyate śukadhāraṇāt | sthānācyutamamuktaṃ hi muṣkayorantare'nilaḥ || śoṣayatyupasaṃgṛhya śukraṃ tat śukramaśmarī’ iti || Gū. aśmarīsaṃkhyāmāha - vātādeścaturdhā aśmarī smṛteti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | aśmavadvāyurbastimukhaṃ ruddhvā mūtrakṛcchrarodhādikaṃ karotīti aśmarī || tathā mehāśca viṃśatiḥ || 59 || ikṣumehaḥ surāmehaḥ piṣṭamehaśca sāndrakaḥ | śukramehodakākhyau ca lālāmehaśca śītakaḥ ||60|| sikatākhyaḥ śanairmeho daśaite kaphasaṃbhavāḥ | mañjiṣṭhākhyo haridrākhyo nīlamehaśca raktakaḥ ||61|| kṛṣṇameha: kṣāramehaḥ ṣaḍete pittasaṃbhavāḥ | hastimeho vasāmeho majjāmeho madhuprabhaḥ || 62 || catvāro vātajā mehā iti mehāśca viṃśatiḥ | Dī. tathā mehāśca viṃśatirityādi | tatheti bastigatadoṣatvādgrahaṇam | mehaḥ pramehaḥ, prakarṣeṇa medo- māṃsakledādimehatīti pramehaḥ | taduktam - ‘medaśca māṃsaṃ ca śarīrajaṃ ca kledaṃ kapho bastigataṃ pradūṣya | karoti mehān samudīrṇamuṣṇaistāneva pittaṃ paridūṣya cāpi || kṣīṇeṣu doṣeṣvavakṛṣya dhātūn sandūṣya mehān kurute'nilaśca iti | viṃśatiriti viṃśatibhedāḥ | tadyathā - ikṣurasatulya ikṣumehaḥ - tulyatā mūtrasyetyabhiprāyaḥ | surā madirāviśeṣaḥ, tattulyaṃ surāmehaḥ | piṣṭaṃ taṇḍulakalkaṃ tadrasatulyaṃ piṣṭamehaḥ | sāndraṃ ghanaṃ āvilaṃ ca sāndramehaḥ | śukratulyaṃ śukramehaḥ| śvetavarṇasadṛśamudakamehaḥ | lālātantuyutaṃ picchilaṃ lālāmehaḥ, bahuvārānmadhuramatiśītalaṃ śītamehaḥ, sāndraṃ sikatārūpaṃ sikatāmehaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ sakaphakṛcchraṃ śanairmehaḥ, ete daśabhedāḥ kaphajā jñeyāḥ | atha pittajānāha -mañjiṣṭhāsalilopamaṃ visraṃ ca mañjiṣṭhāmehaḥ | sadāhaṃ haridrāsannibhaṃ ca haridrāmehaḥ | saphenamacchaṃ nīlavarnaṃ ca nīlamehaḥ | visramuṣṇaṃ ca śoṇitaprakāśaṃ raktamehaḥ | maṣīnibhaṃ kṛṣṇamehaḥ | strutakṣārapratimaṃ kṣārameha:| kṣāratoyasadṛśamityarthaḥ | taduktaṃ - ‘gandhavarṇarasasparśai: kṣāreṇa kṣāratoyavat’ iti ṣaṭ pittajāḥ | idānīṃ vātajānāha - hastimeha ityādi | mattamātaṅgavadajasraṃ pravṛddhaṃ hastimehaḥ | vasāprakāśaṃ vasamiśraṃ vā vasāmehaḥ | majjābhaṃ majāmiśraṃ vā majjāmehaḥ | madhu kṣaudraṃ tasya tulyaṃ tadvarṇaṃ vā madhumehaḥ | iti catvāro vātajā jñeyāḥ | iti mehāśca viṃśatiriti | iti pūrvoktaprakāreṇa viṃśatirmehāḥ sādhyā yāpyā asādhyāścānena pratipāditāḥ | yaduktaṃ - ‘sādhyāḥ kaphotthā daśapittajāḥ ṣaṭ yāpyāścatuṣkāḥ pavanādasādhyāḥ | samakriyatvādviṣamakriyatvānmahātyayatvācca yathākramaṃ te ||’ nanu madhumeho'nyatra pṛthak ekaviṃśatiko gaṇitaḥ tatkathamatra vātajeṣu paṭhitaḥ ? satyaṃ, citketsārthe tu pṛthaganyatrāsya grahaṇaṃ kṛtam, atrāsādhyatvena vātajeṣu prameheṣvevāntarbhūto darśitaḥ doṣadūṣyarasavarṇasādharmyāt | yataḥ - ‘nūnaṃ sarve pramehāstu kālenāpratikāriṇaḥ | madhumehatvamāyānti tathā sādhyā bhavanti hi’ iti || 59-62 || Gū. atha pramehasaṃkhyā -- tathā mehāśca viṃśatiriti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | te ikṣumehādayaḥ, teṣu daśa kaphajāḥ ṣaṭ pittajāścatvāro vātajā iti || 59-62 || somarogastathā caikaḥ - Dī. somaroga iti | ekaḥ somarogaḥ ca sa mūtramārgeṇa sravati | tathāhi - ‘āpaḥ sarvaśarīreṣu kṣubhyanti prasravanti ca | mūtramārgeṇa vimalāḥ somaroga iti smṛtaḥ’ | asya cihnamapyatīva balahānitvenopalakṣitam | taduktam ‘śarīradhāraṇāccāpi soma ityabhiśabditaḥ | tasmāt somakṣayāddeho niśceṣṭaśca bhavet sadā’ iti | mūtrātīsāro'sya bheda iti manyante kecit dravadoṣasādharmyāt | yataḥ - ‘mūtrātīsāramatimaithunataḥ prasūtaṃ ruktodatāpaparivarjita- malpamalpam | śaṅkāvihīnamapi somagadasya tasya bhedaṃ vadanti bhiṣajaḥ sakalāmayajñāḥ’ iti || Gū. somarogasaṃkhyāmāha - somaroga ekaprakāraḥ | sa tu strīṇāmeva jalasrāvādilakṣaṇo bhavati || pramehapiḍakābhedānāha - pramehapiḍakā daśa || 63|| śarāvikā kacchapikā putriṇī vinatālajī | masūrikā sarṣapikā valinī ca vidārikā || 64 || vidradhiśca daśaitāḥ syuḥ piḍakā mehasaṃbhavāḥ | Dī. pramehapiḍakā daśeti | apratikriyamāṇāt pramehāt piḍakāścotpadyante piḍakā nānākārā vraṇasaṃjñā eva | ‘sandhimarmasu jāyante māṃsaleṣu ca dhāmasu | tāvaccaitā na lakṣyante yāvadvāstuparigrahāḥ’ iti | vāstu vraṇādhiṣṭhānaṃ kadācidanyairvā, yataḥ ‘vinā pramehamapyetā jāyante duṣṭamedasaḥ’ ityapi | tāsāṃ svarūpaṃ keṣāṃcijjñāpanārthaṃ likhyate | tatra śarāvikā yathā - ‘antonnatā tu tadrūpā nimnamadhyā śarāvikā’ iti | sarṣapikāmāha - gaurasarṣapasaṃsthānā tatpramāṇā ca sarṣapī’ iti | kacchapikāmāha - ‘sadāhā kūrmasaṃsthānā jñeyā kacchapikā budhaiḥ’ iti | jālinīmāha — ‘jālinī tīvradāhā tu māṃsajālasamāvṛtā’ iti | tantrāntare'pi ‘parasparābhisambaddhā piḍakā caikadeśajā | cittotkaṭā dāhavatī bhṛśaruk jālinī matā’ iti | vinatālakṣaṇamāha - ‘avagāḍharujā kledā pṛṣṭhe vāpyudare'pi vā | mahatī piḍakā nīlā vinatā nāma sā smṛtā’ iti | putriṇīmāha - ‘mahatyalpacitā jñeyā piḍakā sāpi putriṇī’ iti | masūrikāmāha - ‘masūrākṛtisaṃsthānā vijñeyā tu masūrikā’ iti | alajīmāha - ‘raktā sitā skoṭacitā vijñeyā tvalajī bhavet’ iti | vidārīmāha - ‘vidārī kandavadvṛtā kaṭhinā ca vidārikā’ iti | vidradhikāmāha - ‘vidradherlakṣaṇairyuktā jñeyā vidradhikā tu sā’ vidradhilakṣaṇayuktetyanena asyā abhedo boddhavyaḥ | piḍakānāmārambhakānapyāha kaścit ‘ye yanmayāḥ smṛtā mehāsteṣāmetāstu tanmayāḥ’ ityādi | piḍakāḥ prāyeṇādhaḥkāye bhavanti doṣadūṣyānāmadhaḥprakramāt rasāyatanānāṃ daurbalyācca ||63||64|| Gū. śarāvikādyāḥ pramehāpekṣayā bhavanti | śarākṛtivatsaṃbhavantītyatastallakṣaṇaniruktiḥ ||63||64|| medodoṣastathā caikaḥ - Dī. medodoṣa iti | medovṛddhijanito doṣo medodoṣaḥ, yadvā meda eva doṣaḥ kāraṇe kāryopacārāt, vṛddhiryathā-‘avyāyāmadivāsvapnaśleṣmalāhārasevinaḥ | madhuro'nnarasaḥ prāyaḥ snehānmedovivardhanaḥ’ iti | tat prāyeṇa udarasthitaṃ bhavati | yaduktaṃ - ‘medastu sarvabhūtānāmudareṣvasthiṣu sthitam | ata evodaro vṛddhaḥ prāyo medasvino bhavet’ iti | nanu meda eva doṣaḥ kathaṃ ? taducyate - ‘medasā'vṛtamārgatvāt puṣyantyanye na dhātavaḥ | medastu cīyate tasmādasaktaḥ sarvakarmasu || kṣudraśvāsatṛṣāmohasvaprakathanasādanai | yukta: kṣutsvedadaurgandhairalpaprāṇo'lpamaithunaḥ’ iti || Gū. medorogasaṃkhyāmāha - medodoṣa ekaḥ ekaprakāraḥ vātapradhānaḥ | dehamāṃsātivṛddhiḥ meda ucyate || śotharogā nava smṛtāḥ || 65 || doṣai: pṛthagvayaiḥ sarvairabhighātādviṣādapi | Dī. śotharogā nava smṛtā iti | doṣabhedena śotha evaṃ rogaḥ śotharogaḥ | ayamapi vraṇaśothādbhinna eva kevalatvaḍmāṃsasaṃśrayatvāt | yataḥ ‘raktapittakaphān vāyurduṣṭo duṣṭān bahiḥ śirāḥ | nītvā ruddhagatistairhi kuryāttvaṅgmāṃsasaṃśrayam | utsaṃgha saṃhataṃ śothaṃ tamāhurnicayādataḥ’ iti | ata eva śothasya tvaṅgmāṃsameva saṃśrayaḥ | vraṇasya tvaṣṭau vastūni, yaduktam - tvaṅgmāṃsaśirāsnāyvasthisandhikoṣṭhamarmāṇītyaṣṭau vraṇavastūni, aṣṭasu vraṇavastuṣu vraṇaśothasya sambhavatvāt navasmṛtā iti | śotharogasya nava bhedāḥ | doṣaiḥ pṛthagiti | doṣairvātādibhirvyastaistrayo bhedāḥ, dvayairiti militadoṣadvayenā'pi trayo bhedāḥ| sarvairiti | militadoṣatrayāṇāmapyatra eko bhedaḥ sannipātenetyarthaḥ | abhighātāditi | abhighātaḥ śastrādinā chedabhedakṣataprabhṛtikatvena prasaraṇaśīlo'pi san prakṛtaśotho bhavati | yaduktam - ‘abhighātena śastrādicchedabhedakṛtādibhiḥ | himānilodadhyanilairbhallātakapikacchujaiḥ | rasaiḥ śūkaiśca saṃsparśācchvayathu: syādvisarpavān | bhṛśoṣmā lohitābhāsaḥ prāyaśaḥ pittalakṣaṇaḥ’ iti | viṣāditi | sthāvarajaṅgamātmakaviṣaprabhāvat | yaduktaṃ - ‘viṣaja: saviṣaprāṇiparisarpaṇamūtraṇāt | daṃṣṭrādantanakhāghātādaviṣaprāṇināmapi | viṇmūtraśukropahatamalavadvastrasaṃkarāt | viṣavṛkṣānilasparśādgarayogāvacūrṇanāt |mṛduścalo'valambī ca śīghro dāharujākaraḥ’ iti || 65 || Gū. śotharogasaṃkhyāmāha - dvayairdvidoṣaistu ya: tribhirdoṣairekaḥ, saptamaḥ abhighātātprahārādeḥ viṣādekaḥ eṣaṃ nava śothāḥ ||65|| vṛddhaya: sapta gaditā vātātpittātkaphena ca || 66 || raktena medasā mūtrādantravṛddhiśca saptamī | Dī. vṛddhaya iti | vṛddhistu śothopalakṣitatvāt śothabheda eva | tathāhi ‘kruddho'nūrdhvagatirvāyuḥ śothaśūlakaraścaran | muṣkau vaṃkṣaṇataḥ prāpya phalakośābhivāhinīḥ | prapīḍya dhamanīrvṛddhiṃ karoti phalakośayoḥ || doṣāsramedomūtrāntraiḥ sā vṛddhiḥ saptadhā matā’ iti | saptadhā saptaprakārā bhavati | tadyathā vātapūrṇadṛtisparśo vātavṛddhiḥ, pakvodumbarasaṃkāśaḥ pittavṛddhiḥ, kaṇḍūmān kaṭhino'lparuk ityādinā śleṣmavṛddhiḥ | raktenetyādi | duṣṭaraktena raktakṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ pitta- vṛddhiliṅgaśca | medaseti | kaphavṛddhivattālaphalopamaśca | mūtrāditi | mūtradhāraṇaśīlasya pānīyapūrṇadṛtivadbhavati savyatho mṛduśca mūtrajavṛddhiḥ | antravṛddhistu kṣudrāntrāvayavaṃ yadā adhovaṅkṣaṇasandhau granthyābhaḥ śvayathuriti | ata evāsau cāparo bhedo bradhna iti kathitaḥ | yaduktam - antraṃ viguṇamādāya jantornayati ? vaṅkṣaṇam | vaṅkṣaṇāt tadrujāyuktaṃ phalakośaṃ prapadyate’ iti || 66 || Gū. atha vṛddhisakhyā - vātādeḥ sapta vṛddhayo gaditā uktā: | spaṣṭamanyat || 66 || aṇḍavṛddhistathā caikā -- Dī. aṇḍavṛddhistathā caikā iti | eko'ṇḍavṛddhistvasyaiva bhedaḥ, yata uktam ‘upekṣamāṇasya ca muṣkavṛddhimādhmānaruk stambhavatīṃ sa vāyuḥ ityādinā kuraṇḍakaśabdavācyatvena cikitsārthaṃ tu pṛthagabhidhānamātramasya na doṣa: || Gū. aṇḍavṛddhisaṃkhyāmāha - sugamam | aṇḍavṛddhirvṛddhāṇḍatā ekā ekaprakārā || tathaikā gaṇḍamālikā ||67|| Dī. tathaikā gaṇḍamālikā iti | gaṇḍamālā jātiścaikā syāt | gale gaṇḍakarūpā vraṇā evaṃ gaṇḍamālādayo jñeyāḥ | mālātulyaṃ gaṇḍayogāt gaṇḍamālā | galagaṇḍādbhinnā | yaduktaṃ - ‘karkandhukolāmalakapramāṇaiḥ kakṣāṃsamanyāgalavaṃkṣaṇeṣu | medaḥkaphābhyāṃ ciramandapākaiḥ syādgaṇḍamālā bahubhiśca gaṇḍai:’ iti | asyā eva medo'pacīti vadanti kecit | tulyagranthisādharmyāt | yataḥ - ‘te granthayaḥ kecidavāptapākāḥ sravanti naśyanti bhavanti cānye | kālānubandhaṃ ciramādadhāti saivā'pacīti pravadanti kecit ’ iti | nanu kathaṃ kaṇṭhasthānaprasiddhatvādgaṇḍamālā'pacī ca vaṅkṣaṇe pratītā ? satyaṃ - doṣagativiśeṣāt vaṅkṣaṇasandhāvapi gaṇḍamālā, bhavatīti na doṣaḥ | yadāha bhojaḥ - ‘vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaścāpi samācitam | jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāṃ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśān bahūn | kurvanti grathitāṃstebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito'nilaḥ | tān doṣānūrdhvago vakṣaḥ kakṣamanyāgalāśritaḥ | nānāprakārān kurute granthīn sā tvapacī matā | apacī kaṇṭhamanyāsu kakṣāvaṃkṣaṇasandhiṣu | gaṇḍamālāṃ vijānīyādapacītulyalakṣaṇām’ iti || 67 || Gū. gaṇḍamālāmāha - gaṇḍamālikā kaṇṭhadeśe mālākārā granthirūpā sāpyekaprakārā apacībhedaḥ || 67 || gaṇḍālajī tu caikā syāt Dī. gaṇḍālajī tu caikā syāditi | gaṇḍālajī cātra galagaṇḍasyaiva nāmāntaraṃ yato gaṇḍamālayā bhinno galagaṇḍa eva nānyat | ata evāha mādhavaḥ - ‘vātaḥ kaphaścāpi gale praduṣṭau manye tu saṃśritya tathaiva medaḥ | kurvanti gaṇḍaṃ kramaśaḥ svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitaṃ taṃ galagaṇḍamāhuḥ’ iti | bhojenāpyuktaṃ - ‘mahāntaṃ śothamalpaṃ vā hanumanyāgalāśrayam | lambantaṃ muṣkavadduṣṭaṃ galagaṇḍaṃ vinirdiśet’ iti | yadvā gaṇḍālajītyatrālajī kṣudrarogapaṭhitā boddhavyā | eke gaṇḍālajīsthāne gaṇḍāpacīti paṭhanti tanmate tu eko gaṇḍaḥ ekā'pacī ceti | ayamapi pāṭho manoharo na doṣaḥ || granthayo navadhā matāḥ | tribhirdoṣaistrayo raktācchirābhirmedaso vraṇāt || 68 || asthnā māṃsena navamaḥ Dī. granthayo navadhā matā iti | granthistu śophasamutthāno vraṇabhedaḥ loke vatīgurīti śabdavācyatvena pratīta: | tadyathā - ‘vātādayo māṃsamasṛkpraduṣṭā: saṃdūṣya medaśca tathā śirāśca | vṛttonnataṃ vigrathitaṃ tu śothaṃ kurvantyato granthiriti pradiṣṭaḥ’ iti | navaprakāramāha - tribhirdoṣairiti | trayo bhedāḥ, tena vyastena vātena, pittena, kaphenetyarthaḥ | raktādrudhirāccaturthaḥ | śirābhiriti granthiḥ pañcamaḥ | medasā iti duṣṭamedasā janitaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ | vraṇāditi vraṇajanitaḥ saptamaḥ | asthneti doṣadūṣitāsthijanito'ṣṭamaḥ | māṃseneti māṃsajanito navama iti | nanu mādhavena pañcabhedā grantha- yo'bhihitāḥ vātādidoṣeṇa trayaḥ medaḥśirābhyāṃ ca dvāviti, tatkathamatra navabhedā darśitāḥ ? ucyate, yadi māṃsāsṛjāvatra dūṣyabhedenodāhṛtau tathāpi granthyāśrayatvena sthānaviśeṣānmedaḥśirāvattatsambhavasthāna evoktau | yaduktaṃ bhoje - ‘medo vāyuryadā māṃse nikṣipedathavā tvaci | tatra medobhavagranthiḥ śyāvo bhavati pāṇḍuraḥ’ ityādinā | cikitsārthaṃ tu pṛthagabhidhānamanyatrāpi dṛśyate | taduktaṃ - ‘granthau māṃsodbhave yojyo hyayameva kriyāpathaḥ | śirāgranthiṃ parityajya śeṣaṃ yatnena sādhayet’ ityādibhiradoṣaḥ || 68 || Gū. atha granthisaṃkhyā - granthayo vātādibhirnavaprakārāḥ || 68 || ṣaḍvidhaṃ svāttathārbudam | vātātpittātkaphādraktānmāṃsādapi ca medasaḥ ||69|| Dī. arbudamapi vraṇabhedo vraṇākāratvāt | yataḥ - ‘gātrapradeśe kvacideva doṣāḥ samutthitā māṃsamasṛk pradūṣya | vṛttaṃ mṛdu mandarujaṃ mahāntamanalpamūlaṃ ciravṛddhyapākam | kurvanti māṃsocchrayamatyagādhaṃ tadarbudaṃ śāstravido vadanti’ iti | ṣaḍvidhatvācca sugamam | māṃsādapi ceti | cakāragrahaṇādatra dvirarbudamapi grāhyam, adhyarbudamapi kecit | tathāhi -‘yajjāyate'nyat khalu pūrvajāte jñeyaṃ tadadhyarbudamarbudajñaiḥ | yadvmandvajātaṃ yugapat kramādvā dvirarbudaṃ tacca bhavedasādhyam’ iti ||69|| Gū. arbudo'pi tadbhedaḥ vātādinā ṣaḍvidhaḥ||69|| ślīpadaṃ ca tridhā proktaṃ vātātpittātkaphādapi | Dī. ślīpadaṃ ceti | caraṇayoḥ śilāvaducchrayaḥ ślīpadaśabdavācyaḥ | tatheti grahaṇāt karakarṇādiṣu ca bhavatīti kecidāhuḥ | yaduktaṃ - ‘yaḥ saṃjvaro vaṃkṣaṇajo bhṛśārtiḥ śotho nṛṇāṃ pādagataḥ krameṇa | tat ślīpadaṃ syāt karakarṇanetraśiśnauṣṭhanāsāsvapi kecidāhuḥ’ iti | vātapittakaphādityanena vyastasamastena kṛtvā catvāro bhedā: tena vātena, pittena, śleṣmaṇā cetyabhiprāya: | eke tu traya eva bhedāḥ ślīpadasyeti vadanti | yataḥ tatra kaphasyāvyabhicāreṇa prādhānyam | taduktam - ‘trīṇyetāni vijānīyāt ślīpadāni kaphocchrayāt | gurutvaṃ ca mahattvaṃ ca yasmānnāsti vinā kaphāt’ iti || Gū. ślīpadaṃ pādaśothaḥ sthūlatāviśeṣaḥ sa trividhaḥ || vidradhiḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ khyāto vātapittakaphaistrayaḥ||70|| raktatkṣatāttridoṣaiśca - Dī. vidradhirapi vraṇabheda eva | yaduktam - ‘tvagraktamāṃsamedāṃsi pradūṣyāsthisamāśritāḥ | doṣāḥ śothaṃ śanairghoraṃ janayantyucchritā bhṛśam | mahāmūlaṃ rujāvantaṃ vṛttaṃ vāpyathavāyatam | sa vidradhiriti khyāto vijñeyaḥ ṣaḍvidhaśca saḥ’ iti | carake tu vidāhaprakarṣādvidradhisaṃjñā | yaduktam - ‘sa vai śīghravidāhitvād vidradhistu nirūpyate’ iti | sa ca bāhyābhyantare bhavati | antare tu gulmasādṛśyam | yataḥ - ‘tulyadoṣasamutthāno vidradhergulmakasya ca’ iti | nanu tulya- tvāt kathaṃ vidradheḥ pākaḥ kathaṃ vā gulmasya na pākaḥ ? ucyate - ‘na nibandho'sti gulmānāṃ vidradhiḥ sanibandhanaḥ | gulmākāraṃ svayaṃ doṣo vidradhirmāṃsaśoṇite | vivarānucaro granthirapsu budbudako yathā | evaṃprakāro gulmastu tasmāt pākaṃ na gacchati’ iti | tathā'nyatrāpi - ‘māṃsaśoṇitabāhulyāt pākaṃ gacchati vidradhi: | māṃsaśoṇitahīnatvāt gulmaḥ pākaṃ na gacchati’ iti | ṣaḍvidhaprakāro'tra sugamaḥ | kṣatādityatra tu kāṣṭhalaguḍapāṣāṇādiprahārāt | tridoṣairiti | militadoṣatrayeṇa sannipātenetyarthaḥ || 70 || Gū. vidradhisaṃkhyāmāha -- vidradhiḥ vaṃkṣaṇadeśe vraṇaviśeṣaḥ so'pi ṣaḍvidhaḥ || 70 || vraṇāḥ pañcadaśoditāḥ | teṣāṃ caturdhā bhedāḥ syurāganturdehajastathā || 71|| śuddho duṣṭaśca vijñeyastatsaṃkhyā kathyate pṛthak | vātavraṇaḥ pittajaśca kaphajo raktajo vraṇaḥ || 72 || vātapittabhavaścānyo vātaśleṣmabhavastathā | tathā pittakaphābhyāṃ ca sannipātena cāṣṭama:|| 73 || navamo vātaraktena daśamo raktapittataḥ | śleṣmaraktabhavaścānyo vātapittāsṛgudbhavaḥ || 74 || vātaśleṣmāsṛgutpannaḥ pittaśleṣmāsrasaṃbhavaḥ | sannipātāsṛgudbhūta iti pañcadaśa vraṇāḥ || 75 || Dī. vraṇaṃ tu śothasamutthānaṃ kathitaṃ śothopalakṣitamityarthaḥ | ata evāha kaścit pūrvarūpatvena yathā – ‘ekadeśasthitaḥ śotho vraṇānāṃ pūrvalakṣaṇam’ ityādi sa ca śopho vilakṣaṇaḥ unnataṃ pṛthuḥ grathitaḥ samo viṣamo vā tvaṅmāṃsasthāyī doṣasaṅghātaḥ śarīraikadeśotthita ityucyate | teṣāṃ caturdhā bhedaḥ syāditi | teṣāṃ vraṇānāṃ caturdhā bheda ityatra catuḥprakārabhedatvena saṃjñābhedaḥ sāmānyo darśitaḥ | āganturdehajaḥ - śuddho duṣṭaśceti | āganturiti saṃghātabalapravṛttaḥ; śastravyāpadikṛta ityarthaḥ, dehajaḥ iti doṣabalapravṛttaśarīrasaṃjñaḥ | yaduktam - ‘dvidhā vraṇaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ śārīrāgantubhedataḥ| doṣairādyastayoranyaḥ śastrādikṣatasambhavaḥ’ iti | śuddha iti | śuddhavraṇaḥ, yaduktaṃ ‘jihvātalābho'timṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ snigdho'lpavedanaḥ | suvyavastho nirāsrāvaḥ śuddho vraṇa iti smṛtaḥ’ iti | duṣṭa iti duṣṭo vraṇaḥ | yaduktam - ‘pūtiḥ pūyātiduṣṭāsṛksrāvyutsaṅgī cirasthitiḥ | duṣṭavraṇo'tigandhādiḥ śuddhaliṅgaviparyayaḥ’ iti | kecittu śuddhaduṣṭaśabdau sādhyāsādhyatvena vyākhyānayanti tanna sarvamatam | tatsaṃkhyā kathyate pṛthagiti | tadvraṇasya saṃkhyā gaṇanāniyamaḥ pṛthagabhinnatvenātra kathyate, sā tu pañcadaśaprakārā vakṣyamāṇā boddhavyā | yadyapi ṣaḍvidho'nyatra vraṇaḥ pratipāditastathāpyatra doṣāṇāṃ prasaratvena pañcadaśaprakāro darśitaḥ | taduktaṃ suśrute -‘kadācidekaśo dviśo bahuśaḥ śoṇitasahitā vā anekadhā prasaranti |’ iti | tena pañcadaśaprakārā bhavanti, yataḥ ‘tribhireva vātādikaiḥ śoṇitacaturthai: śarīramidaṃ dhāryate’ iti dvitīyadarśanāt | yaduktam - ‘kālāntareṇābhyuditaṃ tu pittaṃ kṛtvā vaśe vātakaphau prasahya | pacatyata: śoṇitameṣa pāko mato'pareṣāṃ viduṣāṃ dvitīyaḥ’ iti | pañcadaśasaṃkhyā subodhā iti || 70-75 || Gū. vraṇāḥ pañcadaśeti teṣāṃ saṃkhyāmāha - te bhedataścaturdhā | tadbhedānāha - pañcadaśavraṇā uditāḥ kathitā iti pūrveṇa sambandhaḥ | teṣāṃ pañcadaśavraṇānāṃ caturdhā bhedaḥ tatra ekaḥ āgantuśastrādikṣataja:, dvitīyo dehajaḥ śārīraḥ sa tu doṣairjanyate ekaḥ śuddha: dvitīyo duṣṭaḥ evaṃ caturdhā bhedaḥ | nanu nidāne dvividho bhedaḥ proktaḥ taduktaṃ ‘dvidhā vraṇaḥ parijñeyaḥ śārīrāgantubhedataḥ | doṣairādyastatastanyaḥ śastrādikṣatasaṃbhavaḥ’ iti, tatkatham ? ucyate, nidāne śuddhāśuddhalakṣaṇaṃ bhinnamuktam atastayormilitvā caturdheti na doṣaḥ tatsaṃkhyā pañcadaśaprakārābhidhā vātāderbhedataḥ pañcadaśavraṇā bhavantīti yojyam || 71-75 || sadyovraṇastvaṣṭadhā syādavikḷptavilambinau | chinnabhinnapracalitā ghṛṣṭaviddhanipātitaḥ || 76 || Dī. sadyovraṇa iti | śastrādiprahārajanita āgantukasaṃjñaḥ | sa cānekākṛtirityeke bhāṣante | yaduktam -‘nānādhāramukhaiḥ śastrairnānāsthānanipātitaiḥ | bhavanti nānākṛtayo vraṇāstāṃstān nibodha me’ iti | teṣāṃ bhedamāha -avakḷptamityapakartanaṃ, vilambino lambanaśīlaḥ, māṃsāvalambanenetyabhiprāyaḥ | chinnamiti | tiryag ṛjurvā chedanamavayavādiṣu gātrasya pātanamiti bhāvaḥ | bhinnamiti | koṣṭhe bahudhā śaktikuntakhaṅgāgra- vidāraṇādibhirbhedarūpam | yaduktam - ‘śaktikunteṣu khaḍgāgraviṣāṇairāśayo hataḥ | yat kiṃcit sravate taddhi bhinnalakṣaṇamucyate’ iti | āśayo'tra sthānaṃ tat koṣṭhaśabdenopadarśitam | tadyathā - ‘sthānānyāmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca | hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaśca koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate’ iti | ata evāśayarahite'nyadeśe vyadha eva vacanāt | pracalitā iti | prakarṣeṇa calitā māṃsādikamiti bhāvaḥ | tantrāntare picchitamiti nāmāntaraṃ - yataḥ ‘prahārapīḍanābhyāṃ tu yadaṅgaṃ pṛthutā gatam | sāsthi tat picchitaṃ vidyānmajjāraktapariplutam’ iti | athavā pracalitamityanena yadvraṇaṃ yadbhagnasya tathā sadyovraṇasya ca cikitsāviṣayaṃ tena bhagnādhikāre pratipādito'pi tasyaivātrāvasaro na doṣaḥ majāraktapariplutatvena vraṇabhāvatvāt | ghṛṣṭamiva ghṛrṣitaṃ, tadyathā - ‘gharṣaṇādabhighātādvā yadaṅgaṃ vigatatvacam | uṣāsravānvitaṃ tattu ghṛṣṭamityabhidhīyate’ iti | viddhamiva viddham | yathā - sūkṣmāsyaśalyābhihataṃ yadaṅga tvāśayādvinā | uttuṇḍitaṃ nirgataṃ vā tadviddhamiti nirdiśet’ iti | nipātita iti viśeṣeṇa pātito'vayavādyo yatra sa tathā, eke avaliptavilambināṃ vivakṣitamiti nāmnā ekameva bhedaṃ pratipādayanti tadyathā ‘nāticchinnaṃ nātibhinnamubhayorlakṣaṇānvitam | viṣamaṃ vraṇamaṅgeṣu tat kṣataṃ tvabhinirdiśet’ iti | atrākṛtiviṣayatvādaṣṭavidho likhito na doṣaḥ || 76 || Gū. sadyovraṇasaṃkhyāmāha - sadyovraṇaḥ śasnādisaṃbhūta: aṣṭadhā syādbhavet | sa tu avakḷptādilakṣaṇaḥ || 76 || koṣṭhabhedo dvidhā proktaśchinnāntro ni:sṛtāntrakaḥ | Dī. koṣṭhabhedo dvidhā prokta iti | ekaḥ chinnāntraḥ aparo niḥsṛtāntraka iti | atra koṣṭhaśabdenodaramātrameva gṛhyate na tu pakvāmāśayādisaṃjñaḥ || Gū. koṣṭhabhedasaṃkhyāmāha - evaṃ dvidhā | sugamam || asthibhaṅgo'ṣṭadhā prokto bhagnapṛṣṭhavidāritau || 77 || vivartitaśca viśliṣṭastiryakkṣiptastvadhogataḥ | ūrdhvagaḥ sandhibhagnaśca vahnidagdhaścaturvidhaḥ ||78|| pluṣṭo'tidagdho durdagdhaḥ samyagdagdhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | Dī. asthibhaṅga iti | asthibhaṅgaparyāyavācako bhagna ityatra kathitaḥ, na tu bhagnaśabdo'ṣṭasaṃkhyāyāmiha gaṇitā:, te tu piṣṭavidāritādayo'ṣṭau gaṇitāḥ | agniveśe tu bhagnaṃ dvividhaṃ kāṇḍasandhimedāt | yaduktaṃ - ‘bhagnaṃ samāsāddvividhaṃ hutāśakāṇḍe ca sandhāvapi tatra sandhau | utpiṣṭhaviśliṣṭavivartitaṃ ca tiryaggataṃ kṣipramadhaśca ṣaṭ ca ||1||’ atra tu yadvidāritordhvagau dvau bhedāvadhikau likhitau tadgranthāntarasaṃvādānna doṣaḥ | yataḥ - adhaḥkṣiptavadūrdhvakṣiptasyāpyabhidhāne prāpte'nuktamapyūrdhvakṣiptābhidhānaṃ tenātrordhvagaḥ pṛthagdarśitaḥ | yaduktaṃ - ‘adhaḥkṣiptordhvagāvetau tulyalakṣaṇasaṃjñakau’ ityādi | vidāritonāma bhagnaścāsthibhaṅgenānyatra pratipāditatvāda- trāpi likhitaḥ, suśrute'pyayameva saṃjñāntareṇa kathitaḥ | yaduktaṃ - ‘taruṇāsthīni nāmyante bhidyante nalikāni ca | kapālāsthīni bhajyante sphuṭanti rucakāni ca ||’ ityatra cakāragrahaṇādvalayānyapi sphuṭanti ityabhiprāyaḥ. | yato'sthīni pañcavidhāni bhavanti taruṇanalakavalayakapālarucakabhedāt | ata eva sphuṭitamiti bhagnaṃ suśrutenoktam | athoktapiṣṭavidāritādīnāmapi vivaraṇamāha - sandhāvubhayataḥ śotho vedanādikaśca piṣṭasaṃjñaḥ | vidārita iti dvayoḥ sandhyayoratikrāntatā vedanā ca nivarteta ityekasandhipārśvagamanaṃ viṣamāṅgatā vedanā ca viśliṣṭa iti manāk sandhiviśleṣaḥ śithilatāmātraṃ rātrirujāśothau ca | tiryakkṣipta ityekaṃ sandhyasthisthānaṃ tyaktvā tiryag yāti tadā tīvrapīḍāḥ syuḥ | adhogata iti | vakṣyamāṇordhvagalakṣaṇaḥ kiṃcidadhogamanamiti śeṣaḥ | ūrdhvaga iti | viṣamā rugapyasthnoratikṣiptatvāt tena dvayorapyasthnoḥ parasparātikramaṇaṃ dūrāgamanamityarthaḥ | sandhibhagna
