vidradhiśceti | vidradhiḥ prasiddhā | sā tu mūrdhanyapi bhavati bahirgatamarmāśritatvāt, asyā lakṣaṇaṃ vidradhinidāne jñātavyam | dāruṇamiti | dāruṇaṃ keśabhūmau bhavati | loke'pi phyāṃsaśabdavācyo roga viśeṣaḥ | taduktam -‘dāruṇā kaṇḍarā rūkṣā keśabhūmi: prajāyate | kaphavātaprakopeṇa vidyāddāruṇakaṃ tu tam’ iti | yadyapi kaphavātaprakopādityuktaṃ tathāpi atra pittaraktānubandho draṣṭavyaḥ | yaduktaṃ videhe - ‘yadabhrapaṭalābhāsaṃ sarajaskaṃ śirastvaci | pāruṣyaṃ jāyate jantostasya rūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ || todaiḥ samanvitaṃ vātāt sakaṇḍu gauravaṃ kaphāt | sapipāsaṃ sadāhārtirogaṃ pittāsrajaṃ tathā’ iti | piḍaketi | śirasi yāḥ piḍakā bhavanti tāḥ piḍakāḥ rogā kathitāḥ | ayameva kṣudrarogeṣu irivellikāśabdavācyaḥ| tathāhi - ‘piḍakāmuttamāṅgasthāṃ vṛttāmugrarujājvarī | sarvātmikāṃ sarvaliṅgāṃ jānīyādirivellikām’ iti | atra tu śiraḥsthitatvāt likhitā iti na doṣaḥ | arbudamiti | arbudavadarbudaṃ vraṇaviśeṣaḥ | ‘gātrapradeśe kvacideva’ ityaniyamācchirasyapi bhavati | tallakṣaṇaṃ tatraiva boddhavyam | indraluptamiti | indralupto ‘vādipurā’ śabdavācyo romaviśeṣaḥ | asyaiva paryāyakathanaṃ khālityaṃ ruk ceti | tathāhyuktam – ‘romakūpānugaṃ pittaṃ vātena saha mūrcchitam | pracyāvayati romāṇi tataḥ śleṣmā saśoṇitaḥ || ruṇaddhi romakūpāṃstu tato'nyeṣāmasaṃbhavaḥ | tadindraluptaṃ khālityaṃ ruk ceti ca vibhāvyate’ iti | atra tu indraluptakhālityayoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ kārtikācāryavacanāt | tanmate tu indraluptaṃ śmaśruṣu bhavati | khālityaṃ śirasyeva, ata eva videhavacanādindraluptaṃ strīṇāṃ na bhavati | yaduktam – ‘atyantasukumārāṅgyo rajo duṣṭaṃ sravanti ca | avyāyāmaratā yasmānnendraluptaṃ tataḥ striyāḥ’ iti | evamindraluptaṃ khalatiśca pṛthagatra nirūpitam | palitamiti | keśānā śuklabhāvena palitamityucyate | tadyathā - ‘krodhaśokaśramakṛtaḥ śarīroṣmā śirogataḥ | pittaṃ ca keśān pacati palitaṃ tena jāyate’ iti | tat palitaṃ dvividhaṃ bhavati, akālajanitaṃ kālajanitaṃ ca, atraivoktatvāt | yataḥ krodhādikṛtena vaikṛtaṃ, pittena punaḥ prākṛtaṃ palitamiti | anyathā pittoṣmaṇorabhedāt punaruktidoṣaḥ syāt | etena vaikṛtamakālajaṃ, vaya:kṛtaṃ tu pittenetyarthaḥ | kecidetaccākālajalakṣaṇaṃ manyante | anyaistribhireva doṣaḥ syāditi kathayanti, tatra śokaśramābhyāṃ janitavātena śarīroṣmaṇo vikṣepācchirogatatvaṃ tenā'nilo'pi labhyate pittaṃ ca sākṣādupāttaṃ, śleṣmā'pi keśaśuklatākaraṇako gṛhyate | etena doṣatrayasahitaḥ śarīroṣmā palitaheturiti vākyārthaḥ | yaduktaṃ carake - ‘tejonilādyaiḥ saha keśabhūmiṃ labdhvā tu kuryāt palitaṃ narasya | kiṃcittu dagdhvā palitāni kuryāddharitprabhatvaṃ ca śiroruhāṇām’ iti || 151 || 152 || Gū. atha kapālarogasaṃravyā - tathā navakapālarogāḥ syu:, te tu upaśīrṣādayaḥ || 151 || 152 || tathā netrabhavāḥ khyātāścaturnavatirāmayāḥ | teṣu vartmagadāḥ proktāścaturviṃśatisaṃjñakāḥ || 153 || kṛcchronmīlaḥ pakṣmapātaḥ kaphotkliṣṭaśca lohitaḥ | arunnimeṣaḥ kathito raktotkliṣṭaḥ kukūṇakaḥ || 154 || pakṣmārśaḥ pakṣmarodhaśca pittotkliṣṭaśca pothakī | kliṣṭavartmā ca bahalaḥ pakṣmotsaṃgastathārbudam || 155|| kumbhikā sikatāvartma lagaṇo'ñjananāmikā | kardamaḥ śyāvavartmā ca bisavartmā tathā'lajī || 156|| utkliṣṭavartmeti gadāḥ proktā vartmasamudbhavāḥ | netrasaṃdhisamudbhūtā nava rogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 157 || jalasrāvaḥ kaphasrāvo raktasrāvaśca parvaṇī | pūyasrāvaḥ krimigranthirupanāhastathā'lajī || 158 || pūyālasa iti proktā rogā nayanasaṃdhijāḥ | tathā śuklagatā rogā budhaiḥ proktāstrayodaśa || 159|| sirotpātaḥ sirāharṣaḥ sirājālaśca śuklikā | śuklārma cādhimāṃsārma prastāryarma ca piṣṭakaḥ || 160 || śirāyāścippiṭaṃ caiva kaphagrathitako'rjunaḥ | snāyvarma śoṇitārma syāditi śuklagatā gadāḥ || 161|| tathā kṛṣṇasamudbhūtāḥ pañca rogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | śuddhaśukraṃ śirāśukraṃ kṣataśukraṃ tathā'jakā || 162 || śirāsaṃgaśca sarve'pi proktā kṛṣṇagatā gadāḥ | kācaṃ tu ṣaḍvidhaṃ jñeyaṃ vātātpittātkaphādapi || 163 || sannipātācca raktācca ṣaṣṭhaṃ saṃsargasaṃbhavam | timirāṇi ṣaḍeva syurvātapittakaphaistridhā || 164 || saṃsargeṇa ca raktena ṣaṣṭhaṃ syātsaṃnipātataḥ | liṅganāśaḥ saptadhā syādvātātpittātkaphena ca || 165|| tridoṣairupasargeṇa saṃsargeṇāsṛjā tathā | aṣṭadhā dṛṣṭirogāḥ syusteṣu pittavidagdhakam || 166|| amlapittavidagdhaṃ ca tathaivoṣṇavidagdhakam | nakulāndhyaṃ dhūsarāndhyaṃ ratryāndhyaṃ hrasvadṛṣṭikaḥ || 167 || gambhīradṛṣṭirityete rogā dṛṣṭigatā matāḥ ||118 || (catvāraścādhimanthāḥ syurvātapittakaphāsrataḥ || 168) abhiṣyandāśca catvāro raktāddoṣaistribhistridhā | sarvākṣirogāścāṣṭau syusteṣu vātaviparyayaḥ || 169 || alpaśopho'nyatovātastathā pākātyayaḥ smṛtaḥ | śuṣkākṣipākaśca tathā śopho'dhyuṣita eva ca || 170|| hatādhimantha ityete rogāḥ sarvākṣisaṃbhavāḥ | Dī. tathetyanenendriyasādharmyānnāsāśravaṇādīnāmanantaraṃ netrarogagaṇanārambha ityabhiprāyaḥ | sā caturnavatisaṃkhyā-kairāmayaiḥ pratipāditā | tadyathā - ‘nava rogā netrasandhau caturviṃśativartmajāḥ | kṛṣṇabhāgagatāḥ pañca śuklabhāge trayodaśa | ṣaṭ kāce ṣaṭ ca timire aṣṭau dṛṣṭigatā matāḥ | liṅganāśāstathā sapta catvāraścādhimanthajāḥ | abhiṣyandāśca catvārastathā'ṣṭau sarvajāḥ smṛtāḥ’ ityatrācāryeṇa saṃgṛhītāḥ | suśrute tu sthānaviśeṣādeva ṣaṭsaptatiḥ kathitāḥ | yataḥ - ‘nava sandhyāśrayāsteṣu vartmajāstvekaviṃśatiḥ | śuklabhāge daśaikastu catvāraḥ kṛṣṇabhāgajāḥ || sarvāśrayāḥ saptadaśa dṛṣṭijā dvādaśaiva tu | dvau ca bāhyāśrayāvantau tvanimittanimittajau || ṣaṭsaptatirnetrarogāḥ saṃgraheṇa prakīrtitāḥ’ iti | doṣabhedenā'pi ṣaṭsaptatireva | yadāha suśrutaḥ - ‘taistribhistriṃśaduktāste kaphenābhyadhikāstrayaḥ | raktajāḥ ṣoḍaśa jñeyāḥ sarvajāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ || bāhyau punardvau ca tathā rogāḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ smṛtāḥ’ iti | atra śārṅgadharācāryeṇa yaccaturnavatisaṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tannetrarogāntarnetraroganidānatayā pratipāditatvāt | yathā sarvanetrāmayānāṃ hetubhūto'bhiṣyanda iti | taduktam - ‘vātāt pittāt kaphādraktādabhiṣyandaścaturvidhaḥ | prāyeṇa jāyate ghoraḥ sarvanetrāmayākaraḥ’ iti | suśrute'pi yathā - ‘prāyeṇa sarve nayanā''mayāste bhavantyabhiṣyandanimittamūlā:’ iti | adhimanthasyāpyabhiṣyandajanyatvam | yaduktam -‘vṛddhairetairabhiṣyandairnarāṇāmakriyāvatām | tāvantyastvadhimanthāḥ syurnayane tīvravedanā’ iti | tathaiva dṛṣṭigatarogāṇāmapi timirakācaliṅganāśāśca hetubhūtaparamparayā vyavasthitāḥ | tadyathā - ‘timiraṃ rāgatāṃ yāti rāgaḥ kācatvameti ca | kācāt saṃjāyate nīlī tadāndho jāyate naraḥ’ ityādinā | tenā'tra nidānabhūtānāṃ rogāṇāmapi saṃgrahaḥ kṛta ityadoṣaḥ | eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni vakṣyamāṇeṣu netragadeṣu darśayiṣyāmaḥ || atha caturnavatinetrarogāṇāṃ vivaraṇamāha - teṣu vartmagadā ityādi | teṣu pūrvoktacaturnavatisaṃkhyāgadeṣu vartmagadāḥ pakṣmamūlagatarogāḥ | te caturviṃśatibhedāḥ kṛcchronmīlaprabhṛtayaḥ | tadyathā kṛcchronmīla iti | yatra kṛcchreṇa mahatā kaṣṭena unmīlanamuddhāṭanaṃ bhavati | ata eva tantrāntare kuñcanaṃ nāmeti kathayanti | yathā - ‘’vātādyā vartmasaṃkocaṃ janayanti malā yadā | tadā draṣṭraṃ na śakroti kuñcanaṃ nāma tadviduḥ’ iti | pakṣmaṇāṃ śātanaṃ bhavati sa pakṣmaghāta iti kathitaḥ | tenānyatra pakṣmaśātaḥ prasiddhaḥ | yaduktam - ‘vartmapakṣmāśayagataṃ pittaṃ romāṇi śātayet | kaṇḍūṃ dāhaṃ ca kurute pakṣmaśātaṃ tamādiśet’ iti | kaphotkliṣṭa iti | kaphasyotkliṣṭatvena praklinnavartmatvaṃ janyate tena praklinnavartmeti nāmnā prasiddhaḥ | tadyathā - ‘arujaṃ bāhyataḥ śūnaṃ vartma yasya narasya hi | praklinnavartma tadvidyāt klinnamatyarthamantarā’ iti | etena cakṣuṣyeṇa pillākhyaṃ paṭhitam | yathā - ‘bhṛśaṃ praklidyate vartma kaṇḍūmanmandavedanam | vidyāt praklinnavartmeti tat pillaṃ sannipātajam’ iti | lohita iti | lohitākārāṅkuratvena yathārśastathāyamapi | ata- evānyatra śuṣkārśaḥ kathitam | tadyathā - ‘dīrghāṅkuraḥ kharaḥ stabdho dāruṇo hyantarodbhavaḥ | vyādhireṣo'bhivikhyātaḥ śuṣkārśa iti saṃjñitaḥ’ iti | nimeṣa iti nimeṣasaṃjñayā prasiddhaḥ | yataḥ - ‘nimeṣiṇīḥ sirā vāyuḥ praviṣṭo vartmasaṃśrayaḥ | cālayatyakṣivartmāni nimeṣa iti taṃ viduḥ’ iti | ayamapi videhe asādhyaḥ kathitaḥ | yaduktam -‘nimeṣiṇīḥ sirā vāyuḥ praviśya vyavatiṣṭhate | atyarthaṃ cālayedvartmanimeṣaḥ sa na siddhyati ||’ raktotkliṣṭa iti raktenotkliṣṭatvādraktārśo'nyatra pratipāditam | yathā - ‘yaḥ sthito vartmamadhye tu lohito mṛduraṅkaraḥ | tadraktajaṃ śoṇitārśaśchinnaṃ bhinnaṃ pravardhate’ iti | etadasādhyatvena videhe'pi darśitam | yathā - ‘vāyuḥ śoṇitamādāya sirāṇāṃ pramukhasthitaḥ | janayatyaṅkuraṃ tāmraṃ vartmani cchinnarohaṇam | tacchoṇitārśo'sādhyaṃ syādraktasrāvyatha nīrujam’ iti | kukūṇako'nyatra bālaroge paṭhitaḥ | bālānāmatīva sambhavatvāt | akṣigatabhāgenātra gaṇito na doṣaḥ | tadyathā - ‘kukūṇakaḥ kṣīradoṣācchiśūnāmakṣivartmani | jāyate tena tannetraṃ kaṇḍūraṃ ca sravenmuhuḥ | śiśuḥ kuryāllalāṭākṣikū- ṭanāsāvagharṣaṇam | śakto nārkaprabhāṃ draṣṭuṃ na vartmonmīlane kṣamaḥ’ iti | pakṣmārśa iti | yatra karkaṭībījasadṛśāḥ piḍakā vartmano'bhyantarbahiḥ sravanti tat pakṣmārśaḥ kathitam | tathāhi - ‘ervārubījapratimāḥ piḍakā mandavedanāḥ | ślakṣṇā: kharāśca vartmasthāstadarśovartma kīrtyate’ iti | sannipātajamidam | tathāca videhaḥ - ‘nīrujā kaṭhinā vartma pakṣmāntarbāhyato'pi vā | piḍakā sannipātena tadaśovartma kīrtyate’ iti pakṣmarodha iti | pakṣmarodho vartmabandhaḥ kathitaḥ | yatra śothayogānna yathāvannayanaṃ pidadhāti vartma eṣa sannipātajaḥ | tathāhi - ‘kaṇḍūmatālpatodena vartmaśothena yo naraḥ | na sa sat chādayedakṣi bhavedbandhaḥ sa vartmani’ iti | pittotkliṣṭa iti | utkliṣṭaṃ pittaṃ yatra sa pakṣmaprakopa iti nāmnā prasiddhaḥ | yaduktam - ‘pracālitāni vātena pakṣmāṇyakṣi viśanti hi | ghṛṣyantyakṣi muhustāni saṃrambhaṃ janayanti ca || asite ca site bhāge mūlakośāt patanti hi | pakṣmakopaḥ sa vijñeyo vyādhiḥ paramadāruṇaḥ’ iti | ayamapi sannipātajo yāpya eva | pothakīti | yatra sarṣapasadṛśāḥ piḍakā bhavanti sa pothakīśabdavācyaḥ | yathā - ‘srāviṇyaḥ kaṇḍarā gurvyo raktasarṣapasannibhāḥ | piḍakāśca rujāvantyaḥ pothakya iti tāḥ smṛtāḥ’ iti | śliṣṭavartmeti | vartmanaḥ śliṣṭatvena | aklinnavartma iti nāmāntaraṃ pakṣmaṇāmasaṃlagnatvāt | tathāhi — ‘yasya dhautānyadhautāni saṃnahyante punaḥ punaḥ | vartmānyapariklinnāni vidyādaklinnavartma tat’ iti | eke śliṣṭasthāne kliṣṭavartmeti paṭhanti | tatra kliṣṭatvaṃ vedanālpayogādavagantavyam | yataḥ - ‘mṛdvalpavedanaṃ tāmraṃ yadvartma samameva ca | akasmācca bhavedraktaṃ kliṣṭavartmeti tadviduḥ’ iti | bahala iti | yatra tvagvarṇasadṛśyaḥ piḍakā bhavanti tadbahalavarmeti saṃjñayā kathitam | tathāhi - ‘vartmopacīyate yasya piḍakābhiḥ samantataḥ | savarṇābhiḥ sthirābhiśca vidyādbahalavartma tat’ iti | pakṣmotsaṅga iti | vartmana evābhyantare upari sotsedhā piḍakā jāyate | tenotsaṅgapiḍakānyatra kathitā | yathā - ‘abhyantaramukhī tāmrā bāhyato vartmanaśca yā | sotsaṅgotsaṅgapiḍakā raktajā sthūlakaṇḍarā’ iti | iyamapi videhagadādharābhyāṃ vartmani eva jātā darśitā | yadāhatuḥ - ‘vartmotsaṅge'dhare jantoḥ saṃnipātāt prajāyate | abhyantaramukhī sthūlā bāhyataścāpi dṛśyate| piḍakā piḍakābhiśca citā'nyābhiḥ samantataḥ | utsaṅgapiḍakā nāma kaṭhinā mandavedanā | prabhinnā saṃsravet srāvaṃ kukkuṭāṇḍarasopamam’ iti | arbudamiti | vartmārbudaṃ tacca granthirūpeṇa sthitam | tadyathā - ‘vartmāntarasthaṃ viṣamaṃ granthibhūtamavedanam | ācakṣate'rbudamiti saraktamavilambitam’ iti | kumbhiketi kumbhāṇḍulatā tadbījatulyā kumbhikā vācyā | anye kumbhīkā kacchadeśodbhavā dāḍimākāraphalā | tadvījatulyapiḍakā bhidyamānā satī svayameva pūrṇodarā bhavati | yaduktam -‘vartmānte piḍakā dhmātā bhidyante ca sravanti ca | kumbhīkābījasadṛśāḥ kumbhīkā: saṃnipātajāḥ’ iti | sikatāvartmeti | sikatā śarkarā tatsadṛśābhiḥ piḍakābhiścitaṃ yadvartma bhavati tat sikatāvartmeti kathitam | tadyathā - ‘piḍakābhiḥ susūkṣmābhirghanābhirabhisaṃvṛtā | piḍakā yā kharā sthūlā sā jñeyā vartmaśarkarā iti | alagana iti | yatra vartmamūle kolapramāṇo granthiḥ sa alagana iti rogaviśeṣaḥ kathitaḥ | tathāca - ‘apākī kaṭhinaḥ sthūlo granthirvartmabhavo'rujaḥ | sakaṇḍūpicchilaḥ kolapramāṇo'lagano'stu saḥ’ iti | añjananāmiketi | vartmajā komalā yā piḍakā sā'ñjananāmiketi prasiddhā | yaduktam - ‘dāhatodavatī tāmrā piḍakā yā tu vartmajā | mṛdvī mandarujā sūkṣmā jñeyā sāṃ'ñjananāmikā’ iti | kardama iti | prāguktakliṣṭalakṣaṇameva yadā pittaṃ militaṃ punaḥ śoṇitaṃ viklinnatvamāpannaṃ bhavati sa vartmakardama iti kathitaḥ | tathāhi - ‘kliṣṭaṃ punaḥ pittayutaṃ śoṇitaṃ vidahedyadā | tataḥ klinnatvamāpannamucyate vartmakardamaḥ iti | śyāvavartmeti | śyāvatvamatra vātādhikatvena boddhavyam | ata eva vedanānvitamityuktam | tathāhi - ‘vartma tadvāhyato'ntaśca śyāvaṃ śūnaṃ savedanam | tadāhuḥ śyāvavartmeti netrarogaviśāradāḥ’ iti | agnidagdhamiva śyāvatvamityeke | tathāca nimiḥ - ‘duṣṭaśleṣmānilātpittaṃ vartmanoścīyate yadā | agnidagdhanibhaṃ śyāvaṃ śyāvavartmeti tadviduḥ’ iti | visavartmeti | bisaṃ mṛgālaṃ tacchidrākārachidrānvitaḥ śotho vartmamūle bhavati tadvisavartmeti nāma kathitam | taduktam - ‘trayo doṣā bahiḥ śothaṃ kuryuśchidrāṇi vartmano: | prasravantyantarudakaṃ visavadvisavartma tat’ iti | alajīti | yadyapyalajī vakṣyamāṇasandhigatarogeṣu darśitā tathāpyatra prasaṃgāt prasiddhiṃgatatvāt pakṣmasandhāvapi bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| yaduktam - ‘vartulākārapiḍakā sūkṣmā tāmrā ca vartmani | sarujā śoṇitotkliṣṭā dāruṇā tvalajī smṛtā’ iti | utkliṣṭavartmeti | utkliṣṭo vātastena vyāptaṃ yadvartma | ata eva tantrāntare vātahatavartma kathitam | yathā - ‘vimuktasandhi niśceṣṭaṃ vartma yasya nimīlyate | etadvātahataṃ vartma jānīyādakṣicintakaḥ’ iti | evaṃ vartmarogāścaturviśatiḥ proktāḥ || idānīṃ netrarogeṣveva sandhigatān navabhedān āha - netreti | pūrvokteṣu caturnavatinetrarogeṣu nava rogā ye sandhigatāsteṣāṃ vivaraṇaṃ likhyate | yathā - jalasrāva iti | jalasrāvo'tra pittādboddhavyaḥ | jalābhasrāvadarśanāt | tadyathā - ‘haridrābhaṃ nīlamuṣṇaṃ jalābhaṃ pittasrāvaḥ saṃsravet sandhimadhyāt’ iti | yatasa Gū. atha netrarogasaṃkhyā - iti caturviṃśativartmajāḥ | atha nava netrasaṃdhijāḥ nava nayanasaṃdhibhavā rogāste jalasrāvādayaḥ | atha trayodaśa sitabhāgagatāḥ | tathā trayodaśa rogā budhaiḥ sitabhāgagatāḥ śuklabhāgagatāḥ proktāḥ | te sirotpātādayaḥ | atha kṛṣṇagatā rogāḥ te pañca ete śuddhaśuklādayaḥ pañca kṛṣṇasamudbhūtāḥ proktāḥ | atha ṣaḍvidhakācamāha - evaṃ vātādibhiḥ ṣaḍvidhaṃ kācaṃ jñeyam | ṣaṭ timirāṇyāha - vātādibhiḥ ṣaḍeva timirāṇi rogā aṣṭāviṃśatiruktāḥ || atha sapta (saṃkhyaḥ) liṅganāśa āha - ‘liṅganāśaḥ saptadhā syātsa tu vātādibhirjñeyaḥ | upasargeṇa kasyacitsambandhena saṃsargajaḥ dvidoṣajanyaḥ | athā'ṣṭadhā dṛṣṭirogānāha - ‘aṣṭadhā dṛṣṭirogāḥ syurbhaveyuste pittavidagdhādayaḥ | atha catvāro'dhimanyāḥ, evaṃ catvāraḥ adhimanthāḥ syuḥ te vātādibhiḥ’ athābhiṣyandāḥ, evaṃ catvāra: abhiṣyandāḥ syu: te raktādibhirjñeyāḥ | atha sarvā'kṣirogā aṣṭau syu: te tu vātaviparyayādayaḥ evaṃ caturnavatirnetrarogā uktāḥ | nanu nidāne ṣaṭsaptatirnetrarogā uktā atra caturnavatīti tatkatham ? ucyate - kasmiṃcittantre adhikāḥ prāptā likhitā ato na doṣaḥ || 153-160 || puṃstvadoṣāstu pañcaiva proktāstatrerṣyakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 171 || āsekyaścaiva kumbhīkaḥ sugandhiḥ ṣaṇḍhasaṃjñakaḥ | Dī. puṃstveti | puṃstvadoṣo napuṃsakaśabdavācyaḥ | sa ca pañcaprakāro bhavati | tatrerṣyakamāha | anyavyavāyaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyavāye pravartate yaḥ sa īrṣyakaḥ | yaduktam - ‘dṛṣṭvā vyavāyamanyeṣāṃ vyavāye yaḥ pravartate | īrṣyakaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ sadā rogaviśāradaiḥ’ iti dṛgyonirapīrṣyakāparaparyāyaḥ | tathāpi tantrāntare paṭhito heturyathā - ‘īrṣyābhibhūtāvapi mandaharṣau īrṣā ratereva vadanti hetum’ iti | āsekya iti | yaḥ svabhāryayā yonyādikaṃ spṛṣṭvā saṃkalpapūrvakaṃ pravartate sa āsekyaḥ| suśrute tu - śukraṃ prāśya dhvajadārḍhyaṃ labhate yaḥ sa āsekyaḥ kathitaḥ | taduktam - ‘pitroratyalpavīryatvādāsekyaḥ puruṣo bhavet | sa śukraṃ prāśya labhate dhvajocchrāyamasaṃśayam’ iti | ata evāsekyanāmāyaṃ ṣaṇḍo mukhayonyaparaparyāyaḥ kathitaḥ | kumbhīka iti | yaḥ puruṣaḥ svakīyapāyau anyapuruṣapārśvādvyavāyaṃ kārayitvā paścāt strīṣu viṣaye pumān pravartate sa kumbhīkaḥ | suśrute - ‘sve gude'brahmacaryādyaḥ strīṣu puṃvat pravartate| kumbhīkaḥ sa tu vijñeyo rogorogaviśāradaiḥ’ iti | gudayonirayamaparaparyāyanāmnā kathitaḥ | asyotpattihetuśca tantrāntare varṇitaḥ | yathā - ‘māturvyavāyapratimena vakrī syādbījadaurbalyatayā pituśca’ ityādi | gayadāsastu kumbhīkotpattau hetumāha yathā - ‘arajaskāṃ yadā nārīṃ śleṣmalastu vrajedṛtau | anyāsaktā bhavet prītirjāyate kumbhikastadā’ iti | sugandhīti | yo yonyādigandhamāghrāya dhvajabalaṃ labhate sa sugandhīti nāma ṣaṇḍhaḥ kathitaḥ | yaduktam - ‘yaḥ pūtiyonau jāyeta sa saugandhikasaṃjñitaḥ | sa yoniśephasorgandhamāghrāya labhate balam’ iti | ayaṃ saugandhiko'pi nāsāyonyaparaparyāyaḥ | ṣaṇḍhasaṃjñita iti | yaḥ pumān stryākṛtiḥ strīceṣṭitaśca strīvadadhobhūtaḥ svameḍhrasyordhvapradeśe aparapuruṣāt vīryacyutiṃ kārayati sa ṣaṇḍhaḥ, utpattiviṣayatvāt | yaduktam - ‘yo bhāryāyāmṛtau mohādaṅganeva pravartate | tatra strīceṣṭitākāro jāyate ṣaṇḍhasaṃjñitaḥ’ iti | ayaṃ ṣaṇḍhastu aretāḥ kathitaḥ | īrṣyakādayaścatvāraḥ saretasa ityuktatvāt | tathāhi - ‘āsekyaśca sugandhī ca kumbhīkaścerṣyakastathā | saretasastvamī jñeyā aśukraḥ ṣaṇḍhasaṃjñitaḥ || 171 || Gū. atha pañca puṃstvadoṣānāha - puṃstvadoṣāḥ pañcaiva syuste īrṣyakādayaḥ, eṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni śārīre proktāni || 171|| śukradoṣāstathāṣṭau syurvātātpittātkaphena ca || 172|| kuṇapaṃ cāsrapittābhyāṃ pūyābhaṃ śleṣmapittataḥ | kṣīṇaṃ ca vātapittābhyāṃ granthilaṃ śleṣmavātataḥ|| 173|| malābhaṃ saṃnipātācca śukradoṣā itīritāḥ | Dī. doṣairduṣṭaṃ śukraṃ śukradoṣa ityucyate | tadyuktāḥ puruṣā garbhotpattau na kṣamā iti | prayojanaṃ suśrutavacanāt | yataḥ -‘vātapittaśleṣmakuṇapagranthipūtipūyakṣīṇamūtrapurīṣaretasaḥ prajotpādane na samarthā bhavanti’ iti | tatra śukraṃ yadā aruṇakṛṣṇavarṇaṃ bhavati todabhedanaviśeṣānvitaṃ ca bhavati tadvātaduṣṭam | pittaduṣṭaṃ tu pītanīlādivarṇānvitaṃ oṣacoṣavedanāviśeṣayuktaṃ ca | kaphaduṣṭaṃ ca śvetavarṇaṃ kaṇḍvādivedanānvitaṃ ca | kuṇapaṃ cāsrapittābhyāmiti | kuṇapaḥ śavaḥ, tasyeva gandho yasya śukrasya bhavati | so'pi raktena pittena bhavati | analpaṃ ca bhavati | cakārāt śoṇitavarṇaṃ pittavedanaṃ ca | suśrute tvayaṃ raktaja ityuktaḥ, yataḥ - ‘kuṇapagandhyanalpaṃ ca raktena’ iti | atra rakteneti vyapadeśo ghṛtatailadagdhavat | yato raktasyāpi doṣā eva pradūṣayitāraḥ | tenātra asrapittābhyāmiti grahaṇaṃ na doṣaḥ | pūyābhaṃ śleṣmapittayoreva iti | pittaśleṣmabhyāṃ yaddūṣitaṃ taddhaṭitaṃ pūyasadṛśaṃ śukraṃ bhavati | varṇavedanāścātra militaśleṣmapi- ttayoreva boddhavyā: | kṣīṇaṃ ca vātapittābhyāmiti | kāraṇaiḥ svamānādalpībhūtam | lakṣaṇaṃ ca yathā - ‘daurbalyaṃ mukhaśoṣaśca pāṇḍutvaṃ sadanaṃ bhramaḥ | klaivyaṃ śukravisargaśca kṣīṇaśukrasya lakṣaṇam’ iti | granthilaṃ śleṣmavātata iti | granthilasadṛśaṃ granthilaṃ tat śleṣmavātajanitaṃ bhavati | atrāpi dvidoṣavarṇavedanā boddhavyā | malābhaṃ sannipātācceti | malaṃ mūtrapurīṣam, tadābhaṃ tadgandhi ca yat śukraṃ bhavati tat sannipātadūṣitam | suśrute'pi - ‘mūtrapurīṣagandhisannipātena’ iti | iti pūrvoktaprakāreṇa śukradoṣā īritāḥ kathitāḥ || 172 || || 173 || Gū. athā'ṣṭau śukradoṣāḥ - tathā tena prakāreṇa aṣṭau śukradoṣāḥ syuḥ te vātāderbhedato jñeyāḥ, eṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni śārīre nidāne vā proktāni || 172 || 173 || atha strīroganāmāni procyante pūrvaśāsrataḥ ||174|| aṣṭāvārtavadoṣāḥ syurvātapittakaphaistridhā | pūyābhaṃ kuṇapaṃ granthi kṣīṇaṃ malasamaṃ tathā || 175 || tathā ca raktapradaraṃ caturvidhamudāhṛtam | vātapittakaphaistredhā caturthaṃ saṃnipātaḥ || 176 || Dī. strīrogetyādi | strīṣu bhavā rogāḥ strīrogāḥ | teṣāṃ puruṣeṣu na sambhavatvāt | pūrvaśāstrata iti munivacanāt | teṣvādau ārtavadoṣānāha - ‘aṣṭau cārtavadoṣāḥ syu’rityādi | doṣairduṣṭamārtavaṃ ca vīryavadbhavatītiprayojanaścakāraḥ | yaduktaṃ suśrute - ‘ārtavamapi tribhirdoṣaiḥ śoṇitacaturthai: pṛthagdvandvai: samastaiścopasṛṣṭamabījaṃ bhavati’ iti | eteṣāṃ doṣavarṇavedanādibhirvijñānopāyaṃ kathitāṣṭaśukradoṣe jñātavyam || tathā raktapradaramityādi | tathetyanenārtavameva kāraṇamasṛgdarasyeti bhāvaḥ sūcitaḥ | yaduktam - ‘tadevātiprasaṅgena pravṛttamanṛtāvapi | asṛgdaraṃ vijānīyādato'nyadraktalakṣaṇam’ iti | sāmānyalakṣaṇamapi yathā – ‘asṛgdaro bhavet sarvaḥ sāṅgamardaḥ savedanaḥ’ iti | ārtavātipravṛttitvenāsṛgdaraḥ,tasmāttasyātisrutasya lakṣaṇāni | yathā -‘tasyātivṛttau daurbalyaṃ bhramo mūrcchā madastṛṣā | dāhaḥ pralāpaḥ pāṇḍutvaṃ tandrā rogāśca vātajāḥ’ iti | tasya saṃkhyāścatuḥprakārā bhavanti | vātapittakaphairityādi | tatra vātikamāha - ‘rūkṣāruṇaṃ phenilamalpamalpaṃ vātāt satodaṃ piśitodakābham’ iti | pittajamāha - ‘sapītanīlāsitaraktamuṣṇaṃ pittārtiyuktaṃ mṛśavegi pittāt’ iti | kaphajamāha - ‘āmaṃ sapicchāpratimaṃ sapāṇḍu pulākatoyapratimaṃ kaphāttu’ hati | tridoṣajamāha - ‘sakṣaudrasarpirharitālavarṇaṃ majjaprakāśaṃ kuṇapaṃ tridoṣāt’ ityādi || 174-176 || Gū. atha strīrogasaṃkhyā - atha strīroganāmāni procyante, kutaḥ ? pūrvaśāstrataḥ | teṣāṃ vivaraṇaṃ kriyate, aṣṭau ārtavadoṣāste vātādibhirjñeyāḥ, tathā raktapradaraṃ caturvidhaṃ udāhṛtaṃ kathitaṃ tribhirvātādyaiḥ sannipātenaikaśca ||174-176 || viṃśatiryonirogāḥ syarvātātpittātkaphādapi | saṃnipātācca raktācca lohitakṣayatastathā ||177|| śuṣkā ca vāminī caiva khaṇḍitāntarmukhī tathā | sūcīmukhī viplutā ca putraghnī ca pariplutā || 178|| upaplutā prākcaraṇā mahāyoniśca karṇinī | svānnandā cāticaraṇā yonirogā itīritāḥ ||179|| Dī. yonau bhavā rogā yonirogāḥ kathitāḥ | te duṣṭārtavavīryadoṣādinā janitāḥ | tathāhi - ‘viṃśatirvyāpado yonau nirdiṣṭā rogasaṃgrahe | mithyācāreṇa tāḥ strīṇāṃ praduṣṭenārtavena ca | jāyante bījadoṣācca daivādvā śṛṇu tāḥ pṛthak’ iti | tatra viśeṣalakṣaṇāttāsvādau vātalāmāha - vātasya pṛthag vidhānaṃ vātavedanāprādurbhāvārthaṃ, yatra tantrāntare udāvṛttāvandhyāviplutāsu vātānubandhitvam | yaduktam - ‘catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu bhavantyanilavedanāḥ’ iti | evaṃ pittānubandhinyo raktakṣayā vaminī prasraṃsinī putraghnī ceti catasraḥ pittalayā saha pañca paittalyaḥ | yaduktam-‘catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu pittaliṅgocchrayo bhavet’ iti | evaṃ śleśmānubandhinyo'tyānandā karṇinī acaraṇā'ticaraṇāścatasraḥ śleṣmalayā saha pañca vijñeyāḥ | yataḥ - ‘catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu śleṣmaliṅgocchryo bhavet’ iti | evaṃ sannipātajāḥ pañca vijñeyāḥ | ṣaṇḍī, aṇḍalī, vivṛtā, sūcivakrā iti | catasraḥ sannipātajayā saha pañca | yataḥ - ‘pañcāsādhyā bhavantīha yonayaḥ sarvadoṣajāḥ’ iti | evaṃ suśrutoktatvācca doṣānubandhitvaṃ darśitam | atra vyastagaṇanāsaṃgrahatvena pṛthaksvarūpamadhunā vidhīyate | tadyathā - vātāditi | vātānvitā vātalā yonirbhavati | tathāhi ‘vātalā karkaśā stabdhā śūlanistodapīḍitā’ iti | pittāditi | pittānvitā pittalā yoniḥ | yathā-‘atyarthaṃ pittalā yonirdāhapākajvarānvitā’ ityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena nīlapītasitārtavā bhavantītyavagantavyam | tathāca tantrāntare - ‘vyāpallavaṇakaṭvamlakṣārādyaiḥ pittajā bhavet | dāhapākajvaroṣmārtā nīlapītasitānvitā’ iti | kaphānvitā śleṣmalā yoniḥ | taduktam - ‘śveṣmalā picchilā yoni: kaṇḍūgrastātiśītalā’ iti | atiśītaletyupalakṣaṇam, tena savedanādikatvamapi boddhavyam | yaduktaṃ tantrāntare - ‘kapho'bhiṣyandibhirvṛddho yoniṃ ceddūṣayet striyāḥ | sa kuryāt picchilāṃ śītāṃ kaṇḍūgrastāṃ savedanām? iti | sannipātāditi militadoṣatrayadūṣitā yonirbhavati | tathāhi - ‘sarvaliṅgasamutthānā yatra sā sannipātajā’ iti | raktācceti raktadūṣitā | yadyapi raktapittānubandhinī yugapat paṭhitā tathāpyatra raktasyātisravaṇādraktajeti vyapadeśaḥ | tasmādiha raktajā sraṃsinī kathitetyabhiprāyaḥ | tadyathā - ‘prasraṃsinī sraṃsate tu kṣobhitā duṣprajāyinī’ iti | lohitakṣayato lohitakṣayā kathitā | tathāhi - ‘sadāhaṃ kṣīyate raktaṃ yasyāṃ sā lohitakṣayā’ iti | śuṣkā ceti | śuṣkā naṣṭārtavā kathitā | śuṣkaṃ vandhyamārtavaṃ yasyā bhavati sā | ata eva tantrāntare vandhyāyoniḥ ‘vandhyā naṣṭārtavā jñeyā’ ityādivacanāt | vāminī ceti | yā rajasā yutaṃ savātaṃ bījamudgiret sā vāminī | yathā - ‘savātamudgiredbījaṃ vāminī rajasā'nvitam’ | khaṇḍiteti | arajaskā bhavati | tathāhi - ‘anārtavā'stanī ṣaṇḍī kharasparśā ca maithune’ iti | antarmukhīti | bṛhanmehanapuruṣeṇa gṛhītā yā taruṇā khaṇḍinī bhavet (sā atarmukhī) (aṇḍavannisṛtā yonirityeke | tatrāṇḍalīśabdavācyā | yataḥ - ‘atikāyagṛhītāyāstaruṇyāstvaṇḍalī bhavet’ iti |) sūcīmukhīti atiśayaṃ sūcīvat saṃkīrṇamukhī - ‘sūcīvakrātisaṃvṛtā’ ityādivacanāt | viplutā ceti | ‘viplutā nityavedanā’ ityādinā vātajanitatodādivedanāyuktetyarthaḥ | putraghnī ceti | tathāhi - ‘sthitaṃ sthitaṃ hanti garbhaṃ putraghnī raktasaṃkṣayāt’ iti | yadyapi sarvāpatyavināśinī tathāpyatra putrasya prādhānyāt putraghnīti vyapadeśaḥ | paripluteti saṃjñā | yaduktam - ‘pariplutāyāṃ bhavati grāmyadharme rujā bhṛśam’ iti | upapluteti | vāyorūrdhvamupaplutatvāt | tantrāntare udāvarteti saṃjñā | yaduktam - ‘sā phenilamudāvartā rajaḥ kṛcchreṇa muñcati’ iti | mahāyoniriti | ativivṛtamukhatvānmahāyoniḥ kathitā| yataḥ - ‘vivṛtātimahāyoniḥ’ ityādi | karṇinīti | māṃsakandarākāro granthi: karṇinī kathitā | yataḥ - karṇinyāṃ karṇiko yonau śleṣmā'sṛgbhyāṃ prajāyate’ iti | atyānandeti | ‘atyānandā na saṃtoṣaṃ grāmyadharmeṇa gacchati’ iti | aticaraṇeti | ‘bahuśaścarāticaraṇā tayorbījaṃ na vindati’ iti | tayoracaraṇāticaraṇayoḥ | evaṃ yonidoṣā īritāḥ kathitāḥ || 177-179 || Gū. atha yonirogāḥ - viṃśati syuste vātādergaṇitā jñeyāḥ, evaṃ dvātriṃśat strīrogāḥ ||177-179 || caturvidhaṃ yonikandaṃ vātapittakaphaistridhā | caturthaṃ saṃnipātena - Dī. yonisaṃśritatvādviṃśatitamayonibhedādyonikando'pītyekaḥ pṛthak, doṣabhedena nāmasaṃgrahatvāt pṛthagatra paṭhitaḥ | yonau lakucākāraṃ kandamutpadyate tadyonikandamiti | lakucaṃ cātra nāraṅgaphalam | tadyathā - ‘pūyaśoṇitasaṃkāśaṃ lakucākṛtisannibham | utpadyate yadā yonau nāmnā kandaḥ sa yonija:’ iti | asya vātādivikṛtilakṣaṇamāha | vātajaṃ yathā - ‘rukṣaṃ vivarṇaṃ sphuṭitaṃ vātikaṃ tadvinirdiśet’ iti | paittikamāha - ‘dāharāgajvarakaraṃ vidyāt pittātmakaṃ tu tat’ iti | ślaiṣmikamāha - ‘nīlapuṣpapratīkāśaṃ kaṇḍūmantaṃ kaphātmakam’ iti | nīlapuṣpavarṇatā ca kaphaje'pi roga- prabhāvāt | anye cainaṃ pittaliṅgasaṃbaddhamāhuriti | sāṃnipātikaṃ yathā - ‘sarvaliṅgasamāyuktaṃ sannipātātmakaṃ vadet’ iti || Gū. strīrogeṣveva yonikandasaṃkhyāmāha - vātādibhiścaturvidhaṃ yonikandaṃ bhavatīti yojanā || tathāṣṭau garbhajā gadāḥ || 180 || upaviṣṭakagarbhaḥ syāttathā nāgodaraḥ smṛtaḥ | makkallo mūḍhagarbhaśca viṣkambho gūḍhagarbhakaḥ || 181 || jarāyudoṣo garbhasya pātaścāṣṭamakaḥ smṛtaḥ | Dī. śukraśoṇitaṃ gārbhāśayasthamātmaprakṛtivikārasaṃmūrcchitaṃ garbha ityucyate | tatsambhavā vikārā garbhajā gadā vācyāḥ | te'ṣṭaprakārā bhavanti | upaviṣṭakagarbhaḥ syādityādi | raktaparisrutinimittopaviṣṭakasaṃjñayā garbhavikṛtiḥ kathitā | taduktaṃ carake - ‘yasyāḥ punaruṣṇatīkṣṇopayogādgarbhiṇyā mahati jātasāre garbhe puṣpadarśanaṃ yonisrāvāt tasyā garbho vṛddhiṃ na prāgnoti, kālāntaramupatiṣṭhate, saspandanaśca bhavati tamupaviṣṭakamityācakṣate iti | nāgodara iti | nāgabandha iva sthitiryasya garbhasya bhavatītyeke | suśrute - tannāgodaralakṣaṇaṃ yathā - ‘śukraśoṇitaṃ vāyunābhipannamavakrāntajīvamādhmāyatyudaraṃ tat kadācit yadṛcchayopaśāntaṃ naigameṣāpahṛtamiti bhāṣante | tameva kadācit pravilīyamānaṃ nāgodaramityāhuḥ’ | makkalla iti | makkallo raktamārutajaḥ śūlaviśeṣaḥ | sa dvividho bhavati| eko garbhāvasthāyāṃ, aparaḥ sūtikāvasthāyām iti | tadyathā - ‘mānasāgantubhirupatāpaiḥ prapīḍito yo garbhaḥ kukṣau vedanāṃ janayati sa garbhamakkalla: | yatra prakupito vāyuḥ sūtayā rudhiramatyantaṃ saṃrudhya hṛcchirobastiśūlaṃ karoti sa prasūtimakkalla iti | tantrāntare yonisaṃvaraṇo'yaṃ rogaviśeṣaḥ kathitaḥ | yaduktam - ‘vātalānyannapānāni grāmyadharmaṃ prajāgaram | atyarthaṃ sevamānāyāṃ garbhiṇyāṃ yonimārgagaḥ || mātariśvā prakupito yonidvārasya saṃvṛtim | kurute ruddhamārgatvāt punarantargato'nilaḥ || niruṇaddhyāśayadvāraṃ pīḍayan garbha( nābhi )saṃsthitim || niruddhavacanocchvāso garbhaścāśu vipadyate || rujā saṃruddhahṛdayāṃ nāśayatyāśu garbhiṇīm | yonisaṃvaraṇaṃ vidyādvyādhimetaṃ sudāruṇam’ iti | mūḍhagarbhaśceti | mūḍho vyāsaktagatiḥ pavano mūḍhagarbhaṃ karoti | yonijaṭharādiṣu śūlaṃ karotītyabhiprāyaḥ | tathāhi - ‘mūḍhaḥ karoti pavanaḥ khalu mūḍhagarbhaṃ śūlaṃ ca yonijaṭharādiṣu mūtrasaṅgam’ ityādi | viguṇānilayogādadṛśyāsaṃkhyeyatvamāhureke, tasmādatra eka eva paṭhitaḥ | tadyathā - ‘bhugno'nilena viguṇena tataḥ sa garbhaḥ saṃkhyāmatītya bahudhā samupaiti yonim’ ityādi | keṣāṃcinmate tatra vyavahārayogyā aṣṭau prakārāḥ kathitāḥ | tadyathā - ‘dvāraṃ nirudhya śirasā jaṭhareṇa kaścit kaściccharīraparivartitakubjadehaḥ | ekena kaścidaparastu bhujadvayena tiryaggato bhavati kaścidavāṅmukho'nyaḥ || pārśvāpravṛttagatireti tathaiva kaścidityaṣṭadhā gatiriyaṃ hyaparā caturdhā’ iti | saṃkīlakādibhedena catuḥprakārān punarāhureke | tadyathā - ‘saṃkīlakaḥ pratikhuraḥ parigho'tha bījasteṣūrdhvabāhucaraṇaiḥ śirasā ca yonau | saṅgī ca yo bhavati kīlakavat sa kīlo dṛśyaiḥ khuraiḥ pratikhuraḥ sa hi kāyasaṅgī || gacchedbhujadvayaśirāḥ sa ca bījakākhyo yonau sthitaḥ saparigha: parigheṇa tulyaḥ’ iti | tantrāntare'pi kīlakādīnāṃ lakṣaṇam | yathā - ‘ūrdhvabāhuśiraḥpādai rundhyādyonimukhaṃ tu yaḥ | pratikīlopamasthityā sa kīla iti saṃjñitaḥ | adhastāt pārśvato vāpi tathaivākuñcito'pi vā | yo niḥsṛtya mukhaṃ yonerjñeyaḥ pratikhurastu saḥ || yonidvārātta nurgacchedyaścaikāṅghriśirobhujaḥ | tamāhurbījakaṃ nāma mūḍhagarbhacikitsakāḥ || yonimāvṛtya yastiṣṭhet parigho gopuraṃ yathā | tathāntargarbhamāyāntaṃ vidyāt parighasaṃjñitam’ iti | viṣkambha iti | viṣkambha iva viṣkambhaḥ, mārgāvarodhāt tiṣṭhati ityabhiprāyaḥ | sa tu vātābhipannagarbhasya śoṣaṇānmātuḥ kukṣiṃ na pūrayati, mandaṃ spandate ca | ata eva vṛddhakāśyapena śuṣkalakṣaṇaṃ vihitam | yathā - ‘garbhanāḍyāstu vahanādaplavatvādrasasya ca | cireṇāpyāyate garbhastathaivākālayojanāt | akukṣipūraṇo garbho mandaspandana eva ca’ iti | mūḍhagarbha iti | līnagarbhaḥ kathitaḥ | tathāca suśrutaḥ - ‘vātopadravagṛhītatvāt srotasāṃ vīyate garbhaḥ so'tikālamavatiṣṭhamāno vyāpadyate’ iti | jarāyudoṣa iti | vikṛtajarāyuṇā chādanaṃ jarāyudoṣaḥ | jarāyurgarbhasyāveṣṭanarūpaścarmaviśeṣaḥ | ‘jarāyuṇā mukhe cchanne’ ityādidarśanāt | arthādgarbhaśayyāyāṃ sthito yo bālastasyopari veṣṭitolpavikāratvājjarāyudoṣa ityabhiprāyaḥ | garbhaśayyā ca prasaṅgato yathā - ‘śaṅkhanābhyākṛtiryonistryāvartā sā ca kīrtitā | tasyāstṛtīye tvāvarte garbhaśayyā pratiṣṭhitā || yathā rohitamatsyasya mukhaṃ bhavati rūpataḥ| tatsaṃsthānāṃ tathā rūpāṃ garbhaśayyāṃ vidurbudhāḥ’ iti | pāta iti | garbhasya pāto'ṣṭamo bhedaḥ | sa dvividhaḥ, ekaḥ srāvarūpaḥ, ’aparaḥ pātarūpaḥ | tathāhi - ‘ācaturthāttato māsāt prasavedgarbhavidravaḥ | tataḥ sthi(ta)raśarīrasya pātaḥ pañcamaṣaṣṭhayoḥ’ iti| atighanāvayavatvena viśeṣeṇa dravarūpatayā garbhavidravaḥ kathyate | yaduktaṃ bhoje - ‘ātṛtīyādyato māsāt garbhaḥ sravati śoṇitam | ūrdhvaṃ saṃghātabhūtastu garbhaḥ patati yoṣitām’ iti | viguṇapavane tu saptamādimāseṣvapi pāta iti kecit | yataḥ -‘garbho'bhighātaviṣamāśanapīḍanādyai: pakvaṃ drumādiva phalaṃ patati kṣaṇena’ iti || 180 || || 181 || Gū. aṣṭau garbharogā bhavanti tānāha - upaviṣṭakādayo'ṣṭau garbharogāḥ || 180 || || 181 || pañcaiva stanarogāḥ sturvātātpittātkaphādapi || 182|| saṃnipātātkṣatāccaiva tathā stanyodbhavā gadāḥ | bālarogeṣu kathitāḥ strīdoṣāśca trayaḥsmṛtāḥ|| 183|| adakṣapuruṣotpanna: sapatnīvihitastathā | daivājjātastṛtīyastu tathā ye sūtikāgadāḥ || 184|| jvarādayaścikitsyāste yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam | Dī. pañcaiveti | stanayorbhavā rogāḥ stanarogāḥ, te ca śothādirūpā ityarthaḥ | yaduktam - ‘sakṣīrau vāpyadugdhau vā doṣaḥ prāpya stanau striyāḥ | pradūṣya māṃsarudhire stanarogāya kalpate’ iti | ata eva teṣāṃ vātapittakaphasaṃnipātāgantujānāṃ lakṣaṇāni raktajanyavidradhiṃ vinā bāhyavidradhivajjñātavyāni | tathācoktam -‘pañcānāmapi teṣāṃ hi raktajaṃ vidradhiṃ vinā | lakṣaṇāni samānāni bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaiḥ iti | tathā stanyodbhavā gadā iti | tathetyanena yathā stanarogā doṣabhedena pañcasaṃkhyakā uktāstathaiva doṣabhedena kṣīrabhedā iti tātparyārthaḥ| stanyaṃ kṣīraṃ, tatsvarūpaṃ ca suśrutenoktam - ‘rasaprasādo madhuraḥ pakvāhāranimittajaḥ | kṛtsnadehāt stanau prāptaḥ stanyamityabhidhīyate’ iti | vātādīnāṃ bhedāḥ keṣāṃcidbodhanārthaṃ likhyante yathā - ‘kaṣāyaṃ salilaplāvi stanyaṃ mārutakopataḥ | kaṭvamlalavaṇaṃ pītarājīmatpittasaṃyutam || kaphaduṣṭaṃ ghanaṃ toye nimajjati supicchilam | dviliṅgaṃ dvandvajaṃ vidyāt triliṅgaṃ sāṃnipātikam’ iti || evaṃ doṣadūṣitāt stanyāt gadā rogā utpadyante | yaduktam -‘gurubhirvividhairannairduṣṭairdoṣaiḥ pradūṣitam | kṣīraṃ dhātryāḥ kumārasya nānārogāya kalpate’ iti | ata eva tānrogānkṣīrālasādīn bālarogeṣu darśayiṣyāmaḥ | strīdoṣāśca trayaḥ smṛtā ityādi | strīṇāṃ duḥkhajanakāḥ strīdoṣāḥ, ‘tadduḥkhasaṃyogā vyādhaya’ ityupadarśanāt | te trayaḥ | adakṣapuruṣotpanna iti| nijāhārādyarjane'pyasamarthaḥ tenotpannaṃ duḥkhamiti bhāvaḥ | sapatnīvihita iti | strīṇāṃ sapatnībhāvo'tīva duḥkhakaro vihitaḥ vipakṣastatvāt | ‘pṛthakśayyā ca nārīṇāmaśastravadha ucyate’ itivacanāt | daivājjāta iti | duḥkhakara iti śeṣaḥ | daivaṃ bhāgadheyaṃ tajjātaḥ sahagamanaprabhṛtika ityabhiprāyaḥ | tathā ye sūtikāgadā ityādi | prasūtiviṣaye bhavā ye rogāste sūtikāgadāḥ kathitāḥ | tadyathā - ‘jvarātisāraśothaśca śūlanāhabalakṣayāḥ | tandrāruciprasekādyāḥ kaphavātāmayodbhavāḥ || kṛcchrasādhyā hi te rogāḥ kṣīṇamāṃsabalāgnitaḥ | te sarve sūtikānāmnā rogāste cāpyupadravāḥ’ iti | ete sūtikārogatvena lakṣaṇāntarā ityarthaḥ, upadravatvāt | sūtikāyāṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ ca suśrutenoktaṃ yathā - ‘aṅgamardo jvaraḥ kāsaḥ pipāsā gurugātratā | śothaḥ śūlātisārau ca sūtikārogalakṣaṇam’ iti| evaṃ strīrogāḥ pradarśitāḥ ||182-184|| Gū. atha stanarogāḥ - stanarogā: pañcadhā syuḥ | te vātāderjāyante | tathā stanyodbhavā dugdhodbhavāḥ, teṣu tatrādau strīdoṣāstrayastānāha - bālarogeṣu trayaḥ strīdoṣāḥ te | anye jvarādayo'pi bālarogāḥ || 182-184 || dvāviṃśatirbālarogāsteṣu kṣīrālasāstrayaḥ ||185 || vātātpittātkaphāccaiva dantodbhedaścaturthakaḥ | dantaghāto dantaśabdo'kāladanto'hipūtanam 186 || mukhapāko mukhasrāvo gudapākopaśīrṣakau | pārśvaruṇastālukaṇṭo vicchinnaṃ pārigarbhikaḥ ||187|| daurbalyaṃ gātraśoṣaśca śayyāmūtraṃ kukūṇakaḥ | rodanaṃ cājagallī syāditi dvāviṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ ||188|| Dī. atha bālarogānāha - dvāviṃśatiriti | bālake bhavā rogā bālarogāḥ | āṣoḍaśādbālaḥ | sa trividhaḥ | kṣīrapaḥ, kṣīrānnādaḥ, annāda iti | eteṣu bhavā rogā bālarogaśabdavācyāḥ | yataḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣaparyantaṃ bālagrahacikitsā dṛśyate | teṣviti | dvāviṃśatisaṃkhyeṣu | trayaḥ kṣīrālasā iti doṣadūṣitastanyajanitā rogaviśeṣāḥ | ata eva vātāt pittāt kaphāditi grahaṇam | tadyathā - ‘vātaduṣṭaṃ śiśuḥ stanyaṃ piban vātagadāturaḥ | kṣāmasvaraḥ kṛśāṅgaḥ syādbaddhaviṇmūtramārutaḥ’ iti | pittaduṣṭamāha - ‘svinno bhinnamalo bālaḥ kāmalāpāṇḍurogavān | tṛṣṇāluruṣṇasarvāṅgaḥ pittaduṣṭaṃ payaḥ piban’ iti | kaphaduṣṭalakṣaṇamāha - ‘kaphaduṣṭaṃ piban kṣīraṃ lālāluḥ śleṣmarogavān| nidrānvito jaḍaḥ śūnavakrākṣaśchardanaḥ śiśuḥ’ iti | evaṃ trayaḥ kṣīrālasāḥ kathitāḥ | dantānāmudbheda utpattiḥ | sa ca sarveṣāṃ rogāṇāṃ kāraṇam | tadyathā - ‘dantodbhedaśca rogāṇāṃ sarveṣāmapi kāraṇam | viśeṣājjaraviḍ- bhedakāsacchardiśirorujām’ iti | anyatrāpyuktam - ‘pṛṣṭhabhaṅge biḍālānāṃ barhiṇāṃ ca śikhodgame | dantodbhede ca bālānāṃ nahi kiṃcittu dūṣaṇam’ iti | dantaghāta iti | dantaghāto dantapātaḥ kathitaḥ | sa dvidhā bhavati | ekaḥ samayodbhavaḥ apara āghātajanitaḥ | tāvapi bāladuḥkhakarāviti prayojanam | dantaśabda iti | dantagharṣaṇaṃ viśeṣeṇa svapnāvasthāyāṃ bhavati, kaphajanyadantaharṣanimittatvāt | bālye'tīva kaphāmayā bhavanti | tena bālaroge dantaśabdaḥ kathitaḥ | akāladanta iti | akāladantotthānenāniṣṭhatvādbalānāṃ duḥkhakara ityarthaḥ | ahipūtanamiti | ahipūtanamanyatra kṣudrarogeṣu paṭhitam | atra bālasaṃbhavatvādbālaroge likhitaḥ | tadyathā - ‘śakṛnmūtrasamāyukte'dhaute'pāne śiśorbhavet | svinne vā snāpyamāne vā kaṇḍū raktakaphodbhavā | kaṇḍūyanāttataḥ kṣipraṃ sphoṭaḥ srāvaśca jāyate | ekībhūtaṃ vraṇe ghoraṃ taṃ vidyādahipūtanam’ iti | bhoje punaridaṃ duṣṭastanyapānādityapi paṭhitam | yaduktam - ‘duṣṭastanyasya pānena malasyākṣālanena ca | kaṇḍūdāharujāvadbhiḥ piḍakābhiḥ samanvitā || saṃbhavettu yathādoṣaṃ dāruṇā hyahipūtanā’ iti | mukhapāka iti | mukhasya pāko mukhapākaḥ | sa tu doṣaviśeṣādbhavati bālake'pyatīva prasiddhatvāt | mukhasrāva iti prasiddhaḥ, lālāstrāva ityarthaḥ | gudapākaṃ iti | so'pi vikṛtadoṣasvabhāvādbhavatīti, bālake'tīva pratītiḥ gurupāka iti prasiddhaḥ | upaśīrṣakamāha | kapālaroge vraṇaviśeṣa upaśīrṣakaśabdavācyaḥ | athavā padmanāmānaṃ visarpamāhureke | yaduktam - ‘visarpastu śiśoḥ prāṇanāśano bastiśīrṣajaḥ | padmavarṇo mahāpadmo rogo doṣatrayodbhavaḥ’ iti | pārśvāruṇo mahāpadmamedaḥ | tatra lohitapadmavarṇaḥ | padmavarṇatā mukhatāluni bahirdeśeṣu iti vadanti kecit | tālukaṇṭa iti | kaṇṭakākāratvena tālukaṇṭakam | tadyathā kaphaḥ kuddhaḥ kurute tālukaṇṭakam | tena tālupradeśasya nimnatā mūrdhni jāyate’ iti | vicchinnamiti | vicchinnamanyatra gataṃ tālupātamiti nāmnā pratītam | tathāhi - ‘tālupātāt stanadveṣaḥ kṛcchrātpānaṃ śakṛddravam | tṛḍakṣikaṇṭhāsyarujā grīvādurvahatā vami:’ iti | pārigarbhika iti | tathāhi - ‘mātuḥ kumāro garbhiṇyāḥ stanyaṃ prāyaḥ pibannapi | kāsāgnisādavamathu tandrākārśyārucibhramaiḥ || yujyate koṣṭhavṛddhyā ca tamāhuḥ pārigarbhikam | rogaṃ paribhavākhyaṃ ca yuñjyāttatrāgnidīpanam’ || iti | daurbalyamiti durbalatvam| bālakasya satataṃ balahānirityarthaḥ | hataujā ityapare | gātraśoṣa iti | gātrakṣamatā bālasya doṣaprabhāvādbhavati | śayyāmūtraṃ prasiddham | rātrau svaprāvasthāyāṃ śayyāgato bālo'kṣīṇapūrvakaṃ mūtrayati doṣaprabhāvāt | kukūṇaka iti | bālasya netravartmagataḥ kukūṇakākhyo rogaḥ | tadyathā -‘kukūṇakaḥ kṣīradoṣāt śiśūnāmakṣivartmani | jāyate tena tannetraṃ kaṇḍūraṃ ca sravenmuhuḥ | śiśuḥ kuryāllalāṭā- kṣikūṭanāsāvagharṣaṇam | śakto nārkaprabhāṃ draṣṭuṃ na vartmonmīlanakṣamaḥ’ iti | ayameva kothuyeti loke | rodana- miti | rodanaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ śiśuvyādhīnāṃ ca sūcakaṃ bhavati | yataḥ - ‘śiśostīvrāmatīvrāṃ ca rodanāllakṣayevrujam | sa yaṃ spṛśedbhṛśaṃ deśaṃ yatra ca sparśanākṣamaḥ || tatra vidyādrujaṃ, mūrdhni rujaṃ cākṣinimīlanāt | koṣṭhe vibandhavamathustanadaṃśāntrakūjanaiḥ || ādhmānapṛṣṭhanamanajaṭharonnamanairapi | bastau guhye ca viṇmūtrasaṃgatrāsadigīkṣaṇaiḥ | srotāṃsyahāni saṃdhīṃśca paśyedyattanmuhurmuhuḥ’ iti | tīvrāṃ rujaṃ ca bahurodanāt, atīvrāmalparodanā- llakṣayedbālānāmeva duṣṭastanyapānādineti | ajagallīti | prāyeṇa bālānāmanyeṣāmapi ajagallikā bhavati | tadyathā - ‘snigdhāḥ savarṇāḥ prathitā nīrujā mudrasannibhāḥ | kaphavātotthitā jñeyā bālānāmajagallikāḥ’ iti | iti dvāviṃśatiḥ smṛtā iti | iti kathitaprakāreṇa bālārogā dvāviṃśatiḥ proktāḥ || 185-188 || Gū. atha bālarogāḥ tathā bālagrahāḥ khyātā dvādaśaiva munīśvaraiḥ | skandagraho viśākhaḥ syātsvagrahaśca pitṛgrahaḥ || 189|| naigameyagrahastadvacchakuni: śītapūtanā | mukhamaṇḍitikā tadvatpūtanā cāndhapūtanā || 190 || revatī caiva saṃkhyātā tathā syācchuṣkarevatī | Dī. tatheti | bālaṃ gṛhṇanti iti bālagrahāḥ | te tu prāyeṇa śaucabhraṃśādinā skandagrahādayo bāleṣvāviśanti | tatparijñānārtha sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ ca vyācaṣṭe | tatra sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ yathā - ‘kṣaṇādudvijate bālaḥ kṣaṇāt trasyati roditi | nakhairdantairdārayati dhātrīmātmānameva ca | ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣate dantān khādet kūjati jṛmbhate | bhruvau kṣipati dantauṣṭhaṃ phenaṃ vamati vāsakṛt | kṣābho'tiniśi jāgarti śūnāṅgo bhinnaviṭsvaraḥ | māṃsaśoṇitagandhiśca na cā'śnāti yathā purā | sāmānyagrahajuṣṭānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ samudāhṛtam’ iti | ete grahāḥ pūjāhetorbālān hiṃsanti | yaduktaṃ carake - ‘dhātrīmātrorātmanaścāparādhācchaucabhraṣṭān maṅgalācārahīnān | kṛtsnān srastān durjanāṃstāḍitāṃśca pūjāhetorhiṃsyurete kumārān’ iti | viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ yathā pratipāditamatraiva | tadvivaraṇamāha - skandagraha iti | skandagraheṇa gṛhīto bālo yathā bhavati tallakṣaṇamāha - ‘ekanetrasya gātrasya srāvaḥ spandanakampanam | ūrdhvadṛṣṭyā nirīkṣeta vakrāsyo raktagandhikaḥ | dantān svādati visraṃstaḥ stanyaṃ naivābhinandati | skandagrahagṛhītānāṃ bālānāṃ cālparodanam’ iti viśākha iti | svagraha iti | svagrahastu skandāpasmāra ityeke tadyathā - ‘naṣṭasaṃjño vamet phenaṃ saṃjñāvānatirodati | pūyaśoṇitagandhitvaṃ skandāpasmāralakṣaṇam’ iti pitṛgrahaḥ | naigameyagraha iti | tadyathā - ‘chardi- spandanakaṇṭhāsyaśoṣamūrcchābhigandhitā | ūrdhvaṃ paśyeddaśeddantānnaigameyaṃ grahaṃ vadet’ iti | śakunīti | śakunī nāma- grahagṛhīto bālopīdṛśo bhavati | yathā ‘srastāṅgo bhayacakito vihaṅgagandhiḥ sāsrāvavraṇapīḍitaḥ samantāt | sphoṭaiścapracitatanuḥ sadāhapākairvijñeyo bhavati śiśuḥ kṣataḥ śakunyā’ iti | vihaṅgagandhirityatra visragandhirityapare | hiraṇyākṣepyuktaṃ - ‘sasrāvadāhapākādyaiścitaḥ sphoṭairbhayānvitaḥ | srastāṅgo visragandhaḥ syācchakunyā pīḍitaḥ śiśuḥ’ iti | śītapūtaneti | vepate kāsate kṣīṇo netrarogo vigandhatā | chardyatīsārayuktaśca śītapūtanayā śiśuḥ’ iti | mukhamaṇḍitiketi | ‘prasannavarṇavadanaḥ śirābhirabhisaṃvṛtaḥ | mūtragandhistu bahvāśī mukhamaṇḍitikāgrahī’ iti | pūtaneti | ‘atīsāro jvarastṛṣṇā tiryakprekṣaṇarodanam | naṣṭanidrastathodvigno grastaḥ pūtanayā śiśuḥ’ iti | andhapūtaneti | ‘chardiḥ kāso jvarastṛṣṇā vasāgandho'tirodanam | stanyadveṣo'tisāraśca andhapūtanayā śiśoḥ’ iti | revatīti | vraṇaiḥ sphoṭaiścitaṃ gātraṃ paṅkagandhaṃ sravedasṛk | bhinnavarcā jvarī dāhī revatīgrahalakṣaṇam’ iti | śuṣkarevatīti ||189||190 || Gū. atha bālagrahasaṃkhyāmāha tathā caraṇabhedāstu vātaraktādikāśca ye || 191 || dvicatvāriṃśaduktāste rogeṣveva munīśvaraiḥ | dviṣaṣṭirdoṣabhedāḥ syuḥ sannipātādikāśca ye || 192|| te'pi rogeṣu gaṇitāḥ pṛthakproktā na te kvacit | Dī. tatheti | caraṇabhedāḥ pādarogāḥ kathitāḥ | te vātaraktapramukhā rogeṣveva boddhavyāḥ | vātaraktādikā ityatrādigrahaṇena pādasuptipādastambhapādaharṣapādasphuṭanaprabhṛtayaḥ | rogeṣviti ślīpadādiṣu || 191 || dviṣaṣṭirdoṣabhedāḥ syuriti | doṣā vātādayaḥ | teṣāṃ bhedā utkarṣādivikalpanādvātenetyucyante | tatra vātādīnāṃ doṣāṇāṃ kṣīṇabhedāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ, tāvanta eva vṛddhānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ bhedāḥ, ekaikavṛddhisamatākṣayaiḥ kṛtvā ṣaḍbhedāḥ, evaṃ kṣīṇavṛddhānāṃ darśitāḥ | ekavṛddhidvandvakṣayeṇa trayo bhedāḥ, dvivṛddhyekakṣayeṇa trayo bhedāḥ, evaṃ dviṣaṣṭirdoṣabhedāḥ kathitāḥ | kecittu doṣāṇāṃ sāmyaṃ bheda ityanena triṣaṣṭirdoṣabhedā bhavanti iti vadanti | tacca sannipātabhedena jñātavyam | taduktam - ‘dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇaiḥ ṣaṭ ca hīnamadhyādhikāśca ṣaṭ | samaścaiko vikārāṇāṃ saṃnipātāt trayodaśa’ iti | tantrāntare'pi yathā - ‘dviṣaṣṭidhā vadantyete bhūyiṣṭhamiti niścayaḥ | tata eva pṛthag doṣā dviśo nava samādhikaiḥ|| trayodaśādhikaikadvisamamadhyolbaṇaistriśaḥ | pañcāśadevaṃ tu saha bhavanti kṣayamāgataiḥ || kṣīṇamadhyādhikakṣīṇakṣīṇavṛddhaistathā'paraiḥ | dvādaśaivaṃ samākhyātāstrayo doṣā dviṣaṣṭidhā’ || te'pīti | te dviṣaṣṭirdoṣabhedā rogeṣu gaṇitāḥ, ataḥ kvacit kutrāpi te na pṛthak proktāḥ | nahyeteṣāṃ dviṣaṣṭibhedānāṃ sarvarogāntargatatvāt pṛthagupādānamiti bhāvaḥ || 192 || Gū. pādarogānāha hīnamithyātiyogena bhedaiḥ pañcadaśoditāḥ || 193 || pañcakarmabhavā rogā rogeṣveva prakīrtitāḥ | snehasvedau tathā dhūmo gaṇḍūṣo'ñjanatarpaṇe || 194 || pīḍā aṣṭādaśaitajjāstāśca rogeṣu lakṣitāḥ | Dī. hīneti | pañcakarmabhavā rogā iti | vamanavirecananirūhānuvāsananasyānīti pañcakarmāṇi | tajjātā rogā rogeṣveva jñātavyāḥ | rogatā ca teṣāṃ hīnamithyātiyogatvādbhavati | etena kimuktam - yadā vamanādikaṃ hīnamithyātiyogena kṛtaṃ tadā rogatvaṃ syāt | taduktam - ‘hīnamithyātiyogena yadā bhavati dehinām | pañcakarma tadā nūnaṃ rogotpattyai ca kevalam’ iti | ata eva pratyekaṃ tribhedena pañcadaśabhedāḥ pūryante || sneha iti | snehādīnāmapi aṣṭādaśa pīḍābhedāḥ kathitāḥ | atrāpi hīnamithyātiyogeti saṃbandhaḥ | tenātrāṣṭādaśabhedāḥ pūryante | pīḍā'tradoṣarūpā | sneho'trasnehapānam | svedaḥ prasiddhaḥ | dhūmo dhūmapānam | gaṇḍūṣaḥ kavalaparyāyaḥ | añjanaṃ netrāñjanam| tarpaṇaṃ dhātutṛptijanakaṃ netrāntastarpaṇaṃ vā | ete tu yadā hīnamithyātiyogadvāreṇa prayuktāstadā rogāya bhavantītyarthaḥ ||193||194|| Gū. pañcakarmajarogasaṃkhyām āha - aṣṭādaśavidhā etajjāḥ pīḍāstā api rogeṣu bhavanti | tā āha - aṣṭādaśavidhā etajāḥ pañcakarmādijāstā api rogeṣu jñeyāḥ | teṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tu snehādivyāpatsu jñeyam || 193 || 194 || śītopadrava ekaḥ syādekaścoṣṇodbhavo mataḥ|| 195|| śalyopadrava ekaśca kṣārāccaikaḥ smṛtastathā | Dī. śītopadrava iti | atiśītena janitaḥ upadravaḥ | atiśītaḥ kālaḥ, atiśīto deśaḥ, atiśītā kriyā ceti | eka uṣṇopatāpa iti | atyuṣṇena janita upatāpa upadrava ityarthaḥ | atrāpi uṣṇakālaḥ, uṣṇo deśaḥ, uṣṇā kriyā ceti | ekaḥ śalyopadrava iti | sarvaśarīrabādhakaṃ śalyam | tacca dvividham - śārīramāgantukaṃ ceti | taduktam -‘śārīrāgantukaṃ caiva dvividhaṃ śalyamucyate’ iti | tatra śārīraṃ romanakhādidhātavo'nnaṃ malā doṣāśca duṣṭāḥ | āgantukamapi śārīraśalyavyatirekeṇa yāvanto bhāvā duḥkhamutpādayanti tadāgantukaṃ, tacca lohaveṇutṛṇaśṛṅgāsthigrāvādikam | ekaḥ kṣāropadrava iti | upadravatā tathetivacanāt | etena kimuktam - sa kṣāro yadā ajñaiḥ prayuktastadā rogāya bhavatīti tātparyārthaḥ | taduktam - ‘viṣāgniśastrāśanimṛtyukalpaḥ kṣāro bhavatyalpamatiprayuktaḥ | sa dhīmatā samyaganuprayukto rogān nihanyādacireṇa ghorān’ iti || 195 || Gū. śītādayaścatvāra upadravasaṃjñā rogāḥ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva kṛtrimaṃ ca tridhā viṣam ||196|| teṣāṃ ca kālakūṭādyairnavadhā sthāvaraṃ viṣam | jaṅgamaṃ bahudhā proktaṃ tatra lūtā bhujaṅgamā: ||197|| vṛścikā mūṣikāḥ kīṭāḥ pratyekaṃ te caturvidhāḥ | 1 - vāgbhaṭasaṃhitāyāṃ tu - ‘saṃsargādrasarudhirādibhistathaiṣāṃ doṣāṃstu kṣayasamatāvivṛddhibhedaiḥ | ānantyaṃ taratamayogataśca yātān jānīyādavahitamānaso yathāsvam ||’ ityanantatvaṃ kathitam | vṛddhikṣayasamarūpā doṣāṇāṃ tridhā gatiḥ | daṃṣṭrāviṣaṃ nakhaviṣaṃ vālaśṛṅgāsthibhistathā || 198 || mūtrātpurīṣācchukrācca dṛṣṭerniśvāsatastathā | lālāyāḥ sparśatastadvattathā śaṅkāviṣaṃ matam || 199 || kṛtrimaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ garadūṣīvibhedataḥ | saptadhātuviṣaṃ jñeyaṃ tathā saptopadhātujam || 20. || tathaivopaviṣebhyaśca jātaṃ saptavidhaṃ matam | duṣṭanīraviṣaṃ caikaṃ tathaikaṃ digdhajaṃ viṣam || 201 || kapikacchūbhavā kaṇḍūrduṣṭanīrabhavā tathā | tathā sūraṇakaṇḍūśca śotho bhallātajastathā || 202|| Dī. viṣabhedānāha – sthāvarajaṅgamakṛtrimaviṣabhedena trividhopadravā iti piṇḍārthaḥ | tatra sthāvaraviṣaṃ yannavadhā kālakūṭaprabhṛtibhiḥ svīkṛtaṃ tadvijñānamāha | yaduktam - ‘kālakūṭo vatsanābhaḥ śṛṅgikaśca pradīpanaḥ | hālāhalo brahmaputro hāridraḥ śaktukastathā || saurāṣṭrika iti proktā viṣabhedā amī nava’ iti | navadhetyatrātiprasiddhatvāt saṃgrahaḥ | keṣāṃcinmate'ṣṭādaśabhedā bhavanti | teṣu daśa jātayastyājyā aṣṭau grāhyā iti | tathāhi - ‘śaktukaṃ mustakaṃ śṛṅgī vālukaṃ sarṣapāhvayam | vatsanābhaṃ kāryamanyaṃ śvetaśṛṅgī tathāṣṭamam | ityaṣṭau yojayedyoge kālakūṭādi varjayet iti | tadyathā - ‘kālakūṭaṃ meṣaśṛṅgī hālāhalaṃ ca darduram | karkaṭaṃ gahvaraṃ granthi hāridraṃ raktaśṛṅgikam’ | keśaraṃ daśamaṃ ceti varjanīyaṃ bhiṣagvaraiḥ’ iti | varjanīyatvameṣāmatyantaduṣṭikaratvāt | niṣiddhe'pi śārṅgadhareṇātra saṃgṛhītaṃ prasiddhatvāt | jaṅgamaṃ bahudhā proktamityādi | jaṅgamaṃ sarpādisaṃbhavaṃ bhavediti sambandhaḥ | tatra lūtā ‘makaḍī’ śabdavācyaḥ kīṭaviśeṣo vā | bhujaṅgamāḥ sarpāste cānekavidhāḥ | vṛścikamūṣikau prasiddhau | kīṭā api nānāvidhā nānākṛtayaśca | teṣāṃ svarūpaṃ na likhitamatra vistarabhayāt | pratyekaṃ te caturvidhā iti te lūtādayaḥ, caturvidhā iti jarāyujāṇḍajasvedajodbhijjāḥ pratyekam, yataḥ caturtho nipatitānām ūṣmāṇaṃ vinā kasyacit siddhirnāsti iti nyāyena sarve bhuvaḥ śarīrasya ca svedājjātāḥ | anye'pi yathā pakṣiṣu balākādayo jarāyujā aṇḍajāśca sarpajātiṣu ahipatākā jarāyujāḥ saṃsvedajeṣvapi kāścit pipīlikā aṇḍajā udbhijāśca ityanena yonisaṃ- karotpattitvāccaturvidhatvam | yadvā vātapittakaphasannipātātmānaste sadṛśaviṣāścaturvidhā bhavantītyeke | tadapi na sarvamataṃ kiṃtu sarvajātaya eva bhavantītyanye | taduktam - ‘vātapittakaphātmāno bhogimaṇḍalarājilāḥ’ ityādi | suśrute tu dvidoṣakopameva caturtham | tathāhi - ‘kopayantyanilaṃ sarpāḥ phaṇinaḥ sarva eva tu | pittaṃ maṇḍalinaścāpi kaphaṃ cānekarājayaḥ | apatyaṃ samavarṇābhyāṃ dvidoṣakaralakṣaṇam’ iti | daṃṣṭrāviṣamityādi | eteṣāṃ madhye keciddaṃṣṭrāntaragataviṣopadravāḥ, kecinnakhaviṣāḥ, kecidbālaśṛṅgāsthiviṣā ityādayo jñātavyāḥ | tathāhi -‘bhaumasarpāṇāṃ daṃṣṭrāviṣam, mārjāramakaravyāghrādayo daṃṣṭrānakhaviṣāḥ | viṣahatāsthimatsyāsthiprabhṛtayo'sthiviṣāḥ | picciṭakauṇḍikādanye mūtrapurīṣaviṣāḥ mūṣikādayaḥ śukraviṣāḥ | divyāḥ sarpāḥ dṛṣṭiniśvāsaviṣāḥ | vṛścikavaraṭyucciṭādayo lālāviṣāḥ | lūtā lālāsparśa viṇmūtraśukramukhasaṃdaṃśaviṣā iti | tathā śaṅkāviṣaṃ matamiti | tathaivoktaprakāreṇaiva śaṅkāviṣamapi upadravakaraṃ bhavati | kṛtrimaṃ dvividhaṃ proktamityādi | kṛtrimaṃ viṣaṃ garadūṣibhedāt dviprakāraṃ kathitam | tantrāntare yathā - garaṃ garalī tacca ‘dināi’ śabdavācyam | yataḥ ‘saubhāgyārthaṃ striyaḥ svedarajonānāṅgajān malān | śatruprayuktāṃśca garān prayacchantyannamiśritān’ ityādi | dūṣīviṣamapi deśakālādidūṣaṇāt kathitam | tadyathā - ‘dūṣitaṃ deśakālānnadivāsvapnairabhīkṣṇaśaḥ | yasmātsaṃdūṣayeddhātūṃstasmāt dūṣīviṣaṃ smṛtam’ iti | eke dvividhamityasya sthāne vividhamiti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca vividhaṃ nānāprakāram, eke dvividhaṃ kṛtrimamanyathā vyākhyānayanti | tadyathā - ‘ekaṃ saviṣāviṣasaṃyogakṛtaṃ kṛtrimaṃ viṣaṃ, aparaṃ nirviṣakṛtaṃ garasaṃjñam | yadāha kāśyapaḥ - ‘saṃyogajaṃ ca dvividhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ viṣamucyate | garaḥ syādaviṣastatra saviṣaṃ kṛtrimaṃ matam’ iti | ata eva carakaḥ rasāyane - ‘daṃṣṭrāviṣe mūlaviṣe sagare kṛtrime viṣe’ iti | dhātavo'tra suvarṇarajatādayaḥ | te yadā aśuddhā bhakṣitāstadā viṣatulyā iti tātparyārthaḥ | yathā viṣādajanakatvādviṣaṃ tathā saptopadhātujaṃ viṣamiti śeṣaḥ | upadhātavo haritālādyāḥ | tathaivopaviṣebhya iti saptavidhaṃ viṣajātaṃ upaviṣamatrārkasehuṇḍaprabhṛtikam | yaduktam - ‘arkasehuṇḍadhatūralāṅgalīkaravīrakaḥ | guñjāhiphena ityetāḥ saptopaviṣajātayaḥ’ iti | duṣṭanīrāṇi vyāpannapānīyāni tañjanitaṃ viṣaṃ viṣādajanakatvāt | tattu bāhyābhyantaraṃ bhavati | bāhyaṃ snānādinā ābhyantaraṃ tu pānādeva | tadyathā - ‘na pibet paṅkaśaivāla- tṛṇaparṇāvilāvṛtam | sūryandupavanādṛṣṭamabhivṛṣṭaṃ ghanaṃ guru | phenilaṃ jantusaṃkīrṇaṃ dantāgrāhyatiśaityataḥ | anārtavaṃ ca yaddivyamārtavaṃ prathamaṃ ca yat | lūtāditantuviṇmūtraviṣamaṃ śleṣmadūṣitam’ iti | tathaikaṃ digdhajaṃ viṣamiti | viṣaliptaṃ śastrādikaṃ digdhaṃ kathitaṃ, tajjanitaṃ viṣam | tena viṣaliptaśastrahato janturdigdhāhataḥ kathitaḥ | kapikacchubhavā kaṇḍūriti | kapikacchū vānarī tasyāḥ phalam tajjanitā kaṇḍūḥ kharjūḥ, iyamapi kaṇḍūrdravyasaṃsargajālpadoṣā na tu kuṣṭhoktā | duṣṭanīrabhavā tatheti | duṣṭanīrāṇi pūrvākhyātāni tajjanitā kaṇḍūrapi duḥkhakarā bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ | tathā sūraṇakaṇḍūśceti | sūraṇaḥ kandaviśeṣaḥ prasiddha eva tenāpi saṃjātā kaṇḍūriti | tathā bhallātajaḥ śotha iti | bhallāto bhallātakaphalāni tatsparśāt śotho duḥkhakaro bhavati | sa ca doṣaśothādbhinna eva || 196-202 || Gū. atha viṣarogasaṃkhyāmāha -- sarvaṃ viṣaṃ sthāvaraṃ, jaṅgamaṃ, kṛtrimamiti trividhaṃ bhavati | teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ madhye navadhā sthāvaraṃ viṣaṃ, tattu kālakūṭādibhedairjñeyam | jaṅgamaṃ tu bahudhā bhavati nidāne tu ṣoḍaśavidham | jaṅgamaṃ tattu latābhujaṅgamādikam | te'pi caturvidhā bhavanti daṃṣṭrāviṃṣādibhedāt | kṛtrimaṃ tu garadūṣībhedataḥ dvividham | atha saptadhātvādibhedena viṣabhedānāha - saptadhātuviṣaṃ svarṇādisaptadhātavaḥ evaṃ saptopadhātujaṃ hīratālādijātam | tathā upaviṣebhyaḥ ahiphenādibhyo jātaṃ saptavidhaṃ bhavati ekaṃ duṣṭanīrajātam | digdhajaṃ viṣadagdhakāṇḍajanyam | atha kapikacchvādibhedena viṣabhedamāha - ekā kapikacchūbhavā tatra kaṇḍūrjāyate, ekā duṣṭanīrabhavā sāpi tadviṣajanyā, ekā sūraṇajanyā kaṇḍūḥ | tathā bhallātajaḥ śothaḥ eteṣāmapi viṣacikitsāsti tadarthaṃ viṣādhikāre gaṇitāḥ || 196-202 || madaścaturvidhaścānyaḥ pūgabhaṅgākṣakodravaiḥ | caturvidho'nyo dravyāṇāṃ phalatvaṅmūlapatrajaḥ ||203|| Dī. anyo madaścatuḥprakāro jñeyaḥ | sa ca pūgabhaṅgākṣakodravaiḥ kṛtvetyarthaḥ | ayamapi āsavāriṣṭādbhinna eva| pūgo'lpamadakaraḥ, bhaṅgā prasiddhā | akṣaṃ vibhītakaphalamajjā madakaratvāt | taduktam - ‘tanmajjā madakārakaḥ’ ityādivacanāt | kodravāṇi madakarāṇi grāhyāṇi | anyo'pi mado dravyāṇāṃ phalatvagmūlapatrajaḥ sāmānyo vi- hitaḥ, phalaṃ khākhasaphalaniryāsaḥ tatphalaṃ jātīphalādi madajanakaṃ gṛhyate| tvaṅmada ityādi | ākallakerimedādi- kānām, irimedo viṭkhadiraḥ | sa eva phalamado'pi gaṇitaḥ | ākallako'pi vakṣyamāṇamūlamadasaṃgṛhītaḥ | mūlamada iti kṣudrabadaryādīnāṃ mūlaṃ madakaratvāt | patramada iti jātipatrikābhaṅgāprabhṛtīnāmiti || 203 || Gū. madaśca viṣatulyo bhavati, so'pi caturvidhastamapyāha - pūgīphalaṃ, bhaṅgā prasiddhā, akṣaṃ vibhītakaṃ, kodravaḥ mādakaḥ, eṣāṃ madaviṣatulyā rogāstu anekadhā bhavanti nānāviṣajanyāstadartham || 203 || iti prasiddhā gaṇitā ye kilopadravā bhuvi | asaṃkhyāścāpare dhātumūlajīvādisaṃbhavāḥ || 204 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānarogagaṇanādhyāyaḥ || Dī. itiśabdaḥ parisamāptau | kila niścayena ye upadravā rogarūpā bhuvi pṛthivyāṃ prasiddhāḥ santi te'tra gaṇitāḥ śārṅgadhareṇeti śeṣaḥ | apare ye'prasiddhāḥ asaṃkhyāśca santi te'pyanumānato jñātavyā ityarthaḥ | te ke ? dhātumūlajīvādisambhavā iti | dhātavaḥ pārthivāste suvarṇarajatamaṇimuktāmanaḥśilāhīratālamṛtkapālādayaḥ | mūlaśabdena sthirā gṛhyante | te'pi caturvidhāḥ vanaspatayo vṛkṣā vīrudha oṣadhaya iti | nanu loke dvaividhyatvena pārthivā api sthāvaraśabdena vācyā:, tatkathamatra pṛthagupādānam ? ucyate - yeṣu vyavahārayogitvaṃ phalamūlādyavayaveṣu rasapradhānatayā, tatraiva caturvidhe vanaspatigaṇe sthāvaraśabdo vartate na tu pārthiveṣvapi, teṣāmāhāreṣu prāyeṇānupayogāt| jīvādisaṃbhavā iti jīvaśabdena jaṅgamā gṛhyante | te'pi caturvidhā bhavanti | te jarāyujāṇḍajasvedajodbhijā ityarthaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt pravātanipātātapachāyājyosnātamaḥśītoṣṇavarṣāprabhṛtayaḥ | ete tvayathāvidhisevanāt du:khakarā ityabhiprāyaḥ||204|| vividhamuninibandhā ye mahatsu prasiddhāḥ sumatiduravabodhāste mayā naiva dṛṣṭāḥ | tadapi gurusakāśādyacchrutaṃ tadvyalekhi hyaḍhamalabhiṣajā'syāṃ bhāvasiṃhātmajena || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ pūrvakhaṇḍe rogagaṇanā'dhyāyaḥ saptamaḥ || Gū. vinayaślokamāha - iti prasiddhā iti | ye prasiddhopadravā bhuvi santi te mayā gaṇitāḥ, apare asaṃkhyā dhātumūlajīvādisambhavāste'pi jñeyāḥ vistarataḥ vistaratvānmayā
